Arkitekten Olof Thunström hämtade idéer: The architect Olof Thunström got ideas for the terraced houses at the Weissenhof Estate exhibition in Stuttgart in 1927. The streets between the rows were named after the mill: Havrevägen, Vetevägen and Rågvägen – Oat, Wheat and Rye Road.
Arkitekten Ralph Erskine, som själv bodd: The architect Ralph Erskine, who lived on Lovön himself, dreamed of a lakeside town on Lake Mälaren at Tappström, and Ekerö centrum is what came of it. The area was finished in 1991, and Erskine was prouder of this project than any other: it works as a complete community, he said in an interview, and that was something he probably hadn't managed anywhere else. Keep an eye out for the centre's landmark, a dot more than twenty metres tall.
Arkitekten Rolf Bergh var med och skapad: The architect Rolf Bergh helped develop the 1960s "studio church", in which the congregation gathers around the altar. The star-shaped interior is crowned by a lantern with a copper-clad dome.
Arkitekten Victor Bodin hämtade inspirat: The architect Victor Bodin drew inspiration from English garden cities. Each terraced house is just 4.5 metres wide and 9.5 metres deep, yet fits three rooms and a kitchen into 90 square metres. The kitchen opened straight out onto the garden.
Arkitekten som aldrig flyttade in: The architect who never moved in
Arkitekten som sa nej till rivning: The architect who said no to demolition
Arkitekten Åke E. Lindqvist lät simhalle: The architect Åke E. Lindqvist let the swimming pool show as a jutting block of raw concrete in the middle of the building. The building has kept its original character and is green-listed by the Stockholm City Museum as being of high heritage value.
Arkitektens fru hade höjdskräck: The architect's wife was afraid of heights
Arkitekterna Bengt Romare och Georg Sche: The architects Bengt Romare and Georg Scherman only came second with their entry 'Nytt och gammalt' ('New and Old'), but they got the job anyway. The museum became an enclosed castle around a large courtyard with a lawn and a pond, intended for staging historical pageants.
Arkitekterna kallade förslaget Prins Ber: The architects called their design the Prince Bertil Arena, but the city didn't want that. In the naming competition that followed, entries weren't allowed to contain personal names, the word "hovet" or the letters å, ä and ö. The result was Stockholm Globe Arena.
Arkitekttävlingen om kommunalhuset gav 4: The architectural competition for the municipal offices drew 43 entries. Sture Frölén won with his proposal "Perhaps", praised for its restrained façades. The war delayed construction, and the building was completed in 1948.
Arkitekttävlingen om kyrkogården vanns a: The design competition for the cemetery was won by the landscape architect Åke Andersson. It opened in June 2003 and was planned for 1,435 coffin graves, 861 urn graves and a memorial grove. There are plans to extend it.
Arkitekturen i bostadsområdet Gretas bac: A short walk from here, on Gamla Stockholmsvägen, is the Gretas backe housing area, whose architecture won Huddinge's building award in 2017 – an award that had only just been launched. It's part of Glömsta, a former noble estate that is now a residential area to the south, east and north of Lake Gömmaren.
Arkiv räddat från slottsbranden: Archives saved from the palace fire
Arkivet grundades i juli 1902 på initiat: The archive was founded in July 1902 at the initiative of Oscar Borge, who was also a distinguished marine biologist. The library was actually ten years older than the archive, but it wasn’t until 2001 that both were officially included in the name.
Arkivet har drygt 5 000 arkiv och tar em: The archive holds just over 5,000 collections and takes in around 100 new ones every year. There are also photographs, posters, films, sound recordings, banners and badges.
Arne Nicklasson bodde på torpet från 191: Arne Nicklasson lived in the cottage from 1917, when he was four, right up until 2001. He fetched his water from the well until 1997, and electricity wasn't brought in until 1990.
Arre Essén ritade en paviljong med resta: Arre Essén designed a pavilion with a restaurant and café for around 500 people, run by AB Feiths kaféer och konditorier. The pavilion was demolished after the exhibition, and no photos or drawings of it have ever been found.
Artillerigården har använts för artiller: Artillerigården, the Artillery Yard, has served the army's gunners since the 1640s, and today it's home to Armémuseum, the Army Museum. Hidden beneath the yard are two air-raid shelters from the Second World War, which are sometimes opened for tours. Round the corner at Artillerigatan 14 was Gastrologik, a Michelin-starred restaurant with no menu – the chefs simply decided what you'd eat. Since 2024 the restaurant ergo has taken over the premises.
Arton höghus på rad: Eighteen tower blocks in a row
Artur Hazelius, som också grundade Skans: Artur Hazelius, who also founded Skansen, went on his first collecting trip in 1872 to save a folk culture he believed was about to vanish. His motto, "Känn dig själv" (Know thyself), is still used as the museum's logo today.
Askarna mitt i bussterminalen: Ash trees in the bus terminal
Askim ligger vid Askimsfjorden, en del a: Askim lies on Askimsfjorden, an arm of the Kattegat, in hilly country where the villas cluster close to the coast. The name is often pronounced 'Ash-im'. In 1975 the built-up area of Askim merged with Gothenburg's, and today the district counts as part of the Gothenburg urban area. Askims torg, the local square, is a short walk away.
Askim omnämns tidigt i ett pastorat med: Askim appears early on as part of a parish group with Fässberg as its mother church. In 1454 the group's only priest was one 'herr Lauritz'. Askim didn't become a parish group of its own until 1953. Today Askim Church, Billdal Church and Mikaelskyrkan all belong to the parish.
Askim uttalas ['aʃim]. Namnet skrevs Ask: Askim is pronounced ['aʃim]. In 1489 the name was written Askym. The ending -hem means a dwelling or farm, while the first part contains the ash tree.
Askim uttalas ”Ashim”, med ett sje-ljud,: Askim is pronounced ‘Ashim’, with a ‘sh’ sound – which tends to catch visitors out. The parish of Askim goes back to the Middle Ages and lies in the southern part of Gothenburg municipality. A short way from here is the coastal area of Skintebo, which was farmland until the early 1970s.
Askims gamla stenkyrka från 1200-talet b: Askim's old 13th-century stone church burned down in the middle of a service on 12 November 1876. The church bells were saved, and a memorial stone now marks where it stood.

On 12 November 1876, Askim's old 13th-century stone church burned down while a service was under way. The bells and some of the furnishings were saved. A memorial stone marks the spot, beside today's Mikaelskyrkan (St Michael's Church).

Askim's old stone church, dating from the 13th century, burnt down in the middle of a service on 12 November 1876. The bells and some of the furnishings were saved. A memorial stone marks the spot, by what is now the north cemetery.
Askims kyrka byggdes 1878–1879 och har e: Askim Church was built in 1878–1879 and is unusually aligned north to south, with the chancel at the southern end and the tower at the northern. Some of its material came from the old church.
Askims kyrka ligger inom promenadavstånd: Askim church is within walking distance. A little further on is Sisjön, a lake in the Sandsjöbacka nature reserve that's good for swimming and fishing, with both perch and pike. Curiously, the municipal border between Gothenburg and Mölndal runs straight through the middle of the lake, and there's a hiking trail all the way round.
Askims kyrka står bara ett par hundra me: Askim Church is just a couple of hundred metres away. It's the parish church for a parish stretching along the coast south of Gothenburg, which became part of Gothenburg municipality in 1974. At the marina in Hovås there's also a sea rescue station. Its first boat, in 1983, was the former pilot boat Alice Olsson.
Askims kyrka, uttalas ”Ashim”, ligger al: Right next door is Askim Church – pronounced 'Ashim'. Its parish is large, almost 37 square kilometres, and in 1974 it became part of Gothenburg municipality. Within the parish lie parts of Billdal, Gundal and Högås, the town of Hovås and, of course, the parish church itself.
Askims norra kyrkogård, bara några minut: Askim's northern cemetery, just a few minutes away, hides an intriguing secret. What's known as the privateer's grave is said to be the resting place of a privateer captain who sailed under Lars Gathenhielm. The cemetery dates back to the Middle Ages, and its older part is enclosed by a stone wall with two lychgates.
Askims skärgård spänner från kala skär,: The Askim archipelago ranges from bare skerries, where lichens thrive on bird droppings, to larger islands. On the Amundö islands close to the shore, people have even farmed, and sessile oak and birch grow in sheltered spots.
Askims socken har vuxit rejält. Den 31 d: Askim parish has grown enormously. On 31 December 1888 it had 1,352 inhabitants; by 2000 the figure had risen to 21,434. The parish belonged to Askim hundred, an old administrative district, and became part of Gothenburg municipality in 1974. The parish church, Askim Church, is a short walk from here – and by the way, the name is pronounced 'Ash-im'.
Askimsbadet öppnade provisoriskt 1927 oc: Askimsbadet opened on a trial basis in 1927 and was run by the city from 1928. It once had changing huts, a first-aid hut and a café, and for many years Doktor Allard's 'bathing children' came here on holiday. In 1965 a 25-metre pool was built for swimming lessons.
Askimsbadet öppnades provisoriskt av Sär: Askimsbadet beach was opened on a trial basis by the Säröbanan railway in 1927, and the city took it over the following year. In its heyday it had changing huts, a first-aid hut, room for 300 tents and 540 little cabins. In winter, the pool built in 1965 doubled as a cold plunge for the sauna.
Aspen lades ner redan efter nio år, i ma: The Aspen cinema closed after just nine years, in May 1961. In the 1970s and 80s the Spårvägen table tennis club took over the premises as a training hall, and J-O Waldner was among the players who trained here regularly.
Asperö är en liten ö i Göteborgs södra s: Asperö is a small island in Gothenburg's southern archipelago with just over four hundred year-round residents. Neighbouring Rivö is uninhabited, but the Asperö islanders' free-roaming sheep and horses graze there among the foundations of huts from the old herring booms and two abandoned graveyards. On Brännö next door lies the songwriter Lasse Dahlquist, in a churchyard whose memorial grove is the smallest in Gothenburg.
Asplund ritade först ett stenkapell, men: Asplund first designed a stone chapel, but it proved too expensive. On his honeymoon in Denmark he visited Liselund, a small 18th-century manor on the island of Møn, and the simple wooden chapel deep in the woods clearly takes after it.

Asplund first designed a stone chapel, but it turned out too expensive. Meanwhile he went on honeymoon to Denmark and visited Liselund, an 18th-century manor on the island of Møn – and the little wooden chapel in the forest clearly bears its stamp.
Asplund, Stadshuset och stjärnhusen: Asplund, City Hall and the star houses
Aspnäskyrkans församling bildades i nove: The Aspnäs Church congregation was founded in November 1974, when 190 people from Järfälla left the Filadelfia Church in Stockholm to build something in their own suburb. The church premises on Hästskovägen opened in autumn 1976.
Aspnässkolan var Järfälla sockens första: Aspnässkolan was the first school in Järfälla parish. It opened in 1846 in a manor house at the Aspnäs crossroads that had once been a roadside tavern. The old school building was pulled down in 1959, but it lives on in a surprising way – today it's a wind shelter at the Ängsjö outdoor recreation centre. Right next door is Aspnäskyrkan, a Pentecostal church.
Aspnässkolan, ett par minuter bort, var: A couple of minutes away is Aspnässkolan, the very first school of Järfälla's own parish. It opened in 1846 in a manor house the parish had bought, a building that had once been a roadside tavern. The oldest schoolhouse was pulled down in 1959, but it lives on in a surprising way – today it's a wind shelter at the Ängsjö outdoor centre. The hospital itself belongs to Region Stockholm, and among other things has a health centre and a pharmacy.
Aspudden började byggas på 1910-talet, o: Aspudden was built from the 1910s onwards, and many of the new homes had no bathroom. That made Aspudden's bathhouse on Schlytersvägen hugely popular, and it stayed open from 1919 all the way until 2009. Even older is Villa Emmalund from 1885, where a farm slaughterhouse – mostly for horses – operated until 1912, when slaughtering at the public abattoirs became compulsory.
Aspudden var från början ett torp under: Aspudden started out as a smallholding under the Hägersten estate, known since 1772. In the 19th century flowers and fruit were grown at Lilla Aspudden, while Stora Aspudden grew tobacco.
Aspuddsparken är en av Stockholms störst: Aspuddsparken is one of Stockholm's biggest staffed playgrounds with animals – perfect if you fancy saying hello to a goat or two. Next door is Aspuddens IP, a sports ground opened in 1913. Locals call it Linnéa, after a villa where the boys who founded the club IF Linnéa used to play football. On Manhemsgatan is the fountain sculpture Fontändamm, created in 1912 by the architect Albin Brag, who also designed several of the area's Art Nouveau buildings.
Astrid Lindgrens berg: Astrid Lindgrens berg, Astrid Lindgren's Hill
Att Mao är med har väckt debatt, och 200: Mao's presence has caused controversy, and in 2006 a motion in the municipal council proposed removing the sculpture. Pye Engström explained: “It was the seventies, and back then Mao had to be in it.”
Att det vuxit skog här mycket länge är o: It's unusual for woodland to have grown here for so long, because for much of its history Hisingen had very few trees. The oldest known document mentioning Rya skog is a drawing by Erik Dahlbergh from 1678.
Att platsen var bebodd redan på järnålde: A runestone shows that people lived here as far back as the Iron Age. It stayed where it was found in eastern Islinge until some way into the 1860s, when it was placed by the farm. In 1943 it was moved to a hillock at Dalängen, where it could be seen better.
Att torka tvätt var svårt, särskilt på v: Drying laundry was hard work, especially in winter. The drying sheds were fitted with hatches all round to regulate the airflow, and these are what give them their distinctive look. On the shore stands an old laundry house that looks as if it's about to slide into the river.
Aula Magna ligger delvis under mark. I n: Aula Magna is partly underground. In the lower foyer you can see exposed bedrock, and the glass façade to the north looks out over the old oaks. On the roof, solar reflectors channel daylight down into the auditorium.
Aula Magnas hörsal har inspirerats av an: The Aula Magna auditorium was inspired by ancient amphitheatres so that 1,194 listeners can hear a speaker without amplification. The steep, sculpted wooden ceiling spreads the sound and prevents echoes.
Aula Medica har en amfiteater för cirka: Aula Medica has an amphitheatre seating around 1,000 people and partly spans Solnavägen. Its facade of triangular glass panels in different colours hides a frame of glulam timber and steel that you can see from inside.
Av Mörby gård finns bara några höga aska: All that's left of Mörby farm is a few tall ash trees, standing right in the middle of the bus terminal in front of the hospital. The farm burnt down on 23 September 1976, just three weeks before its fate was to be decided after a long battle over demolishing it for Norrtäljevägen.
Av Stuvsta gård finns bara arrendatorsbo: All that's left of Stuvsta farm is the tenant's house. The only windmill still standing in Huddinge today is Balingsta mill by Lake Orlången.
Av de äldre inredningarna finns lite kva: Little remains of the older interiors. But the library has a 17th-century grisaille-painted ceiling taken from a house in Gamla stan, the Old Town.
Av det försvunna runstensfragmentet finn: All that survives of the lost runestone fragment is a scrap of text: ‘... raise the stone in memory of Svarthövde ...’. So we don’t know who Svarthövde was or who raised the stone.
Av fragmenten från källarväggen går bara: Only a couple of words can be made out on the fragments from the cellar wall. Translated, they read roughly: "björn … after brother …"
Av geotekniska skäl gick det inte att dr: For geotechnical reasons the tram line couldn't be extended all the way to Rymdtorget, which left a gap of about 400 metres. For the first few years this was bridged by a moving walkway, which was later taken out. A public lift is still there.

Ground conditions made it impossible to run the tramline all the way, so the stop ended up some 400 metres from the square. For the first few years there was a moving walkway, but it had to be taken out. A public lift up to Stjärnbildsgatan remains.
Av geotekniska skäl kunde spårvagnen int: For geotechnical reasons the tram line couldn't be brought all the way to the square, so the stop ended up about 400 metres to the west. For the first few years the gap was bridged by a moving walkway. That's gone now, but a public lift up to Stjärnbildsgatan is still in service.
Av idrottsparken finns bara Tennispavilj: All that's left of the sports ground is the Tennis Pavilion. It had two indoor tennis courts with wooden floors and was moved in 1911 to Fiskartorpsvägen 20, where it still stands today.
Av inskriften går det fortfarande att lä: You can still make out from the inscription that someone, perhaps named Sirhun, had the stone raised. At the end it says that Öpir carved the runes.
Av reservatets 52 hektar utgör Strålsjön: Of the reserve's 52 hectares, Lake Strålsjön makes up only about half a hectare. The aim of the reserve is "to preserve a less common type of habitat".
Av runstenen vid Edsbacka finns bara fot: Only the base of the Edsbacka runestone remains. The inscription names Holmsten and Forkunn, who raised the stone for their father, and ends with the prayer "God help his soul".
Avgörande för skolans tillkomst var dona: The school owed its existence to donations made in 1919, when the consul Johan Ekman and his heirs gave 500,000 kronor. The same amount came that year from the Wilh. Röhss donation fund.
Avknoppningen Virtutech byggde simulator: The spin-off company Virtutech built the Simics simulator, which can run a completely unmodified operating system as if it were a real computer. Since 2010 the company has been owned by Intel.
Avsked med stolar som souvenir: A farewell with seats as souvenirs
Axel Kandell löste den branta tomten gen: Axel Kandell solved the problem of the steep plot by putting the entrances inside the building. From three corridors running right through it, you go up or down to the 32 flats. Each flat has its own 18-square-metre terrace, and the five highest also have a studio.
Axel Wenner-Gren tjänade en förmögenhet: Axel Wenner-Gren made a fortune from vacuum cleaners and fridges. The Nobel laureate Hugo Theorell suggested a centre for visiting researchers, and in 1955 Wenner-Gren donated 8 million kronor. The government chipped in with a free plot.
Axelsbergs torg invigdes 1964 som Axelsb: Axelsbergs torg was opened in 1964 as Axelsbergsplan and got its current name in 1979. Here you'll find a boules court and Osome-Jo, a fountain sculpture by Tommy Widing from 1983.
BK Häcken hyr Gothia Park Academy av ett: BK Häcken rents Gothia Park Academy from a property company. The clubhouse covers 1,300 square metres, and two of the pitches have artificial turf and floodlights.
BK Häcken spelade allsvenskt här på disp: BK Häcken played top-division Allsvenskan matches here under a special exemption, as the ground didn't meet the association's standards. It was demolished in 2014, and Häcken moved temporarily to Gamla Ullevi. By summer 2015 the new Bravida Arena stood on the same spot.
BP började bygga raffinaderiet 1965, i e: BP started building the refinery in 1965, at a time when the company was more or less mass-producing refineries around the world. Princess Alexandra of Kent opened it on 12 September 1967. Since then it has been called both OK Raffinaderi and Preem Raffinaderi.

BP began building the refinery in 1965, at a time when the company was putting up refineries around the world almost on a production line. It was opened on 12 September 1967 by Princess Alexandra of Kent.
BP började bygga raffinaderiet 1965, och: BP began building the refinery in 1965, and on 12 September 1967 it was opened by Princess Alexandra of Kent. It has since been known as OK Raffinaderi and, from 1996, Preemraff Göteborg.
Backa Röd heter hyreshusområdet runt knu: Backa Röd is the rental housing area just round the corner, with 1,500 flats. And no, despite röd meaning red, the name probably has nothing to do with colour. Here it most likely means cleared land – ground that was once cleared for farming. The district has the Backavallens IP sports ground and also Gothenburg's very first neighbourhood sports ground.
Backa kyrka byggdes 1864–1865 efter ritn: Backa Church was built in 1864–1865 to designs by Johan Fredrik Åbom, replacing a medieval church. It was remodelled around 1930, when the tower took on its present shape.
Backa kyrka ritades av Johan Fredrik Åbo: Backa Church was designed by Johan Fredrik Åbom in the Romanesque Revival style and came into use in 1864, though it wasn't consecrated until 1868. The original pointed tower was in poor condition and was replaced in 1927 by today's pyramid-shaped spire.
Backa socken i Bohuslän hörde en gång ti: Backa parish, in the province of Bohuslän, once belonged to the Västra Hising district and was a rural municipality in its own right. In 1948 it became part of the City of Gothenburg, and its old parish church, Backa Church, is a short way from here. The parish covered almost fifteen square kilometres, and by 1988 more than 20,000 people lived here.
Backa socken tillhörde Norge före 1658 o: Backa parish belonged to Norway before 1658 and was hit by several wars. So the Danes built a star-shaped fort by the river, ringed by an earth rampart and a moat. It was called Pulitz skans, and later Fredrikshamns skans.
Backa teater startade 1978 som Skolteate: Backa Teater started in 1978 as Skolteaterensemblen, the School Theatre Ensemble, and spent years playing on various small stages, mostly at Backa Kulturhus – hence the name. In 1989 it moved into an old bolt factory at Backaplan, and since 2007 it has performed at Lindholmen.
Backa, även kallat Hisings Backa, ligger: Backa, also known as Hisings Backa, lies on the east side of Hisingen and stretches from Brunnsbo in the south to Skälltorp in the north. The old Backa parish became part of the City of Gothenburg in 1948. Backa Church, the parish church, is a little way from here, and a bit further on is Selma Lagerlöfs torg, a square named after the famous author.

Backen som doftade kaffe: The hill that smelled of coffee

Backström och Reinius hämtade idéer från: The architects Backström and Reinius borrowed ideas from the USA, with long canopies to stroll under when it rained. In 2008 Gert Wingårdh's K-fem was named the world's best shopping building at the World Architecture Festival.
Backström och Reinius ritade låga gula t: Backström and Reinius designed low yellow-brick buildings with pleated facades and bay windows that catch the light while keeping prying eyes out. The dining room for 150 guests is in the tallest building, with sweeping views over Stockholm and Lake Mälaren.

Badet började i slutet av 1950-talet som: The baths started out in the late 1950s as Hägersten's open-air sun-and-shower bath, with nothing but showers and a toilet block. The pools came later; the largest is 25 metres long and 1–1.4 metres deep. Personnevägen is named after Nils Personne.
Badet har bara öppet på sommaren och har: The pool is only open in summer and has been free to use. A renovation began in 2025 and is due to finish in 2027, after which there will be an entrance fee.
Badet har länge haft fri entré under som: The pool has long been free to use in the summer months. A renovation began in 2025 and is due to finish in 2027, after which there will be an entrance fee.
Badet har tre bassänger: en på 25 meter,: The pool complex has three pools: a 25-metre pool, a shallower 20-metre one and a small nine-sided paddling pool with a slide for the youngest. All around are big lawns, barbecue areas and a boules pitch.
Badet invigdes den 22 juni 1938. Kiosken: The open-air pool opened on 22 June 1938. The kiosk and entrance were given a pared-back functionalist style, and the entrance building survives as an example of Zimdal and Ahrbom's light, airy architecture.

Badhuset byggdes ut 1939 och lockade gäs: The bathhouse was extended in 1939 and drew bathers from all over Stockholm. When the city's leisure committee decided in 2009 to demolish it and build a nursery school, the action group Save Aspuddsbadet occupied the building – until the police stormed it one November morning.
Badkläderna med? En kort promenad bort l: Brought your swimming things? A short walk away is Stora Mölnesjön in eastern Rannebergen, with a bathing spot and jetty on its western side. A little further on is Lilla Mölnesjön, part of the Vättlefjäll Natura 2000 area, and in the other direction the Lärjeån valley nature reserve begins.

Badplatsen vid Rösjön ligger formellt i: The bathing spot on Rösjön is officially in Sollentuna but can only be reached from Skarpäng. That's why it's traditionally called the "Täby side" of Rösjön, or Täbybadet.
Bagare by var förr namnet på Turebergs g: Tureberg farm was once called Bagare by, 'the Baker's Village', and that's where the area gets its name. For many years this was the site of Sollentunamässan, once Sweden's third-largest exhibition centre, until it was demolished in 2017 to make room for housing. Today the area is dominated by Rättscentrum, a justice centre with a police station, district court and remand prison. Running through it all is Malmvägen, known locally as Tian, 'the Ten', after its ten tower blocks – a Million Programme housing project that drew international attention when it opened in 1972.
Bagaregårdsskolan fick smeknamnet Lagår': The children nicknamed Bagaregårdsskolan 'Lagår'n' – the barn. With its broad brown wooden panelling and steep tiled roof, it's easy to see why.
Bagaregårdsskolan stod klar i april 1918: Bagaregårdsskolan, the school designed by Johan Jarlén, was finished in April 1918, with a base of rough grey stone and an elegant little clock tower on the roof. Round the corner was the Saga cinema, which opened in 1942 and closed in 1964. The following year Bengt Johansson bought the building and opened a grocery, Saga hemköp – the first shop in what became the Sagabutikerna chain. From the box office to the checkout, you might say.
Bagarna lät dalkarlar gräva diken och sp: The bakers hired dalkarlar, migrant labourers from Dalarna, to dig ditches and blast through rock to drain the marshland. The water flowed on to Ältasjön and from there to Nacka Ström, where the bakers owned or leased three flour mills.
Bageri och tvätteri i stor skala: Baking and laundry on a grand scale
Bageriet Anderson Bakery byggde 1997 ett: In 1997 Anderson Bakery built an unusual office block on Regulatorvägen with an almost life-size windmill on the roof. Today the bakery is run by Lantmännen Unibake, where 30 staff bake over 100,000 baguettes a day.
Bageriet hade först ett större sortiment: The bakery once had a wider range but now specialises in a single product: gingerbread biscuits. The shop on Sankt Sigfridsgatan still has its original 1940 interior. The bakery used to be on Ingeborgsgatan in Lunden.
Bageriet har fått Gastronomiska Akademie: The bakery has been awarded a diploma by the Gastronomic Academy for 'many years of making unsurpassed gingerbread', and Gourmet magazine has twice named it 'Sweden's best gingerbread bakery'.
Bageriets 40 meter höga silo, där mjölet: The bakery's 40-metre silo, where the flour was stored, rises to 78 metres above sea level and is one of Kvarnholmen's landmarks. The 140-metre-long bakery building got a saw-tooth roof with a long row of roof lanterns that gave the factory indirect light.
Baggeby blev plötsligt slutstation i jun: In June 2023, Baggeby suddenly found itself at the end of the line. The old Lidingö Bridge had been demolished, and construction faults meant the new Lilla Lidingöbron couldn't yet carry trains. So the Lidingöbanan trams turned round here instead of carrying on to Ropsten. Up in the villa suburb of Mosstorp, a short walk away, Hersby water tower stands at the end of Vattentornsvägen.
Baggeby är en av Södra Lidingöbanans urs: Baggeby is one of the original stations on the Södra Lidingöbanan line, opened in January 1914. The little station building dates from the start and is rated as being of "great cultural and historical value". Until the late 1970s a Pressbyrån newsagent's kiosk stood next to it.
Bakom Lisebergs staket en bit härifrån l: Behind the fence of Liseberg, the amusement park, not far from here, is Balders Hage, the spot where the Örgryte IS sports club was founded in 1887 and where a skating rink opened on New Year's Day 1888. Today the Balder roller coaster thunders past nearby – one of the biggest wooden roller coasters in the Nordic countries. And if you fancy a fright, there's Gasten, a haunted hotel where live actors lie in wait to scare visitors.
Bakom Spårfinnargränd i Rågsved har man: Behind Spårfinnargränd in Rågsved, a miniature battle axe has been found from the Battle Axe culture, around 4,500 years ago. It may possibly mark a grave.
Bakom altaret sitter en glasmålning av L: Behind the altar is a stained-glass window by Lars Abrahamsson, showing branches, lush foliage and a red apple. He also designed the altar, whose top is made of limestone from Borghamn in Östergötland. The silver font bowl has a dove on the inside.
Bakom den trekantiga parken döljer sig e: Behind the triangular park lies one of Stockholm's most talked-about unsolved crimes. On 4 May 1932, Lilly Lindeström was found murdered in her flat at Sankt Eriksplan 11 – the case that became known as the Vampire Murder. There are happier memories just round the corner: the Capitol cinema from 1926 closed in 1985 but reopened in 2018 as Bio & Bistro Capitol.
Bakom granitmuren intill parken ligger V: Behind the granite wall next to the park lies Västra kyrkogården, the Western Cemetery, on a slope in what is now the middle of Kungälv. When it was finished in 1864 it was just outside the town, and it was called Nya kyrkogården, the New Cemetery, to set it apart from the old one. Most of the headstones in the northern part date from the early 1900s, while the newer ones are in the south. In other words, the town has grown right past its own graves.
Bakom husen renar Käppalaverket avloppsv: Behind the houses, the Käppala plant, Käppalaverket, has been treating wastewater since 1969, and it's considered one of the most efficient treatment works in the world. Not far away is Käppalaställningen, a Second World War anti-aircraft battery that reopened in 1994 as a memorial to Stockholm's air defence – the only one of its kind in Sweden. A bit further on is M/S Soya III, a tanker built in 1936 to carry soybean oil and now a conference ship.
Bakom hållplatsen ligger Östra Mölna rad: Behind the stop lies the Östra Mölna terraced housing estate, also known as Vita staden, the White Town. The architect Nils Tesch designed its 52 terraced houses and eight villas back in 1954, but they weren't built until 1962 to 1972. The municipality rates the area as irreplaceable for its cultural history. Not far off stands Villa Sjöstigen, designed by Ferdinand Boberg in 1911 as an experiment in affordable summer housing.
Bakom konsthallen ligger en kringbyggd b: Behind the art gallery is an enclosed, blooming garden, and on its far side the Blå porten restaurant. You can eat indoors or out in the garden, and it has its own entrance from Djurgårdsvägen.
Bakom murarna i Härlanda satt fångar frå: Behind the walls at Härlanda, prisoners were locked up from 1907 to 1997. The old central prison is now a listed building and goes by the name Härlanda park. The Saga cinema on Sofiagatan closed in 1964, and the following year it became a grocery shop – Saga Hemköp, the first in the Sagabutikerna chain. Tucked in among the buildings, you'll also find the ruins of an old church.
Bakom namnet Almedal finns ett litet bar: Behind the name Almedal is a little child. The area is named after Alma Buchholtz, who lived only from 1840 to 1841 – the daughter of a former owner of the Almedal country estate. The name lived on in the linen mill that Hans Hemming Wesslau founded by the Mölndalsån river in 1848, Almedahls fabriker. Almedalsvägen has been here since 1933.
Balder invigdes 2003, och redan efter 12: Balder opened in 2003, and after just 120 days of operation a million people had ridden it. It has been voted best wooden roller coaster three times. In 2022 every one of its wooden boards was replaced because of rot.
Balders två tåg är det ena rött och det: Of Balder's two trains, one is red and the other blue – the colours of Örgryte IS, since the club was founded in Balders hage, Balder's meadow. The meadow in turn was named after the god Balder, son of Odin and Frigg.
Balkar från gamla Tranebergsbron: Girders from the old Traneberg bridge
Balltorp kan låta som en modern förort,: Balltorp might sound like a modern suburb – and it's true that it grew mainly in the 1980s. But people were living here as long as 10,000 years ago! The district is in the southern part of Västra Mölndal, which corresponds to the Fässberg district, and a little further on are both Västra and Östra Balltorp – West and East Balltorp.
Banan anlades av Stockholms GK, men när: The course was laid out by Stockholm Golf Club, but when the club was offered the chance to buy the land in 1929, it chose a site at Kevinge farm instead. So in 1933 a new club, Lidingö GK, was formed to take over the course, becoming the 13th member of the Swedish Golf Federation.
Bandhagen och tunnelbanan invigdes samti: Bandhagen and its metro station opened together in 1954, making it one of the first districts to have the metro from the very start. At the station you'll find Linear, a giant folding ruler by the Danish artist Freddy Fraek.
Bandhagen var från början ett torp under: Bandhagen started out as a croft belonging to Örby Castle, mentioned as early as 1677. The cottage burnt down in 1942 and the last barn was demolished in 1961. It stood about 300 metres north-east of today's centre.
Bandhagens centrum invigdes 1954 tillsam: Bandhagen's centre opened in 1954 along with the metro station, and it's still owned by the housing cooperative HSB Bandhagen, with just over 500 flats and around twenty shops. Towering above it is the Murbruket block, an eleven-storey slab block from 1955. The City Museum rates both the building and the whole district as culturally and historically valuable.
Bandhagens gymnasium vid Trollesundsväge: Bandhagens gymnasium, the upper secondary school on Trollesundsvägen, was built between 1957 and 1959, with the assembly hall added ten years later. It housed a range of upper secondary courses until 2002, and in the early 2000s the building was converted into flats. So today people live in the old classrooms – and the City Museum has marked the property green as especially valuable.
Bandyhallen mäter 76 gånger 134 meter. S: The bandy hall measures 76 by 134 metres. The standing terrace along one of the long sides holds almost 2,000 spectators. The ice is also used for speed skating, short track and figure skating.
Bandyhallen är 25 meter hög och mäter 76: The bandy hall is 25 metres high and measures 76 by 134 metres. The stand holds just under 2,000 spectators. The hall is also used for speed skating, short track and figure skating.
Bangården har över 60 spår men saknar he: The rail yard has more than 60 tracks but no train protection system such as ATC at all. Instead, every train movement here is run as shunting, at no more than 30 km/h.
Bankdirektören Knut Agathon Wallenberg d: In 1903 the bank director Knut Agathon Wallenberg donated 100,000 kronor to raise the social standing of the merchant class. The Stockholm School of Economics was first housed in Brunkebergs hotell on Brunkebergs torg, and when it outgrew the space it moved, in 1926, into the building on Sveavägen.
Bankens namn i sju säsonger: A bank's name for seven seasons
Bankhus 90 har en hög, böljande fasad kl: Bankhus 90 has a tall, undulating façade clad in white square clinker tiles facing Ulvsundavägen, and its shape is easy to make out even from the air. On the courtyard side the building breaks up into smaller "pavilions", such as a round dining room in stainless steel.
Bankiren Carl Gustaf Cervin ska ha flytt: The banker Carl Gustaf Cervin is said to have moved the runestone here without permission and against the wishes of the people of Skesta. There's no historical basis for its position on the Viking grave – it was mainly meant to decorate the park.
Bankiren och konstsamlaren Ernest Thiel: In 1905 the banker and art collector Ernest Thiel had Villa Eolskulle built at the very top of the headland, to designs by Ferdinand Boberg. The villa is better known as the Thiel Gallery.
Banmästarbostället från 1859 är den enda: The track master's house from 1859 is the only building left from the railway's early days here. Today it's a summer restaurant called Restaurang Tegelhuset, 'the Brick House'.

Bara ett par hundra meter bort, nära Glö: Just a couple of hundred metres away, near Glömstavägen, is Glömstahällen, a rock carved with runes in the Glömsta valley. Glömsta only became a district in its own right in 2018 – before that it was part of Flemingsberg. Its houses are clustered around Lake Gömmaren, and what was once an area of old holiday cottages is gradually filling up with new homes.
Bara ett par minuter bort ligger en sten: Just a couple of minutes away is a stone house nobody has quite dared to live in: Dvärgahuset, the Dwarf House. It's a stone cist grave from the Late Neolithic, and people once believed it was home to dwarves. It was described in writing as early as the 17th century – and local people surely knew of it long before that. The archaeologist Oscar Montelius examined it in 1899.
Bara ett par minuters promenad härifrån: Just a couple of minutes' walk from here are the ruins of Ytterby's old church. It was built in the 12th century, when this was Norwegian land, and legend says Saint Olaf himself built it. It served as the parish church until 1870. The station on the Bohus line is much younger – it opened in 1907.

Just a couple of minutes' walk from here stands Kälvesta kvarn, a 17th-century windmill also known as Lilla Stampan and Lunda kvarn. The City Museum has blue-listed it – the highest heritage rating there is – for its exceptional cultural and historical value. Not bad for a mill that started out on Observatoriegatan in the city centre.
Bara ett stenkast bort ligger Nilento St: Just a stone's throw away is Nilento Studio, a recording studio founded in 1993 by the musicians Lars Nilsson and Jenny Nilsson. It began life as a mobile studio and is now popular for everything from jazz and big band to choirs, opera and symphony orchestras. Since 2013 they've also run their own record label.
Bara ett stenkast bort står Kummelbysten: Just a stone's throw away stands the Kummelby stone, a runestone carved in the late 11th century – almost a thousand years before the suburb appeared. It's beside Kummelby church, built where Kummelby farm once stood. The first church was so small, with room for only 50 people, that it was nicknamed Kummelby lillkyrka, the Little Church. The new church was consecrated just before Christmas 2000.
Bara ett stenkast bort står Villa Lundin: Just a stone's throw away stands Villa Lundin, built around 1911 and now one of the few well-preserved villas from that era. People often called it 'the Castle', and the Lundin family who lived there are said to have owned one of Fagersjö's two cars in the 1930s. Real luxury in those days!
Bara i Sverige fick omkring 3 000 fartyg: In Sweden alone, around 3,000 vessels were fitted with an Avance engine. Most of the exports went to Russia, where the engines powered motor ploughs. In 1907 the company changed its name from Automobilfabrik to Motorfabrik.
Bara nedre halvan av runstenen finns kva: Only the lower half of the runestone survives. In 1923 a caretaker said he had helped build the quay at Islinge harbour in 1902, and that the top of the stone had been used as fill. Attempts to dig it up in the 1940s came to nothing.
Bara några minuter bort reser sig Tyresö: Just a few minutes away rises Tyresö View, 82 metres and 23 storeys tall – in 2016 the fourth-tallest residential building in the whole of Stockholm County. About as close is Tyresö Centrum, a glass-roofed shopping centre with 74 shops, plus the council offices and a library whose exhibition hall always has something new on show.
Bara några minuters promenad bort väntar: Just a few minutes' walk away is Kärna bokskog, a beech wood that became a nature reserve in 2008. It's a treat for lichen lovers, with several red-listed species, and the plant life includes a rare grass, wood fescue. The reserve covers about 18 hectares and is managed by the West Coast Foundation, and parts of it have been adapted so that everyone can get around.
Bara några steg härifrån porlar Sankt Bo: Just a few steps from here, Saint Botvid's Spring bubbles up – a cold-water spring at the south-eastern tip of Lake Bornsjön. About fifty metres away is the Söderby Stone, a runestone beside the old Södertäljevägen road. And a little further on is the Söderby burial ground, one of the best preserved in the Mälaren Valley, with around 150 visible graves from the early Iron Age, along with the 18th-century farm of Nedre Söderby.

Bara sju år efter Bellman landsteg Johan: Just seven years after Bellman, Johan Fischerström came ashore at Råstock – and painted a very different picture. The building was wretched, he wrote, and the only living creatures he saw were an old woman and a cat.

Bara under 1910 byggdes 15 femvåningshus: In 1910 alone, 15 five-storey blocks went up in Gröndal, all with flushing toilets – a novelty at the time. A one-room flat with kitchen cost 250–300 kronor a year in rent.

Bassängen omgavs från början på två och: Originally the pool was surrounded on two and a half sides by big windows, with a large roof lantern rising above it – about as close to an open-air pool as you could get indoors. Bastun byggdes från september 2014 i en: Work on the sauna began in September 2014 in a public workshop led by Raumlabor Berlin. It stands on a concrete mooring dolphin between Kvillepiren and Norra Frihamnspiren piers and holds 20 people. Bastusjön är liten, bara 0,04 kvadratkil: Bastusjön is small, just 0.04 square kilometres, but 5.9 metres deep. As well as fish, two kinds of mussel live here: the duck mussel and the swan mussel.

Bebyggelsen består mest av radhus – 798: The housing here is mostly terraced – 798 of them – but there are also 328 atrium houses and just 57 detached villas.
Bebyggelsen i Skintebodalen fick Per och: The housing in Skintebodalen won the Per and Alma Olsson Foundation's prize for the best new building in Gothenburg in 1975. In recent years its attractive location has sent property prices soaring.

Beckomberga sjukhus byggdes 1929–1935 ef: Beckomberga Hospital was built in 1929–1935 to designs by Carl Westman, with a clock tower and a large park for 'open-air therapy'. It became one of Europe's largest psychiatric hospitals. Since it closed in 1995, the buildings have been turned into homes.
Beckomberga sjukhus ritades av Carl West: Beckomberga Hospital was designed by Carl Westman and built in 1929–1935 with a symmetrical layout, a clock tower and a large park for open-air therapy. It became one of Europe's largest psychiatric hospitals. Since it closed in 1995, the buildings have been converted into homes.
Beckomberga skulle från 1689 hålla en bå: From 1689, Beckomberga was required to provide a seaman for the navy. The foundations of the old seaman's croft can still be seen in the undergrowth near the school playground. The cottage was moved in 1880 and again around 1955, to Svenskbyvägen in Spånga, behind the Solvalla racecourse.
Befästningen Södra skans byggdes 1643–45: The Södra skans fortification was built in 1643–45 on the hill where Söderstadion stadium now stands. The last wall to be built, from 1859, actually survives – it's now incorporated into one of the new buildings by Söderstadion.
Befästningen på Lilla Billingen skyddade: The fortification on Lilla Billingen guarded the approach to Gothenburg together with the Rya Nabbe redoubt on the other side of the river. Ullmund's battery was built on the low-lying ground between Stora and Lilla Billingen in 1801 or the year after.
Begravningskapellet från 1969 ritades av: The funeral chapel from 1969 was designed by Sven Ivar Lind in dark-fired brick, with four corner windows that cast a beautiful raking light. By the entrance a seven-branched candlestick is etched into the plaster, and a wall bears plaques in memory of the victims of the Holocaust.
Begravningskapellet på Silverdals grifte: At Silverdal Cemetery, the funeral chapel and the crematorium are built together. The whole Gärdestad family is buried here. The cemetery itself was laid out in 1914 as a garrison cemetery for the Stockholm garrison. And the Silverdal area very nearly got a different name: when planning began in 1989, the project was first called Margreteborg.
Begravningsplatsen anlades i början av 1: The cemetery was laid out in the early 1960s together with a crematorium and two chapels, Rosens kapell and Liljans kapell – the Chapel of the Rose and the Chapel of the Lily. It was designed by Gunnar Martinsson and Klas Fåhræus after an architectural competition and covers 17 hectares.
Begravningsplatsen bygger på det vinnand: The cemetery is based on 'Öarna' (The Islands), the winning entry in an international architecture competition in 2009, by Kristine Jensens Tegnestue and Poul Ingemann. Curved timber buildings mark the entrances and exits so that visitors can find their way.
Begravningsplatsen hette först Brännkyrk: The cemetery was first called Brännkyrka New Cemetery. In 1898 it got a red-brick chapel in neo-Gothic style designed by Konrad Elméus, and in 1947 Torsten Nordberg painted a fresco on the altar wall.
Begravningsplatsen invigdes den 9 juni 1: The cemetery was consecrated on 9 June 1827 by the archbishop and hymn writer Johan Olof Wallin, whose speech contained the oft-quoted words: ‘Know ye upon what ground ye stand? Ye stand upon your own graves!’ Twelve years later he was buried on that very spot.
Begravningsplatsen ligger i ett grönområ: The cemetery lies in a green space among pine trees and bilberry bushes, designed by landscape architect Gunnar Martinsson. The burial sections are named after plants, such as Cypressen, Eken and Flädern – the cypress, the oak and the elder.
Begravningsplatsen är cirka 1 100 kvadra: The cemetery covers about 1,100 square metres and was bought in January 1787. It became Stockholm's second Jewish burial ground, after Aronsberg, which had opened eleven years earlier. The cast-iron railings went up in 1905–1906.
Begravningsplatsen, ritad av Gunnar Mart: The cemetery, designed by Gunnar Martinsson, lies among pine trees and bilberry bushes. Its sections have been given plant names such as Cypressen (the Cypress), Eken (the Oak) and Flädern (the Elder).
Bele Barkarby IF har en omfattande idrot: Bele Barkarby IF runs a wide range of sports in Skälby. It's the boyhood club of Johan Mjällby, who played for the Swedish national football team in the 1990s and 2000s.

Berget har två toppar på 55 meter. På de: The hill has two summits, each 55 metres high. On the eastern rock slab stands a red granite memorial stone bearing Astrid Lindgren's signature, along with a copper plaque from the Save Järvafältet Association.
Berget kyrkan står på hette på 1600-tale: In the 1600s the hill the church stands on was called Tysktölskullan or Tistelskullan. The plot itself is known as Sprängkullen, after the quarrying that went on here in the early 1800s.
Berget är byggt i U-form kring en krater: The hill is built in a U shape around a crater known as ‘grytan’ – the pot – which is 100 metres across at the bottom. When it was spruced up in 2019, 70 boxes were put up for birds, bats and butterflies. On a clear day you can see central Stockholm.
Bergets främsta sevärdhet är klappersten: The hill's main attraction is the field of rounded boulders on its southern slope, with old beach ridges and stone "squares". On top grows rocky pine forest carpeted with reindeer lichen and mosses.
Bergets äldsta kända namn är Kråkberget,: The hill's oldest known name is Kråkberget, Crow Hill, recorded in 1668. The name Vita bergen, the White Hills, probably comes from the pale bedrock of what was once a bare hill. On the highest point, 46 metres above sea level, stands Sofia Church, and on the other summit a music pavilion from 1907 shaped like an echo temple.
Bergfabriken stängdes 1987, men interiör: The underground factory closed in 1987, but much of the interior is intact and has been described as a time capsule from the 1950s to the 1970s. A plan to turn it into a car park was shelved.
Berghangaren byggdes 1950–1955 och ligge: The rock hangar was built between 1950 and 1955 and lies almost 30 metres below ground. It's as big as three football pitches, and the whole underground complex covers 22,000 square metres.
Berghällen med U 80 sluttar mot en svack: The rock face bearing runestone U 80 slopes down to a hollow that was probably once a strait – perhaps the one that gave Sundby farm its name. In the mid-1000s the carving sat barely a metre above sea level, clearly visible to passing ships. All that remains of the waterway today are the Spångaån and Bällstaån streams.

Bergrummet består av åtta tunnlar ihoplä: The rock shelter consists of eight tunnels linked by cross-passages, 4,800 square metres in all. It housed a large combat command centre staffed by officers and women of the naval auxiliary, with dormitories, a mess hall and a sick bay, and mines and torpedoes were stored here too.
Bergrummet stängdes 1987 men interiören: The rock shelter closed in 1987, but much of its interior survives intact, a time capsule from the 1950s to the 70s. It's the last remaining example of the great wartime underground factories. In a crisis it could shelter up to 3,000 people.
Bergrummet tömdes på utrustning 1987, me: The rock chamber was stripped of its equipment in 1987, but the interior is largely intact – a time capsule from the 1950s to the 1970s. The owner still keeps the heating and dehumidifiers running, and a plan to turn it into a car park was shelved.
Bergrummet är det sista bevarade av de s: The rock cavern is the last surviving of the large bomb-proof factories from the Second World War. The equipment has been gone since 1987, but the interior is largely intact, a time capsule from the 1950s to the 1970s. A proposal to turn it into a car park was dropped.

Bergshamras tunnelbanestation har en ova: Bergshamra metro station has an unusual design: Bergshamravägen runs over an underground bridge directly on top of the passage between the southern entrance and the platform. The area also has some old houses down by the Stocksundet strait, such as the villa Fjällstugan from 1835 and Stocksundstorp farm, whose buildings probably went up around 1753.
Bergsingenjören Carl Gustaf Dahlerus köp: The mining engineer Carl Gustaf Dahlerus bought the farm in 1889 and built the Islinge Kolförädlingsverk, a charcoal-processing works, at the innermost point of Islingeviken bay – roughly where the tennis courts are today. Bergsjön ligger högt, och från vissa pla: Bergsjön sits high up, and from some spots you can see the island of Vinga at the harbour entrance. Gärdsåstoppen hill, to the south-west, is 130 metres high and can even be seen from the city centre.

Bergslagsbanan fick köpa marken i Huvuds: The Bergslagen railway was allowed to buy the land at Huvudsta from the landowner Max Wibom on condition that a station building was put up here. When Swedish Railways took over in 1945 the line was electrified and the steam engine shed became redundant, but it was kept for emergency preparedness.
Berndt Hellebergs konstverk föreställer: Berndt Helleberg's artwork shows a bird keeping watch over its eggs. The yellow bird flies above Bromma torg, while the eggs – one black, one yellow and one blue – lie scattered around the square. See if you can spot them!

Beslutet att bygga bostäder på åkermarke: The decision to build homes on the Eklanda farmland was taken in 1986. The neighbourhood then grew from Eklanda Hage and Eklanda Skog in the north-west towards Eklanda Vall and Eklanda Äng in the south.

Biblioteket vid Götaplatsen invigdes den: The library on Götaplatsen was opened by Astrid Lindgren on 2 April 1967. Since its renovation, a green-black wall runs right through the building, bearing the words ‘Lorem ipsum’ in Morse code – a work by the artist Kent Karlsson.
Biblioteket öppnade 1964 under namnet Vå: The library opened in 1964 as Vårväderstorgets bibliotek. In 2020 the Swedish Arts Council named it a Romani reading embassy, with a special focus on the Romani minorities and their language. On an ordinary day it gets 700–800 visitors.
Biblioteksbyggnaden från 2004 ritades av: The library building from 2004 was designed by Christer Malmström and won the Kasper Salin Prize, Sweden’s top architecture award, that same year – sharing it with the Museum of World Culture in Gothenburg.
Bifrost byggdes på inägor till Toltorps: Bifrost was built on the infields of Toltorp village, where the last harvest was brought in in 1963. The first blocks of flats were already going up in 1967, and the Fässberg care home was finished in 1970.
Bifrost ligger på det som var inägor til: Bifrost was built on the former fields of Toltorp village, where the last harvest was brought in in 1963. Just a few years later, in 1967, work began on the blocks of flats. The Tegen housing cooperative, formed in 1970–1971, has 477 flats.
Bilaffären som fanns här före köpcentret: The car dealership that stood here before the shopping centre was Philipssons o. Söner AB. The two big car lifts left behind were made by Deve.

Biljetthallen och gångrampen fick år 200: In 2000 the ticket hall and walkway ramp were given Christian Partos's artwork Teleporteringar (Teleportations), in clinker and cement mosaic. The station is 18.6 kilometres from Slussen, and since 2015 its entrance has been in the middle of a new building.
Billdal bjuder på både kyrka, park och h: In Billdal, church, park and sea are all within walking distance. Billdal church is just a couple of hundred metres away, and right beyond it begins Billdals park, a nature area with Billdals gård, the manor house. A little further on, the Killingsholmen peninsula juts out into the sea, with a municipal small-boat harbour and its own boatyard, Killingsholmens Varv.
Billdals kyrka har ytterväggar av falurö: Billdal Church is clad in board-and-batten panelling painted in classic Falu red, and its tower doubles as the roof of the nave. Two of the doors are painted with local Billdal scenes by Helmut Weber.
Billdals park är i dag friluftsområde me: Today Billdal Park is an outdoor recreation area of broadleaf trees, ringed by hills and forest. The Krogabäcken stream meanders through it, and Billdal's riding hall stands right next door.

Billman-Regulator hade tidigare tillverk: Billman-Regulator had previously made its products at some 15 different addresses and could now bring everything together under one roof. The factory was designed by Karl G.H. Karlsson, one of the most sought-after industrial architects of the day, and opened in June 1964 in the presence of Prince Bertil. The office building is now considered of cultural and historical value.
Bilmuseet som levde i sju månader: The car museum that lasted seven months
Bilpremiär i tennishallen: A car premiere in the tennis hall
Bio Capitol vid Skanstorget har visat fi: Bio Capitol on Skanstorget has been screening films since 1941, and since 1999 it has been home to Cinemateket, the film archive's cinema. A stone's throw away was Sprängkullen, an activity centre started in 1974 that became a key meeting place for the progressive music movement and later the punk scene, with plenty of well-known bands taking the stage. And Husargatan is named after the Crown Prince's Hussars, who were once stationed in barracks at the end of the street.
Bio Kaskad lades ner i slutet av 1990-ta: Bio Kaskad closed in the late 1990s but reopened in 2018, kitted out with 120 second-hand seats from the Fontänen cinema in Vällingby. Its name glows in blue neon script above the entrance.
Bio Kaskad, alldeles intill, öppnade 195: Bio Kaskad, the cinema right next door, opened in 1957, closed in the late 1990s and came back to life in 2018. Beneath the square, part of the metro platform runs inside the rock, lined with green, blue and yellow tiles. The cooperative housing block nearby was built in 1952 with 84 small flats for single people and young couples without children, complete with a central kitchen, restaurant and shop in the building.

Under the square, part of the metro platform is set into the rock and lined with green, blue and yellow tiles. The collective housing block nearby was built in 1952 with 84 small flats for single people and young couples without children. And Josephinahemmet is named after Queen Josefina, the wife of Oscar I.

Bio och café under samma tak: Cinema and café under one roof

Biocafé Tellus vid Vattenledningsvägen ä: Biocafé Tellus on Vattenledningsvägen is one of the few old neighbourhood cinemas left in Stockholm, with a café that hosts all kinds of cultural events. A little further away is the Aspen cinema. When it opened in 1952 it was the first privately run cinema to open in Stockholm since 1943, with 300 seats but no balcony.
Biodling var en annan viktig binäring. M: Beekeeping was another important sideline. With its vast heather moors, Lindome produced plenty of heather honey at times – and the name itself means just that: heather and dwelling place.
Biografen Aspen lades ner redan 1961. På: The Aspen cinema closed as early as 1961. In the 1970s and 80s the auditorium became a training hall for the Spårvägen table tennis club, and J-O Waldner was among those who trained here. Since 2019 Aspen has been a cinema again, with two screens, a stage and a bistro.
Biografen Bristol på Sturegatan invigdes: The Bristol cinema on Sturegatan opened on New Year's Eve 1939, when it was owned by Algot Myrgren. Today it's both a cinema and an arts venue. A little further on is Folkets hus, the community hall, built back in 1903, with rooms for meetings, conferences and parties; the main hall holds up to 100 people. And on the nearby Esplanaden you'll find a bust of the town's founder, Anders Petter Löfström.
Biografen Flamman öppnade 1935 med filme: The Flamman cinema opened in 1935 with the film Flickornas Alfred, starring Birgit Tengroth and Sture Lagerwall. The building was put up by Olle Engkvist, who was building Gothenburg's Concert Hall at the same time.
Biografen Forum ritades av Erik och Tore: The Forum cinema was designed by Erik and Tore Ahlsén and seated 600. Its ceiling is a light, white-painted vault suspended from thousands of wires, a construction that gave it superb acoustics. Uno Vallman's large mural survives to this day.
Biografen Forum öppnade den 10 oktober 1: The Forum cinema opened on 10 October 1959 and closed on 30 December 1965. Today the buildings around the square house a library, a health centre, restaurants and a bingo hall, among other things.
Biografen Gnistan hade 435 platser och l: The Gnistan cinema had 435 seats and stood on the corner of Brämaregatan and Tunnbindaregatan. At its opening in 1938, the actor Ludde Gentzel read a prologue written by Fritz Schéel – a compulsory part of any cinema opening at the time.
Biografen Möllan ligger på Göteborgsväge: The Möllan cinema is at Göteborgsvägen 19, in the Folkets hus community centre by the town hall square. Café Möllan is in the same building. In 2013 the cinema received a council grant to modernise and go digital.
Biografen Prisma öppnade den 21 november: The Prisma cinema opened on 21 November 1960 with Let's Make Love, starring Marilyn Monroe. Its name had been chosen in a vote by readers of the local paper Västerort.
The Prisma cinema opened on 21 November 1960 with the premiere of Let's Make Love, starring Marilyn Monroe. Its name had been chosen in a vote by readers of the local paper Västerort.
Biografen Reflexen byggdes av SF och rit: The Reflexen cinema was built by the film company SF and designed by Sverker Feuk. The auditorium had 437 seats, 48 of them so-called courting couches for two, and a 10.5 by 4-metre CinemaScope screen. A red neon sign glowed above the entrance.
Biografen Rex ägdes av Hugo Hansson och: The Rex cinema was owned by Hugo Hansson and stood at what was then Backavägen 75, now Granåsgatan 2. The last screening took place in June 1958.
Biografen Rival invigdes 1937 med en pro: The Rival cinema opened in 1937 with a prologue by the revue star Karl Gerhard, and back then it had 1,218 seats. On 4 July 2008 the film Mamma Mia! had its premiere here. The hotel opened in 2003 as Sweden's first lifestyle hotel.
Biografen Rondo gick i brunt: brun samme: The Rondo cinema was decked out in brown: brown velvet in the foyer, brown walls, a brown curtain and brown wall-to-wall carpet. Only the 436 armchairs were upholstered in green.
Biografen Rondo var brun nästan överallt: The Rondo cinema was brown almost everywhere you looked: the façade, the velvet sofas, the walls and the fitted carpet – only the armchairs were green. The auditorium seated 436. After it closed, the foyer became a pharmacy and the auditorium was turned into shops and flats.
Biografen Roxy öppnade den 15 november 1: The Roxy cinema opened on 15 November 1956, the same month as the library on the square. Its last show was on 28 March 1965.
Biografen Saga på Sofiagatan 2 stängde 1: The Saga cinema at Sofiagatan 2 closed in 1964. The following year Bengt Johansson opened a grocery there, Saga hemköp, which became the first shop in the Sagabutikerna chain.
Biografen Savoy hade 363 platser och stä: The Savoy cinema had 363 seats and closed in the mid-1960s. After that the pop group Hep Stars rehearsed in the space, and their manager Åke Gerhard ran the first studio here.
Biografen Tranan ritades av Sune Lindstr: The Tranan cinema was designed by Sune Lindström for the housing cooperative HSB, and Einar Jolin painted large murals of cranes in the foyer. The name shone in lower-case neon letters. Today the premises are a photo studio, Studio Tranan.
Biografen Vingen på Gamla Björlandavägen: The Vingen cinema at Gamla Björlandavägen 145 had a short but eventful life. It was built and run by Leif Harald Winqvist and opened on 19 December 1957. Rolf Magnusson took it over in 1960, but on 2 January 1962 the lights went out for good. Right next to the stop is Toleredskyrkan, a church in Lundby parish.
Biografen Vågen fanns i centrumet från 1: The Vågen cinema was in the shopping centre from 1969 to 2004. Today's Skärisbiografen is in the former assembly hall of Skärholmen upper secondary school, where the biggest screen seats 150. Among other things it runs film showings for the very youngest, aged 3 to 6.
Biografen blev närbutik: The cinema became a corner shop
Biografen byggdes av politikern Anna Joh: The cinema was built by the politician Anna Johansson-Visborg, a Stockholm city councillor from 1916 to 1950, together with her husband Sven Visborg. In 1952 Svensk Filmindustri took over, and the red SF sign hung on the gable end facing Alviksplan.
Biografen byggdes där Tussmötetorpet låg: The cinema was built on the site of the Tussmötetorpet croft, which gave Tusse-Bio its name. After the last film in 1969 a printing works moved in, and in 2012 the building was converted into owner-occupied flats. The canopy with the name in looping script is gone.
Biografen drivs av Kulturhuset Möllan i: The cinema is run by the Möllan cultural centre in the Folkets hus building by the town hall square. Café Möllan is in the same building, so you can stop for fika – a coffee and a bite – before the show.
Biografen heter officiellt Filmstaden Vä: The cinema is officially called Filmstaden Vällingby, but the neon sign with its old name, Fontänen (the Fountain), is still up – and that's what everyone calls it. The TV4 series Välkommen åter was filmed in the shopping centre in 2010.
Biografen höll i sex år: A cinema that lasted six years
Biografen som blev en kedja: The cinema that became a chain
Biografen som blev kyrka: The cinema that became a church
Biografen som levde i fem år: A cinema that lasted five years
Biografen var ett fristående hus i stram: The cinema was a free-standing building in crisp functionalist style, a contrast to the villas around it. A broad flight of steps led up to the entrance, under a canopy bearing the name Corso in flowing script. After it closed it became a printing works, and since 2012 it has been flats.
Biografen vänder sig främst till barn oc: The cinema is aimed mainly at children and young people aged 5 to 19, but also runs screenings for little ones aged 3 to 6. Every Monday during term time, school classes can see films at a reduced price.

The cinema caters mainly to children and young people aged 5 to 19. There are toddler screenings for 3- to 6-year-olds, film festivals and talks with directors, and young people can get help writing scripts and editing their own films.
Biografen öppnade 2001 och drevs först a: The cinema opened in 2001 and was first run by the American chain AMC. SF struck back by refusing to let AMC show Swedish films and took over the Vågen cinema in Skärholmen. After just two years AMC gave up and sold its screens to SF.

The cinema opened in 2001 and was first run by the American chain AMC. In retaliation, SF refused to distribute Swedish films to AMC and took over the Vågen cinema in Skärholmen instead. AMC gave up after just two years – but since 2017 it has owned the cinema again, having bought Filmstaden's parent company.
Biografens ridå formgavs av konstnären T: The cinema's curtain was designed by the artist Tor Hörlin and showed the view from his studio at Kornhamnstorg. In 2005 the film 165 Hässelby had its world premiere here.
Biograferna har avlöst varandra här. Bio: Cinemas have come and gone around here. Biografteatern on Sveagatan was already showing films in 1904–1908. Mignon on Linnégatan had 182 seats and was open from 1941 to 1982. At Sveaplan there was Klappan, and after it Svea, until 2008. The street is named after the Olivedal estate.

Biokriget i Kungens kurva: The cinema war in Kungens kurva
Biomedicums långa fasader består av omkr: Biomedicum's long façades are made up of some 1,500 shimmering green, angled glass panels that hang like a curtain outside the wall itself. The windows can't be opened. In the central hall, the Atrium, daylight pours in through around forty round skylights.
Bion i den gamla aulan: The cinema in the old assembly hall
Bion som blev teater: The cinema that became a theatre
