Fartyget byggdes på Lövholmsvarvet i Sto: The ship was built at the Lövholmen shipyard in Stockholm. Because it would carry oil, it had to be completely tight, so the hull around the cargo hold was fastened with double rows of rivets.
Fartygsdieslar var på sin tid en svensk: Marine diesel engines were in their day a Swedish product sold worldwide, and they were test-run here. When production in Sickla ended in 1951, the last diesel engine was delivered to Slite.
Fasaden består av triangelformat glas av: The facade is made of triangular panes of eight different kinds of glass, designed to sparkle in the sun. Gert Wingårdh has said his inspiration was Charlotte Perrelli's glittering microphone when she sang 'Hero'. The building is T-shaped.
Fasaden mot Perstorpsvägen är smyckad me: The façade facing Perstorpsvägen is decorated with playful brick motifs. Look out for a sailing boat, a witch, a Christmas goat, a girl skipping and the short poem 'a b c – 1953'.
Fasaden är klädd med vitlackerade glassk: The façade is clad in white-lacquered glass panels, and it's the glass's own blue-green tint that gives the colour. The architect David Helldén wanted the buildings to get darker towards the middle, but the idea had to be dropped for technical reasons.
Fasaderna är klädda i faluröd träpanel,: The façades are clad in Falu red timber panelling, and a vertical north-facing skylight shaped like a shark's fin gives the hall its distinctive look. The roof rests on seven two-metre-high glulam arches.
Fasaderna är klädda i gult tegel. Hallen: The façades are clad in yellow brick. The hall's vaulted roof rests on arches of steel and concrete with a clear span of 48.5 metres, and bands of skylights let in the daylight.
Fasaderna är klädda med lackerade alumin: The facades are clad in lacquered aluminium panels in bright colours chosen by the artist Gert Marcus, so that each group of buildings would have its own identity. The buildings were partly cast as whole tunnels, with walls and floors in a single piece – a method that attracted international attention.
Fascinate målades sommaren 1989 av Circl: Fascinate was painted in summer 1989 by Circle and Tarik Saleh, who were seventeen at the time. The mural was 13 metres wide and 8 metres high, and was done with the property owner's permission – but with no payment for either the work or the paint.
Fascinate var 13 meter bred och 8 meter: Fascinate was 13 metres wide and 8 metres high. It was painted on the outside wall of an industrial building from 1970 – with the owner's permission, but without payment for either the work or the paint.
Fastighetsborgarrådet Walfrid Frank kall: City property commissioner Walfrid Frank called Hagsätra a calm and human-scale centre, where the architects had ‘abandoned the heaven-storming’. He meant that it had no tall building as a landmark, which was common at the time.
Fastighetsdirektören Axel Dahlberg bilda: In 1926 the city's property director Axel Dahlberg set up the Small Cottage Office, which organised self-build housing. The following year work started on 200 small cottages in Olovslund and here in Pungpinan. Today the area is considered a cultural environment of national interest.
Fattigbössorna sitter kvar: The alms boxes are still there
Fattiggård på stadshustomten: A poorhouse on the town hall site
Fattighus blev bank och post: From poorhouse to bank and post office
Fel tåg i mörkret: The wrong train in the dark
Fem SM på samma bana: Five national championships on one track
Fem arkitekters förslag blev för dyra, s: Five architects' proposals turned out too expensive, so the parish premises were delivered ready to assemble by the prefab builders Oresjö of Anneberg. The church itself was designed by Rolf Bergh, with a steep roof, pointed gables and an indoor square known as the kyrkbacken, the church green.
Fem fålar ur Staffansvisan: Five foals from the Staffan song
Fem varianter av samma lek: Five versions of the same game
Ferdinand Boberg älskade uppdraget. Till: Ferdinand Boberg loved the commission. He wrote to his friend Carl Milles that he'd had 'an absolutely insane' amount of fun while the idea took shape – 'days like none before'. He considered it the boldest thing he had ever designed.
Ferdinand Bobergs gasverk byggdes av röt: Ferdinand Boberg’s gasworks was built of red brick from the Haga brickworks outside Enköping. Typical touches are the round-arched windows and the patterned bands of brown and yellow brick beneath the eaves. The plan showed four gasholders in his style, but only two were built.
Ferroamp bygger på en patenterad innovat: Ferroamp is built on a patented innovation that makes better use of three-phase electricity in buildings. The company has around 60 employees and has been listed on the First North exchange since 2019.
Feskekôrka, räkmacka vid vattnet: Feskekôrka fish market – and a prawn sandwich by the water
Feskekörka och Blötaplatsen: The Fish Church and the Wet Square
Festivalen som startade allt: The festival that started it all
Festpaviljongen vid stranden byggdes om: The party pavilion by the shore was rebuilt as a surprise for one of Gustav III's visits – though whether the King ever came here is unclear. Inside stands one of Sweden's tallest tiled stoves, 4.65 metres high.
Festsalen ser i stort sett ut som på Tor: The banqueting hall looks much as it did in Torstenson's day. The centre of the ceiling shows Phaëton driving the sun chariot so close to the earth that sky and land catch fire, painted by the court painter Salomon de la Houve. Torstenson had the same scene painted in his residence in Gothenburg too.
Festvåning i takkupolen: A function room in the dome
Filmen Vinterviken från 1996, efter Mats: The 1996 film Vinterviken, based on Mats Wahl's novel, is partly set at Skärholmen upper secondary school.
Filmerna kom en vecka tidigare: The films came a week earlier
Filmhuset: Filmhuset, home of the Swedish Film Institute
Filminstitutet förvaltar Ingmar Bergmans: The Swedish Film Institute looks after Ingmar Bergman's archive, which has been part of UNESCO's Memory of the World register since 2007. The film archive is one of the oldest in the world, and the library is Sweden's only specialist film library.
Filmstaden Kista har elva salonger i tre: Filmstaden Kista has eleven screens in three sizes, the largest seating 202 people. The cinema is a big part of Kista Galleria, and in summer 2012 the foyer got a complete makeover.
Filmstaden Kista invigdes den 27 novembe: Filmstaden Kista was opened on 27 November 2002 by the actors Josephine Bornebusch and Fares Fares. The cinema has eleven screens, the largest seating 202.
Filmstaden Scandinavia har femton salong: Filmstaden Scandinavia has fifteen screens with a total of 1,860 seats. The IMAX auditorium with its giant screen holds 419 people, and three screens have Dolby Atmos 3D surround sound.
Filmstaden byggdes 1919–1920 på mark där: Filmstaden, the film studio complex, was built in 1919–1920 on land that had once been an ostrich farm – feathered hats were all the rage back then. The architect Ebbe Crone took inspiration from Babelsberg near Berlin, and by area the complex became Europe's largest film studio.

Filmstaden, the film studios, was built in 1919–1920 on the site of a former ostrich farm – a relic of the days when plumed hats were all the rage. At the time it was Europe's largest studio, at least by floor area. The wrought-iron gateway at the entrance is original and appears in many old SF films.

Filmstaden was built in 1919–1920 on land that had once been an ostrich farm – feathered hats were all the rage back then. The site was chosen for peace and quiet away from the noise of the city, and the studio became the largest in Europe by area.
Filmstaden i Råsunda: Filmstaden in Råsunda, the old film studios
Filmstaden är i dag öppen för besök. I P: Filmstaden is open to visitors today. Portvaktsstugan, the porter's lodge, houses a café in 1920s style for a fika (coffee and a bun), and there are restaurants in Backstugan, the old staff canteen, and in the Regissörsvillan, the Director's Villa. In 2024 the European Film Academy named the area a Treasure of European Film Culture.
Filmstjärnor på biodörrarna: Film stars on the cinema doors
Filmstudio i en tennishall: A film studio in a tennis hall
Filmstudio på en strutsfarm: A film studio on an ostrich farm
Finansmannen Allan Abenius grundade 1907: In 1907 the financier Allan Abenius set up a company to turn the land of Brevik farm into 'the white villa town by the shipping lane'. Among those who moved here were the artists Otto Gripensvärd and Klas Fåhraeus.
Finansmannen Ernest Thiel lät Ferdinand: The financier Ernest Thiel commissioned Ferdinand Boberg to design him a villa in the Viennese Art Nouveau style, and since 1924 it has been an art museum, Thielska galleriet – the Thiel Gallery. On its walls you'll find Bruno Liljefors, Ernst Josephson, Carl Larsson, August Strindberg and Anders Zorn, alongside Edvard Munch, Paul Gauguin and Toulouse-Lautrec. Just next to it, on a south-facing slope at Blockhusudden, is Gravitational Ripples by Lea Porsager, the memorial to the victims of the 2004 tsunami.
Finn Malmgrens väg fick sitt namn 1937 o: Finn Malmgrens väg was named in 1937 and is lined with the narrow slab blocks typical of the 1930s and 1940s. By Willy Brandts park it becomes a quiet cul-de-sac.
Finnboda var från början ett torp, och n: Finnboda started life as a croft, and the name is thought to come from its role as a harbour for boats from Finland. In the early 1700s tar was produced here in a pitch works. The works manager's house is the only building left from that time.
Finnboda varv anlades 1874 som filial ti: The Finnboda shipyard was founded in 1874 as an offshoot of the Bergsund yard. Since then the old shipyard has become a mixed neighbourhood. Its old workshops – the joinery, the steam engine shop and the canteen – now house flats, offices and shops. The shipyard workers used to live on the surrounding hills, Finnbodaberget, Skatberget and Finnberget among them.
Finsenljuset kom till Sverige 1902 genom: Finsen light therapy came to Sweden in 1902 through Dr Magnus Möller at St Göran's Hospital, where the home's patients were treated. The home was first based at the Mariedal farm, and in 1932 it got a new building at Stadshagsvägen 5, designed by Karl Güettler.
Fisk, glass och bryggeri: Fish, ice cream and a brewery
Fiskaffär, kemtvätt och post: Fishmonger, dry cleaner and post office
Fiskaren som lurade örlogsmannen: The fisherman who fooled the warship
Fiskebäck är Sveriges största fiskeläge,: Fiskebäck is Sweden's largest fishing village, and several of its fishing families are now shipowners too. The modern fishing harbour was built in the 1950s on land filled out with rubble from demolished buildings in Majorna.
Fiskebäck är stadsdelen där Göteborg möt: Fiskebäck is where Gothenburg meets the sea, by the southern archipelago. The district covers 561 hectares and borders Hinsholmen and Långedrag to the north and Önnered to the south. Its name – 'fish brook' – gives away what once mattered most here, and life by the water still shapes the area today.
Fiskebåten som fann Ulven: The fishing boat that found Ulven
Fiskemuseet i Fiskebäcks hamn drivs i nä: The Fishing Museum in Fiskebäck harbour is run in close partnership between the local homeowners' and heritage association and the museum's own workshop and café. In other words, it's local people who keep the history of fishing alive here.
Fisken provades först: The fish had a trial run
Fiskeön som betalade ett högt pris: The fishing island that paid a high price
Fiskodling blev fågelparadis: From fish farm to bird paradise
Fisksätra kyrka är en del av fredsprojek: Fisksätra Church is part of the peace project Guds hus (House of God), a partnership between Nacka parish, the Catholic parish of St Konrad and the Muslim Association of Fisksätra. The church occupies one part of the building, a mosque is planned for the other, and in the middle is a shared meeting place.
Fisksätra, inklämt mellan Lännerstasunde: Fisksätra, squeezed in between the Lännerstasundet strait and the Nacka forests, is Sweden's most densely populated urban area, with 7,724 people per square kilometre. Lännerstasundet is an arm of the Baltic on the border between the Boo and Nacka districts. Fisksätra is also home to the Toy and Collectors' Museum, a museum devoted entirely to toys and play.
Fisksätras höghus byggdes 1971–1974 med: Fisksätra's tower blocks were built in 1971–1974 under the slogan ‘Det går att gå’ – you can walk it. The street level is closed to cars, which are parked in garages beneath the buildings instead. The atrium houses on Båthöjden were given white brick, black panelling and flat roofs for an international look.
Fittja bro blev klar 1669, byggd av Erik: Fittja Bridge was completed in 1669 by Erik Dahlbergh's fortification troops, the final link in a new southbound highway first planned in 1622. In 1677 Dahlbergh had the site fortified because of its strategic importance.
Fittja moské byggdes 1998–2007 i turkisk: Fittja Mosque was built in the Turkish style between 1998 and 2007. The central dome is panelled in birch, the walls of the prayer hall are covered in hand-painted tiles, and the minaret is 32.5 metres tall.
Fjällbohemmet ritades av Karl Severin Ha: Fjällbohemmet was designed by Karl Severin Hansson and Gerdt Stendahl in the functionalist style. It consisted of light, detached buildings set among planted gardens and opened in December 1939.
Fjällbohemmet ritades i funktionalistisk: Fjällbohemmet was designed in the functionalist style by Karl Severin Hansson and Gerdt Stendahl. By the late 1960s the home's laundry was washing around 500 tonnes of linen a year, and its bakery was turning out some 275,000 kg of bread.
Fjällbohemmets föregångare var stadens f: Fjällbohemmet's forerunners were the city's poorhouses. From 1816 old wooden buildings in Nordstaden known as the Holtermanska barackerna were used, and that's where “Bracka” – the word for the poorhouses – comes from.
Fjällstugan är byggd i trä med spånbeklä: Fjällstugan is built of wood with shingle cladding, and has several projecting sections and roofs pitched at different angles. Inside there's an 18th-century tiled stove that may have come from Gustav III's opera house.
Fjärde kyrkan på platsen: The fourth church on the site
Fjärden mellan Södertörn och Ekerön: The bay between Södertörn and Ekerön
Flamingoparken ovanpå tunnelbanan: Flamingo Park on top of the metro
Flaten has no permanent residents at all. Instead you'll find a nature reserve, a bathing spot, a campsite, minigolf and a disused speedway track for children.
Flatenbadet är stadens största friluftsb: Flatenbadet is the city's biggest outdoor swimming spot, and Stockholm Vatten, the water company, reckons Lake Flaten is the cleanest lake in Stockholm. The buildings were designed by the architect Paul Hedqvist, and the bathing place opened on 23 June 1934. All around it is the Flaten nature reserve, the largest in Stockholm, which even has a racetrack for radio-controlled model cars.
Flemingsbergs industriområde anlades på: Flemingsberg's industrial area was laid out in the 1960s, and Billman-Regulator's factory from the early part of that decade is still standing; the street name Regulatorvägen remembers the electronics firm. Serious culture may be on its way, too: the municipality is planning space for the activities the Royal Swedish Opera and Dramaten, the Royal Dramatic Theatre, currently have in Nacka. This is also home to the Labour Movement Archives and Library, the oldest of its kind in the world.
Flemingsbergs kyrka i brunt tegel ritade: Flemingsberg Church, in brown brick, was designed by Gunnar Cedervall and consecrated in 1976. The foot of the communion chalice echoes the shape of the free-standing bell tower outside the entrance.
Flemingsbergs kyrkas altartavla är skulp: The altarpiece in Flemingsberg church was carved in pine by Per Nilsson-Öst. It shows Jesus on the shore of the Sea of Tiberias while the disciples struggle to haul in nets heavy with fish.
Fler radhuslängor var planerade i Gamla: More rows of terraced houses were planned in Gamla Enskede, but interest was so weak that detached houses were built instead. Terraced housing didn't really take off in Sweden until the 1950s. Today the houses are owned individually, and in 2019 a terraced house on Margaretavägen cost around eight million kronor.
Flera av Säbys torp finns kvar i Järvafä: Several of Säby's crofts survive in the Järvafältet nature reserve. Tånglöt is mentioned as early as 1589, when the crofter was called Mårthen. Granskog, also mentioned in 1589, is now the clubhouse of the Järfälla orienteering club.
Flera av godsets gamla byggnader lever k: Several of the estate's old buildings live on in new roles. The Bergholm croft is now a summer café serving fika (coffee and cake), the old smithy belongs to a market garden, and the statare row – once housing for farmworkers paid in kind – has become terraced houses.
Flera av godsets gamla hus finns kvar. T: Several of the estate’s old buildings survive. The Bergholm croft is now a summer café, the old smithy belongs to a nursery garden, and the farmworkers’ row has been turned into terraced houses. The red granary is counted among Stockholm’s best-preserved 19th-century farm buildings.
Flera fotbollsspelare har vuxit upp här,: Several footballers grew up here, among them David Frölund, Mikael Dyrestam and Carlos Strandberg. The hip-hop artist Sarettii is from Hisings Backa too.
Flera gator i Veddesta är uppkallade eft: Several streets in Veddesta are named after office and invoicing terms: Kontorsvägen (Office Road), Saldovägen (Balance Road), Fakturavägen (Invoice Road) and Girovägen (Giro Road).
Flera gator i trakten har fått sina namn: Several streets in this area are named after a sawmill. Sörensens gata honours the sawmill owner Nils Georg Sörensen, whose company, Säfveåns AB, also lent its name to Hyvelsågsgatan, Klyvsågsgatan and Stabbetorget. On a hill by Stabbetorget stands Björkekärr Church. And a little further on is Queen Silvia Children's Hospital, the biggest children's hospital in Sweden.
Flera kända kulturpersoner har studerat: Several well-known cultural figures studied at Jakobsberg folk high school, among them Cornelis Vreeswijk, Stefan Sundström, Cordelia Edvardson and Bob Hansson. The school was founded in 1919 by Karl Petander, Sweden's first associate professor of economics.
Flera kända personer har anknytning till: Quite a few well-known names have ties to Sävedalen, among them the actor Morgan Alling, the TV presenter Petra Mede, the restaurateur Marcus Samuelsson and the singer Björn Rosenström.

Several well-known people have links to Tuve. Among them are Magnus Wislander, voted the world's best handball player of the 20th century, the journalist and author Lotta Lundgren, and Jonas Olsson of IFK Göteborg.
Flera kända personer kommer från Hjällbo: Several well-known names grew up in Hjällbo, including the singer and actor Jennifer Brown, the singer Javiera Muñoz and the athlete Khaddi Sagnia, who competes in the triple jump and long jump.
Flera människor begravdes i den cirka fy: Several people were buried in the coffin, which was around four metres long. At least one was buried without being cremated first, and another's bones were placed in a clay pot. On top lay the burnt bones of a small child, and the grave goods included flint arrowheads and scrapers.
Flickan hade en riktig förebild: The girl had a real-life model
Flottans arkiv blev kvar i Amiralitetshu: The navy's archives stayed in the Admiralty House when the naval base moved to Karlskrona. When Tre Kronor, the royal castle, burned on 7 May 1697, documents from its archives were brought here.
Flume ride rymmer 1 200 000 liter vatten: The Flume Ride holds 1,200,000 litres of water, and filling it takes about two days. Its 28 log-shaped boats carry 140 people at a time, reaching 60 km/h on the final drop. At least seven staff are always on duty here – more than at any other ride at Liseberg.
Flygambulans och var tionde svensk: Air ambulances and one Swede in ten
Flygeln som kom 90 år senare: The wing that came 90 years late
Flyghamnen hette först Göteborgs Flygham: The airport was first called Göteborgs Flyghamn and had a seaplane harbour too. The plans were ambitious: airships were meant to be able to dock here. When the airfield closed in 1977, it was one of the oldest in Europe with scheduled flights.
Flyghamnen skulle invigas den 4 augusti: The airport was due to open on 4 August 1923, but bad weather put it off by a day. On 5 August Crown Prince Gustav Adolf opened the airfield – the same year Gothenburg celebrated its 300th anniversary with the Jubilee Exhibition.
Flygplatsen öppnade för trafik klockan 1: The airport opened to traffic at 3 pm, and ten minutes later the planes started landing. The very first passenger to arrive at Bromma was Prince Bertil. Also at the opening was the world's largest landplane at the time, a Junkers G-38, in which some passengers sat inside the wings.
Flygtekniska försöksanstalten testade fl: The Aeronautical Research Institute tested aircraft in wind tunnels, which were used extensively when Swedish planes were being designed. The first was built in 1940; the first hypersonic tunnel followed in 1960, and a high-Reynolds-number tunnel in 1990.
Flysta är i huvudsak en villastadsdel, m: Flysta is mostly villas, but it has a small mystery of its own. A Viking Age runestone, known as Uppland runic inscription 70, once stood here. People have searched for it several times without success, and it's probably lost for good. Neighbouring Sundby counts as part of Old Spånga, and its name goes all the way back to 1312.
Flytdockan for till Mexiko: The floating dock went to Mexico
Flöjtspelande ängel kom till under en pe: Flute-Playing Angel was made during a period when Milles produced several angels and divine motifs, such as God's Hand. As well as by Lidingöbron bridge, you'll find it at Millesgården, outside Lagga church in Uppland, in St Louis and in London.
Folk kallade platsen Masthuggstullen eft: People called this spot Masthuggstullen, after a customs house. Later it became Bierhalleplatsen, after an open-air beer garden serving German-style beer, which Johan Albrecht Pripp had started brewing.
Folket röstade fram ett kafé: The people voted for a café
Folket valde gatunamnet: The people chose the street name
Folkets Hus invigdes 1931 och hade biogr: The Folkets Hus community centre opened in 1931 and had a cinema from 1935 to 1960. Not far away was the Saga cinema, which opened on Boxing Day 1939 and closed in 1962. Before the Allum shopping centre was built, Göteborgsvägen was the main shopping street for the whole of Partille.
Folkets hus blev House of Possibilitas: From Folkets hus to House of Possibilitas
Folkets hus invigdes hösten 1931 och had: The Folkets hus, or People's House, opened in the autumn of 1931 and had its own cinema from 1935 to 1960. Close by stood the Saga cinema, which opened on 26 December 1939 and closed in 1962.
Folkets hus rymde förutom biografen med: As well as a 256-seat cinema, the Folkets hus community centre housed a Konsum co-op shop, which closed in 1970. The name 'Park' still glows above the entrance.
Folketshusföreningen bildades 1899, och: The Folkets hus association, which runs the local community hall, was formed in 1899, and the building was opened by the Social Democrat leader Hjalmar Branting. In 1930 the association moved to a bigger building facing Sturegatan with a cinema and theatre, but that was sold in 1999 and the association returned to the old building in the courtyard.
Folkhögskola i en slottsvilla: A folk high school in a castle-like villa
Folkhögskolan från Dalarö: The folk high school from Dalarö
Folkpark med karusell och varmkorv: Carousels and hot dogs in the park
Folkpark med varmkorv: A people's park with hot dogs
Folkparkens hus lever vidare: The folk park's buildings live on
Folksamhuset är 89 meter högt. Fasaderna: The Folksam building is 89 metres tall. Its facades are clad in 7,100 square metres of white Ekeberg marble and blue enamelled panels, and it has 2,800 windows.
Fontändamm ritades av arkitekten Albin B: The fountain pool was designed by the architect Albin Brag, who also designed several buildings in Aspudden. The granite sculpture, in a simple Art Nouveau style, shows a boy half sitting, half leaning against a large rock. Manhem's buildings have ornate gables and bay windows.
Fontändamm är i granit och föreställer e: The granite fountain shows a boy half sitting, half leaning against a large stone. It was paid for by the building firm Manhem, which gave its name to Manhemsgatan; the firm's houses have ornate gables and bay windows in a simple art nouveau style.
Fontänen Elementens kamp: The Elementens kamp fountain, 'the Struggle of the Elements'
Fontänen Tors fiske: Tors fiske, Thor's Fishing, the fountain
Fontänen från invigningsåret: A fountain from the opening year
Fontänen visar ögonblicket då Tor har få: The fountain captures the moment Thor has hooked the Midgard Serpent and raises his hammer, Mjölnir. Two water-spouting prehistoric lizards flank him. Wissler, by the way, wasn't impressed by Versailles: "one has no wish to see it a second time".
Fontänens entréhall har väggar målade me: The entrance hall of the Fontänen cinema has walls painted with abstract figures, and the auditorium is lined with beech panelling. The armchairs were originally upholstered in orange fabric, and there were 502 seats.
Fontänens guldgula och vita neonskylt ha: Fontänen's golden-yellow and white neon sign has shone since 1956 and won the Lysande skylt ('Brilliant Sign') award in 2016. The jury singled out the script lettering, where several lower-case letters are boldly stretched up to the height of the F.
Fordbilarna skeppades hit i delar, nerpa: Ford cars were shipped here in parts, packed in crates, because taxes and duties made it cheaper to assemble them in Sweden. The assembly hall was 150 metres long. Today the building houses offices for 1,500 people.
Formbrädorna syns i betongen: The mould boards show in the concrete
Fornborg och tuffa klätterleder: A hillfort and tough climbing routes
Fornborgen anlades troligen under folkva: The hill fort was probably built during the Migration Period, around AD 500. It was most likely a refuge where local people could flee in times of danger, and inside the wall there was a waterhole for longer stays.
Fornborgen kan ha ingått i en kedja av b: The hillfort may have been part of a chain of beacon hills stretching from Lake Mälaren's inlet at Stockholm all the way to Birka – an early warning system against enemy fleets. Other beacons burned on Vikingaberget and Korpberget.
Fornborgen på vikingaön: The hill fort on the Viking island
Fornborgen som blev vattentorn: The hill fort that became a water tower
Fornfynden som mosaikerna bygger på är p: The archaeological finds behind the mosaics are tiny – in reality the Rinkeby goat is no bigger than a ten-krona coin. Rinkeby lies in one of the richest runestone areas around Stockholm, which is why two runestones also appear as mosaics in the central vault.
Fornnordisk villa och Bobergs: An Old Norse villa and Boberg's
Forsån, en bit härifrån, är en liten å m: Not far from here runs Forsån, a small river with a big job. In just 1.4 kilometres it links Lake Magelungen with Lake Drevviken as part of the Tyresån lake system. It flows mostly at a gentle pace and marks the boundary between the City of Stockholm and Huddinge municipality. North of Drevviken is Orhem, a district made up mostly of countryside in the Flaten nature reserve.
Forsåns hela fallhöjd är 0,7 meter, och: Forsån drops just 0.7 metres in total, almost all of it in the first hundred metres nearest Magelungen. Yet this short river is crossed by bridges carrying the Nynäs railway, Nynäsvägen, Magelungsvägen and three smaller roads.
Fort från första världskriget: A fort from the First World War
Fortet byggdes 1908, och årtalet står på: The fort was built in 1908, and the date is carved on a stone tablet above the entrance. A drawing from 1909 shows positions for five machine guns. It was built at a time when air raids were still unheard of.
Fortet skulle skydda Beatebergspasset me: The fort was meant to guard the Beateberg pass between Lake Magelungen and Lake Drevviken, and was the biggest installation on the Southern Front. It was to be manned by around 3,700 men, mostly reservists over 32 armed with ordinary rifles – this was a time when air raids were unheard of.
Forum användes redan från början till me: Right from the start Forum was used for more than just films – for church services, theatre and school end-of-year ceremonies, among other things. The cinema closed in 1972 and became a Folkets hus community centre, but the back of the auditorium still works as a 210-seat cinema.
Fotbollsplan på torget: A football pitch on the square
Fotbollsplanen ligger på mark som förr h: The football pitch stands on land once known as Söderlingska ängen, Söderling's Meadow, after the organ builder Johan Nikolaus Söderling – the first person to suggest turning Slottsskogen into a park. Majvallen was built as a public relief-work project from 1946 and opened on 5 June 1949, at a cost of just over 327,000 kronor. Today it's where Göteborgs FF, among others, play their home games.

The football pitch lies on land once known as Söderling's Meadow, after the organ builder Johan Nikolaus Söderling, the first person to suggest that Slottsskogen should become a park. Majvallen was built as a relief works project in the 1940s and opened on 5 June 1949, at a cost of just over 327,000 kronor. Since 2009 the pitch has been artificial turf.
Fotbollsproffs från skolbänken: From school desk to pro football
Fotbollsstadion Råsunda fick en smygprem: Råsunda football stadium had a low-key opening in April 1937 with a match between AIK and Malmö FF, and at the time it was Sweden's largest sports venue. King Gustaf V performed the official opening that May, at a match between Sweden and England. Råsunda was the home of the men's national team and AIK's home ground up to and including 2012. Nearby Råsunda IP sports ground had already opened back in 1910, and AIK played some of its matches there too.
Fotbollsstjärnan Lotta Schelin, med 88 m: The football star Lotta Schelin – 88 goals in 185 internationals and many years with Lyon in France – began her career at Kållereds SK. The ice hockey players Magnus Kahnberg and Mikael Johansson also started out at the club.
Football star Lotta Schelin, who scored 88 goals in 185 internationals, began her career at Kållereds SK. From there she moved on to Mölnlycke and FC Göteborg before turning professional with Lyon.

Football star Lotta Schelin, who scored 88 goals in 185 internationals, began her career at Kållereds SK. Ice hockey players Magnus Kahnberg and Mikael Johansson also took their first strides on the ice at the club.
Fotogen och den första elen: Paraffin lamps and the first electricity
Fotogenlampa vid tavlan: A paraffin lamp by the blackboard
Fotö är en liten ö i Göteborgs norra skä: Fotö is a small island in Gothenburg's northern archipelago – just 0.70 square kilometres, yet home to just over six hundred year-round residents. Yew grows here; the islanders call it barlind. There's a swimming spot on the east side and a sheltered harbour on the south side. Climb up to the higher ground on a clear day and you can see all the way to Vinga.
Fotö är en riktig miniatyrvärld: 621 bof: Fotö is a whole world in miniature: 621 permanent residents share just 0.70 square kilometres. On the south side there's a sheltered harbour, and on the east side, a tempting place for a swim. The island is also known for its yew trees – called barlind in the local dialect – and on a clear day you can see all the way to Vinga, the lighthouse island, from the higher rocks.
Fragmenten av U 128 är av sandsten och s: The fragments of runestone U 128 are sandstone and are now fixed to the inside of the church's west wall. The carving isn't signed, but the pattern is one of Öpir's most characteristic. The inscription names Fride and Sigvat and their father.
Fragmentet U 129 är bara 0,60 gånger 0,4: The fragment U 129 measures just 0.60 by 0.48 metres, but part of the inscription can still be read: "Lax had the stone raised in memory of … help the soul." The name of the dead has been lost.
Fram till 1658 tillhörde Backa socken No: Until 1658 the parish of Backa belonged to Norway and was caught up in several wars. So the Danes built a star-shaped fort by the river, ringed by an earth rampart and a moat. It was called Pulitz skans and later Fredrikshamns skans.
Fram till 1797 var Landsvägen en del av: Until 1797 Landsvägen was part of the main road between Stockholm and Drottningholm Palace via Bällsta Bridge. Today it's lined with urban buildings dating from around 1900 to 2014, and since autumn 2013 the Tvärbanan light rail has run along it.
Fram till 1803 sköttes trafiken mellan L: Until 1803, travel between Lidingö and Stockholm relied on rowing ferries between Torsvik and Ropsten. Later there was even a steam ferry with tram tracks that carried the trams across the water to Ropsten.
Fram till 1889 hörde Järva krog till Ulr: Until 1889 Järva krog belonged to the royal estate of Ulriksdal. Ulriksdals Wärdshus mainly served the court staff and estate workers, while Järva krog was meant for travellers on the road. So the two inns complemented each other.
Fram till 1905 var Mariatorget ett salut: Until 1905 Mariatorget was a market square with 32 stalls selling vegetables and fruit – and on certain days livestock too. In autumn 2012 the park gained four sound installations with hidden speakers, playing the sounds of earth, fire, water and air.
Fram till 1920-talet låg Hammarby sjö fy: Until the 1920s Hammarby sjö lay four metres higher than it does today. Along its shore was Sickla Park, the temperance movement's great gathering place, said to outshine Djurgården in beauty. The drained land is now home to Hammarby Sjöstad.
Fram till 1925 lystes skolsalarna bara u: Until 1925 the classrooms were lit only by paraffin lamps, and when it was dark it was barely possible to read. In the 1925 class photo a paraffin lamp hangs in front of the blackboard, but by 1926 an electric light can be seen.
Fram till 1930-talet var Safjället mest: Until the 1930s Safjället was mostly meadow grazed by cows; then trees were planted. Today birch dominates, and a 2.5-kilometre floodlit trail runs through the reserve. Two fields to the east are known as Pettersson's and Olle's meadows.
Fram till 1945 gick gränsen mellan Göteb: Until 1945 this was the boundary between the City of Gothenburg and the rural municipality of Västra Frölunda, and the stop was called Stadsgränsen – “City Limits”. When Frölunda became part of Gothenburg, the stop was renamed Kungssten on 30 October 1945.
Fram till 1945 restes omkring 950 stugor: Up until 1945, around 950 self-built cottages went up here, designed by the architect Edvin Engström. The first was built at Kulstötarvägen 14. In 1937, a 513-square-metre plot cost 198 kronor a year in ground rent.
Fram till 1949 gick Älvsjövägen bara mel: Until 1949, Älvsjövägen only ran between Herr Stens väg and Sjättenovembervägen. That stretch was first called Odenvägen but was renamed Älvsjövägen in 1924.
Until the 1950s, Bollmora was a village. Bollmora farm stood roughly at the junction of Njupkärrsvägen and Industrivägen, where first a petrol station and, since 2014, a supermarket have stood.

Until the 1950s Bollmora was a village. Then came Lex Bollmora in 1959, a change in the law that allowed municipal housing companies to build in other municipalities. Stockholm was short of building land, and the city's companies started building here straight away.
Fram till 1956 hade Skälby en hållplats: Until 1956 Skälby had a stop on the Lövsta line. When the metro reached Hässelby gård it closed to passengers, but rubbish trains nicknamed Silverpilen – the Silver Arrow – kept rolling past right up to 10 September 1970.
Fram till 1960-talet var området nästan: Until the 1960s the area was almost empty. The first to arrive was IKEA, which opened its furniture store on 18 June 1965 – the second the company built in Sweden after the original store in Älmhult.

Until the 1960s the area was almost empty. On 18 June 1965 Ikea opened its second furniture store in Sweden here, after Älmhult. The property was named Kurvan, 'the Curve', and the blocks were then given geometric names such as Diagonalen, Kvadraten and Sekanten.
Fram till 1960-talet var trakten nästan: Until the 1960s the area was almost undeveloped. IKEA opened its store here on 18 June 1965 – the company's second in Sweden after Älmhult. The name Kungens kurva, “the King's Bend”, came from two Esso petrol stations that their owner Tore Jakobson named that way.
Fram till 1968 låg krogbyggnaden Lerkrog: Until 1968 the old tavern building Lerkrogen stood diagonally opposite Brännkyrka Church. It was taken apart and now stands in Solberga.
Fram till 1980 hette tätorten inte Täby: Until 1980 the town wasn't called Täby but Roslags-Näsby. Since 2015 the area has officially been counted as part of the Stockholm urban area.
Fram till 1980-talet kunde man fiska krä: Until the 1980s you could catch crayfish in the lake, but then crayfish plague struck. At Hellasgården there are rocks and jetties for swimming, in winter you can take an icy dip, and when the weather allows, a skating track is ploughed on the ice.
Fram till 1981 fanns här en svängbro frå: Until 1981 there was a swing bridge here from around 1900, replaced by a higher concrete bridge. Beneath the strait runs the water main from the Norsborg waterworks to Stockholm, completed in 1904.
Fram till 1994 hade vägen många trafiklj: Until 1994 the road was full of traffic lights – including one right outside the tunnel. On 1 December 1994 the Hagen and Gnistäng interchanges opened. Today around 55,000 vehicles pass through the tunnel every day.
Fram till 1997 sändes testsignalen för f: Until 1997 the test signal for the air-raid siren, known in Sweden as Viktigt meddelande till allmänheten (Important Message to the Public), was broadcast from here, among other places. After 1998 the facility stood unused for 19 years until the Swedish Armed Forces bought it in 2017.

Until 1997 the test signal for air-raid sirens and the 'Important Message to the Public' alert was broadcast from the command room of the Elefanten bunker. Swedish Radio had a room of its own in the facility.

Until 1997 the test signal for the air-raid siren, known as Viktigt meddelande till allmänheten (Important Message to the Public), was sent from the control room at Vargen, or from Elefanten or premises on Södermalm. The only visible clue above ground is the radio mast on the hill.
Fram till 2005 låg den kända skivbutiken: Until 2005 the well-known record shop Skivhugget stood in the south-east corner of the square. Since 1971 the square has also been home to Erling Torkelsen's sculpture Masterna, The Masts, a nod to the name of the area.
Fram till 2008 var Preem den dominerande: Until 2008 the oil company Preem was the main tenant. During a renovation in 2017–2018 the entrances and stairwells were given marble and new wall colours inspired by the artist Olle Bærtling.
Fram till 2013 var Skagersvägen 22–26, d: Until 2013, Skagersvägen 22–26, where Skagershuset now stands, was a small wood. For a few years there was a temporary building with a preschool at numbers 40–42.
Fram till 2014 hette stationen Vreten, e: Until 2014 the station was called Vreten, after a croft that once stood here. Once the area had been renamed Solna strand, the property owners wanted the station renamed too – and had to pay for the new signs themselves. The change became official on 18 August 2014.
Fram till 2016 låg den stora kapplöpning: Until 2016 the big Täby Galopp racecourse was in Tibble. It closed in favour of Bro Park in Upplands-Bro, and the Täby park housing development is to be built on the site.
Fram till 2016 låg kapplöpningsbanan Täb: Until 2016 the Täby Galopp racecourse was in Tibble. It was replaced by Bro Park, and the Täby park housing area is to be built on the site. On Attundafältet, once a car park, new housing blocks and a new town hall have gone up.
Fram till början av 1900-talet kunde man: Until the early 20th century you could reach the palace grounds from the west along the church avenue. The entrance was closed by a barrier, or bom, and so was known as Cantonbommen. The little Grindstugan lodge was built for the gatekeeper in 1846–1847.
Fram till cirka 500 före Kristus hängde: Until around 500 BC Edsviken was joined to Norrviken. As the land rose, boats had to be hauled across the isthmus, the ed, where a trading place grew up that for a time competed with Stockholm.
Fram till mitten av 1600-talet kallades: Until the mid-1600s the parish was called Thorlandum, meaning Thor's Land. Today Torslanda is best known for Volvo Cars' factory, Torslandaverken.
Fram till oktober 1928 hade ingången til: Until October 1928 the entrance to Slottsskogen park had gates here. That made it a popular meeting spot, and people would say: "Let's meet at the Slottsskogen gates!"
Fram till omkring 1660 var Gamla Stockho: Until around 1660, Gamla Stockholmsvägen was part of Göta landsväg, the highway that ran from Stockholm via Flottsbro and Södertälje to southern Sweden. Ancient remains along the road suggest it is even older than that.
Fram till slutet av 1960-talet fanns run: Until the late 1960s, Ängby torg was ringed by shops including a Konsum co-op, a fishmonger, a dairy shop, an ironmonger and a tobacconist. The name was officially added to the town plan in 2005, which made life easier for the police and fire brigade.
Fram till varvskrisen på 1970-talet låg: Until the shipyard crisis of the 1970s, Hisingen was home to some of the biggest shipyards in the world, such as Götaverken and Eriksberg. The very first Volvo car rolled out of the factory here back in 1927. Since the 1990s, the old shipyard sites have been turned into housing and schools.
Framför GP-huset stod länge en svartpopp: For many years a black poplar stood in front of the GP building, home of the Göteborgs-Posten newspaper, and many older Gothenburgers still remember it. It was felled in the early 1980s, but a cutting from the tree was planted at the paper’s new offices in Backa.
Framför Nidaros fanns en halvrund terras: In front of Nidaros was a semicircular terrace with ornamental cannons and two larger saluting guns pointing out over the water, while two bronzed cement deer stood by the gable. Next to it was a water-lily pond with an arched bridge. The terrace, pond and bridge are all still here.
Framför biblioteket en bit härifrån står: In front of the library nearby stand nine granite animals. This is Fredens rike, the Peaceable Kingdom, a play sculpture by Pye Engström, who lived in the area for a whole month to get to know it. The title comes from the Book of Isaiah and its vision of a kingdom of peace where former enemies live side by side. The animals are carved from black, red and grey granite, and the whole group is made for children to play on.
Framför centrumet anlades 2015 en stadsp: In 2015 a town park with a fountain, trees, public art and a paved square was laid out in front of the shopping centre. It opened in September 2015 during the Tyresö Festival, held here every year.
Framför huvudbyggnaden Sjövillan står åt: In front of the main house, Sjövillan, stand eight lime trees that continue into the park to the east. They were probably planted in the late 1700s. In the late 1800s the yellow wing gained a glazed veranda facing Lake Drevviken.
Framför huvudbyggnaden står bronsskulptu: In front of the main building stands Peter Linde's bronze sculpture Pilt-Carin, put up in 2005. She was a milkmaid on the estate in 1833–1834, and when she sold milk on Stortorget in Gamla stan, crowds gathered just to look at her.
Framför höghuset anlades 2015 en stadspa: In 2015 a town park with a fountain, trees and public art was laid out in front of the tower block. It opened on 6 September 2015 during the Tyresö Festival, which is held in the area every year.
In front of the tower block, a town park with a fountain, trees and public art was laid out in 2015. It opened on 6 September 2015 during the Tyresö Festival, which is held here every year.
Framför kapellets entré ligger en damm m: In front of the chapel entrance is a pond with a little metal ship from 1979, made by the architect Lage Knape and the art blacksmith Gunnar Bengtsson. Inside is a sun cross in Carrara marble echoing the Uppland cross, a pre-Christian symbol later adopted by Christianity.
Framför konsthallen står en rad kolonner: In front of the art gallery stands a row of columns with gilded Ionic capitals. They date from the 1600s and come from the Makalös palace. The building won the Kasper Salin Prize, Sweden's top architecture award, in 1999.
Framför stadshuset står Carl Fagerbergs: In front of the town hall stands Carl Fagerberg's 1933 sculpture group Familjelycka (Family Happiness) – a man, a woman and a small child symbolising the young town of Sundbyberg. The fountain beside it has four bronze reliefs of local industries: Marabou, the Kronan crispbread factory, the Kronan brewery and Sieverts Kabelverk cable works.
Framtiden 1 ritades av Cyrillus Johansso: Framtiden 1 was designed by Cyrillus Johansson. Its facade is of bagged brick in various shades of yellow and red, giving the impression of several houses built together. In the middle are bay-like windows and a gateway into the courtyard.
Fransk gourmet på varvet: French fine dining at the shipyard
Franz Sjöberg fick lämna ifrån sig Stora: Franz Sjöberg had to hand Stora Villan over to his creditors just two years after building it. Since the 1950s no one has lived on the 600-metre-long island all year round, and six families use the houses as holiday homes. Björnholmen still has no mains electricity.
Fred Asp och illern Göran: Fred Asp and Göran the ferret
Fredde Granbergs och Peter Settmans film: Fredde Granberg and Peter Settman's film series about Tratten and Finkel is set in Fruängen, and the TV comedy Tusenbröder was also filmed here.
Fredens rike: Fredens rike, the Kingdom of Peace
Fredrik Magnus Piper ritade 1781 en smal: In 1781 Fredrik Magnus Piper designed a slender viewing pyramid with four balconies, one facing each point of the compass. Louis Jean Desprez wanted a tall Doric column topped by Gustav Vasa instead, from which you could see the park by day and the stars by night.
Fredrik Magnus Åkerman beställde en serv: Fredrik Magnus Åkerman ordered a set of East India porcelain for a punch table. The punch bowl has a purple and gold drapery border and a shield bearing the name Ellsbo. Two pieces are now in the Gothenburg City Museum.
Fredrikshamns skans byggdes 1645 under H: Fredrikshamn fort was built in 1645, in the closing stages of the Hannibal Feud, when Hannibal Sehested tried to attack Gothenburg. It guarded the bridgehead of a temporary bridge that Norwegian troops had thrown across the Göta älv river.
Fredsforskning i kanslihuset: Peace research in the old HQ
Frescati hage vid Brunnsviken hette tidi: Frescati hage, the meadow by Brunnsviken bay, used to be called Norrbrunnshagen, after the Norra Brunn tavern. In 1897 the State Entomological Institute was built here to study insect pests on farms. Down on the shore paddles Brunnsviken Canoe Club, founded in 1909. And a little further away is Södra huset, the university's building complex, sometimes called the Blue Houses because of its sky-blue facade.
Fresk av ett slag 1519: A fresco of a battle in 1519
Fridhems kyrkogård i Backa församling ha: Fridhem Cemetery in Backa parish contains one of the Church of Sweden's three Islamic burial grounds in Gothenburg.
Fridhems kyrkogård är 87 hektar stor. De: Fridhem Cemetery covers 87 hectares. The present chapel was consecrated in 1982 by Bishop Bertil Gärtner.
Fridhems kyrkogård, alldeles intill, rym: Fridhem Cemetery, right next to us, has around 5,627 Christian grave plots. It's also home to one of the Church of Sweden's three Muslim burial grounds in Gothenburg. The cemetery opened in 1968, and until 1982 a mobile church had to serve as its chapel. A little further away is the manor house Bäckebols gård.
Fridhems kyrkogård, en bit härifrån, inv: Fridhem cemetery, a short way from here, opened on 20 November 1968. For fourteen whole years a portable church had to serve as a temporary chapel, until the present chapel was consecrated by Bishop Bertil Gärtner in 1982. The cemetery covers no less than 87 hectares and holds around 5,627 grave plots.
Fridhemsplan är en av Kungsholmens stora: Fridhemsplan is one of Kungsholmen's big hubs, with the metro, buses and shops. In the 16th century, Kungsholmen was known as Munklägret, 'the Monks' Camp', after the monks who owned land here.
Friedländerska kyrkogården i hörnet Litt: The Friedländer cemetery, on the corner of Litteraturgatan and Skälltorpsvägen, has just over twenty graves. It's privately owned and belongs to the Bäckebol estate.

The Friedländer cemetery on the corner of Litteraturgatan and Skälltorpsvägen is privately owned. It belongs to Bäckebol manor, and together with the manor it was listed as a historic building in 1964.
Friedrich Neumüller kom till Stockholm s: Friedrich Neumüller came to Stockholm at 21 and founded Neumüller's Brewery on Södermalm. In 1861 he bought Skarpnäck for 175,000 kronor – a huge sum at the time – and turned the estate into one of the model farms of Södertörn.

Friedrich Neumüller came to Stockholm aged 21 and founded Neumüller's Brewery on Södermalm. In 1861 he bought Skarpnäck for 175,000 kronor, a huge sum at the time, and under his ownership it became one of the model farms of the Södertörn area.
Frihamnen har tre pirar. Från Norra Frih: Frihamnen, the old free port, has three piers. DFDS Seaways ferries to Newcastle once sailed from Norra Frihamnspiren, while the train ferry Stena Scanrail docked at Kvillepiren on its way to Frederikshavn.
Frihamnen invigdes den 31 augusti 1922 a: Crown Prince Gustaf Adolf opened the Free Port on 31 August 1922. It started out with 1,135 metres of quay; today there are 1,937. In 1943 the City of Gothenburg took over all the shares in Göteborgs Frihamns AB, the company that ran it.
Frihamnen var förr en hamn där varor kun: Frihamnen, the Free Port, was once a harbour where goods could be stored without paying customs duty. Now a whole new district is taking shape here. In a moment we'll cross the Göta älv on Hisingsbron, a lift bridge that opened in 2021, replacing the old Götaälvbron.
Frihetens port: Frihetens port, the Gate of Freedom
Friluftsskola för sjuka barn: An open-air school for sick children
Frimurarhemmet, ritat av arkitekten Ludw: Frimurarhemmet, the Freemasons' Home, designed by the architect Ludwig Peterson, is made up of eleven buildings, the first of which was ready in 1912. Elderly Freemasons and their families from all over Sweden could apply to live here, and since 2007 the buildings have belonged to a housing cooperative. Neighbouring Gångsätra, like so much of Lidingö, started out as a farm and is mentioned in writing as early as 1379.
Frimurarna ville göra om skolan: The Freemasons' plan for the school
Fritidshusområdet Kungshättan på östra d: Kungshättan, a holiday-home area on the eastern part of the island of Kungshatt, had no fewer than 87 holiday homes on 30 hectares in 2010. The island has a long history: in 1531 the Crown acquired an outlying plot here, probably then called Serszöön, from the village of Norrby on Lovön. The neighbouring island of Fågelön also lies in the eastern part of Lake Mälaren.
Fructushuset består av en lång fabriksde: The Fructus building has a long single-storey factory section stretching through the block, and a two-storey office wing set crosswise facing Ulvsundavägen. The facades are rendered white with ribbon windows. Today the building houses other businesses.
Fructushuset byggdes 1939–1940 efter rit: The Fructus building, where the soft drink Pommac was made, was built in 1939–1940 to designs by Ture Wennerholm, with white rendered walls and ribbon windows. The long, single-storey factory wing stretches through the whole block. The building is considered of great cultural and historical value, and today it houses other businesses.
The Fructus building was designed by Ture Wennerholm. A long, single-storey factory wing runs through the block, with a two-storey office building set crosswise facing Ulvsundavägen. The facades are white render with ribbon windows. Today the building houses other businesses.
Fruktodling norr om Skåne: The biggest orchard north of Skåne
Fruktträden som blev saft: The fruit trees that became juice
Fruängen blev egen stadsdel den 1 februa: Fruängen became a district in its own right on 1 February 1948, when it was split off from Västberga. Fruängen School was built between 1956 and 1960 to designs by the architect Ture Ryberg, and the City Museum has given it a green listing for its heritage value. Much earlier, around 1650, the croft of Istorp – also known as Komöte – appeared here. It's long since gone.
Fruängens centrum planerades efter ameri: Fruängen's town centre was planned along American lines, with more parking and bigger shops. An eight-storey slab block became its exclamation mark.
Fruängens station ligger 46,8 meter över: Fruängen station lies 46.8 metres above sea level, the highest point on the whole metro network. The station building opened in 1956 but was served by trams until 1964.
Fruängens station är den högst belägna i: Fruängen is the highest station on the entire metro network, at 46.8 metres above sea level. The local church, Vårfrukyrkan – the Church of Our Lady – has an unusual story. The church centre opened in 1963, but the actual sanctuary included in the original plans wasn't started until 2004, and it was finally consecrated on Advent Sunday 2005. A block away is Triangelhuset, the Triangle House, from 1955, named after its unique three-sided floor plan.
Fryshuset startade hösten 1984 i AB Stoc: Fryshuset opened in autumn 1984 in the old premises of AB Stockholms Kylhus, a cold-storage company, at Norra Hammarbyhamnen. The tireless youth leader Anders Carlberg had been asked by the YMCA in Söder to find somewhere young people on Södermalm could play basketball.
Frälsningsarméns skola låg 1958–2006 i L: From 1958 to 2006 the Salvation Army's school was at Lyngsåsa on Dalarö and was called Dalarö folkhögskola, a folk high school. In 2000 the Salvation Army bought the Ågestagården outdoor centre, where the school is now based. The old Ågestagården is today called Strandhus.
Främlingsvägen fick sitt namn 1941 och h: Främlingsvägen ('Stranger's Road') was named in 1941 and belongs to a group of names on the theme of Swedish prehistory and the Middle Ages, along with Vallfartsvägen, Härbärgesvägen and Pilgrimsvägen. The surrounding blocks, by contrast, have plant names such as Akacian, Ormbunken, Murgrönan and Buxbomen – Acacia, Fern, Ivy and Box.
Fräntorp bebyggdes under 1930-talet med: Fräntorp was built up in the 1930s with small prefabricated houses that the future owners put up together. Stone was quarried on the rocky hills of Valåsen and Källeberget from the mid-1800s to the early 1900s, and on the high ground above the motorway there are traces of ancient settlement. Folkets hus, the community hall, stands where the main house of the Fräntorp estate once was.
Från 1419 låg här Horns tegelbruk, mycke: From 1419 this was the site of Horn's brickworks, vital to Stockholm, and later tobacco was grown in the area. Bergsund's engineering works was founded in 1769, and workshops and shipyards remained the main employers until the mid-1900s.
Från 1423 hörde Kvibergsnäs till Nya Löd: From 1423 Kvibergsnäs belonged to Nya Lödöse, the forerunner of Gothenburg, but once Gothenburg was founded it passed to the city and became a landeri – one of the country estates around the town. In 1656 it was held by the burgrave Israel Norfelt.
Från 1600-talet och in på 1900-talet had: From the 17th century well into the 20th, Lindome parish had a thriving furniture industry, best known for the Lindome chair. August Werner's textile mill also stood by the Lindomeån river.
Från 1672 arrenderade hökarna Hindrik Ab: From 1672 two Stockholm hucksters, or petty traders, Hindrik Abrahamsson and Per Mickelsson, leased the land here – probably as pasture for livestock they intended to sell. When the lease was terminated in 1684 the name Hökarängen ("the hucksters' meadow") appears for the first time. The western end of Lake Drevviken was called Sjöänden, a name that later became Sköndal.
Från 1729 drev Bengt Trana och hans hust: From 1729 Bengt Trana and his wife Anna Gertrud ran an inn here. People came to Traneberg's inn by water or by road to "eat well, refresh themselves, dance and make merry". The road along the water is now called Bengt Tranas väg.
Från 1748 arrenderades kvarnen av en rad: From 1748 the mill was leased to a succession of millers, who ground the manor's grain free of charge and handed half of what the farmers paid over to the owners of Hässelby. The millers couldn't write, so they signed their contracts with their house marks.
Från 1790 var torpet ryttartorp åt Livre: From 1790 the croft housed a cavalryman of the Life Regiment Dragoons. The soldiers here took the name Wård or Wårberg, and kept it even when the cavalry were replaced by grenadiers. The post was abolished in 1836.
Från 1794 fanns en optisk telegraf på Gö: From 1794 an optical telegraph on the Gothic Tower sent messages to and from Stockholm Palace, with a relay station at Traneberg. The very first message was a birthday greeting to King Gustav IV Adolf.
Från 1834 var huset sjukhus under kolera: From 1834 the building served as a hospital during the cholera epidemic, and it was seven years before it was considered decontaminated. Later the sanitation department's barracks were here. After demolition plans in the 1970s, the tavern reopened in 1984, and Monica Zetterlund's park was laid out on the cleared land in 2006.
Från 1841 fanns Prins Carls uppfostrings: From 1841 this was the site of Prince Carl's institution for the upbringing of poor children. There were dormitories for 100 boys and workshops for tailors, smiths, shoemakers and carpenters.
Från 1863 gick ångslupen S/S Nackanäs me: From 1863 the steam launch S/S Nackanäs ran between Hammarby sjö and Järlasjön lake, calling at the inn's jetty. When the inn lost its licence to serve spirits in 1913 the passengers vanished, and that same late summer the launch made its last trip through the Sickla canal.
Från 1865 gick hästomnibussar mellan Möl: From 1865, horse-drawn omnibuses ran between Mölndal's Kvarnby and Gothenburg. Kalle Bergman owned the yellow omnibuses Napoleon and Delfinen (the Dolphin) and lived by Mölndalsbro – Bergmansgatan is named after him.
Från 1870-talet blev Arendal en badort d: From the 1870s Arendal became a bathing resort where merchants, shipowners and doctors had summer houses. In the 1890s a golf club and course were set up here – both among the first in Sweden. The course was ploughed up for crops during the First World War.
From the 1870s Arendal became a bathing resort. Wholesale merchants, shipowners and doctors kept summer houses here, and one salt trader's villa is said to have been built from old salt barges.
Från 1870-talet var Arendal en badort me: From the 1870s Arendal was a bathing resort, with summer houses for shipowners, wholesale merchants and an eye doctor. The salt merchant Gustav R. Setterberg is said to have built the first villa here – out of salt barges.
Från 1880-talet kom industrin till Marie: Industry arrived in Mariehäll from the 1880s. Sundbyberg's founder, Anders Petter Löfström, ran a brickworks here, and a hat factory from 1885 was Bromma's biggest business in its day. Around 1900 there was also a cigar factory and an engineering works.
Från 1880-talet till 1935 drev Pixbo her: From the 1880s until 1935 the Pixbo manor ran a market garden, growing fruit and vegetables to sell in Gothenburg. It was watered through pipes from ponds on the hills above, and most of the ponds are still there.
Från 1880-talet till 1935 drev herrgårde: From the 1880s until 1935 the manor ran a market garden supplying Gothenburg with fruit and vegetables, watered from ponds up on the hills. The roads in southern Pixbo are named after the fruit tree varieties that grew in the garden.
Från 1881 till 1936 fanns ett tunnbinder: From 1881 to 1936 Alvik had a cooperage making containers for soap and soft soap – as well as butter tubs and slop barrels. The tower block Alviks Torn, built in 2014, stands exactly where the cooperage once was.
Från 1895 till 1994 marscherade soldater: From 1895 to 1994, soldiers marched across this barracks yard. Today the buildings are listed and house a restaurant, a market and museums. The Sports Museum, Idrottsmuseet, has more than 15,000 objects, and since 2005 it has also held the boxer Ingemar Johansson's collection of trophies. The old horse hospital has been home to a military history museum.
Från 1900 var Gårda namnet på ett eget m: From 1900 Gårda was a self-governing township in its own right. It only became part of Gothenburg in 1923 – the same year the name Gårdavägen was made official.
Från 1904 köpte Stocksunds municipalsamh: From 1904 the township of Stocksund bought electricity from here for its street lighting. Much later the building became a studio, and Utbildningsradion, Sweden's educational broadcaster, was based here from 1978 to 1993.
Från 1905 till 1970 var Järvafältet mili: From 1905 to 1970 Järvafältet was a military training area, covering 5,000 hectares at its largest. Because it was closed to the public until 1962, the old farms survived. A memorial stone tells the story of the military years.
Från 1905 var Järvafältet militärt övnin: From 1905 Järvafältet was a military training ground, and the valley lay unused for a long time. That's why it looks much as it did in the 1800s. In the southern part of the reserve runs the embankment of the once-secret Krutbanan, the 'Gunpowder Line' from the 1940s, now a bridle path.
Från 1905 var gården militär mark. Ballo: From 1905 the estate was military land. The balloon company tested the most advanced reconnaissance method of the day here – balloons – and the army kept a loft for carrier pigeons. Street names such as Ballonggatan, Telegrafgatan, Brevduvegatan and Signalistgatan recall that era.
Från 1909 gick ångsluparna Drefviken I o: From 1909 the steam launches Drefviken I and II plied the lake; the larger was 14 metres long and carried 40 passengers. By 1932 the boats made seven trips a day on weekdays, and the journey from Vendelsö to the station at Länna took 15 minutes. The service ran until 1938.
Från 1910-talet till 1950-talet byggdes: From the 1910s to the 1950s Gröndal built leisure boats, including the well-known Pettersson boats. Today only the Skeppsmyran wooden boat society remains, restoring wooden boats in an old shipyard building protected in the local plan.
Från 1910-talet till 1950-talet fanns en: From the 1910s to the 1950s, this was a busy place for building leisure boats. Today only Träbåtssällskapet Skeppsmyran remains, a wooden boat society that restores boats in a green-listed boatyard building.
Från 1915 låg Skogshögskolan här i hagen: From 1915 the Royal College of Forestry stood here in the meadow. When the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences was formed in 1977, it moved to Umeå and Garpenberg, and in 1982 Stockholm University's psychologists took over the buildings.
Från 1917 arrenderade Nordiska Kompaniet: From 1917 the department store Nordiska Kompaniet (NK) leased Haga Trädgård and looked after the whole of Haga Park. That same year NK built a conservatory – now Stockholm's oldest – and sent flowers to its florist's shop. The city took over in 1937.
Från 1923 gick en privat busslinje från: From 1923 a private bus line ran from Tussmötevägen to Ringvägen on Södermalm, which gave villa building a boost. In 1930 the bus was replaced by tram line 19 between Slussen and Örby.
Från 1928 gick det cirka 850 meter långa: From 1928 the Rastaspåret, a branch line about 850 metres long, ran to the oil harbour at Gåshaga, where Shell had storage tanks. Until 1978 daily freight trains carried oil along the Lidingöbanan line. Talludden stop existed from 1917 to 2013 and was then merged with Gåshaga.
Från 1943 och fram till slutet av 1940-t: From 1943 until the end of the 1940s, 878 småstugor – small, often self-built family cottages – went up in Långbro. The deposit was 300 kronor, and the basement had a wood-fired laundry copper and sauna. To get a cottage you had to have several children, sound finances and 'good conduct'.
Från 1957 var teatern en sidoscen till D: From 1957 the theatre was a secondary stage for Dramaten, the Royal Dramatic Theatre, then an experimental theatre and a student stage for the University College of Opera. Finally it was converted into recording studios for the dubbing company Eurotroll.
Från 1970 gick E3/E4 längs Norra Station: From 1970 the E3/E4 ran along Norra Stationsgatan, which became a notorious bottleneck. It was meant as a temporary solution but lasted around 20 years, until the Norra länken link road opened in 1991.
Från 1970 hölls andakter och söndagsskol: From 1970, services and Sunday school were held in a former grocer's shop. A few years later a portable church from Hjällbo was put up next door and consecrated in 1974. Today's church was consecrated in 1992.
Från 1970 kallade SCB tätorten Nolered,: From 1970, Statistics Sweden called the built-up area Nolered, but in 1980 it switched back to Torslanda. Today it's mostly detached and terraced houses, with plenty of beaches and lots of countryside on western Hisingen.
Från 1970 kallade Statistiska centralbyr: From 1970, Statistics Sweden called the built-up area Nolered. In 1980 it went back to the name Torslanda.
Från 1970-talet köpte kommunen upp elva: From the 1970s the municipality bought up eleven properties on Storholmen and demolished or burned down the summer cottages. When blocks of flats were planned there in the 1990s, the neighbours started the protest movement Save Storön, and the plans were shelved.

From the 1970s onwards the municipality bought up eleven properties on Storholmen and pulled down the cottages. When plans for blocks of flats surfaced in the 1990s, the neighbours launched the protest movement Save Storön, and the plans were shelved.
Från 1971 var arenan orange. Sommaren 20: From 1971 the arena was orange. In summer 2006 it was repainted silver-grey, and with coloured floodlights it can now be lit up in any colour you like.
Från 1983 hade Nacka hembygdsförening fo: From 1983 the Nacka local heritage society ran prehistoric camps here, with reed-thatched huts, blacksmithing, plant dyeing and flint knapping. Around 13,000 schoolchildren took part over the years.
Från 1984 hyrde Aspnäskyrkan Baset och k: Aspnäs Church rented Baset from 1984 and bought it in 1996. Every year there was a Walpurgis Night celebration on 30 April, with a bonfire, a speech to welcome spring and a big firework display, drawing up to a thousand people. In summer there was a café too.
Från 1995 byggdes en ny ostindiefarare p: From 1995, a new East Indiaman was built at Eriksberg. The Götheborg was launched in 2003 and spends the winter at one of the piers. You can walk along the waterfront all the way from Lindholmen to Färjenäs.
Från 2030 ska det gå att byta till tunne: From 2030 you'll be able to change to the metro's blue line at the new Järla station – though you'll have to cross Värmdövägen to get there. It's 4.9 kilometres from Slussen to here.
Från Alby naturreservat går Sörmlandsled: From Alby nature reserve the long-distance Sörmlandsleden trail follows Nyforsvägen down to the rapids. That's one of the entrances to the nature conservation area around Tyresta National Park.

The ferries Nordö III, Ulrika and Linda serve it, and it's the only Swedish Transport Administration ferry route that calls at more than two terminals. Hälsö itself is a small island of just 1.28 square kilometres.

Från Eneby Torg leder vägar till Enebybe: From Eneby Torg, paths lead to Enebyberg farm and on to Rösjön, a lake with bathing jetties by a sandy beach. Once the ice has set, a skating track is ploughed on the lake. The name comes from a boundary cairn on the island of Rösjöholmen.
Från Eneby torg leder Rosenvägen och Ene: From Eneby torg, Rosenvägen and Eneby skogsväg lead down to Lake Rösjön, where there are bathing jetties by a sandy beach. Once the ice has formed, a skating rink is ploughed. The name comes from a boundary cairn on Rösjöholmen.
Från Eneby torg leder Rosenvägen till En: From Eneby torg, Rosenvägen leads to Enebyberg farm, and from there Eneby skogsväg continues to Lake Rösjön, with bathing jetties by a sandy beach. Från Islingeviken på Lidingö gick en ång: A steam ferry with tram tracks ran from Islingeviken on Lidingö. It carried the trams across to Ropsten and on into the city's tram network, on the Ropsten–Norrmalmstorg–Karlberg line. The ferry was in service until around 1914.

Från Klare mosse rinner Osbäcken ner mot: From Klare mosse, the Osbäcken stream runs down towards the Björlanda kile valley. The pool is 6–8 metres deep and about 100 metres across – small, but the source of the stream.
Från Kärrtorp når man ända bort till Nac: Kärrtorp stretches all the way to Nackareservatet, the Nacka nature reserve, in Nacka municipality, so you're never far from the forest. Closer by is the Reflexen cinema, showing films since 1961, and Kärrtorpshallen, the sports hall from the early 1960s designed by Kjell Ödeen and given a green listing for its heritage value by the City Museum. Kärrtorp Park only got its current name in 2009, but in its southern part stands the old croft that gave the district its name.

Från Lilla Erstagatan leder Ersta trappo: From Lilla Erstagatan, Ersta trappor lead down towards Stigbergsparken and Folkungagatan – a broad stone staircase in three flights, named in 1968.
Från Lumabryggan går Hammarbyfärjan över: From the Luma jetty the Hammarby ferry crosses to Södermalm. In the summer months you can also catch a boat from here to Djurgården and Nybroplan.

Från Ropsten går Lidingöbanan över Lidin: From Ropsten, the Lidingöbanan line runs across the Lidingö Bridge out to Lidingö. The bridge opened in 1925, and for many years it was the only road link to the island.

Från Spånga station byggdes Spånga–Lövst: From Spånga station the Spånga–Lövsta railway was built, and its trains were known as Silverpilen, the Silver Arrow. Specially built wagons carried rubbish and night soil out of Stockholm. The first train ran in the autumn of 1889.

Från Tappström går pendelbåten linje 89: From Tappström, commuter boat 89 runs all the way into Stockholm, to Stadshuskajen by the City Hall, with boats such as M/S Lux. Tappström, the channel that marks the boundary between the islands of Lovön and Ekerön, also has a guest harbour for visiting boats. A little further off stood the Tappsund brickworks, which opened in the late 1800s and closed down in 1959.

Från bronsåldern finns spridda gravrösen: Scattered Bronze Age cairns survive in the parish, and from the Iron Age there are no fewer than 35 burial grounds and a hillfort. Six runic inscriptions have been found in all. The parish is first mentioned in 1289 as Logö; no one knows what the name means.
Från båten ser du Saltsjöqvarn, den stor: From the boat you'll see Saltsjöqvarn, the big mill by the shipping lane. Built in 1888–1890, it kept grinding until the late 1980s and now houses flats and a hotel.
Från början av 1700-talet låg här ett da: From the early 18th century this was a labour-service croft under the Näsby manorial estate. The name comes from a gate (grind) on the road between Näsby and Tibble that marked the boundary. The croft became a pig farm in 1926 and was demolished when the new houses were built.

From the early 1700s a croft stood here whose tenants paid their rent in labour on the Näsby estate. The name comes from a grind, a gate on the road between Näsby and Tibble that marked the boundary between the estate and the farm. In 1926 the croft was bought out and became a pig farm.
Från början bakade bageriet fler sorter,: The bakery used to make more varieties, but over time it decided to concentrate on gingersnaps alone. Before it ended up here, it was on Ingeborgsgatan in the Lunden district.
Från början gick färjan till Öckerö, men: The ferry originally ran to Öckerö, but in 1981 the terminal moved to Hönö. Today each ferry takes 75 cars, and the route can manage a departure every ten minutes.
Från början hade båda husen strandtomt n: Both houses originally had plots running down to the lake shore, but that link was cut when a lakeside promenade was built in the 1980s. The cowshed and stables were torn down for houses, and the granary with its pyramid roof disappeared in the early 2000s. The old root cellar is still there, though.
Från början hette gården och byn Anderst: The farm and village were originally called Andersta. The name Flemingsberg came when the farm passed to the Fleming family, through Henrik Klasson Fleming's marriage to Ebba Erlandsdotter Bååt. In the mid-1600s it became a manor.
Från början kallades området Maltesholm,: The area was originally called Maltesholm, after a small farm. Many people thought it was wrong to build so close to the water. Even so, 16 slab blocks went up on Strandliden in 1956–1957, leaving only a narrow lakeside path between the buildings and Lake Mälaren.
Från början låg skolan mellan en park, e: The school originally stood among a park, a meadow and open pine woods. When the Essingeleden motorway was built in the early 1960s, it ended up in the middle of a large interchange and parts of the building were demolished. Today it houses offices, a workshop and artists' studios.
Från början omfattade Botaniska 37 hekta: The Botanical Garden started out with 37 hectares; today it covers 175, including parts of the Änggårdsbergen nature reserve with its arboretum. The nature park and the outer grounds have been protected since 1975.
Från början var bottenvåningens fasad mo: Originally, the ground-floor façade facing Rangstaplan was bare concrete. In the early 1990s it was clad in dark brown clinker tiles, while the other façades are red-brown brick.
Från början var det tänkt att verket sku: The plant was originally meant to get a new turbine, but the Stockholm electricity board chose a second-hand de Laval turbine from the Värtan steam power station instead. Its electrical output was just 10 MW – Sweden's later reactors produced 450 to 1,000 MW.
Från början var kranen grönmålad och bet: The crane was originally painted green and was far less eye-catching than it is today. Its girder was made by NOHAB in Trollhättan in eight sections and brought here by barge. In 2010 the lighting of the crane and the dock won an international award from the lighting designers' association.
Från den försvunna runstenen på samma hö: Only a fragment of the text survives from the lost runestone on the same hill: "... raise the stone in memory of Svarthövde ..."
Från det som kallas Högsta toppen i sten: From the spot known as Högsta toppen, the highest point in the quarry, you can see the Globe arena and the City Hall tower in Stockholm – if visibility allows and the vegetation isn't too tall.

Från mitten av 1800-talet till 1960-tale: From the mid-1800s until the 1960s, people here did the washing for Stockholmers. Från mitten av 1800-talet växte några bo: From the mid-19th century a handful of houses sprang up on the isthmus. The first was probably the croft Haganäs, which still stands and is now known as Röda caféet – the Red Café.
Från mitten av 1930-talet fram till år 2: From the mid-1930s until 2000, the Banana Pier handled all of Sweden's banana imports, brought in on purpose-built ships. Från oktober 1944 användes källarbaren i: From October 1944, the cellar bar of what was then Hotel Aston was used for Operation Stella Polaris. Here, Finnish signals intelligence staff sorted and microfilmed intelligence material that had been smuggled into Sweden. It was all burnt in 1960.

Från slutet av 1480-talet gick en roddfä: From the late 1480s a rowing ferry crossed from Rödstuguviken to Ekudden on the Djursholm side. It carried Lidingö's farmers over to do their work for church and state, and let the priest from Danderyd get to Sunday service. The ferryman lived at Rödstugan.
Från slutet av 1800-talet hade Skälby en: From the late 1800s, Skälby had a stop on the Lövsta line. Passenger services ended in 1956 when the metro to Hässelby gård opened, but the rubbish trains, nicknamed Silverpilen (the Silver Arrow), kept rumbling past until 1970.
Från slutet av 1800-talet och långt in p: From the late 1800s until well into the 1900s, market gardening was an important local trade. Flowers, fruit and vegetables were grown for sale in Gothenburg, at places such as the Råda estate and Pixbo manor.

From the late 19th century until well into the 20th, market gardening was an important trade here. Flowers, fruit and vegetables were grown and sold in Gothenburg, from places such as the Råda estate and Pixbo manor.
Från slutet av 1800-talet och under 1900: From the late 19th century and right through the 20th, Albano was an industrial area. Today it's dominated by Campus Albano, shared by Stockholm University and KTH Royal Institute of Technology, which opened in September 2023 with around 1,000 student flats. Albano is also home to Nordita, the Nordic Institute for Theoretical Physics. It was founded in 1957, with Niels Bohr among its instigators, and moved here from Copenhagen in 2006.

Från slutet av 1870-talet blev Arendal e: From the late 1870s Arendal became a seaside resort where Gothenburg's wholesale merchants, shipowners and doctors kept their summer retreats. The villa of salt merchant Gustav R. Setterberg is said to have been built from salt barges, and was probably the first villa in Arendal.
Från slutet av 1920-talet hade stålgross: From the late 1920s the steel wholesaler Söderberg & Haak had its warehouse here, and its competitor Odelberg & Olson soon followed. The business wound down at the end of the 1980s, and today some 7,000 people work in the area.

Frölunda Torg öppnade 1966 och var ett a: Frölunda Torg opened in 1966 and was one of Sweden's first big suburban shopping centres. All around is Västra Frölunda, and a few kilometres to the west the sea and the archipelago begin.
Frölunda specialistsjukhus låg i ett 55: Frölunda's specialist hospital was housed in a 55-metre slab block, the tallest building in Frölunda. Only the bottom five of its 17 floors were hospital – the rest were flats.
Frölunda torg invigdes den 8 september 1: After seven years of construction, Frölunda torg was opened by Olof Palme on 8 September 1966. In the first four days alone, 50,000 people came through the doors.
