I Lännerstasundet ligger ön Fisksätra ho: Out in the Lännerstasundet strait lies the islet of Fisksätra holme, with bathing spots and barbecue areas, reached by a foot and cycle bridge. The Folkets hus community centre has hosted its International Festival since 1974.
I Långbro ligger restaurangen Aloë, som: Långbro is home to the restaurant Aloë, which was awarded two Michelin stars in 2020. In the area where Långbro hospital once stood, you'll also find Långbro värdshus, an inn.
I Mattisborgen 2 har man staplat radhus: At Mattisborgen 2, one- and two-storey terraced houses are stacked on top of each other, with entrances from the ground and from access balconies. The façades are painted black, and the buildings were nominated for Stockholm Building of the Year in 2013.
I Mega Ditch hölls VM i banked slalom 20: Mega Ditch hosted the banked slalom world championships in 2016, 2017 and 2018. Every year it holds Bowlstock, a skateboarding and music festival, and in 2013 The Gathering event drew around 2,000 skaters.
I Monteliushusets låga gathus öppnade Ol: In 1903 Olof Alwert opened Södermalm's Walking Stick & Umbrella Factory in the low street-front building of the Montelius house. A tin umbrella, fully opened, hung above the entrance as a sign. An 18th-century stable and hayloft still survive in the courtyard.
I Mälaren nedanför huvudbyggnaden flöt k: Around 1900 a floating bathhouse lay in Lake Mälaren below the main house, complete with a tower and a pool that could be raised and lowered. The bathhouse can already be seen in a picture of Skärholmen from 1848.
I Mälarhöjdens ishall håller Djurgården: Mälarhöjden's ice rink is home to Djurgården Hockey's youth section, which runs an ice hockey school among other things. The sports ground also has an indoor tennis hall and a gymnasium that opened in 2019.
I Mälarskogen kan du hitta fyra hackspet: In Mälarskogen woods you can find four species of woodpecker: the black woodpecker, the green woodpecker, and the great and lesser spotted woodpeckers. The reserve is also important for bats – no fewer than ten species have been recorded here.
I Mölnlycke utbildas bland annat tullspe: Mölnlycke is one of the places where Sweden trains its customs specialists. Yrkeshögskolan i Mölnlycke, a higher vocational college run by Härryda Municipality, opened in 1998 and has about 200 students, who can also train as payroll specialists or in information security. A short way off, right in central Mölnlycke, is the little lake Massetjärnen.
I Nackareservatet, en bit härifrån, står: In the Nacka nature reserve, not far from here, is Brotorp, a tiny croft just eight metres by five. It's now a protected ancient monument and the clubhouse of the orienteering club Skogsluffarnas OK. Right beside it flows the Ältaån stream, which long-distance skaters and canoeists like to call the Brotorp Canal. Closer by stood the croft of Parken, built in 1839 and pulled down in the mid-1950s.
I Nobelparken, ett stenkast härifrån, sk: In Nobelparken, a stone's throw from here, there were plans for a monumental Nobel Palace in memory of Alfred Nobel. The architect Ferdinand Boberg worked on designs for it from 1906 to 1911, but it was never built. All that's left of those grand plans are the names Nobelparken and Nobelgatan, chosen in 1912. Today the street runs through Diplomatstaden, an exclusive neighbourhood of grand villas and embassies.
I Nockeby, en bit härifrån, ligger Villa: In Nockeby, a little way from here on Grönviksvägen, is Villa Markelius, the functionalist house the architect Sven Markelius lived in from 1930 to 1938. Sankta Birgitta kyrka, St Birgitta's Church, was built where the Nockebybanan tram line used to end and was consecrated in 1962. Winding past the villas is Hässelbystråket, a walking trail of about 19 kilometres that runs all the way from Hässelby strand to Gamla stan, the Old Town.
I Nora träsk har man vid provfiske fått: Test fishing in Nora träsk has turned up pike, perch, bleak and tench, among other species.
I Nordre älv, en bit härifrån, finns Orm: A short way from here, in the Nordre älv river, is the Ormo barrier, an adjustable dam that can hold back the flow in the Nordre älv when needed and send the water down the Gothenburg branch of the Göta älv instead. It sits between the Nordre älv railway bridge and the Kornhall ferry – a kind of tap that decides how the river splits.
I Norra Sköndal är gator och kvarter upp: In Norra Sköndal the streets and blocks are named after dogs. There's Vinthundsvägen (Greyhound Road), Terriergränd and Gråhundsvägen, for example, and blocks such as Kungspudeln, Bulldoggen and Lapphunden.
I Nyfikeliden låg små trähus som var ett: Nyfikeliden was lined with small wooden houses a couple of hundred years old. They were pulled down when Bagaregården was built towards the end of the First World War, but the last of them hung on until the mid-1940s.
I Oasen sim- och ishall har Kungälvs IK: Oasen swimming and ice arena is home ground for Kungälvs IK and KB Knights. The building also houses offices for several sports clubs, including Kungälvs Simsällskap, the local swimming club.
I Orhem finns flera koloniområden, och e: Orhem has several allotment areas, and some cabins were moved here from older sites nearer the city when that land was needed. The largest is Listudden, with 317 plots, laid out in 1944 and named after a croft.
I Ostkupans källare finns en studentbar: Down in Ostkupan's basement there's a student bar with darts and table football, and an open pub night on Wednesdays. The building also has a sauna, a billiards room and a small gym. In the 1980s Ostkupan was a youth hostel.
I Philipshusets lågdel fanns en ljudisol: The low-rise part of the Philips building housed a soundproofed hall with 142 seats that could serve as a theatre, cinema or recording studio. Sweden's first test broadcast in colour television was made here on 3 February 1965, during a fashion show.
I Pixbo har bland andra Hanna Ferm, Evel: Pixbo has been home to Hanna Ferm, Evelyn Jons, Karin and Olof Dreijer, radio presenter Erik Blix and chef Frida Ronge, among others. It's also where the floorball club Pixbo Wallenstam IBK was founded.
I Pixbo har bland andra sångerskorna Han: Pixbo has been home to the singers Hanna Ferm and Evelyn Jons, the musicians Karin and Olof Dreijer, the radio presenter Erik Blix and the chef Frida Ronge, among others. It's also where the floorball club Pixbo Wallenstam IBK was founded.
I Restaurang Barnvagnsfabrikens gamla lo: On Sockenvägen, in the old premises of Restaurang Barnvagnsfabriken – 'the pram factory' – the upmarket restaurant Mistral served local seasonal food and, often, biodynamic wines between 2009 and 2012. It had moved here from Gamla stan, the Old Town, where it had held a Michelin star. Right next door is the Mursmäckan block, named after the women who carried mortar to the bricklayers on building sites. Its urban terraced houses were voted Stockholm's Building of the Year in 2012.
I Roslags Näsby finns en runhäll med en: Roslags Näsby has a rune-carved rock that was discovered by a writer. The Kvarntorp rock was found in 1943 by the author Jan Fridegård, who was living in Täby at the time. The inscription is faint and partly worn away, but it includes the word for “stepsons”, which appears in only a handful of runic inscriptions. Roslags Näsby is about a kilometre south of Täby centrum.
I Ryaverkets kulvert finns världens stör: Deep in a service tunnel at the Ryaverket plant is the world's largest painting: 696 square metres, by the artist Pontus Andersson. The plant itself is the biggest wastewater treatment works in the Nordic countries.
I Rådsparkens lilla djurpark bor bland a: Rådsparken's little zoo is home to donkeys, goats, sheep, rabbits, ducks and hens, among others. There's also a staffed play park with a café, and a playground designed for children with disabilities.
I Rågsveds friområde finns Stockholms st: The Rågsved open space has Stockholm's largest wetland, broadleaf woodland, natural shorelines and abundant birdlife. It's classed as a core area of 'the highest biological value in the City of Stockholm', and animals have grazed here for at least 1,500 years.
Skintebo has a copy of Kina slott, the Chinese Pavilion at Drottningholm. The area sits in a hollow ringed by rocky hills, and a narrow valley leads you to the sea half a kilometre to the west.
I Skrubbas nordöstra del finns ett namnl: In the north-east of Skrubba is a nameless hill, 74 metres above sea level – the highest natural point in Söderort, Stockholm's southern suburbs. The district has 4,700 metres of shoreline along Drevviken lake, including the Skrubbabadet beach.

In the north-east of Skrubba is a nameless hill 74 metres above sea level, the highest natural point in Söderort, Stockholm's southern suburbs. The district has 4,700 metres of shoreline along Lake Drevviken, including the Skrubba bathing spot. On 31 December 2018, just 14 people lived here.
I Skyttorp stod eldstaden vid yttervägge: At Skyttorp the hearth stood against the outer wall, and besides the kitchen the cottage had a porch and a larger main room. In the 1930s the croft became a forestry workers' cabin, and it was pulled down around 1965 when Salem's town centre was built. The name lives on in Skyttorp School and Skyttorpsvägen.
I Skändla by i Tuve ligger bondgården Sk: In the village of Skändla in Tuve stands the farmstead Skändla sörgård, a listed building since 2002. You reach it via Tuve kyrkväg.
I Skändla har man hittat boplatser redan: Settlements dating back as far as the 12th century have been found in Skändla, and the surrounding area has many settlement sites and graves from the Stone, Bronze and Iron Ages. The best known is Skändla rös, a burial cairn on top of Skändlaberget.
I Solbergaskogen växer den rödlistade ox: In Solbergaskogen forest the red-listed beefsteak fungus grows on several oaks. There's also pine bracket and cauliflower fungus, which only grow on old pines. Every spring the woods are full of spawning frogs, and both great spotted and lesser spotted woodpeckers nest here.
I Stockholms tunnelbaneplan från 1965 fa: Stockholm's 1965 metro plan included an extension of the Bagarmossen line to Bollmora, with a station in Älta. It never came to pass.
I Strandlidens lägenheter fick köken en: In the Strandliden flats, the kitchens were given a generous dining area with wall-to-wall windows, and could be reached from both the hall and the living room. The layout was new, and it became something of a standard in Swedish kitchens during the 1960s.
I Svindersvik finns varken elektricitet: Svindersvik has neither electricity nor modern heating. Most of the furniture has stood in the same place since the late 1700s, the walls are hung with Chinese rice-paper wallpaper, and the 18th-century billiard table is still upstairs.
Many classics were filmed at Synvillan. Hem till byn began in 1971 and aired its fifty-second and final episode in 2006. Albert & Herbert, starring Sten-Åke Cederhök, and Raskens, with Sven Wollter, were made here too.
I Säveån lever en genetiskt unik stam av: The Säveån river is home to a genetically unique strain of rare wild salmon. You'll also find most of the 37 fish species that live in the Göta älv river here.

Säveån is home to a genetically unique strain of rare wild salmon, along with most of the 37 fish species found in the Göta älv. Salmon fishing has a long tradition here, and the nature reserve has one of Sweden's few fishing jetties accessible to disabled anglers.
I Södra länken har varje avfart fått en: In the Södra länken road tunnel, every exit has its own artistic design to help drivers find their way underground. The tunnels have their own names too, such as Hammarbytunneln and Årstatunneln, along with connections like the Guldtunneln and Silvertunneln – the Gold and Silver Tunnels.
I Tibble låg kapplöpningsbanan Täby Galo: The Täby Galopp racecourse stood in Tibble until 2016, when it moved to Bro Park in Upplands-Bro. The Täby park housing area is to be built on the site.
I Torpadammen, i grönområdet i sydöstra: Torpadammen, a pond in the green area in south-eastern Högsbohöjd, is home to great crested newts and the endangered great diving beetle Dytiscus latissimus, among other species.
I Trekantsparken finns Fruktlekparken me: Trekantsparken has the Fruit Playground, with play equipment shaped like sculpted fruit, made by the artist Johan Ferner Ström for the 1998 Capital of Culture year. A 1.75-kilometre walking loop runs through the park around Lake Trekanten.
I Troxhammar på södra Färingsö ligger Tr: Troxhammar, in the south of Färingsö, is home to Troxhammar Golf Club – but the area has traces far older than any golf ball. A little further on stands a granite runestone from the Viking Age, 2.2 metres tall. The village of Ekeby is mentioned as early as 1342, when land was swapped with the Vårfruberga convent, and in the 1400s the Crown took over a royal farm in Ekeby that had long been abandoned.
I Tulebo mosse, söder om Hårssjön, har m: In Tulebo mosse, the bog south of Hårssjön lake, traces of an ancient hillfort have been found. An excavation in the 1990s turned up logs, planks and sharpened stakes, the oldest from the 4th century. Even in the Iron Age, the bog had a strategic position in a borderland.
I Tumlehed finns hällmålningar med fyra: At Tumlehed there are rock paintings of four ships, a deer and four fish, probably from the Stone Age. Some 170 ancient sites are known across the parish, around a hundred of them Stone Age settlements.
I Tunnelbaneplan för Stockholm 1965 fann: The 1965 metro plan for Stockholm included an extension of the Bagarmossen line down to Bollmora, with a station in Älta. The plan never came to pass.
The 1965 Stockholm metro plan included an extension of the Bagarmossen line to Bollmora, with a station in Älta. It never came to pass.
I Tyresö finns flera insjöar, som Albysj: Tyresö has several lakes, including Albysjön, Fatburen and Trehörningen. Among its watercourses are Gammelströmmen, Gudöån, Nyfors and Åvaån.
I Täbys nordöstra del ligger Fågelsångsm: In the north-east of Täby lies Fågelsångsmossen, one of the few raised bogs in Stockholm, where dwarf birch grows among other plants. In the Täby prästgård nature reserve you’ll find the red-listed Finnish eyebright and an unusual pink-flowering pasqueflower.
I Ulvsunda låg AB Fructus, som gjorde su: Ulvsunda was home to AB Fructus, maker of the hugely popular soft drink Pommac. The Fructus building on Ulvsundavägen was designed by Ture Wennerholm and built in 1939–40; today it's a protected building.
I Viksjö ligger grönområdet Hummelmora m: In Viksjö lies the green space of Hummelmora with Hummelmoraberget hill. Much of Viksjö borders on the Görväln nature reserve, which follows Lake Mälaren past Hummelmora hage, Sandudden and the Görvälnsbadet beach.
I Villa Nynäs, vid nuvarande Stockholmsv: Villa Nynäs, at what is now Stockholmsvägen 109, housed a general store, a post office and, from 1883, Lidingö's first telephone exchange. Villa Nynäs, Telefonvillan and Näsets krog all survive today as private homes.
I Villa Yngve Larsson vände Ragnar Östbe: In Villa Yngve Larsson, Ragnar Östberg turned the ideals of the day upside down: at the client's request the bedrooms are on the ground floor, with the living and dining rooms upstairs. The façade is clad in tarred boarding, and the foundations are built of rough granite blocks.

In Villa Yngve Larsson, Ragnar Östberg turned the ideals of the day on their head: the bedrooms went on the ground floor and the living and dining rooms upstairs. The facade has tarred panelling and the foundation sturdy blocks of rough granite. The house has several American touches.
I Vinsta industriområde ligger Vällingby: In the Vinsta industrial area you'll find Vällingby fire station, designed by Mårten J. Larsson and opened in January 1965. The firefighters based here are specially trained in cutting through roofs and in high-rise climbing. This area was once also home to Hässelby kvarn, a windmill that belonged to the Hässelby manor estate. It was first recorded in the mid-1600s and had vanished by the 1820s. And when the metro reached Hässelby gård on a temporary basis in 1956, it was only a month before passenger trains on the Spånga–Lövsta railway stopped running.
I Välen finns ett våtmarksmuseum, en pla: Välen has a wetland museum, a birdwatching platform, a nature trail and a time trail. The reserve covers about 68 hectares and was established in 2014. Its water arrives via Stora ån, which drains the whole Fässberg valley.
I Västra Frölunda har man hittat 8 000 å: Stone Age settlements 8,000 years old have been found in Västra Frölunda, 20–25 metres above today's sea level – where the shoreline was back then. The parish also has three nature reserves, among them the Högsbo pegmatite quarry.
I Vårby gårds kyrka sitter församlingen: In Vårby gård Church the congregation sits around an altar table in the middle of the room, as if gathered for a meal. Normally the altar stands to the north. But for the consecration, Bishop Ingmar Ström insisted it face east – and so, for that occasion, it did.
I Willy Brandts park står en skulptur av: In Willy Brandt's Park stands a sculpture of Willy Brandt by the German sculptor Rainer Fetting, unveiled on 14 June 2007 by, among others, former prime minister Ingvar Carlsson. It's a smaller copy of a 3.4-metre bronze statue in the German Social Democrats' headquarters in Berlin.
I YK-huset har bland andra journalisten: Residents of the YK-huset building have included the journalist Barbro Alving, the food writer Pernilla Tunberger and the cultural historian Axel Strindberg. The building's architect, Hillevi Svedberg, and the architect Léonie Geisendorf also lived here.
I YK-huset kunde de boende beställa färd: In the YK building, residents could order ready-cooked meals from the restaurant on the ground floor, which were sent up by dumbwaiter. The restaurant is still there, now serving Chinese food, and the dumbwaiter is still in use.
I april 1878 annonserade greve Erik Spar: In April 1878 Count Erik Sparre advertised cheap plots "beautifully situated by the lake" in Dagens Nyheter. The catch: the plots were only leased out for 50 years, and the land turned out to be boggy.
I april 1973 togs ett nytt storkök i bru: In April 1973 a new central kitchen opened here, at the time the most modern in the Nordic countries. It delivered 4,000 meals a day to Lillhagen, S:t Jörgen's Hospital and several nursing homes.

In April 1973 a new central kitchen opened at Lillhagen – at the time the most modern in the Nordic countries. Every day it sent out 4,000 meals to Lillhagen, St Jörgen's Hospital and several nursing homes.
I april 2017 invigdes Susanna Arwins kon: In April 2017 Susanna Arwin's artwork 'The Handbag Mountain in Hammarbyhöjden' was unveiled. Arwin is known for the project 'The Swedish Auntie' and the jewellery range 'The Handbag', and the work is meant to encourage courage and moral bravery.
I arkitekttävlingen 1915 kom 53 förslag: The 1915 architectural competition drew 53 entries. The winner was Tallum, by Gunnar Asplund and Sigurd Lewerentz, both 30 at the time. Their inspiration came from German forest cemeteries and the paintings of Caspar David Friedrich.
I arkitekttävlingen 1981 kom 123 förslag: The 1981 architecture competition drew 123 entries. A 40-storey high-rise scheme was turned down. Instead the area was built as traditional city blocks, including the Catalan architect Ricardo Bofill's great arc.
I arkivet finns cirka tre miljoner karto: The archive holds around three million maps and drawings. Among them are 2.5 million building plans, which UNESCO added to its Memory of the World register in 2011.
I augusti 2013 vägrade regeringen dispen: In August 2013 the government refused an exemption from the shoreline protection rules at Lake Aspen, which more or less spelled the end for the park. Even so, John John Lindgren, CEO of the Lindgren family company, maintained that the shoreline rules had nothing to do with their withdrawal – the parties simply couldn't agree on the development contract.
I barnkammaren finns en lekfull bård sig: In the nursery runs a playful frieze signed "the artist Alf Wallander". The ceiling above the entrance is coffered with turquoise squares, and furniture and textiles from when the house was built are still in place.
I berget bakom optiktornet tillverkades: From 1943, inside the rock behind the optics tower, workers made periscopes for Swedish submarines and wing spars for the J 22 fighter plane, among other things. From the tower's balconies, sights were tested against a board on Ekbacken, about 400 metres away.
I berget en bit härifrån gömmer sig Nybo: Hidden in the rock nearby is Nybohovshissen, a funicular-style lift in a rock tunnel nicknamed Klumpen, 'the Lump'. It's 230 metres long, climbs 37 metres, and the ride between Liljeholmen metro station and Nybohovsberget hill takes 2 minutes and 16 seconds. The Nyboda tunnels also pass through Nybodaberget, and the oldest of them became Sweden's very first railway tunnel when the Western Main Line reached Stockholm in 1860.
I berget tillverkades bland annat vingba: Among other things, wing spars for the FFVS J 22 fighter were made inside the rock. Thick blast doors protected the workers, and in a crisis the plant could serve as a shelter for up to 3,000 people.
I berget under Eriksberg kan 17 tåg stå: Inside the rock beneath Eriksberg there's room to park 17 trains. The depot, finished in December 2016, serves the new C30 type of metro trains. The building above ground is just over 200 metres long.
I bergrummet bakom tornet tillverkades v: In the rock cavern behind the tower, wing spars were made for the FFVS J 22 fighter plane, along with submarine periscopes. The facility had its own back-up power and its own well, and in a crisis it could shelter up to 3,000 people.
I bergrummet förvaras också en stor mäng: The rock chamber also stores a large collection of uniforms that have been used in various film productions.
I bergrummet tillverkades efter 1943 bla: After 1943 the rock cavern was used to make parts including the wing spars for the FFVS J 22 fighter plane. Thick blast doors protected the workers, and in a crisis the cavern could serve as a shelter for up to 3,000 people.
I biljetthallens lanternin hänger konstn: Hanging in the lantern roof of the ticket hall is Min vän (My Friend), a sculpture by the artist couple Eva and Peter Moritz, unveiled in 2006. It's made of aluminium rods bolted and welded together.
I bostadsområdet Stora Mellansjö står Vi: In the Stora Mellansjö residential area stands Villa Brännugnen, designed by Gert Wingårdh in 2016. It won Huddinge's architecture prize in 2019.
I bostadsområdet står ett sextiotal skul: Around sixty sculptures by well-known Swedish artists are dotted around the housing area. On Rissne torg there's an octagonal building that has become a Rissne landmark.
I bottenvåningen fanns järnhandel, mjölk: The ground floor had an ironmonger, a dairy shop, a grocer, a delicatessen, a pharmacy and a post office. On the corner was a watchmaker with a big clock on the facade – the premises are now a goldsmith's. The bus stopped in front of the building, where there was also a Shell petrol pump.
I bottenvåningen låg restaurangen Fondbe: On the ground floor was the restaurant Fondbersån, named after the block. At first the young tenants had to buy 20 meal vouchers a month, for 54 kronor in total. The rent of 125–160 kronor included cleaning and laundering of linen.
I butikshusen på Doktor Bex gata öppnade: Konsum opened in the shopping parade on Doktor Bex gata in 1951, followed by Rolf Nilsson's fishmonger, a paint shop, a photo studio, a ladies' hairdresser and a dry cleaner. A post office opened in December 1952.
I byn Bärby skipades rätt under 1800-tal: In the 1800s, the village of Bärby was where justice was done. It was the court site for the Western and Eastern Hising court district, formed in 1824 to cover both the Västra and Östra Hising hundreds. The district lasted until 1888, when it was merged into the Askim, Hising and Sävedal court district. Today Bärby is a quiet little village west of Säve.
I byn Törnby på södra Färingsö, en bit h: In 1541 the village of Törnby on southern Färingsö, not far from here, had two farms owned by the nobility and one tax-paying farm. In 1544 Karin Axelsdotter Tott sold both noble farms to none other than King Gustav Vasa. The village is first mentioned back in 1342 and has now merged with Stenhamra, while neighbouring Söderberga has become part of the Tureholm built-up area.
I båthamnen står sedan 1995 Carl Milles: Since 1995 Carl Milles' 23-metre sculpture God the Father on the Rainbow has stood in the marina, sending water in an elegant arc out into the Saltsjön. It has become the emblem of Nacka Strand.
I början av 1500-talet fanns här tre bya: In the early 1500s there were three villages here: Lilla Fiskebäck, Fiskebäcks Mellangård and Stora Fiskebäck. Today it's almost all detached and terraced houses, with just a few older buildings left.
I början av 1600-talet startade den förs: In the early 1600s the first ferry service across the Göta älv started up, between Klippan and Färjestaden on Hisingen. Regular ferry traffic didn't end until 1967, when the Älvsborg Bridge opened.
I början av 1698 beordrade den 15-årige: In early 1698, the 15-year-old King Charles XII ordered proposals for strengthening the west coast's naval defences. The result was a permanent naval station in Gothenburg.
I början av 1800-talet arrenderades Smed: In the early 19th century Smedslätten was leased by Anna Margareta Lundberg, a hatter's widow. Her husband had left her a considerable fortune, and in 1810 she took over Nedre Smedslätten.
I början av 1800-talet byggdes huset om: In the early 19th century the house was rebuilt to take in overnight guests, giving it the look it has today. A few false windows were added to keep the window pattern symmetrical.
I början av 1900-talet bröts torv här ti: In the early 1900s peat was cut here for a factory near Lovisedalstorpet that made peat litter for animal bedding. Plenty of water-filled pits and ditches still bear witness to the work.
In the early 20th century peat was cut here for a peat-litter factory near Lovisedalstorpet. Water-filled pits and ditches still bear witness to the work.
In the early 1900s, peat was cut here for a peat-litter factory near the Lovisedal croft. Water-filled pits and ditches all over the bog still bear witness to it.
I början av 1900-talet bröts torv på Ält: In the early 1900s peat was cut on Älta bog for a peat-litter factory near the Lovisedal croft. Lots of water-filled pits and ditches can still be seen. The bog is the largest raised bog in Nacka.
I början av 1900-talet etablerades varvs: Shipbuilding came to the island in the early 1900s. Hälsö has also won the archipelago football cup several times.
I början av 1900-talet sköttes gården av: In the early 1900s the farm was run by Arvid Johansson, director of Svenska Slakteri AB, a meat company. Animals he bought around the country were kept in the barn and paddocks before being sold on. He had no interest in the garden and leased it out.
I början av 1900-talet styckade AB Söder: In the early 1900s AB Södertörns Villastad divided the land into plots, and the first villas went up near Fagersjö station house on the new Nynäs railway. Many were torn down when modern Fagersjö was built in the 1960s.
I början av 1900-talet styckades Snättri: In the early 1900s Snättringe was divided up for villas, and the surveyor Nils Åhlin drew up a map with 142 plots. Sales were slow, as transport links were poor.
I början av 1930-talet var Brotorp friti: In the early 1930s Brotorp was a holiday home for the Grand Hôtel staff club. At the time a Turkish man in a red fez lived here; he worked at the hotel, serving coffee in the dining room.
I början av 1950-talet byggdes Annes hus: In the early 1950s Annes hus, Anne's House, was built for Milles's secretary Anne Hedmark. It was furnished by Estrid Ericson and Svenskt Tenn with furniture by Josef Frank. Carl and Olga Milles spent their summers here, and Carl Milles died in the music room in 1955.
I början av 1950-talet grävdes gravfälte: In the early 1950s the Beckomberga-Råcksta burial ground was excavated and 190 graves were found, the oldest from the 3rd century. Finds included glass beads, gold rings, gaming pieces and bear claws – traces of a prosperous farming community.
I början av 1950-talet hade Ikea bara et: In the early 1950s IKEA had only a small showroom in Kungshuset on Kungsgatan, with signs reading 'IKÉA shows SMÅLAND FURNITURE'. Customers could try out the furniture and place orders, but couldn't take anything home with them.
I början av 1950-talet hade Storstockhol: In the early 1950s, Greater Stockholm had 765 market gardens, and much of their produce was sold at Klarahallen market hall in central Stockholm. This new wholesale area was meant to replace it. When Trädgårdshallen opened, it had room for more than 300 local growers of flowers and vegetables – and there was even a bank.
I början av 1960-talet hade Atlas Copco: In the early 1960s Atlas Copco had around 2,100 employees in Sickla, but in 1992 production moved to Örebro. The halls were renovated by Nyréns architects, and the culture centre opened in 2002. The cinema is now in what used to be Hall B.
I början av 1960-talet kostade ett radhu: In the early 1960s a terraced house on Däldvägen cost 192,000 kronor. In 2019 one on Utsiktsvägen sold for 11,200,000 kronor.
I början av 1970-talet arbetade cirka 70: In the early 1970s about 700 people worked at the shipyard. When demand for ship repairs collapsed in 1990, the company went bankrupt the following year, and the big floating dock was sold to Mexico.
I början av 1970-talet byggdes kedjehus: In the early 1970s terraced houses were built in southern Pixbo, on the site of the old market garden. The roads were named after the fruit tree varieties that had grown there.
In the early 1970s, linked houses were built in southern Pixbo on the site of the old market garden. The roads were named after the varieties of fruit tree that once grew there.
I början av 1970-talet var fosforhaltern: In the early 1970s, phosphorus levels in Drevviken were very high because of a poor sewage works upstream. Since then phosphorus and nitrogen have roughly halved, there's less algae, and you can see up to three metres down.
I början av 1990-talet blev det som fann: In the early 1990s what was left of Handen's folkpark – its old people's park for dances and entertainment – became a cultural park, with local associations taking over the old buildings. Besides the RoJ theatre, Levande Zon is based in the Gula Villan, and ABF Södertörn has Villa Rudan and Alphyddan.
I början fanns ett 40-tal butiker, varuh: At first there were some 40 shops, the Domus and Tempo department stores, a Systembolaget off-licence and a three-storey bowling alley. By summer 2011 the shopping centre had just over 200 shops, restaurants and cafés, making it Gothenburg's second largest after Nordstan.
I centrallagret spikades standardlådor f: In the central warehouse, standard crates for outgoing goods were nailed together on a conveyor belt – 1,250 a day, or one every 26 seconds. Goods were moved around by radio-controlled trucks, and one article of the time said the warehouse was more like a packaging factory.
I centrum står skulpturen Fruarna av Wil: In the centre stand Willy Gordon's 1968 sculpture The Ladies and the Fruängen fountain by Bertil Johnson from 2005.
I dag används lokalen för dramaundervisn: Today the venue is used for drama teaching and the school's music classes. In December 2016 the musical RENT 2.0! premiered at Prisma after the company lost the venue it had planned to use.
I dag används stugan för konst och hantv: Today the cottage is used for art and crafts. There's an open workshop for painting, throwing and ceramics, and in Galleraget some 25 artists show their work over the year.
I dag finns en överväxt husgrund med en: Today there's an overgrown foundation with a pile of bricks from the croft's chimney. Next to it is the cold-water spring where the residents fetched their drinking water. The area lies within the Gömmaren nature reserve.
I dag finns omkring 100 stugor på ön. Se: Today there are about 100 cottages on the island. Since 2005 one of them has been lived in all year round.
I dag huserar Kvibergs marknad i de före: Today Kvibergs marknad, a big weekend market, is housed in the former stable buildings. The site also has Kvibergs museum, a regimental museum, along with club premises and homes.
I dag kan du besöka området. Det finns r: Today you can visit the area. There are restaurants in Backstugan, the old staff canteen, and in Regissörsvillan, the Director's Villa, plus a 1920s-style café in Portvaktsstugan, the gatekeeper's lodge – perfect for a fika, or coffee break. The wrought-iron gateway at the entrance is original and a familiar sight from old SF films.
I dag ligger ett hyrlager närmast E4:an,: Today there's a self-storage warehouse right by the E4, and a new housing area has been built to the south. It's been named Gyllene ratten, "the Golden Steering Wheel", with Vantörsvägen as its main street.
I dag vill Aeroseum berätta om flygets h: Today Aeroseum sets out to tell the story of flight from the days of Icarus to modern space travel, both civil and military. There's a sizeable collection of helicopters and aircraft, and every year it hosts events such as the Aeroseum Flight Weekend.
I dag är Duggregnet 5 ett vanligt bostad: Today Duggregnet 5 is an ordinary block of 108 flats, most of them with two bedrooms. In front of the entrance stands the Björkhagen fountain, created in 1963 by Emil Näsvall.
I dag är Filmstaden öppen för besök. Det: Filmstaden is open to visitors today. There are restaurants in Backstugan, the old staff canteen, and in Regissörsvillan, the Director's Villa, plus a 1920s-style café in Portvaktsstugan, the Gatekeeper's Lodge. In 2024 Filmstaden was named a European film heritage site.
I dag är fortet igenväxt och klottrat. D: Today the fort is overgrown and covered in graffiti. Parts of the old firing trenches now serve as retaining walls for the tower blocks in south-western Skogås.
I dag är paviljongen Visitors Center, me: Today the pavilion is the Visitors Center, with a café in the west wing. The east wing has a small museum whose exhibits include Lewerentz's armchair, Asplund's wooden chair and Carl Milles's small Angel of Death.
I dag är varvsområdet småbåtshamn, och p: Today the old shipyard is a marina, and around 500 boats are stored here over the winter. Bergsbo II, the shipyard workers' housing, has been turned into artists' studios.
I dag är vattnet så rent att man kan bad: Today the water is clean enough to swim at Långholmen and Smedsudden. The open-water swimming race was stopped in 1927 because the water was unfit, but in 1976 the Riddarfjärden swim between the City Hall and Smedsudden was revived.
I dagens centrum fanns förr tre sjöar: G: Today's town centre was once home to three lakes – Grundmarn, Rudmarn and Putten – which were filled in during the 1940s and 50s. Where Bagarns träsk used to be, the Round House now stands on Bagarvägen, and the car park on Rudmarn has sunk by several decimetres.
I december 1924 fick Stockholm sitt förs: In December 1924 Stockholm got its first traffic light, right here on Nybroplan. It was a traffic beacon known as an AGA light, put up on trial on the American model.
In December 2016 the musical RENT 2.0! was staged at Prisma. It was originally meant to be performed at St Thomas’s Church in Vällingby, but when plans changed, Hässelbygård School offered up its old cinema. The premiere was on 18 December 2016.
I den 100 hektar stora Fagersjöskogen vä: The 100-hectare Fagersjö forest is home to Stockholm's biggest spruce, with a trunk more than three metres round at chest height. It also contains Högdalstoppen, two of Stockholm's highest points, with sweeping views over the south of the city.
I den första domkyrkan fanns en kungssto: The first cathedral had a royal pew carved by Marcus Jäger. In 1689 it was upholstered in red velvet, most likely in time for King Karl XI's visit to Gothenburg on 10 September that year.
I den gamla fytotronen på Frescati hagvä: Since 1998 the old phytotron – a plant-growing research facility – at Frescati hagväg 9 has housed the Gösta Ekman Laboratory for sensory research. It includes a smell laboratory, a lab for the sense of touch and facilities for noise research.
I den gamla maskinhallen spelade Film AB: From 1946 the film company Film AB Imago shot slapstick comedies such as 91:an Karlsson, Kronblom and Påhittiga Johansson in the old machine hall. After Svensk Filmindustri took over, some scenes from Ingmar Bergman's This Can't Happen Here were filmed here too.
I den lilla Karptjärnen, en bit härifrån: In Karptjärnen, a little pond not far from here, live both medicinal leeches and horse leeches. They're thought to have been put there back in the days when Stockholm's pharmacies released and collected leeches to treat all sorts of ailments. In spring the pond is teeming with tadpoles. Since the mid-1990s, the area around Tyresö Strand has filled up with detached, semi-detached and terraced houses – but this same part of Tyresö is also home to the 17th-century Tyresö Palace and church.
I den röda klockstapeln hänger två klock: Two bells cast in Ystad hang in the red bell tower. One has a Latin inscription in the style of Tuve Church's 18th-century bell, naming King Carl XVI Gustaf and the year 1976.
I det före detta Långbro sjukhuset fanns: For several years, the former Långbro hospital was home to Långbro Folk High School, a college for adult education. Among other things, it housed the Linnea art school, a three-year post-secondary art course for people with intellectual disabilities, which moved to Södra Stockholms folkhögskola in Skärholmen in 2007. The old heart of the hospital grounds is now Långbroparken park.
I det första Cyklopen ordnades teater, a: The first Cyklopen hosted theatre, studios, film screenings and electronic music club nights. Workshops with Konstfack, the University of Arts, Crafts and Design, produced among other things a table that was sent to a furniture fair in Milan. Even though the building had no electricity, water or heating, around 1,000 people a month came in summer 2008.
I det gamla fordonsskyddet har brandförs: The old vehicle shelter now houses the fire service's vintage vehicle workshop. It has three roadworthy old fire engines that often take part in rallies, both in Sweden and abroad.
I det gula runda huset Rotundan vid idro: The round yellow building by the sports ground, Rotundan, is home to the Örnsberg scout troop and the role-playing club MiFF. Teams such as Gröndals IK and IFK Aspudden-Tellus play on the pitch.
I det här industriområdet forskade state: The state once carried out aircraft research in this industrial area. The Aeronautical Research Institute was based in the Ulvsunda industrial area, doing research and testing in aeronautics until, at the turn of 2000/2001, it became part of the Swedish Defence Research Agency. A short way from here, the Huvudsta bridge – known locally as the Pripps bridge – crosses over to Solna.
I det här området finns något så ovanlig: This area has something rather unusual: a prison just for women, Anstalten Sagsjön in Lindome. Not far from it is Lindome station, which has had a real rollercoaster history. It opened in 1888, stopped serving passengers in 1970 and closed altogether in 1989 – only to be given a new lease of life by the commuter trains in 1992.
I det informella området Vasalund ligger: Vasalund, an informal neighbourhood rather than an official district, is home to Solna's only municipal sixth-form school and the Vasalundshallen sports hall. Here too is Södra Långgatan, which became 'Lyckliga gatan', the Happy Street, in Anna-Lena Löfgren's hit song – although the stretch in the song was actually in Hagalund. You'll also find Charlottenburg, Solna's heritage farmstead and home to the local history museum.
I det jordfasta blocket U 45 berättar Sa: On the earthfast boulder U 45, Saxe tells how he had the stone cut and a bridge built in memory of his mother. Building a bridge, in other words, was another way to honour the dead. The mother's name has been lost, but the carver was called Sven.
I det runda kyrkorummet står dopfunten c: In the round church interior the font stands at the centre, symbolising the role of baptism in Christian life, with a symbolic dove hanging above it. Windows by the glass artist Ralph Bergholtz depict various Bible stories.
I dokusåpan bodde välbeställda innerstad: In this reality show, well-heeled city-centre residents and less well-off suburbanites lived together on the island for 40 days. The first episode drew half a million viewers, but the ratings soon dropped. The winner was Serhan Sören Erdal.
I en frihamn kunde varor lagras utan att: In a free port, goods could be stored without paying customs duty, since the area counted as foreign territory. King Gustaf V opened Sweden's first free port here – still a provisional one – in 1919. Gothenburg's free port didn't follow until three years later, in 1922.
I en gammal konsumbyggnad i villaområdet: An old Konsum co-op building in the villa area was home to the restaurant Aloë from 2015 to 2025. The restaurateurs Daniel Höglander and Niclas Jönsson won a Michelin star in 2018, and two years later a second one. There was room for just 35 guests, and the name Aloë is Latin for 'of unknown origin'.
I en intervju från 2006 sa Ralph Erskine: In a 2006 interview Ralph Erskine said of the area: 'I like to go there myself to shop and walk around.' The hall in the culture house, which hosts theatre, concerts and films, is named Erskinesalen after him.
I en källarlokal på Omvägen i Kallebäck: It was in a basement on Omvägen in Kallebäck that Per-Olof Ahl, founder of the fashion chain Kappahl, opened his first shop in 1953. Kallebäck is also home turf for the footballer Johnny Ekström, nicknamed the Kallebäck Express for his speed.
I en reklamtext från 1953 kallades Bandh: A 1953 advertisement called Bandhagen and Högdalen "the City of Sun and Light". The idea was a combination town, with the calm of a small town and the services of a big city.
A 1953 advertisement called Bandhagen and Högdalen ‘the town of sun and light’. It was to be a ‘combination town’, pairing small-town calm with big-city services.
I en trädgård vid gamla Råsta gård, en k: In a garden at the old Råsta farm, a short walk from here, stands Råstastenen, a runestone from the days when Råsta belonged to Spånga parish. There used to be a second runestone here as well, but only a fragment of it survives, kept since 1976 at the Sundbyberg museum. Råsta gård sits at the north-western corner of Lake Råstasjön.
I en utgåva av Bellmans skrifter från 18: An 1861 edition of the poet Bellman's works includes a woodcut for Fredman's Epistle No. 48, about Ulla Winblad's journey home from Hessingen. It notes that the inn was still standing from those merry days.
I ett av punkthusen fanns förr snabbköpe: One of the tower blocks used to house the Sannadals livs grocery and a hairdresser. The old supermarket premises are now home to Jazzcafé Snabbköpet – the Supermarket Jazz Café.
I ett av rösena som togs bort 1922 vid S: In one of the cairns removed in 1922 near Sunnerdahlsvägen, a bronze socketed axe from the Late Bronze Age was found. It's now in the Swedish History Museum and is one of the few Bronze Age grave finds from the Stockholm area.
I ett hemma-hos-reportage i Idun 1906 be: In a 1906 at-home feature in the magazine Idun, Richard Bergh described his new home: it had a calm that often found him lost in a book “until half past one in the morning”. The family room had blue walls and a Blüthner grand piano.
I ett protokoll från föreningens tidiga: In the minutes from the association's early years, someone wrote in pencil: 'The beginning may be small, but the vision shall be great – the result will be just right.' The building opened in 1986 with singing, dancing and the Botkyrka Eccentric Dixieband.
I fasaden mot landsvägen finns fortfaran: The façade facing the road still has two alms boxes with coin slots. The stone slabs around them read "Hear the cry of the poor. Take counsel of your heart" and "He that giveth unto the poor lendeth unto the Lord".
I februari 2010 utsåg Göteborgs-Posten s: In February 2010 the newspaper Göteborgs-Posten named the semlor – cream-filled cardamom buns – at Mehran café & konditori on Radiotorget the best in town. The square also has an upholsterer, a fishmonger and a dog groomer.

In February 2010 the Göteborgs-Posten newspaper crowned the semlor – cream-filled cardamom buns – at Mehran café & konditori on Radiotorget the best in town. The square is also ringed by small shops, among them an upholsterer, a fishmonger and a dog groomer.

In February 2010 the Göteborgs-Posten newspaper named the semlor – cream-filled cardamom buns – at Mehran café and patisserie, here on Radiotorget, the best in Gothenburg. The square still has both a patisserie and a restaurant.
I filmen Varning för Jönssonligan stjäls: In the film Varning för Jönssonligan (Beware of the Jönsson Gang), a flagpole is stolen from a plot in the Linnéa allotment garden.
I friområdet ligger ett stort stenblock: The open space has a large boulder with 32 cup marks, and there are rock carvings at five spots. Legend has it that a Danish cannon was dug up in the marshes, perhaps from the Battle of Brännkyrka in 1518.
I första kyrkans torn hängde enligt en s: According to an account from 1739, the tower of the first church held three great bells that could be heard more than three kilometres away. The hour bell on the north side of the tower weighed just over a tonne.
I gamla Spånga socken finns gravrösen fr: The old parish of Spånga has Bronze Age burial cairns, around 90 burial grounds and two Iron Age hill forts, and 14 rune carvings have been found here. There are also three nature reserves: Igelbäcken, Grimsta and Hansta.
I gamla handlingar stavas Snättringe uta: Old records spell Snättringe without the r – Snettingen or Snättingen, as in 1628. It was originally a croft under Fullersta farm and was bought out in 1873 by Hugo Stegeman.
I gamla skolans östra flygel fanns från: The east wing of the old school originally held a domestic science kitchen and a swimming pool. The pool is actually still there, but it's been covered over and the room is used as an ordinary classroom.
I gammal folktro kallades stora block nä: In old folklore, large boulders near churches were called jättekast – stones thrown by giants. In the 18th century a sexton's cottage stood next to this one, known from 1801 to 1819 as Biskopsbacken. Nobody knows whether the stone was named after the cottage or the other way round.
I generalplanen från 1970 skulle Balltor: Under the 1970 master plan, Balltorp was to get 11,000 flats for up to 30,000 people, plus a tram line. The plan drew criticism and was scaled back to 6,150 flats. Ground was broken on 12 November 1979.
I grannområdet Frösunda heter två gator: In neighbouring Frösunda two streets are called Signe Tillischgatan and Pomonagatan, after the apple varieties Signe Tillisch and Cox's Pomona. There's an apple orchard at Lilla Frösunda. Signalistgatan and Brevduvegatan – Signaller Street and Carrier Pigeon Street – recall the old signals regiment instead.
I grannskapet öppnade 1907 landets först: In 1907, Sweden's first home for patients with skin tuberculosis opened in this neighbourhood. Patients were treated with Finsen light, an ultraviolet therapy invented by the Danish doctor Niels Ryberg Finsen, who won the Nobel Prize for it in 1903. Right next door stood Vattenborgen, the Water Castle, one of the city's early water reservoirs. It was demolished in 1934, and Stadshagsplan is on the site today.
I grannstadsdelen Arendal låg Arendalsva: In neighbouring Arendal, the Arendal shipyard operated from 1963 to 1989. Today the area is a large logistics and industrial zone, and it's also home to the Volvo Museum.
I hamnbyn Kornhall en bit härifrån gömme: The harbour village of Kornhall, a little way from here, has a name with a hint of grain about it. According to place-name experts, it comes from 'korn', barley, and 'hall', a place where the barley was loaded or unloaded, and it's recorded as early as 1774. The village is best known, though, for its ferry across the Nordre älv river, a crossing with a long history that makes the journey to Gothenburg a good deal shorter.
I hamnen ligger en isfabrik och en falrö: Down in the harbour are an ice factory and a net factory painted in falu red, the classic Swedish barn-red. The net factory was designed in the 1960s by the architect Voldemars Vasilis.
I huset Ryttaren 15 vid Valhallavägen in: The Ryttaren 15 building on Valhallavägen was the first to have rubbish chutes, built to the architect Sven Wallander's own patent. From the start, it was also run so that tenants gradually bought shares in the property company – a forerunner of Sweden's housing cooperatives and of HSB, which Wallander helped to found in 1923. Next door, Wittstocksgatan commemorates Johan Banér's victory at Wittstock in 1636.
The main house is home to Café Grönlingen, named after the stone loach, a rare fish found in the Igelbäcken stream just north of the farm. The farm also has horses, a dovecote, beehives and a theatre barn.
I hörnet av Bondegatan, vid Södermannaga: On the corner of Bondegatan, at Södermannagatan 26, stand two red-painted, weatherboarded wooden houses built before 1748. The City Museum has marked them blue, meaning they are of exceptionally high cultural and historical value.
I hörnet av Bällstavägen och Spångavägen: On the corner of Bällstavägen and Spångavägen, the Round Houses, designed by Nils Sterner, were built in 1953–1954. They were homes for the hospital's staff, above all the nurses.

On the corner of Bällstavägen and Spångavägen, the 'Round Houses' were built in 1953–54 as staff housing, mainly for the hospital's nurses. The architect, Nils Sterner, created a block surrounded by plenty of greenery.

On the corner of Bällstavägen and Spångavägen, Runda husen, 'the Round Houses', were built in 1953–54 as homes for hospital staff, mainly nurses. The architect Nils Sterner created a block of two four-storey and three three-storey buildings set among greenery.
I hörnet av Kronobergsparken finns en ju: Tucked into a corner of Kronoberg Park is a Jewish cemetery that exists because of a quarrel. Some members of the city's Jewish congregation felt that one of its leaders, Aaron Isaac, was far too domineering, so they simply got a cemetery of their own. It was laid out in 1787, the last burial was in 1857, and 209 people lie here. Just a little further away, the Sörman sign used to glow – one of Stockholm's classic neon signs.
I hörnet av Ånäsvägen och Hörngatan såld: On the corner of Ånäsvägen and Hörngatan, “Annika-Mor” sold sweets and fizzy drinks from her little shop at home, while the cooper's wife and daughter served beer and coffee in the house. At Ånäsvägen 5 lived an old spinster who sold knäck, a chewy Swedish toffee.
I hörnet av Östra Larmgatan och Lilla Ny: On the corner of Östra Larmgatan and Lilla Nygatan, the Palladium cinema operated from 1917 to 2008. The grand corner building from 1850 is still standing.
I januari 1969 flyttade familjen Arturss: In January 1969 the Artursson family and their three children moved here from Jönköping, drawn by jobs and low rents. The building was still wrapped in tarpaulins and they had to wade through mud. Their home is now the museum flat.
I januari 2013 fick allmänheten föreslå: In January 2013 the public was invited to suggest names for the new venue. A jury that included young people from Angered picked from 333 suggestions, and the winner was Angered Arena.
I juli 1965 monterades ett provisoriskt: In July 1965 a temporary library was assembled from 35 prefabricated sections in just three days. In the first week, 10,000 books were borrowed. The flat roof leaked, and after a few years a fungus the size of a fist was growing on one wall.
I juni 1811 annonserade Collegium medicu: In June 1811 the Collegium medicum advertised for young men who wanted to train as junior doctors. They were promised free tuition and a daily allowance of 16 skilling banco, and lectures began on 1 July.
I juni 1956 bad den 30-åriga drottning E: In June 1956 the 30-year-old Queen Elizabeth II asked to see a Swedish residential area. Accompanied by Gustaf VI Adolf, she visited the Larsson family's house at Anundsvägen 49.
I juni 1956 ville 30-åriga drottning Eli: In June 1956 the 30-year-old Queen Elizabeth II wanted to see a Swedish residential area. Together with King Gustaf VI Adolf she visited the villa at Anundsvägen 49, then owned by the Larsson family.
I klocktornet hänger fyra klockor, och s: Four bells hang in the bell tower, and ever since the church opened in 1960 they've been rung by hand – a job taken care of by Markusringarna, a volunteer association. Inside, the windows sit straight in the openings in the walls without frames, and the electrical wiring runs openly across the brick.
I kollektivhuset ger solpaneler på taken: In this co-housing block, solar panels on the roofs supply hot water to every household. Toilet waste is separated and used as fertiliser by nearby farmers, and the eco-toilets have become something of a case study for engineers from abroad.
I kontorshuset mot Västberga allé fanns: From 1957 the office building facing Västberga allé housed AB Datacentralen, a company working in electronic data processing. The kidney-shaped canopy over the entrance, perched on slender columns, is made of copper.
I koret går ett mosaikfönster i glas hel: In the chancel, a mosaic glass window runs all the way from floor to ceiling, nine metres high. It was made by the artists Ralph Bergholtz and Randi Fischer and depicts the Vine and the Branches. The font and pulpit are cast in bare concrete.
I koret går ett nio meter högt mosaikfön: In the chancel, a nine-metre glass mosaic window runs from floor to ceiling. It depicts the Vine and the Branches and was created by the artists Ralph Bergholtz and Randi Fischer.
I koret står ett altarskåp som troligen: In the chancel is an altarpiece probably made in Bernt Notke's workshop in northern Germany around 1480. The 1685 pulpit has a four-glass hourglass, bought in 1785.
I korgaveln sitter ett runt fönster vars: In the chancel gable is a round window whose lead glazing bars spell out the year 1825, when the church's windows were rebuilt. The font is even older: it was carved from sandstone in the late 12th century by the Gotland stonemason known as Semi-Byzantinos.
I kryptan står en orgel byggd 1955 i Köp: The crypt houses an organ built in Copenhagen in 1955. It was moved here in 1985 from Donsö Church in the Gothenburg archipelago.
I kulturhuset finns bibliotek, galleri o: The cultural centre has a library, a gallery and an assembly hall named Erskinesalen after the architect Ralph Erskine. It hosts theatre, concerts, talks and film screenings.
I kvarteren runt Skälby gård har folk hå: People have lived around Skälby gård for a very long time. The manor and its former estate go back to the 16th century, and the current main building, from 1802, is surrounded by no fewer than four burial grounds. Nearby is a pair of Viking Age runestones, U 88 and U 89, known as the runestones by Häradsvägen. Back in the 17th century they already stood inside a ring of smaller round stones.
I kvarteret Drivbänken byggdes 1919–1920: In the Drivbänken block, 43 terraced houses designed by Gunnar Wetterling were built in 1919–1920 as an experiment. Each narrow plot was given a fruit tree, and together the gardens form a green oasis in the middle of the block. For a long time the houses were hard to sell.
I kvarteret Kojan låg från 1968 Hornsber: From 1968 the Kojan block was home to the Hornsberg asphalt works, which was demolished in 2008. The land was then divided into new blocks with names in the same romantic spirit: Sällheten (Bliss), Lycksaligheten (Blessedness), Lyckolandet (the Land of Happiness), Välgången (Prosperity) and Lusten (Desire).
I kyrktornet av tegel och betong hänger: The brick-and-concrete church tower holds 20 bells, all in plain sight. Eighteen belong to the carillon and two are ordinary church bells.
I källaren fanns en badavdelning med bas: The basement had a bathing section with a pool and sauna, and the children could buy breakfast and warm milk at school. Altogether the corridors stretched for more than a kilometre, and 110 teachers taught here.
I källaren fanns ett stort, modernt prov: The basement held a large, modern test dairy with a laboratory, cold room and butter room – fitting for a company that made cream separators. There was also a shop for the staff.
I källaren syns spår från medeltiden: et: The cellar still shows traces of the Middle Ages: a room of rough-hewn stone with a low barrel vault that has survived both fire and the passing centuries. The front of the house has three entrances – the middle door was for the owner's family, while the outer two led to the kitchen and the servants' quarters.
I lövskogen lever bland andra mindre hac: The broadleaf woods are home to lesser spotted woodpeckers, tawny owls, hawfinches and spotted flycatchers, among others. On Agntjärnen pond you can see mallards, goldeneyes, goosanders and tufted ducks.
I maj 1892 spelades Sveriges första fotb: In May 1892, Sweden's first football match was played right here on Heden, between Örgryte IS and IS Lyckans Soldater. A memorial stone marks the spot.
I maj 1957 hölls Sveriges första drive-i: In May 1957 Sweden's first drive-in church service was held here. A thousand cars lined the runway and around 6,000 people took part. In 1960 Sweden's first permanent greyhound track was also built on the airfield.
I maj 2017 invigdes en tillbyggnad på 7: In May 2017 a 7,000-square-metre extension opened, with new operating theatres among other things. It stands exactly where the original 1920s sketches had planned another wing.
I mer än 30 år fanns en bemannad fritids: For more than 30 years Eriksbo had a staffed leisure park where children helped look after goats, pigs, rabbits, hens, budgies and sometimes horses. The animals are long gone, but the park still has an artificial-turf pitch, a basketball court and table-tennis tables.
I mitten av 1700-talet fick tobaksfabrik: In the mid-18th century the tobacco manufacturer Daniel Schiller leased ten acres along Landsvägen – today's Södra vägen – to grow tobacco. Others followed, but after a failed harvest in 1783 the plantations came to an end.
I mitten av 1800-talet bodde Herman Säth: In the mid-1800s the poet Herman Sätherberg's mother lived at Tuna, and Sätherberg often came to visit.
I mitten av 1800-talet var Sjövalla odla: In the mid-1800s Sjövalla was farmland, with fields running right down to Rådasjön lake. This was the site of Gröne Backe, a cottage for estate labourers probably dating from the mid-1700s, which wasn't demolished until 1988.
I mitten av 1830-talet försökte frimurar: In the mid-1830s the Freemasons tried to turn Chalmers into a workhouse for beggar boys. Palmstedt fought back, with support from his friend Jacob Berzelius.
I mitten av 2003 avgjordes VM i paintbal: In mid-2003 the paintball World Cup was played out on the football pitch at Sundbybergs IP. The USA won, ahead of Sweden and Russia. The ground's attendance record is 5,785, set at a league final between Sundbybergs IK and AIK that ended 0–0.
I mittvalvets tak hänger Sven Sahlbergs: From the ceiling of the central vault hangs Sven Sahlberg's Roslagsros, a sculpture in gilded sheet metal with petals made of oars, evoking the water journeys of times past. On the track wall, Lennart Gram's birds fly in the direction of the trains.

From the ceiling of the central vault hangs Sven Sahlberg's Roslagsros, a sculpture in gilded sheet metal that looks like a great golden sun. Its petals are oars, a reminder of journeys by water in days gone by. On the track wall, Lennart Gram's birds fly in the same direction as the trains.
I museets källare finns ett skomakeri, e: The museum's basement holds a cobbler's workshop, a carpenter's shop and a police lock-up – and the other old cell has been turned into a laundry room. The exhibition includes objects from Hässelby's market gardens.
I många år var utbildningen ett internat: For many years this was a residential school that trained only women. Today around 850 students study here, at a school that teaches and researches global nursing and global health.
I nordöstra utkanten av Mölnlycke, mella: On the north-eastern edge of Mölnlycke, between Lake Landvettersjön and the Bråta industrial estate, a residential area called Wendelstrand is being planned. It will stand on the site of a quarry that has since closed.
I norr går Ältavägen genom Nackareservat: To the north, Ältavägen runs through the Nacka nature reserve, past Lakes Dammtorpssjön and Källtorpssjön with Hellasgården. The old country road also survives closer to Lake Sandasjön, but it's a private road belonging to the Erstavik estate.
I norra delen av Rissne, inte långt häri: In the northern part of Rissne, not far from here, the whole blue line goes to bed. Every metro train that runs on the blue line is parked overnight in the Rissne depot, on tracks underground. Between 1975 and 1985, the link track there also carried ordinary passengers, because the section via Huvudsta and Rissne wasn't finished yet.
I närheten har skonaren Ingo sin hemmaha: The schooner Ingo has her home port nearby. Built in 1922, this three-master keeps alive the west coast tradition of sailing historic vessels. A short walk away is Kanalhuset, where SVT, Sveriges Radio and Utbildningsradion – Sweden's public television, radio and educational broadcasters – are based. The building was actually put up for the camera maker Hasselblad, which moved out after only a short time. And Jägaregatan was once home to the Lundby Bio cinema.
I närheten ligger Backa Folkets hus, upp: Nearby is Backa Folkets hus, a community hall built in 1924 and rebuilt and extended in the functionalist style by Sven Wedenmark in 1939. The Rex cinema opened here on 13 September 1940 and showed films until 1958. But that wasn't the end of the big screen: in 1992 Folkets Hus Backa bio opened in the same premises.
I närheten ligger Näsbydal, ett bostadso: Nearby is Näsbydal, an egg-shaped housing estate with 900 flats, ranging from studios with a sleeping alcove to seven-room flats on two floors. The residents' association has its own tennis court, basketball court, boules court and barbecue area. Just a couple of hundred metres away is Kvarntorpshällen, a faint and partly worn-away runic inscription on a slab of rock, discovered by the author Jan Fridegård in 1943.
I närheten låg Fjällbohemmet, ett vårdhe: Nearby was Fjällbohemmet, a care home in Utby from 1939 to 1983. It then became sheltered housing for older people, until it was closed down around 1990. But Utby's history goes back much further: the old Utby parish was absorbed into Partille parish as early as 1571, after its church was destroyed in 1566.
I nästan hundra år tog sjukhuset bara em: For almost a hundred years the hospital admitted only men who wore army uniform, a rule that was abolished in 1933. The grounds are enclosed by a cast-iron fence from 1837 decorated with symbols of both the healing arts and the art of war.
I och runt ravinen står många naturvärde: In and around the ravine stand many veteran trees at least 200 years old. On eastern Henriksdalsberget 35 red-listed species have been found, including the black jewel beetle and the relict longhorn beetle. A footpath with a metal staircase leads through the ravine down to Svindersviken bay.
I oktober 1904 fick Karlsrofältet en rik: In October 1904 the Karlsro field got a proper football pitch, giving the newly founded IFK Göteborg a ground of its own. That autumn the team won four friendlies with a combined score of 8–2. In 1982 the club put up a memorial stone on the spot.
I oktober 1989 hade Stand Up Comedy Klub: In October 1989 the Stand Up Comedy Klubben opened at Norra Brunn – a milestone for Swedish stand-up comedy. The TV show Släng dig i brunnen was recorded here every year from 1990 to 1997.
I oktober 2005 stängde Guldhyttan, den s: In October 2005 Guldhyttan closed – the last shop that had been there since the centre opened in 1965. The metro station and bus terminal were opened by King Carl XVI Gustaf on 21 August 1975.
I oktober 2026 köpte AIK fastigheten för: In October 2026 AIK bought the property for its training facility from Fabege – 7,485 square metres of land. The investment is estimated at 125 million kronor.
I området Kristinedal en bit härifrån ka: In Kristinedal, a short way from here, you can see the 1960s dream of a home of your own. Around a hundred detached, terraced and linked houses were finished in 1964, single-storey and split-level homes in facing brick. It was in small-house areas like this one that the carport made its debut. Neighbouring Sjövalla is older – villas began going up there as early as the 1920s and 1930s.
I området Kummelby låg förr en gård, och: There was once a farm in Kummelby, and on its site the first Kummelby Church was built in 1956–57. It was so small that it could only hold 50 people, which is why it was sometimes called Kummelby's little church. A new church was consecrated just before Christmas 2000. Beside it stands Kummelbystenen, the Kummelby Stone, a runestone from the late 11th century.
I området finns Mariakyrkan i Hammarkull: Round here you'll find Mariakyrkan, St Mary's Church, in Hammarkullen. It used to be called Tomaskyrkan, and – unusually – it's shared by two churches: the Uniting Church in Sweden, Equmeniakyrkan, and Angered parish. In the other direction is Hjällbo centrum, built in 1969, with a fruit and vegetable market hall, a library and a church grouped around the square.

In this area is St Mary's Church in Hammarkullen, formerly St Thomas's, which – unusually – is shared by the Uniting Church in Sweden, Equmeniakyrkan, and Angered parish. The mould-damaged church building has been abandoned and is to be replaced by a new one, so services and activities have moved into temporary huts next door. In the other direction is Hjällbo centrum, built in 1969, with a fruit and vegetable market hall, a library and a church around the square.
I området finns flera fornminnen: en häl: The area is rich in ancient remains: a stone cist, a burial mound, two grave fields, a sunken road and a hillfort. A memorial stone was put up by the stream in 1979.
I området ligger Atlantisområdet, en rad: This area includes the Atlantis estate, a little village of terraced houses designed in the early 1950s by the architects Bertil Karlén, Jon Höjer and Sture Ljungqvist. The houses drew attention from abroad, and today they carry the City Museum's highest heritage rating. From 1968 to 1983, one of them was home to Lisbeth and Olof Palme – the future prime minister – and their three sons.
I området ligger Glose, där betade stran: The area includes Glose, where grazed shore meadows meet the shallow waters of Ryskärsfjorden. Birds and plants both thrive here, and the fjord and Glose's meadows are part of the Nordre älv estuary, a vast nature reserve. The six-kilometre Glose å stream also flows out into the fjord.
I området ligger Gunnestorps mosse, en b: The area includes Gunnestorps mosse, a mix of lake, fen and bog in Hisingsparken, Hisingen's big park. Reeds, bulrushes and water lilies grow here alongside cranberries, sundews and cotton grass. North of the bog are the ruins of Mosstorpet, now part of the Fruktträdgården adventure playground.
I området ligger Helgered, med drygt 240: The area includes Helgered, with just over 240 households on either side of Björlandavägen. In its north-eastern corner is Klare mosse, a lovely place for a walk, where the Osbäcken stream has its source. Helgered also borders the Hisingsparken and Svarte mosse nature areas, so forest and bog are never far away from here.
I området ligger Hisingsparken, Göteborg: This is the area of Hisingsparken, Gothenburg's largest park at around 320 hectares, though it only became an official park in 1980. Its oldest part is S.A. Hedlunds park, laid out in the late 1800s. Runners can choose from four trails, from the 2.8-kilometre blue route to the green one, a full 11.1 kilometres. In the northern part of the park is Kättilsröd 4H farm.
I området ligger Mölnlycke, centralorten: This area includes Mölnlycke, the main town of Härryda municipality, about ten kilometres south-east of central Gothenburg. The Mölndalsån river runs through the centre on its way from Lake Landvettersjön to Lake Rådasjön. Since 2023 the village of Öjersjö in neighbouring Partille has also counted as part of the same urban area, so Mölnlycke has now spilled over the municipal border.
I området ligger Vidkärr, som under mång: The area takes in Vidkärr, for many years the end of the line for tram number 1, until it was extended to Östra sjukhuset hospital in 1982. The first two houses in Vidkärr's garden suburb were finished on 24 January 1922. Right next door is Sävenäs station, where commuter trains stood idle from December 2024 to August 2026 while work went on along the Western Main Line.
I området ligger den lilla sjön Skåtte m: The area includes Skåtte mosse, a small lake about 55 metres above sea level, whose water drains away through the Glose å stream. Not far away is Kärna bokskog, a beech forest that has been a nature reserve since 2008, where the rare wood fescue grass and several red-listed lichens thrive. Parts of the forest have been made accessible.
I området ligger ett stort stenblock med: In the area is a large boulder with 32 cup marks. A grinding stone has been found in a clearance cairn nearby, and the finds point to a Bronze Age settlement.
I området runt omkring, ett par kilomete: Around here, a couple of kilometres south of central Mölndal, is the residential area of Rävekärr. It's known for its grey, square terraced houses, aptly nicknamed ‘lådhus’ – box houses. South-east of the houses, two lakes glitter: Horsikan and Rävekärrs Långevatten.
I området, vid Agnesbergs industriområde: It was here, by the Agnesberg industrial estate, that the riverbank gave way on 14 April 1993. The Agnesberg landslide covered an area of roughly 80 by 30 metres along the Göta älv river. A few hours after the first slide, an eight-metre-wide section broke away further back, and several smaller slides followed during the day. It was one of many landslides in western Sweden after the war.
I parken finns roller derby-banan Rullev: The park has the Rullevi roller derby track, urban gardening plots and the outdoor classroom "Näsan i blöt", created by Santiago Cirugeda of the Spanish architects Recetas Urbanas. Look out too for a large mural by the Dutch artists Haas & Hahn.
I parken finns utomhusbanan \"Rullevi\": The park has an outdoor roller derby track called 'Rullevi', urban allotments and a huge mural by the Dutch artists Haas and Hahn. Since 2014 the GKSS yacht club has also run a sailing school in Frihamnen.
I parken hittar du Mulle Meck med hunden: In the park you'll find Mulle Meck and his dog Buffa, Wilma von Winkelhock's observatory, the Airport, Daisy Diesel's garage and Restaurant Chez Nous. A pond, a boat and a children's library have been added since.
I parken kan du se brun kärrhök, smådopp: In the park you can spot marsh harriers, little grebes and lesser spotted woodpeckers. The western pond is ideally kept free of fish, because the little grebe is sensitive and easily disturbed when fish share its home.
I parken ligger Brygghuset, där gårdens: In the park stands Brygghuset, where the estate’s washing was once boiled before being rinsed down by the shore. The singer Magnus Rudbeck turned it into a home in 1946, and today it’s a summer café – perfect for a fika, the Swedish coffee break.
I parken sparades torpet Kärrtorp, som g: The park preserves the croft of Kärrtorp, which gave the whole district its name. In 2009, parts of the hill were renamed Kärrtorpsparken and Fäholmaskogen, after an old marsh and woodland area called Fäholma.
I parken står det gamla sjukhusets karak: Stora Mans and Stora Kvinns – the old hospital's distinctive men's and women's buildings – still stand in the park. Stora Mans now mainly houses the Metapontum school, while Stora Kvinns has been turned into homes.
I parken står en skulptur av Willy Brand: The park has a sculpture of Willy Brandt by the German sculptor Rainer Fetting. Unveiled in 2007 by guests including former Prime Minister Ingvar Carlsson, it's a smaller copy of a 3.40-metre statue in Berlin.
I parken vid Jakobsbergs folkhögskola, e: In the grounds of Jakobsberg Folk High School, a short way from here, stand two runestones that originally stood on the land of Vibble farm, the old name for Jakobsberg. They've been here for about a hundred years. One of them tells us that Gunnvar and Kättilfrid had the stone raised. Nearby also stood Jakobsberg Mill, a windmill from the 1840s that burned down no fewer than three times: in 1980, 1997 and 2005.

In the park by Jakobsbergs folkhögskola, the folk high school just up the road, are two runestones that originally stood on the land of Vibble gård – the old name for Jakobsberg. They've been in their present spot since 1926. One of them tells us that Gunnvar and Kättilfrid had the stone raised. Nearby also stood Jakobsberg mill, a windmill from the 1840s that burned down no fewer than three times: in 1980, 1997 and 2005.
I parkens förtrollade skog finns ett häx: The park’s enchanted forest has a witch’s house that doubles as a slide, a roundabout shaped like a fly agaric toadstool and a spider to climb on. The ground under the swings looks like a rug, so swinging feels like riding a flying carpet.
I parkens miniatyrstad finns bland annat: The park's miniature town has a hot-dog stand, a jeweller's, a café, an optician, a pet shop, a police station, a hotel and a lighthouse. Lasse-Maja's detective agency itself is housed in a steamship. Everything is built down to the tiniest detail, interiors included.
I parkens södra del finns rester av en l: In the southern part of the park you'll find the remains of a maple avenue from the late 19th century. This was the route of Göta landsväg, Stockholm's southern exit road before Södertäljevägen was built in the late 17th century.
I parkens södra ände står kopior av Per: At the southern end of the park stand copies of Per Hasselberg's statues Tjusningen (Enchantment) and Snöklockan (The Snowdrop). The Snowdrop was the first sculpture in Stockholm put up purely as decoration – earlier monuments generally honoured people or events.
I postala sammanhang heter stadsdelen Hi: The district's postal name is Hisings Kärra, and it covers 1,438 hectares. A little further away is Larsered, whose name is a bit of a mystery. It clearly refers to someone called Lars, but nobody knows who he was. The ending '-red' means cleared woodland, so perhaps it was Lars who once cleared the land.
I reservatet finns förhistoriska gravrös: The nature reserve contains prehistoric burial cairns and traces of farming and settlement from the 1700s and 1800s. As well as oak woodland, there's alder swamp, pine forest on bare rock and a hay meadow.
I reservatet finns också grunden efter V: The reserve also holds the foundations of Villa Nidaros, Trondheim's official pavilion at the 1897 Stockholm Exhibition. After the exhibition the building was shipped here, and it burned down after a lightning strike in 1960.
I reservatets gamla ekar bygger kattuggl: Tawny owls and stock doves nest in the reserve's old oaks. In the meadows you may find the protected elder-flowered orchid, known in Swedish as 'Adam and Eve', and there's also a large stand of butterbur, a medicinal plant since the Middle Ages.
I reservatets sydvästra del finns en kul: In the south-west of the reserve is a historic relic: a defensive position made of stone walls, along with the remains of other stone walls.
I reservatets västra del finns en ädellö: In the western part of the reserve is a broadleaf forest with massive old oaks and slow-grown maples and limes. The steep cliffs down to Drevviken have the feel of virgin forest, with species that only thrive in untouched woodland.
I rondellen vid infarten till Lidingö st: In the roundabout at the entrance to Lidingö stands Till en annan värld, To Another World. Carl Milles only ever made it as a bronze sketch just 66 centimetres high, and it wasn't cast at full size until 2008, long after his death. The municipality commissioned it as a symbol of Lidingö's focus on health and wellbeing, and the 240-centimetre version was created by computer-scanning the original. A little further on is Lidingö town hall from the early 1970s, designed by Sten Samuelson.
I ruinens nordvästra hörn sitter en sten: In the north-west corner of the ruin is a stone carved with two heads from the early Middle Ages. They're thought to depict St Halvard and the woman he tried to save. Legend has it the world will end when the stone reaches the ground – and since the walls are slowly sinking, that could happen if nothing is done.

In the north-west corner of the ruin is a stone carved with two heads, probably St Halvard and the woman he tried to save. Legend has it that the world will end when the stone reaches the ground. The walls are slowly sinking, so without protective measures it really will get there.
I runristningen U 59 i berghällen i Riks: The rune carving U 59, on a rock face in Riksby, says that Näst had these runes carved in memory of his father Faste. The ending can be read as 'Ulv carved', giving the carver's name. The runic band forms a circle about a metre across.
I rusningstrafik går omkring 120 spårvag: At rush hour, around 120 trams and 130 buses an hour leave from Brunnsparken’s ten stops. That probably makes it Sweden’s second-busiest interchange by number of departures, after T-Centralen in Stockholm.
I samarbete med Konstfack hölls workshop: Workshops were held in the first building together with Konstfack, the University of Arts, Crafts and Design, and one result was a table sent to a furniture fair in Milan. Even though the building had no electricity, water or heating, around 1,000 visitors a month came in summer 2008.
I samma hus som Världslitteraturhuset fi: Sharing the building with Världslitteraturhuset, the House of World Literature, is Berättarministeriet – the Ministry of Stories – which works to spark children's love of storytelling. The auditorium on the fourth floor seats 60.
I senare år har Rosie Björkman haft hand: In recent years Rosie Björkman has looked after the disused water tower and used it for her witches' society.
I sitt tal tackade kung Olav inte bara f: In his speech, King Olav gave thanks not only for the training of the soldiers but also for Sweden taking in around 60,000 Norwegian refugees. He also paid tribute to Folke Bernadotte and the White Buses. The stone was presented in 1983, 40 years after the first camp for Norwegian police troops opened.
