For a long time Stora Essingens Wärdshus was the only building on the island – a waterside inn on the sailing route into Stockholm, from the 1700s until 1876. The west wing survives as a private home, and Värdshusparken and Värdshusbryggan, the Inn Park and Inn Jetty, keep its memory alive.
Längre in än hit kom fartygen inte, efte: Ships couldn't get any further upriver than this, as the river was too shallow. Instead, cargo was transferred to smaller lighters that carried goods and passengers on into town. The Swedish East India Company also had its harbour here for ships returning from China.
Längre upp i parken står Karl XIII omgiv: Further up the park stands Charles XIII, surrounded by sculpted lions. An old joke had it that one statue showed a lion surrounded by pots – Charles XII with his mortars – while the other showed a pot surrounded by lions.
Längre västerut än så här kommer man int: This is as far west as the metro goes: Norsborg is the westernmost station on the whole network and has been the end of the red line since 1975. A short walk away is the Botkyrka poorhouse. Built in 1798, it took in the poor right up until 1911 and then served as an old people's home and nursing home. Since 1998 it has been full of schoolchildren again, as the independent school Botkyrka friskola holds its lessons here.
Längs Aspens naturstig går spänger högt: Along the Aspen nature trail, boardwalks run high above the marshes. South of Lindhov farm an extra-wide boardwalk leads through an alder wood, where the straight trunks form a kind of colonnade. A detour takes you to the mighty oaks on Ekholmen.
Längs Bergsunds strand låg förr varv och: Shipyards and workshops used to line the Bergsund waterfront. Just across the water is Långholmen, which for many years was home to Stockholm's central prison until it closed in 1975. Today the old prison is a hotel and hostel, and the island has a popular swimming spot and lovely walking trails.

Bergsunds strand was once lined with shipyards and workshops. Across the water is Långholmen, for many years home to Stockholm's central prison, which closed in 1975. Today the old prison is a hotel and hostel, and the island has a popular swimming spot.
Längs Bäckvägen står Uppenbarelsekyrkan: Along Bäckvägen stand the Church of the Epiphany and 1940s slab blocks designed by Rolf Hagstrand and Edvin Engström, among others. At Bäckvägen 41 is the Flora building, one of ten contenders for Stockholm Building of the Year 2021.
Längs Delsjövägen låg förr Synvillan, so: Delsjövägen was once home to Synvillan, 'the Optical Illusion' – Gothenburg's tongue-in-cheek nickname for the old Swedish Television and Swedish Radio building. SVT moved out in 2007, and the building was torn down in 2010 to make way for housing. One of the new blocks, Studio 1, built in black-fired Danish brick, won the Kasper Salin Prize, Sweden's top architecture award, in 2016 – and that same year it was also nominated for the Kasper Kalkon, the 'turkey' prize for the ugliest building of the year.
Längs Doktor Liborius gata står sex niov: Lining Doktor Liborius gata are six nine-storey point blocks from 1950–1952, designed by Sven Brolid and Jan Wallinder. They're admired for their two offset sections joined by a glazed stairwell. Each block had its own developer.
Längs Ekerövägen gick en äldre färdväg,: An older road ran along what is now Ekerövägen, and four milestones from the 1850s or 1860s still stand. They were put up at the initiative of the county governor, Gustaf Fredrik Liljencrantz, whose initials you can see on the stones.
Längs Ekerövägen väster om Träkvista fin: Along Ekerövägen, west of Träkvista, is Fantans hög, an offering cairn with a grim legend attached. Fantan is said to have murdered her husband and been forced to run the gauntlet: if she made it far enough up the Asknäsmalmen ridge to see Ekerö Church, she would go free. She collapsed just short of it and was stoned to death. Legend has it that anyone passing should leave a coin, a stone or a dry twig.
Längs Elfviksvägen finns två villor av a: Along Elfviksvägen are two villas by the architect Ralph Erskine: Villa Molin from 1947, built for the garden designer and editor Ulla Molin, and Villa Gadelius, designed in 1961 for the businessman Knut Saburo Gadelius. A little further on is the Canada block. Its terraced houses, together with those in Gamla Enskede, are thought to be the very first in Sweden, and they've been listed since 1981.
Längs Farstaviken byggde porslinsfabrike: Along Farstaviken bay, the Odelberg family of the porcelain factory built their dream homes. In 1910 Ferdinand Boberg designed Villa Farsta Udde for Maria Bennich, daughter of the factory director Wilhelm Odelberg, and shortly afterwards, probably, Villa Strandvik for her brother Axel. The director himself lived in Farsta Castle, whose original building from the 1620s was burned down by the Russians in 1719. On a hill by the harbour is a burial ground from the late Iron Age.

Along Farstaviken bay, the Odelberg family, who owned the porcelain factory, built their dream homes. In 1910 Ferdinand Boberg designed Villa Farsta udde for Maria Bennich, the daughter of factory director Wilhelm Odelberg, and the following year Villa Strandvik for her brother Axel. The director himself lived at Farsta Manor, whose original 1620s building was burned down by the Russians in 1719. On a hill by the harbour lies a late Iron Age burial ground.
Längs Farstavägen ligger kvarteren Kampö: Along Farstavägen are the Kampö and Hartsö blocks, with late-1950s terraced houses designed by the architect Birger Nygell and recognised by the City Museum for their heritage value. A short walk away, Farsta torg opens out before you. Laid out like an Italian piazza, it was inaugurated on 23 October 1960. The square was once lined with department stores – Nordiska Kompaniet, Kvickly and Tempo – and the shopping centre has been voted shopping centre of the year several times.
Längs Gamla Tyresövägen byggdes kedjehus: The link houses of the Sparsamheten housing cooperative were built along Gamla Tyresövägen in 2009, designed by Kjellander och Sjöberg. They share the block with the original owner-built homes.
Längs Gamla Tyresövägen står 19 radhus f: Along Gamla Tyresövägen stand 19 terraced houses from 2009, designed by Kjellander and Sjöberg. They're essentially detached, joined only by a balcony, and the row is set at a slight angle to the road for a sense of perspective. The block was nominated for Stockholm Building of the Year 2010.
Längs Hagaparken, där Gustav III köpte H: Along Haga Park, where Gustav III bought Haga in 1771.
Längs Hammarby sjö låg Sickla park, en p: Along Hammarby sjö lay Sickla park, a popular day-out spot for south Stockholmers and the great gathering place of the temperance movement. It was thought to outshine even Djurgården in beauty. Until the 1920s the lake was four metres higher than it is today.
Längs Hornsgatan och genom Hornstull, As: Along Hornsgatan and through Hornstull, Aspudden and Örnsberg.
Längs Hornsgatan passerar du Bysis, Stoc: Along Hornsgatan you pass Bysis, Stockholm's old debtors' prison, and Zinkensdamm.
Längs Kyrkvikens norra sida står två av: Along the north side of Kyrkviken bay stand two giant oaks – among the municipality's only protected natural monuments. The larger has a trunk 684 centimetres round. They were given protection in 1969.
Längs Lantmäterivägen går en gammal tipp: An old landfill runs along Lantmäterivägen, marking the northern edge of Hummelmoraberget, a hilly part of the Görväln nature reserve where, after the Ice Age, the waves left beach ridges of gravel and stone. In the other direction, in Viksjö centre, is Viksjö Church, consecrated as recently as 2005 by Bishop Caroline Krook.
Längs Lilla Värtans strand passerar Södr: Along the shore of Lilla Värtan, the Södra Lidingöstråket trail passes Herserudsklippan cliff. At the top, Carl Milles built his home, Millesgården, in 1908. Next door stands the castle-like Villa Foresta, built in 1908–1910 as a private home and a hotel since 1957.
Längs Långedragsvägen fanns förr bio. Ol: Långedragsvägen was once a street of cinemas. Olympia opened in 1929 and kept going until 1971, and even earlier, from 1919 to 1925, the Oden cinema stood here, just outside what was then the city boundary. The Kungssten area was simply known as Stadsgränsen, the City Boundary. A short way off are the Sjöbergen allotments, where people were already keeping small animals in the 1930s.
Längs Malmvägen står tio höghus med 1 24: Ten tower blocks with 1,247 flats line Malmvägen, which is why locals call the street 'Tian', the Ten. The service building, designed by Åke Arell, drew international attention when it opened in 1972, with preschools, shops and club rooms all gathered on the ground floor. Towering over the square is the fifteen-storey Turebergshuset, home to the municipal offices and, since 2023, the library too.
Längs Margaretavägen står Gamla Enskedes: Along Margaretavägen stand the Gamla Enskede terraced houses, known as the English terraces. Together with the Canada Houses on Lidingö, they're Sweden's very first terraced houses. Enskede Church stands out on a rise in a park in the middle of the villas. And on Enskedevägen is Enskedestationen, a former electricity substation from 1911 that's now offices.
Längs Margaretavägen står några av Sveri: Along Margaretavägen are some of the very first terraced houses in Sweden. The terraces of Gamla Enskede – also known as the English terraces – were, together with the Canada houses on Lidingö, the first in the country. The City Museum has marked all 37 homes, in six rows, blue for their outstanding cultural value. Gamla Enskede is a garden city, and it's also home to Enskede skola, one of Stockholm's largest primary schools, with more than 900 pupils.
Längs Mälarens strand ligger Sätraskogen: Along the shore of Lake Mälaren lie the Sätraskogen nature reserve and the Mälarhöjdsbadet beach. There's also a campsite in western Bredäng.
Längs Mälarstranden går en strandpromena: A waterside path runs along the shore of Lake Mälaren through the Sätraskogen nature reserve, from Liljeholmen to Vårberg, with views across to Ekerö. Along the way are two bathing spots and historic sites such as Skärholmen manor and the Sätra boatyard.
Längs Saltsjön och Hammarby sjö låg Stoc: Along the Saltsjön and Hammarby sjö waterfronts lay Stockholm's heavy industry: shipyards, mills, engine works and light-bulb factories. This route takes you by boat, bus and tram through places where the workshops have become homes, arts centres and a whole new district.
Längs Saltvägen heter kvarteren bland an: Along Saltvägen the blocks have names such as Skeppsskorpan, Kryddosten, Bordssaltet, Kaffebalen and Kardemumman – Ship's Biscuit, Spiced Cheese, Table Salt, Coffee Bale and Cardamom. By Kaffebalen and Kardemumman is the highest point in Hökarängen, 61 metres above sea level.
Längs Smörgatan står ett däckshus från 1: Along Smörgatan stands a 'deck house' from 1960 by the architect Erik Friberger: three levels of concrete decks topped with 18 detached houses. It was built as an experiment in flexible, prefabricated housing and is one of a kind.
Längs Sollentunavägen växte gästgivargår: Coaching inns sprang up along Sollentunavägen for travellers between the towns, including at Rotebro, Edsbacka and Silverdal. Edsbacka krog was established in 1626 and had two Michelin stars at the turn of the millennium.
Längs Strandvägen ligger ön Vågaskär med: Along Strandvägen lies the little island of Vågaskär with Björn Ulvaeus's villa, and Villa Grimberg, which once belonged to the historian Carl Grimberg. The Japanese and Czech ambassadors also have their residences here.
Längs Sveavägen här har kulturlivet levt: This stretch of Sveavägen has a rich cultural life. The Golden Circle – Gyllene Cirkeln – a jazz club in the ABF building, kept the music going from 1962 to 1969. And in Kårhuset, the Student Union Building, opened in 1935 with a speech by Prince Eugen, students staged their famous occupation in May 1968. The Grand cinema has been showing films since 1933. And here's a bit of trivia: Rådmansgatan is the only metro station named after a street.
Längs fornstigen passerar du ett område: Along the heritage trail you pass an area that was probably a harbour in the Viking Age, and Rörby farm, whose cellar probably dates from the 16th century. There's also a replica of the architect Ralph Erskine's first home in Sweden, known as Lådan – the Box.
Längs gamla Södertäljevägen, strax norr: Along the old Södertäljevägen road, just north of Långbro Hospital, there used to be an inn called Långpannan. It began life as a croft belonging to the Långbro estate and was pulled down in 1964. The name Långbro itself goes back even further: it comes from a medieval causeway of logs – a 'long bridge' – that carried Göta landsväg, the old highway, across the area.
Längs gatan ligger Sankt Görans sjukhus,: Along this street you’ll find St Göran’s Hospital, Stockholm’s nursing home Stockholms sjukhem and St Göran’s upper secondary school. Kungsholmen’s elementary school once stood at numbers 30–34, and by number 21 there’s an entrance down to Fridhemsplan metro station.
Längs gatan ligger också kvarteret Svärd: Also on this street is the Svärdsliljan block from 1927 – one of the housing cooperative HSB's first developments of landshövdingehus, Gothenburg's distinctive tenements with a stone ground floor and wooden upper storeys.
Längs ledningen står kontrollstationer v: Along the water main stand control stations whose fronts look like little granite houses. They're numbered – the one in Segeltorp is number 10. Both the stations and the water keepers' cottages were designed by the architect Erik Josephson.
Längs länsvägen mellan Mölnlycke och Möl: Lilla Kullbäckstorp lies along the county road between Mölnlycke and Mölndal, and just a short way off is Lake Vällsjön, glittering and only four and a half metres deep. On the far side of the lake begins Pixbo, a very hilly residential area built on and around a height called Björnåsen. Pixbo even has its own postal town.
Längs postvägen mot Åbo: On the post road to Turku
Längs promenadvägen vid grottan reser si: Along the footpath by the cave rises a very steep cliff with a hillfort on top. It also has some of Stockholm's hardest climbing routes, and inside the rock there's a sealed military store from the Second World War.
Längs spårvägen finns tre typiska torg f: Along tramline 12 there are three typical squares from the 1920s and 1930s: Smedslättstorget, Höglandstorget and Nockeby torg, the last to be built. Almost every stop had its own shops and was self-sufficient.
Längs strandpromenaden västerut ligger r: Along the waterfront path to the west are the remains of the farm's English garden, with great oaks and larches. On a knoll out on the point stands the temple, an octagonal summerhouse from around 1800 with a curved metal roof and painted coffers inside its dome. Hässelby Chess Club has held a Midsummer celebration there every year since 1972.
Längs takkanten löper en latinsk text oc: A Latin inscription runs along the edge of the stone's roof-shaped top, and a runic one along its ridge. The Latin says, among other things, that a noble man rests here, along with a prayer to Christ that Björn may be cleansed of sin. The lettering is faint today, but it can still be read thanks to drawings made in 1624 and 1721.
Längs vägen från Gloseby till Ryskärsfjo: Along the road from Gloseby to Ryskärsfjorden, work has been done to boost the wild flowers on the verges. In 2025 the Swedish Society for Nature Conservation highlighted it in its campaign "The world's longest flower meadow".
Längs vägen från Gloseby till fjorden ha: Along the road from Gloseby to the fjord, the wildflowers on the verges have been encouraged to flourish. In 2025 the Swedish Society for Nature Conservation highlighted this in its campaign 'The world's longest flower meadow'.
Längs vägen ligger Bergendals herrgård,: Along the road stands Bergendal manor, built in the 1910s at the initiative of the match manufacturer and landowner Ragnar Liljenroth. Edsberg Palace, from 1760, was the Rudbeck family's residence for more than 200 years.
Längs vägen står bland annat Klockhuset: Along the road you'll find the 1918 Klockhuset (Clock House), designed by Ivar Callmander, and Kämpetorpsskolan from 1952, designed by Paul Hedqvist. LM Ericsson's cable works in Älvsjö is here too.
Längs vägen växte gästgivargårdar fram f: Coaching inns sprang up along the road to serve travellers, among them at Rotebro, Edsbacka and Silverdal. Edsbacka krog was founded in 1626 and won two Michelin stars around the turn of the millennium.
Längs Ältavägen i Nackareservatet ligger: Along Ältavägen in the Nacka reserve is the croft of Snörom. The name probably means ‘snöra om’, to turn back, after the sharp bend the old highway made outside the cottage. During the Second World War a military roadblock was set up here, and it stayed in place well into the 1960s.
Längs Ältavägen ligger torpet Snörom, so: Along Ältavägen lies the croft of Snörom, which probably owes its name to the sharp bend the old highway made outside the cottage ('snöra om' means to swing round). During the Second World War a military roadblock was set up here, and it stayed in place until well into the 1960s.
Längs Ältavägen ligger torpet Snörom. Na: Along Ältavägen lies the croft Snörom. The name probably means “turn back”, after the old country road that made a sharp bend outside the cottage. During the Second World War a military roadblock was set up here, and it stayed in place well into the 1960s.
Längs Ältavägen låg dagsverkstorpet Snör: Along Ältavägen was the croft of Snörom – pronounced ‘snör-om’, but also known as Snurrom – whose tenants paid their rent in labour on the Erstavik estate. North of Lake Sandasjön stood Tuppstugan, a former croft for a soldier-sailor that has gone by names such as Oxberget, Svartbäcken and Solmärke. The 18th-century cottage had unique wall paintings by the artist Olle Nyman, but sadly it burned down over the Whitsun weekend of 2004.
Längs Älvsjövägen står bland annat Klock: Buildings along Älvsjövägen include Klockhuset, the Clock House, from 1918, designed by Ivar Callmander, and Kämpetorp School from 1952 by Paul Hedqvist. Until 1924 the street was called Odenvägen.
Längst bak i samlingssalen hänger en tri: At the back of the assembly hall hangs a painted textile triptych by Ingrid Nilsson and Elisabeth Knall, showing an archipelago landscape beneath a wide horizon. The font was designed by Christer Jonsson at Konstfack, the University of Arts, Crafts and Design.
Längst i norr stod ett 90 meter högt tel: At the northern end stood a 90-metre concrete telecoms tower, built for radio relay links. It was a Farsta landmark until it was demolished in 2023 to make room for housing.
Längst i söder ligger Hägerstalunds gård: At the far southern end lies Hägerstalund farm, with avenues of ash trees, a park and ponds. There has been an inn in the farm building since 1987.
Längst ner i vattentornet är hörnen utfo: At the base of the water tower, the corners are shaped as pilasters that seem to carry the upper part, and at the top the tower is crowned by a heavy cornice. The water was pumped up here from a newly built pumping station in Bagaregården.
Längst norrut, där gårdens ståtliga lind: At the far northern end, where the estate's stately avenue of lime trees begins, is the gatehouse at Orhemsvägen 100. The farm is mentioned as early as 1409, as a smallholding. Today's main building, from the 1860s, has a large entrance veranda and a central gable with a lunette window.
Längst ut i Askims skärgård spolas skäre: Out at the edge of the Askim archipelago the skerries are washed by salt water, and little grows there but lichens and salt-tolerant grasses. On the larger Amundö islands people have even farmed, and in sheltered spots sessile oak, silver birch and black alder thrive.
Längst ut ligger skär som ständigt skölj: Furthest out are bare skerries, constantly washed by salt water and fertilised by bird droppings. The larger Amundö islands have even been farmed, and in sheltered spots sessile oak, silver birch and alder grow.
Längst ut på piren i Järlasjön står en A: At the end of the pier on Lake Järlasjön stands an AGA lighthouse from 1927, which for many years guided ships through Fårösund. It recalls that Gustaf Dalén founded AGA here in 1904 – and it still works.
Lännafortet sträcker sig som en lång kor: The Länna fort stretches through the landscape like a long sausage – hence its nickname, the Korvlinjen or Sausage Line. The fortifications were paid for by private individuals and then donated to the military.
Lännerstasundet har en tröskel vid Bagge: Lännerstasundet has a sill at Baggensstäket that leaves its water stagnant and low in oxygen. In 2009 a pilot project began pumping oxygen-rich surface water down to the bottom to counter the excess phosphorus.
Länsmansgården byggdes 1929 och var tjän: Länsmansgården was built in 1929 as the official residence of the district police chief, Herbert Lilienborg. When the motorway was built in 1968 the house was moved, along with the old lock-up, a small 18th-century log building.
Länsmansgårdens kyrka från 1972 byggdes: Länsmansgården's church from 1972 was built from prefabricated modules and, together with the almost identical Hammarkullen church, was meant to be a model for mass-produced churches. Inside, the tall, steep roof is reminiscent of a tent.
Läppstiftet heter så dels för att huset: Läppstiftet – the Lipstick – owes its name partly to its shape and partly to the fact that the Diocese of Gothenburg (in Swedish, 'stift') has its offices here. Another nickname is Vattenståndet, the Water Level, as the building stands right at the water's edge.
Läraren som flyttade till Millesgården: The teacher who moved to Millesgården
Läraren var också organist: The teacher was the organist too
Lärarens lön 1847 var 53 riksdaler banco: In 1847 the teacher's pay was 53 riksdaler banco, eight barrels of grain and two more for a cow's grazing. On top of that came a vegetable plot, two church collections a year and a free home.
Lärarna tog över skolan: The teachers took over the school
Lärje var en gång den första stationen p: Lärje was once the first station out of Gothenburg on the Västergötland–Gothenburg Railway, about six kilometres from the city station. Just beyond it, the line crossed the tracks of the Bergslagen Railway on a viaduct and then followed the valley of the Lärjeån river. The Alelyckan sports centre is close by, too.
Lärjeholms gård, alldeles i närheten, ha: Lärjeholms gård, the farm close by, has an arched stone bridge over the Lärjeån river just to the east, and this is where the river flows into the Göta älv. Nearby runs the two-kilometre Tideräkningsgatan – roughly “Calendar Street” – one of 54 streets in Kortedala that were all named in 1953 using words taken from the almanac.
Lärjeån flyter genom en gammal fjorddal: Lärjeån flows through an old fjord valley where the sea once laid down clay up to 70 metres thick. Since the Ice Age, the river has cut its way down through the clay, carving out a landscape of ravines and meanders.
Lärjeån har gett namn åt Lärjedalen, som: The Lärjeån river gave its name to Lärjedalen, a district in its own right from 1989 to 2010 that took in Hammarkullen, Hjällbo and Agnesberg. The river rises north of Gråbo and flows into the Göta älv at Lärjeholm, draining an area of 119 square kilometres. Closer to the stop is the Bäckebol Center retail park.
Lärjeån rinner genom en gammal fjorddal: Lärjeån flows through an ancient fjord valley where the sea deposited clay up to 70 metres thick. Since the Ice Age the river has cut down into the clay, creating a landscape of ravines and meanders quite unlike the otherwise level clay plateau.

Lärjeån flows through an ancient fjord valley where the sea laid down up to 70 metres of clay. Since the Ice Age the river has cut its way down through the clay, creating a landscape of ravines and meanders.

Lärjeån flows through an ancient fjord valley where the sea left behind clay up to 70 metres deep. Since the Ice Age the river has carved its way down into the clay, shaping a landscape of ravines and winding meanders in the middle of an otherwise flat clay plain.
Lärjeån slingrar sig genom en gammal fjo: Lärjeån winds through an ancient fjord valley, where the sea left clay deposits up to 70 metres thick. The river has cut down into the clay, creating a landscape of ravines and meanders. In dry summers parts of it shrink to a mere stream.
Lärjeån, som slingrar förbi en bit härif: The Lärjeån river, winding past a short way from here, gave the former district of Lärjedalen its name. It rises north of Gråbo and joins the Göta älv river at Lärjeholm, draining an area of 119 square kilometres. Nearby is the Bäckebol Center retail park, with around twenty shops.
Lärjeåns dalgång är en gammal fjorddal d: The Lärjeån valley is an old fjord valley where the sea laid down clay up to 70 metres thick. As the land rose after the Ice Age, the river cut its way down, carving out a landscape of ravines and winding meanders.
Lärjeåns dalgångs naturreservat är kommu: The Lärjeån valley nature reserve is run by the municipality and has been protected since 2026. It covers no less than 1,148.69 hectares.
Lärkstadens villor har haft spännande gr: The villas of Lärkstaden have had some intriguing neighbours. The one on the corner of Baldersgatan and Valhallavägen was designed by the architect Erik Josephson as his own home. Since then it has been the Danish ambassador's residence and the embassy of both Yugoslavia and Serbia. The villa next door, designed by Torben Grut, has been Libya's embassy since 1978. And a little further along, a villa was built for the theatre and film producer Anders Sandrew.
Läs- och slöjdskola för flickor: A reading and craft school for girls
Läste till halv två på natten: Reading until half past one at night
Låg bro på nio pelare: A low bridge on nine pillars
Låna 90 procent till huset: Borrow 90 per cent for your house
Lånet som inte gick att säga upp: A loan that couldn't be called in
Lång tur västerut via Brommaplan, där vi: A long ride west via Brommaplan, where the 1944 viaduct first carried trams, and Råcksta with its 1950s neon sign.
Långa radens höga hus byggdes som en skä: The tall houses of Långa raden were built as a screen between the new highway and the humbler buildings behind. Until 1891 the road ran right in front of the houses. It was then moved ten metres south, but the old route with its avenue of trees is still there.
Långbro gård har anor från senare delen: Långbro gård dates back to the late 1400s and was already a manor estate by the end of the 1500s. It gave its name to the district, and the name in turn comes from a long medieval causeway made of logs – långbro means 'long bridge'. It probably ran where the northernmost stretch of Sjättenovembervägen is today. The main house has been marked in blue by the City Museum for its historical value, and it now contains public rental flats.
Långbro sjukhus ritades av Gustaf Wickma: Långbro Hospital was designed by Gustaf Wickman on 56 acres of woodland that the city bought from Alfred Söderlund. At its peak, in the 1970s, it had 1,350 beds. Today the heart of the hospital grounds is Långbroparken park.
Långbrodalsskolan byggdes 1914–1915 efte: Långbrodalsskolan was built in 1914–1915 to designs by Georg A. Nilsson, and Örbyskolan and Enskede skola went up at the same time to exactly the same plans. The original building is now known as 'the Castle' and the extension as 'the Palace'.
Långbrodalsvägen hette tidigare Storgata: Långbrodalsvägen used to be called Storgatan, and briefly, in 1928–1931, Långsjövägen. The first villa in Långbrodal was built in 1899 by the shopkeeper Nils Holmqvist at what is now Långbrodalsvägen 55, and it's still standing.
Långholmen och fängelsemuseet: Långholmen island and the prison museum
Långholmens folkhögskola startade 1987 o: Långholmen folk high school opened in 1987, run by the Stockholm County branch of the LO trade union confederation. In 1989 it moved into the Fasta paviljongen at Långholmen's old central prison, and in the summer of 2017 it came here to Marabouparken.
Långsjö var ett torp under Långbro gård: Långsjö was a croft belonging to Långbro farm, mentioned as Longsiön as early as 1627. In 1908 a company called AB Billiga Tomter – “Cheap Plots Ltd” – took over the land and began dividing it up and selling plots.
Långsjöbadet invigdes 1938. Innan dess v: Långsjöbadet opened in 1938. Before that the site was marshland with sewage ditches, big alders and reeds described as impenetrable. Today the lido has a sandy beach about 50 metres long.
Långsjöbadet opened in 1938. Before that the shore was marshland with sewage ditches, big alders and "impenetrable" reeds. Today there's a sandy beach about 50 metres long and a few bathing jetties.
Långsjöhöjden når 73 meter över havet oc: Långsjöhöjden rises 73 metres above sea level, making it the second-highest natural point in the City of Stockholm after Vikingaberget at 77 metres. From the top you can look out over Huddinge and south-west Stockholm.
Långsjön har problem med övergödning och: Långsjön suffers from eutrophication and heavy algal blooms, so Stockholm Vatten pumps 30 litres of clean drinking water a second into the lake. It's also an important breeding site for amphibians.
Långsjön är bara tre meter djup men har: Långsjön is only three metres deep, but it has an important job: it marks the boundary between the municipalities of Stockholm and Huddinge – or, to be precise, between the residential areas of Herrängen and Segeltorp. On the lake's northern shore is Långsjö gård, dating back to the 1600s, when it was a croft belonging to the Långbro estate. Segeltorpsvägen was named in 1928 after Segeltorp farm, which was pulled down in 1964.
Långsjön är en liten sjö med badplats oc: Långsjön is a small lake with a swimming spot and a 1.4-kilometre jogging trail around it, and since 2005 the lake and its immediate surroundings have been a nature reserve. It's 5.6 metres deep and sits just over 20 metres above sea level. A little further away, in Storängen, stands Villa Widstrand, built in 1906 for the publisher Wilhelm Widstrand of the publishing house Wahlström och Widstrand.
Långsjöns reservat är ett typiskt mellan: The Långsjön reserve is a typical central Swedish fault-valley landscape. The hill to the south is covered in pine and spruce, while the northern part is flat clay. An 18th-century map shows the lower ground was once meadow and pasture.
Långsjövägen, ett par hundra meter bort,: Långsjövägen, a couple of hundred metres away, is no ordinary villa street. From its northern end up to Myrvägen it follows the old Göta landsväg, the historic highway to Götaland, and it forms the boundary between Älvsjö and Långbro and between Älvsjö and Långsjö. Close by is Långsjöhöjden, which is a nature area, a residential area and a street all at once.
Långt före fabriken tillhörde marken Sto: Long before the factory arrived, the land belonged to Stora Sickla farm. In the 1860s plots by the Saltsjön waters were split off and leased out as summer retreats with names like Gustafshög, Jacobsdal, Augustendal and Ellensvik.
Långt före vattentornet fanns här en res: Long before the water tower, there was a reservoir here. An advertising brochure promised 'crystal-clear' water from deep-drilled wells and played up its high radium content, then thought to be good for your health. A lookout tower next to it was said to offer 'the most beautiful view over Stockholm and Lidingö'.
Långt i och grav accent: A long i and a grave accent
Långt in på 1800-talet bodde mest varvsa: Well into the 19th century, Tyskbagarbergen was mostly home to shipyard workers, guardsmen and cowmen, and it was one of the poorest parts of Stockholm. The writer Almqvist called it "a most notorious neighbourhood". In 1846 August Blanche predicted that a gold mine would be found here, but no gold ever turned up.
Långt in på 1950-talet drev trädgårdsmäs: Until well into the 1950s, the gardener Allan Mårtensson and his wife Tyra ran a market garden here. It was cleared in 1962, but the white villa Lugnet from 1928 still stands at Söndagsvägen 80.
Långt innan Botaniska fanns ville Arvid: Long before the Botanical Garden existed, Arvid Gren dreamed of turning the bare hills around Änggården into an English-style park. With the gardener Anders Jonsson he planted thousands of trees, mostly in the 1860s and 1870s, choosing different species so the foliage would change colour through the year.
Långt innan husen byggdes fanns här ett: Long before the houses went up, this was an Iron Age burial ground with a domarring – a circle of standing stones. In the broadleaf woods you'll also find a hollow way, an old track worn down into the ground by people and animals.
Långt innan industriområdena fanns Nylös: Long before the industrial estates came along, there was Nylöse parish, the parish of the old town of Nya Lödöse. It ceased to exist around 1624, but the hospital's congregation carried on and in 1627 became Gothenburg's hospital parish, which lasted right up until 1883. The Marieholm industrial estate, incidentally, takes its name from the Marieholm landeri, one of Gothenburg's old country estates.
Långt innan någon bro fanns rodde färjor: Long before any bridge existed, ferries were rowed between Torsvik and Ropsten. The first Lidingö Bridge was built in 1803, but between Larsberg and Kaknäs. In 1884, when Värtahamnen harbour was built, it was replaced by a pontoon bridge between Torsvik and Ropsten.
Långt innan tunnelbanan fanns här rullad: Trams were rolling past here long before the metro arrived: from 1930 the Örbybanan line ran by, with a stop on this very spot. The metro came in 1951, at first with a temporary station, and the permanent station opened in 1953 as the end of the line. In fact, the metro between Globen and Stureby follows the route of the old tramway.
Låtar om spårvagnen, biografer som blivi: Songs about the tram, cinemas turned into shops, and arenas where the stands used to shake. A route for anyone who loves music, film and sport.
Léonie Geisendorf tyckte att stadsplanen: Léonie Geisendorf found the town plan for Fyrtalet monotonous and proposed, among other things, three round towers instead. Slab blocks were built all the same. The site for the other three buildings was occupied by the scenery stores of the Royal Opera and the Royal Dramatic Theatre, which held up the plans until they were dropped.
Löfsta Handelsförening bildades 1898 och: Löfsta Handelsförening was founded in 1898 and was the first consumer co-operative in Greater Stockholm. The shop stood by the avenue to Riddersvik farm, and its first manager, Johan Åberg, later became a member of parliament.

Löfsta Handelsförening was founded in 1898 as the first consumer cooperative in Greater Stockholm. Its first manager, Johan Åberg, was later elected to both the municipal council and the Riksdag, Sweden's parliament.
Löfsta Handelsförening bildades här 1898: Löfsta Handelsförening was founded here in 1898 and was the first consumer co-operative in Greater Stockholm. Incidentally, the place was called Riddersvik until 1913, and from 1926 to 1949 Hässelby villastad was a municipality in its own right.
Löfströms innebandyinriktning startade l: Löfström's floorball programme started in the 2004–05 school year in cramped premises with just seven students – five boys and two girls. Today almost 60 students are enrolled, and one of them has gone on to become an under-19 world champion.
Löftet som blev ett köp: The vow that became a purchase
Löftets kyrka invigdes 1961 men blev öve: Löftets kyrka was consecrated in 1961 but became surplus to requirements when the Solna and Råsunda parishes merged in 2008. It was let to other congregations and sold in 2014. Today it houses businesses, and the bells have been removed from the bell tower.
Löparbana av gamla bildäck: A running track made of old tyres
Lötgubben i jordkulan: The old man in the earth hut
Lötsjökapellet uppfördes 1925 med gulbei: Lötsjö Chapel was built in 1925, with yellowish-beige limewashed brick walls and a delicate wrought-iron cross on the roof. The west front has classical-style granite columns beneath a round window.
Lötsjön är grund och näringsrik, och här: Lötsjön is shallow and rich in nutrients, and both swimming and fishing are banned. Instead, it's very much a birdwatcher's lake, with a heron colony among other things. There are nine small islands in the lake, one of them built on.
Lövgärdet ligger längst i norr av Götebo: Lövgärdet lies at the very northern tip of mainland Gothenburg, bordering Surte in Ale municipality. Just to the north begin the Vättlefjäll nature reserve and Lake Surtesjön.
Lövgärdet ligger längst i norr i Götebor: Lövgärdet is the northernmost part of Gothenburg on the mainland, right on the boundary with Surte. Just to the north lie the Vättlefjäll nature reserve and Lake Surtesjön.
Lövgärdet ligger längst i norr på Götebo: Lövgärdet lies furthest north on Gothenburg's mainland side, bordering Surte in Ale municipality. Just to the north are the Vättlefjäll nature reserve and Lake Surtesjön.
Lövgärdet var det sista av Göteborgs mil: Lövgärdet was the last of Gothenburg's Million Programme estates, part of Sweden's great 1960s–70s housing drive. It was built in 1970–1978 with around 3,600 flats – low slab blocks to the south and tall tower blocks to the north. In 1998 half the tower blocks in Övre Lövgärdet were demolished.

Lövgärdet was the last of Gothenburg’s Million Programme estates, part of Sweden’s great 1960s–70s housing drive. Built between 1970 and 1978, it has some 3,600 flats, with the 1975 shopping centre midway between southern and upper Lövgärdet.

Lövgärdet was the last of Gothenburg's Million Programme estates – the great 1960s–70s state housing drive. It was built in 1970–1978 with around 3,600 flats, and in 1998 half the tower blocks in Övre Lövgärdet were torn down.
Lövgärdets kyrka, en kort promenad härif: Lövgärdet Church, a short walk from here, is a church that's no longer a church. It was deconsecrated on 19 June 2016. While it was in use it belonged first to Gunnared parish and, from 2014, to Angered parish. Lövgärdet itself is a neighbourhood within the Gårdsten district of north-eastern Gothenburg.
Magasin III har visat samtida konstnärer: Magasin III has shown contemporary artists such as Mona Hatoum, Tino Sehgal, Ai Weiwei, Pipilotti Rist and Tony Oursler. More than seventy works in the collection were created especially for the museum.
Magasinet rustades upp på 1990-talet och: The storehouse was restored in the 1990s and now houses a museum about Segeltorp. The Segeltorp local history society holds regular open days here.
Magelungsfortet skulle skydda Beatebergs: The Magelung fort was built to protect the Beateberg pass between Lake Magelungen and Lake Drevviken. It was the largest installation on the Southern Front and was to be manned by around 3,700 men, mostly reservists over 32 armed with ordinary rifles.
Magiskt hus och sagopark: A magic house and a fairy-tale park
Magnus Norman, en av grundarna av Good t: Magnus Norman, one of the founders of Good to Great, has also coached Stanislas Wawrinka, while Mikael Tillström has coached the Frenchman Gaël Monfils.
Majhillshuset byggdes 1911 av byggmästar: The Majhill house was built in 1911 by the master builder Olof Swan and named after his wife, Maj. During the 1912 Olympics the marathon ran right past, and the Swan family could follow it from their balcony. The house was decked out with Swedish flags for the day.
Majoren som anlade parken: The major who laid out the park
Majroskogen var en gång en del av Fagers: Majroskogen was once part of the Fagersjö forest, but it was cut off when the Örbyleden road was built in the 1970s. There have been plans for an ecoduct, a wide bridge covered in greenery, to link the forests again. For now there's only a footbridge and cycle bridge.
Majroskogen är ungefär 56 hektar stor. P: Majroskogen covers about 56 hectares. On a rock slab to the south is a glacial pothole about a metre across. Because farmers only took the trees they needed for their own use, there are pines here up to 300 years old.
Makarna Limnell samlade tidens kändisar: The Limnells gathered the celebrities of the day for their "Kolifej på Lyran" parties. Guests included Jenny Lind, Selma Lagerlöf, Henrik Ibsen and Bjørnstjerne Bjørnson – and Ibsen even wrote a few verses about the house.
Makaronifabriken byggdes 1934 i mörkt He: The macaroni factory was built in 1934 of dark Helsingborg brick, with a glazed stairwell overlooking the sea approach to Stockholm. Since its conversion in 2000, it has housed schools such as Nackademin and Ebba Braheskolan.

The macaroni factory was built in 1934 in dark Helsingborg brick, with a glazed stairwell offering sweeping views over the sea approach to Stockholm. Since its conversion in 2000 it has housed schools, including Nackademin and Ebba Braheskolan.
Malmgård i fransk stil: A country house in French style
Malmgård med ankdamm: A country house with a duck pond
Malmgården Zinkensdamm revs 1934, men na: The Zinkensdamm manor house was demolished in 1934, but the name lives on in the sports ground, the metro station and Zinkens Odlarförening, a gardening society with some 30 allotments on Zinkens väg.
Malmvägen i Tureberg kallas Tian, efter: Malmvägen in Tureberg is known as Tian, the Ten, after the ten tower blocks Åke Arell designed in 1970. The complex holds 1,247 flats, with preschools, shops, a gym and club rooms on the ground floor. It was part of the Million Programme, Sweden's great housing drive, and drew international attention when it opened in 1972. The nearby street name Bagarby recalls Bagare by, an older name for the Tureberg farm.
Man måste vara medlem i föreningen för a: You had to be a member of the association to buy a plot, and the association could say no if it thought the pleasant atmosphere was at risk. At the same time there were loans tied to life insurance, and members stood surety for one another up to 1,500 kronor.
Man vet vem som stod modell för flickan:: We know who modelled for the girl: Birgitta Larsson, a student from Uppsala. Incidentally, the sculptor Bror Hjorth taught alongside Sven “X:et” Erixson at the Royal Institute of Art in Stockholm.
Mangårdsbyggnaden brann ner på 1950-tale: The main house burned down in the 1950s, and the last wing went up in flames in 1981. Fittingly, the site is now home to Tumba fire station. The street Tuna gårdsväg keeps the memory of the estate alive.
Manillaskolan grundades 1809 av Pär Aron: The Manilla School was founded in 1809 by Pär Aron Borg as a school for deaf and blind children, and it stayed here on southern Djurgården until 2013. Just east of the school stands the mighty King's Oak. In the villa Nedre Manilla the Bonnier family keeps its portrait collection of more than 300 works, mostly of Swedish writers. The first painting was bought in 1905: Hanna Pauli's portrait of Verner von Heidenstam.

Manillaskolan, a school for deaf and blind children, was founded by Pär Aron Borg in 1809 and stayed here on Södra Djurgården, the southern part of Djurgården island, until 2013. Just east of the school stands the mighty King's Oak, Kungseken. In the villa Nedre Manilla, the Bonnier family keeps its collection of more than 300 portraits, most of them of Swedish authors. The very first, bought in 1905, was Hanna Pauli's portrait of Verner von Heidenstam. Down on the little islet of Manillaholmen stands the sculpture Frihetens port, the Gate of Freedom, from 1994.
Mannen bakom gatnamnet: The man behind the street name
Mannen som ägde hela Täby: The man who owned all of Täby
Mansardtak från Rosenblads tid: A mansard roof from the Rosenblad era
Mansardtak och rund balkong: A mansard roof and a round balcony
Marabou kom hit 1916 som dotterbolag til: Marabou, the chocolate maker, arrived here in 1916 as a subsidiary of the Norwegian firm Freia, in a factory designed by Ivar Tengbom. Production moved to Upplands Väsby in 1976. The old chocolate factory and Marabouparken, the park beside the Bällstaån stream, are now considered of very high cultural and historical value, and the park is known for its art gallery.
Marabouparken började fyllas med skulptu: Sculptures started appearing in Marabouparken as soon as the park was laid out, and by the 1970s there were sixteen works in the collection. Beneath the eastern part of the park is the Marabouparken art gallery, opened in 2010 beside the old cocoa laboratory designed by Artur von Schmalensee. The park is also home these days to Långholmen Folk High School, which used to be based in an old pavilion at Långholmen Central Prison.
Marabouparken var från början Sundbyberg: Marabouparken was originally the park of Sundbyberg farm. Marabou, the chocolate maker, bought the site in 1916 and demolished the farmhouse in 1935 for its new office building. The municipality then demanded that the park be restored and remain open to the people of Sundbyberg for ever.
Marabouparkens konsthall invigdes 28 aug: Marabouparken's art gallery opened on 28 August 2010, built underground in the eastern part of the park. It connects directly to the cocoa laboratory designed by Artur von Schmalensee.
Maria Sofia De la Gardie drev vidare teg: Maria Sofia De la Gardie carried on the brickworks founded by her husband, Gustaf Gabrielsson Oxenstierna, and in 1661 she named it Gustafsberg after him. In the 1820s the works became a porcelain factory instead.
Mariakyrkan i Hammarkullen: Mariakyrkan, St Mary's Church, in Hammarkullen
Mariakyrkan ritades av Fritz Voigt och i: Maria church was designed by Fritz Voigt and consecrated in 1987. You enter through a free-standing bell tower topped by a golden cross. The altar is adorned with a red and gold mosaic, and the floor and pulpit are of pale marble from Borghamn in Östergötland.

Mariakyrkan was designed by Fritz Voigt and consecrated on 15 November 1987. It's built of light red brick, and you enter from the square through a free-standing bell tower topped with a golden cross. The nave is wider than it is long.
Mariakyrkan vid Skogås Yttertorg ligger: Just a few steps away is Mariakyrkan, St Mary's Church, by Skogås Yttertorg – the parish church of Trångsund-Skogås. Hidden up on the cliff a little way off is Lännafortet, a fort built in 1908–1909 as part of the Southern Front. Together with the Northern Front, nicknamed Korvlinjen, 'the Sausage Line', it was a key part of Stockholm's fixed defences until 1952 – and Lännafortet is one of the forts that has survived in good condition.
Mariakyrkan, tidigare Fattighuskyrkan, r: Mariakyrkan, once known as the Poorhouse Church, was designed by Carl Wilhelm Carlberg, who also designed the cathedral. It was consecrated in 1815 and seats 650. The old church in the poorhouse yard had been a kiln – a drying house for malt.
Mariakyrkans klockor är äldre än själva: The bells of Mariakyrkan are older than the church itself: the small bell dates from 1747 and the great bell from 1771. Both came along from the old poorhouse church.
Mariebergs kyrkogård intill anlades 1787: Marieberg cemetery next door was laid out in 1787 on Majberget hill – the name was simply prettified from 'Maj' to 'Marie'. Among those buried here are Wilhelm Stenhammar and Johan Fredrik Carpelan. Nearby is Captain Hansson's house from 1850, which was threatened with demolition and moved to Chapmansgatan in 1953. And on Chapmans torg square you'll find the Gothenburg English Studio Theatre, the only English-language theatre in western Sweden.
Mariebergsgatan anlades på 1880-talet oc: Mariebergsgatan was laid out in the 1880s and named in the street-name revision of 1885. At that time it continued south across Drottningholmsvägen all the way to Marieberg, which gave the street its name. The southern stretch is now called Gjörwellsgatan.
Mariehäll låg vid den gamla landsvägen m: Mariehäll lay on the old highway between Stockholm Palace and Drottningholm. It was a long, tiresome trip: over Bällsta bridge, along what are now Bällstavägen and Blackebergsvägen to Tyska botten, where a ferry carried travellers across to Lovön.
Mariehällskyrkan har bytt psalmer mot ba: Mariehällskyrkan has swapped hymns for nursery rhymes. Until 2015 it was the church and parish hall of Bromma parish, but then the municipality bought the building and opened a preschool here in 2016. The congregation moved across the street to Kvarterskyrkan. A little further away is Annedal, named after Anna Augusta Wickman-Olsson, who owned a plot beside the Bällstaån stream in the 1880s.
Marina läroverket äger flera fartyg, bla: The Marina läroverket school owns several vessels, among them Petsamo, Taifun, Odd Fellow and the sailing ship Älva. Every year from August to June, Älva is out at sea with one of the school's classes.
Marinbiologen som startade arkivet: The marine biologist who founded the archive
Mark mot att slopa klingelpungen: Land in exchange for silencing the bells
Mark mot ett stationshus: Land in exchange for a station
Markelius ring som aldrig byggdes: Markelius's ring that was never built
Markelius villa vid Kevinge strand blev: Markelius's villa at Kevinge strand became a place of pilgrimage for architects. Le Corbusier and Patrick Abercrombie were among the guests, treated both to Swedish nature and to a crayfish party followed by a dip in the garden pond.
Marken betalade nya banan: The land paid for the new racecourse
Marken där företagsområdet ligger var fö: The land where the business park now stands was first set aside as part of Skogskyrkogården, the Woodland Cemetery. But it proved unsuitable for graves, not least because the bedrock came right to the surface. Instead it became a storage yard for the city's highways department.
Marken hade i äldre tid hört till Ulriks: The land once belonged to the royal estate of Ulriksdal. In 1968 a community centre was built with a taverna, a central laundry and two nurseries. The older part of the area is now protected in the local plan for its heritage value.
The ground here has a dramatic past. On 29 September 1950, Surte was hit by the Surte landslide, one of the worst natural disasters in Swedish history. Several houses were swept away – yet, miraculously, only one person died. Just up the road is Surte station. It opened in 1879, and after a gap of more than 40 years, passenger trains started stopping here again in 2012.
Marken här tillhörde Klara kloster, till: This land belonged to the Klara convent until 1527, when the Reformation parliament in Västerås ordered the convent to be torn down. In the 1560s it was granted to Torbjörn Klockare, who now has a street named after him. Röda bergen, the area around us, is the largest stretch of Stockholm's inner city built all of a piece to the town planning ideals of the 1920s. And over at Torsplan, the Norra tornen, the Northern Towers, rise to 104 and 120 metres.
Marken här var till stor del sumpig, ler: Much of the ground here was swampy, muddy and waterlogged, and in the early 1900s the streets were notorious for mud. That's how the nickname Sumpan ("the Swamp") came about – today an affectionate name for Sweden's smallest municipality by area, at just 8.79 square kilometres.
Marken i Gubbängens företagsområde var f: The land in the Gubbängen business park was first intended as an extension of Skogskyrkogården, the Woodland Cemetery. But it turned out to be unsuitable for graves, partly because the bedrock came right up to the surface.
Marken kallades förr Tegelbruksängen. I: The land used to be called Tegelbruksängen, the brickworks meadow. In the early 1620s the Dutchman Pieter á Naaldwyck set up a brickworks here, and production carried on until around 1850.
Marken kring monumentet är belagd med sv: The ground around the monument is paved with black setts and red sandstone in the shape of a tree, designed by Carl Eldh together with the city's landscape architect Erik Glemme.
The land was sold to JM and Skanska in 2011. The area has been named Täby park, and the municipality is planning homes for 15,000 people where the horses once raced.
Marken under industriområdet är gammal s: The ground beneath the industrial estate is the former bed of Lake Orlången, so extensive foundation work was needed before anything could be built here.
Marken upplät kung Oscar II. När svenska: King Oscar II granted the land. When the Swedish bandy final was played here in 1909, it was an all-Stockholm derby: AIK beat Djurgårdens IF 7–3.
Marken var först reserverad för en tänkt: The land was first set aside for a planned metro branch to Årsta. When that plan was shelved, the park was laid out instead and opened in 1957. It started out as a big playground with a paddling pool, swings, dens and a ball field.
Marken var först åker till Överjärva går: The land was first farmed as part of Överjärva farm. A racecourse stood here from 1919 to 1960, and golf has been played since the 1970s. The course is short and compact, with nine par-3 holes, and the record is 57 strokes.
Marken var tidigare en handelsträdgård o: The land was once a market garden and was bought in 1943. The cemetery was designed to resemble its neighbour Skogskyrkogården, the Woodland Cemetery, with park-like lawns among the existing trees. Most Jewish burials in Stockholm take place here.
Marknad i gamla stallar: A market in the old stables
Marknad i hästarnas stall: A market in the horse stables
Marknad med hö och trävaror: A market for hay and timber
Markuskyrkan ritades av Sigurd Lewerentz: Markuskyrkan, St Mark's Church, was designed by Sigurd Lewerentz, who himself called the style “Persian”. Among other things the church features Iranian motifs in the form of winged lions, and it's regarded as a high point of 20th-century Brutalist architecture. In 1962 it won Lewerentz the very first Kasper Salin Prize, Sweden's top architecture award.
Mars 1566 small det rejält i trakten. Un: In March 1566 this area was rocked by an enormous explosion. During the Swedish siege of Bohus Fortress, the Danish-Norwegian defenders blew up their own keep, Röde Torn, the Red Tower – an event remembered as Bohusiska smällen, ‘the Bohus Bang’. Rödbo covers the very northern tip of Hisingen island, between the Göta älv and Nordre älv rivers. It's mostly forest, with open fields running down to the water and a scattering of houses. Rödbo Church is only a couple of hundred metres away.
Masmo station ligger 20–45 meter ner i b: Masmo station lies 20–45 metres down in the rock and has just one entrance. There's also a lift shaft and an escalator tunnel, blasted out for housing on Masmoberget that has yet to be built.
Masten kröntes av en ratt med tre ekrar: The mast was topped by a three-spoked steering wheel and the neon words Motell, Bar and Grill, visible from far away. The motel had 55 rooms with 110 beds and its own Shell petrol station next door.
Masten som avslöjar: The mast that gives it away
Masthugget har fått sitt namn efter till: Masthugget takes its name from the ship masts once made in the area, and the square was named in 1769. In 1786 it was also called Sänkverkstorget, after a boom that could be lowered across the river to keep enemy ships out. Sänkverksgatan street still bears the name today.
Masthugget hör till Göteborgs allra älds: Masthugget is some of the oldest land in Gothenburg, part of the city since 1621, and it was declared a suburb as early as 1646. An unplanned settlement grew up around the ship harbours along the river. Nearby is the Sjömannasällskapet building, the Seamen's Society house, from 1901 and 1903. Oscar Fredriksskolan, the school from 1897, is said to be named after Oscar II – who was meant to speak at the opening but never turned up.

Masthugget is some of Gothenburg's very oldest land, dating from 1621, and it was declared a suburb as early as 1646. Unplanned houses sprang up around the shipyards and harbours along the river. Close by stand the Seamen's Society building, from 1901 and 1903, and Oscar Fredrik School from 1897, whose reddish-brown brick echoes neighbouring Oscar Fredrik Church.
Masthuggskyrkan, stadens bästa utsikt: Masthuggskyrkan – the best view in town
Masthuggstorget ligger nedanför Masthugg: Masthuggstorget square sits at the foot of the Masthuggsberget hill. Up on the hill is Masthugget Church from 1914, and around the square are some of the city's oldest landshövdingehus – Gothenburg's typical houses with a stone ground floor and wooden upper storeys.
Mat för sex dagar i berget: Six days' food inside the rock
Mathilda Sundelin blev föreståndare på S: Mathilda Sundelin became matron at Skuru estate in 1919. In 1922 she bought the estate and renamed it Solsunda vilohem, and she remained matron right up until 1968.
Mattisborgen är rövarborgen i Astrid Lin: Mattisborgen is the robbers' castle in Astrid Lindgren's Ronia, the Robber's Daughter. The robber chief Mattis ruled there until the Borka robbers moved into the other half of the ruined castle. The surrounding streets are called Pippi Långstrumps gata and Ronja Rövardotters stig.
Mausoleet på kullen är ett litet cirkelr: The mausoleum on the hill is a small, circular classical temple from 1912, designed by Arvid Fuhre. Its copper-clad dome rests on eight columns, and there's a crypt beneath. An avenue of thuja trees leads up the hill.
Max Sievert byggde även en verkstad för: Max Sievert also built a workshop for Alpha, which first made horseshoe nails and later Bakelite products. The Alpha name lived on in the block, including in the Toolex Alpha record-pressing plant and a printing works.
Med 1 390 elever år 2024 hör gymnasiet h: With 1,390 students in 2024, the upper secondary school here, which opened in 1982, is one of the biggest in Stockholm County. Nearby is the Good to Great tennis academy, founded in 2011 by the former pros Magnus Norman, Nicklas Kulti and Mikael Tillström. Players who have trained there include the brothers Mikael and Elias Ymer.
Med Bromma kom man till Berlin på fyra t: From Bromma airport you could reach Berlin in four hours non-stop, compared with 20 hours by train in the 1930s. London took seven to eight hours with a stopover, and a one-way ticket cost 315 kronor.
Med Koka ville Björn Persson skapa ett r: With Koka, Björn Persson set out to create a stripped-back concept at lower prices. The dining room seats 42, guests choose between seven, five or three courses, and the cooking has been described as modern west Swedish. As early as November 2014 Koka was named Restaurant of the Year.
Med Villa Waern kom en ny typ av villaar: Villa Waern brought a new kind of villa architecture to Sweden. Torben Grut combined influences from Germany and Vienna with Swedish National Romanticism. The house has a pyramid roof, tarred horizontal timber cladding and nine rooms over 398 square metres.
Med ballong mot Nordpolen: By balloon to the North Pole
Med båt till Stadshuset: By boat to the City Hall
Med början 1899 köpte Stockholms stad ma: From 1899 onwards, the City of Stockholm bought up the land around Bornsjön lake to secure it as a water source for the city. The parish has three nature reserves: Bornsjön, Korpberget and Garnudden. South of Bornsjön lies St Botvid's spring.
Med cirka 150 000 fordon per dygn är Fre: With around 150,000 vehicles a day, Fredhällstunneln is the busiest road tunnel in the Nordic countries. Its tubes are only 220 metres long – so short that they need no ventilation.
Med den välfyllda äppelkorgen anspelade: With the overflowing apple basket, Bror Hjorth was alluding to Huddinge's thousands of house gardens, where the housewives took care of the harvest and the apple juice. The sculpture is a tribute to women.
Med en vanlig knapptelefon kan du färgsä: With an ordinary push-button phone you can set the colours of the windows on the tower's top ten floors, wherever you are in the world. Keys 1–3 control red, 4–6 green and 7–9 blue. It only works after dark, and the call is free.
Med filmreformen 1963 slopades nöjesskat: The film reform of 1963 abolished entertainment tax on cinema tickets; instead, ten per cent of the ticket price went to the new Swedish Film Institute. The driving force was Harry Schein, the institute's first head.
Med häst och vagn till stan: By horse and cart to town
Med passbåt till sportstugan: By ferry to the weekend cabin
Med sina 100 000 gravplatser är Skogskyr: With its 100,000 graves, Skogskyrkogården is the largest cemetery in the country by number of graves. By area it's the second largest, after Kviberg cemetery in Gothenburg. A rocky hill just inside the entrance was blasted away, and the stone became the cemetery wall.
Med sina 199 kvadratkilometer utgör Hisi: At 199 square kilometres, Hisingen accounts for roughly half of Gothenburg municipality. The island is part of Västra Götaland County and is the fifth largest in Sweden. Water surrounds it on every side: Göta älv, Nordre älv and the Kattegat. About a quarter of the island belongs to the province of Västergötland, the rest to Bohuslän.
Med sina cirka 70 meter är Oscar Fredrik: At around 70 metres, Oscar Fredrik Church is the tallest church building in Gothenburg. Helgo Zettervall designed it in Neo-Gothic brick, and unusually, the tower stands beside the chancel.
Medan nya Åbybadet byggdes 2020–2023 fan: While the new Åbybadet pool was being built in 2020–2023, Lilla Åbybadet stood across the road – a small temporary pool for swimming lessons and clubs. The old baths, opened in 1977 as Åby simhall, closed in February 2020 and were demolished to make way for the new one.
Medan staden växte förföll den gamla mal: As the city grew, the old country house fell into disrepair and ended up as a courtyard building behind a block of flats. In the early 1900s it became Grafström & Co's coffee roastery, but it burned down in 1906. Today no trace remains of either Stora or Lilla Ingemarshof.
Medborgarförslag flyttade stenen: A citizens' proposal moved the stone
Medborgarplatsen är Södermalms stora tor: Medborgarplatsen is Södermalm's big square, with outdoor cafés in summer and an ice rink in winter. From here it's a short hop to Götgatan, the lively main street of Söder.
Medeltidskyrkan såldes för 1 100 riksdal: A medieval church sold for 1,100 riksdaler
Mejeriet fick ett stickspår från Slakthu: The dairy got a branch line from the Slakthusbanan railway at Valla torg, and the site was given the fitting name Mejeristen, the Dairyman. The milk arrived in tank wagons jointly owned with the state railways, SJ. In 1975 the dairy became part of Arla.
Mejerivillan byggdes både som bostad åt: The dairy villa was built both as a home for the stable hand and as a cold store for milk. On the ground floor the milk was cooled in big vats with water from Lake Ulvsundasjön, and Ulvsunda residents came here to buy their daily milk.
Mejerivillan var länge privatbostad och: Mejerivillan, the Dairy Villa, was a private home for many years and was used by the Bromma YMCA-YWCA scouts in the 1990s. Under new plans it may become a conference venue. An old stone bridge, Spången, crossed the canal from the late 1600s until 1937.
Mellan 10 000 och 15 000 personer besöke: Between 10,000 and 15,000 people visit the Kviberg market every weekend. You'll find everything from glass and china, furniture and art to tools, fabrics and gadgets.
Mellan 1844 och 1860 kallades Stora Essi: Between 1844 and 1860 Stora Essingen was known as ‘Djävulsö’ – Devil's Island. Every day, convicts from Långholmen prison were brought here by barge to cut paving stones in the quarry, where the Essingeleden motorway has its slip roads today. Coming out to watch them became something of a day trip for Stockholmers.

Between 1844 and 1860 Stora Essingen was known as "Devil's Island". Convicts from Långholmen prison were shipped here by barge every day to cut paving stones in a quarry. Going out to watch them became something of an outing for Stockholmers.
Mellan 1862 och 1877 arrenderades Ritorp: Between 1862 and 1877, Ritorp was leased by the tinware manufacturer Wilhelm Leonard Klemming. It was his wife Elisabet who ran the farm, growing mainly vegetables and fruit that were sold at Hötorget market in Stockholm.
From 1862 to 1877 Ritorp farm was leased by the Klemming family. Elisabet, the wife, ran the farming, growing mostly vegetables and fruit that were sold at the Hötorget market in Stockholm.
Mellan 1873 och 1971 låg Ekensbergs Varv: From 1873 to 1971, Ekensberg shipyard occupied the western part of the area, and the old inn served as its office. Block names like Flytdockan (the floating dock), Stapelbädden (the slipway) and Bottenstocken (the floor timber) still recall the industry.
Mellan 1874 och 1886 gästades gården lån: Between 1874 and 1886 Gustaf V, then still crown prince, spent long spells as a guest here. The owner, Erling Ribbing, began dividing the land into villa plots, and one of the buyers was the engineer Gustaf Dalén, who built both his own Villa Ekbacken and the AGA factory here.
Mellan 1880-talet och 1935 drev Pixbo he: From the 1880s until 1935, the owners of Pixbo manor ran a market garden supplying fruit and vegetables to Gothenburg. It was watered from ponds on the hills above, and most of them are still there. The streets of southern Pixbo are named after the fruit trees that once grew here.
Mellan 1880-talet och 1935 drev herrgård: From the 1880s until 1935, the owners of the manor ran a market garden supplying Gothenburg with fruit and vegetables. The crops were watered through pipes from ponds on the surrounding hills, and most of those ponds are still here.
Mellan 1900 och 1963 fanns en mindre hål: From 1900 to 1963 there was a smaller stop called Sundbybergs norra a little further north. When the Mälaren line is widened to four tracks, Sundbyberg station is set to move underground into a 1.4-kilometre tunnel.
Mellan 1903 och 1910 gjorde Milles fem v: Between 1903 and 1910 Carl Milles made five versions of the group, in bronze, marble, pale grey savonite stone and silvered bronze. The elephants in the schoolyard were cast in bronze in 1907 in the Millesgården studio.
Mellan 1910 och 1916 hade Radiumhemmet s: From 1910 to 1916 the Radiumhemmet, the cancer clinic, was housed in the corner building at Scheelegatan 10 on Bergsgatan. The street's best-known building, though, is Stockholm City Court, designed by Carl Westman and built in 1909–1915.
Mellan 1911 och 1927 låg Stockholms Folk: From 1911 to 1927, Stockholm's People's Park stood in Ingentingskogen woods. People called it “Tingsan”, and it had dance floors and a theatre stage.
Mellan 1912 och 1934 var Svalnäs slutsta: Between 1912 and 1934 Svalnäs was the terminus of the narrow-gauge Djursholm railway. The whole line closed in 1976. Lahäll station was spruced up in 2009 with a new shelter and bike parking.
Mellan 1928 och 1959 gick spårvagnslinje: From 1928 to 1959 tram route 15 ran along Tulegatan between Råsundavägen and Fredsgatan. Today the 515 bus has taken over.
Mellan 1928 och 1972 låg den kända progr: From 1928 to 1972 the well-known progressive boarding school Viggbyholmsskolan was based in and around Viggbyholm manor. Viggbyskolan is even older, dating from 1926.
Mellan 1943 och 1953 byggdes tio fiskebå: Ten fishing boats were built here between 1943 and 1953. Four went to Iceland, one to France for fishing off the coast of Senegal, and three to Colombia for tuna fishing.
Mellan 1943 och 1987 utbildade Kungliga: From 1943 to 1987 the Royal Swedish Naval Academy trained its cadets at Näsby Castle. Since 1989 it has been a conference hotel.
Mellan 1943 och 1987 utbildades blivande: From 1943 to 1987 future naval officers were trained here, when the Royal Swedish Naval Academy was based at the palace. Since 1989 it has been a conference hotel.
Mellan 1945 och 1964 gick spårvägslinje: Tram line 17 ran here from 1945 to 1964, and in 1965 the metro station on the red line opened. Hägerstensåsen school, from 1948, was designed by Paul Hedqvist, Sweden's foremost school architect.
Mellan 1959 och 1966 hette skolan Kommun: From 1959 to 1966 the school was called Kommunala gymnasiet i Bandhagen, the Bandhagen municipal grammar school. After conversion in 2007–2008 it became 120 flats, and the old assembly hall is set to become 14 split-level flats.
Mellan 1962 och 1994 fanns en Z-formad g: From 1962 to 1994, a Z-shaped pedestrian tunnel ran from Central Station to the corner by Hotel Eggers. Fifty metres long, it had stairs clad in marble and silver gneiss – and it was built like a barge, floating in the clay.
Mellan 1992 och 2012 hade stationen fyra: Between 1992 and 2012 the station had four tracks, two of them with platforms. The idea was that long-distance trains could overtake commuter trains here, but that rarely happened. When the station was rebuilt in 2012 it was reduced to two tracks with longer platforms.
Mellan 1996 och 2002 syntes Stora Nyckel: Between 1996 and 2002 the Stora Nyckelviken manor appeared in the TV soap Skilda världar, where it was called Villa Björkudden. Its billiard wing was used in 2010 and 2011 for filming SVT's Sommarpratarna.
Mellan 1997 och 2005 byggdes briggen Tre: Between 1997 and 2005 the brig Tre Kronor af Stockholm was built here, and Stockholmers could watch the ship slowly take shape and chip in towards the cost. Some 40 older vessels are moored along the quays, from trawlers to lightships.
Mellan 1997 och 2012 stod Krigsseglarnas: From 1997 to 2012 the memorial to Sweden's wartime merchant sailors stood at Stenpiren. It was then moved and rededicated in 2015 about a kilometre away, near the sailing ship Barken Viking.
Mellan 2008 och 2014 var Korsvägen skylt: Between 2008 and 2014 Korsvägen was signposted as a roundabout. Then the signs were swapped for give-way signs and local traffic rules – which in practice left the rules much as they had been before.
Mellan 2012 och 2014 byggdes två bostads: Between 2012 and 2014, two residential blocks were built on top of the shopping centre. The taller one, Tyresö View, has 23 storeys. In front of it a town park with a fountain and artworks was laid out, opening in September 2015 during the Tyresö Festival.
Mellan 2017 och 2025 drevs också den enk: From 2017 to 2025 the same building also housed a more casual sister restaurant, Rinos bodega. Both closed in February 2025.
Mellan Hjulsta och Lunda ligger Hjulsta: Between Hjulsta and Lunda are the Hjulsta allotments, run by an association founded in 1973 and today a fine example of a multicultural growing community. Lunda itself is mostly business parks and industrial estates. The old Kälvesta windmill, by the way, is also known as Lunda kvarn – and it actually stood in Lunda for a while after 1884.
Mellan Kvarnbergsplan och Huddinge centr: Between Kvarnbergsplan and Huddinge centrum lies Rådsparken, the area’s largest park. There’s a barbecue area, a café and Rådsparken’s animal club, where you can meet pigs, hens, rabbits and donkeys.
Mellan Svangatan och Ejdergatan, bakom P: Between Svangatan and Ejdergatan, behind Pellerin's margarine factory, there once stood a milestone inscribed '1/4 mil'. It marked a fjärdingsväg – a quarter of a Swedish mile, or 2,672 metres – from Gustaf Adolfs torg.
Mellan de två kungastatyerna står Molins: Between the two royal statues stand Molin's Fountain and the wych elms at the heart of the Battle of the Elms protest on 12–13 May 1971. That same year the park became city property.
Mellan december 2015 och sommaren 2017 b: Between December 2015 and summer 2017 the ferry terminal was rebuilt and the pier extended into a bus terminal. The work was part of the West Swedish Package of infrastructure projects.
Mellan herrgården och lusthuset ligger N: Between the manor house and the summer house lies Nyckelviken's kitchen garden, run by Nacka council. The idea is to show how to get the most out of your plot while being kind to the environment.
Mellan jugend och nationalromantik: Between Art Nouveau and National Romanticism
Mellan kajen och huset, framför foajén,: Between the quay and the building, in front of the foyer, stands a group of stone sculptures by the artist Claes Hake. At the very top is the Götheborgsutkiken lookout, with sweeping views over the city and harbour.
Mellan nybyggda hus och köpcentrum står: In among the new buildings and shopping centres stand four stones from prehistoric times. The Sannegården monument is what's left of a burial ground from the end of the Bronze Age and the beginning of the Iron Age. The largest, a triangular standing stone, is still in its original spot, while the others were moved to make way for gravel digging. The harbour below, Sannegårdshamnen, opened in 1914.
Mellan torget och älven låg Gamla Varvet: Between the square and the river lay Gamla Varvet, the Old Shipyard, from around 1630 until 1912, when the city bought the site for 1.5 million kronor. Gamla varvsparken and the Maritime Museum were laid out there. East of Gathenhielmska huset stand two small 18th-century ropewalk buildings; the smaller one is now a florist's.
Mellan vägg och tak löper ett smalt föns: A slim band of windows runs between the walls and the ceiling, letting the light in. The walls have horizontal bands that grow narrower and narrower, and long angled pine benches stand on a limestone floor.
Mellan ån och bäcken: Between the river and the stream
Mer än hälften av husen är prefabricerad: More than half the houses are prefabricated Borohus homes from Landsbro Trävarubolag in Småland, with which the state railway SJ had a favourable deal. The most popular models were called Gullebo, Solhem and Furubo.
Metalfans, spetsa öronen. En bit härifrå: Metal fans, listen up! A short distance from here is Studio Fredman, which the producer Fredrik Nordström founded in 1990 and still runs. In Flames, At The Gates, Hammerfall, Opeth and Arch Enemy have all recorded albums here, along with visitors from abroad such as Dimmu Borgir and Panic! at the Disco. Closer to the stop is the Motor Industry Technical upper secondary school – where the engines make the noise.
Metodistförsamlingen beslutade redan 202: Back in 2020 the Methodist congregation decided to wind up its activities at the end of 2022, and the keys were handed over on 15 September 2023. When the church was consecrated for Kållered parish, the congregation from Apelgården Church moved here.
Midsommargården ritades i stram funktion: Midsommargården was designed in austere functionalist style by Ture Wennerholm, who also designed Ericsson’s factory at Telefonplan. On the ground floor were shops, a bank and a pharmacy; higher up, a theatre, a library and a function room; and at the very top, flats.
Midsommarkransens tunnelbanestation ligg: Midsommarkransen metro station lies in a rock cavern 17 metres underground, and it opened along with the red line in 1964. Along Främlingsvägen are slender blocks of flats from the 1940s; in 2013 they were joined by six new buildings, which were shortlisted for Stockholm's Building of the Year the following year. A little further on, the Hägerstensviadukten viaduct carries the Essingeleden motorway.
Mignon startades den 1 november 1941 av: Ottar Edorson opened the Mignon cinema on 1 November 1941. In 1948 the Royal cinema chain took over, but in 1961 Edorson took charge again together with the building's owner. SF bought it in 1968 and ran it until the end.
Milles vattenbåge i hamnen: Milles' arc of water in the harbour
Milles ängel har stulits flera gånger. S: Milles's angel has been stolen several times. Since autumn 2011 the original has been kept at Millesgården, and the chapel roof now carries a copy in composite material from 2010. There's a gilded bronze copy in the visitor centre.
Millesgården var skulptören Carl Milles: Millesgården was the home, studio and garden of the sculptor Carl Milles and his wife Olga, and today it's an art museum and sculpture park. Milles made Skridskoprinsessan, the Skating Princess, in 1949, after watching a girl skating at Rockefeller Plaza in New York. He was so taken with the way she moved that he set out to capture it in bronze. You enter through the art gallery, designed by Johan Celsing.
Milstenen på vägen till Dalarö: A milestone on the road to Dalarö
Milstenen som minns flottbron: The milestone that remembers the pontoon bridge
Milstolpe med kungens namn: A milestone with the King’s name
Min vän i biljetthallen: My Friend in the ticket hall
Miniatyrhusen är byggda med plåttak, trä: The miniature houses are built with tin roofs, wooden panelling and tiled floors, but also from recycled materials such as old coffee tins and spectacles. The building award was decided by public vote, and almost half of the 1,210 votes went to the park.
Minneberg byggdes 1984–1987 efter en sym: Minneberg was built in 1984–1987 to a symmetrical town plan by Jan Inghe, who lived here himself for ten years. Hallmarks of the postmodern style include decorated gables, colonnades, porticoes, striped balconies and split-level flats on the top floors.
Minneslund på högsta punkten: A memorial grove at the highest point
Minnesstenen Norges tack: The memorial stone Norges tack, ‘Norway's Thanks’
Minnesstenen väger cirka 15 ton och komm: The memorial stone weighs about 15 tonnes and comes from Vassfaret in Flå municipality, roughly 120 kilometres north-west of Oslo. The area was an important base for the Norwegian resistance. The stone first stood in Galärparken but was moved in 2016 to Folke Bernadottes väg, below the Norwegian embassy.
Missionskretsen i Stuvsta höll först gud: The mission group in Stuvsta first held its services in a cinema. Stuvsta Church was consecrated in 1954, built with bricks from Stockholm's Betlehemskyrkan, a church from the 1840s that had been pulled down.
Missionskyrka blev samarbetskyrka: From mission church to shared church
Mistrals gamla lokal på Lilla Nygatan 21: Mistral's old premises at Lilla Nygatan 21 kept on attracting stars. The restaurant Frantzén/Lindeberg moved in, winning a Michelin star in 2009 and its second in 2010. Mistral itself had won Dagens Nyheter's award in the Luxury category in 2004.
Mitt bland forskningshusen står ett lite: Among the research buildings stands a small timber house, painted Falu red, with a royal past. Falkenerarbostället, the Falconers' Lodge, was built in 1726 to house the royal falconers and originally belonged to Karlberg Palace. It's extremely well preserved and rated as exceptionally valuable in cultural and historical terms – but today it's a private home.
Mitt bland hamnar och industrier ligger: In the middle of the harbours and industry lies Rya skog, a patch of woodland that became the county's first nature reserve as early as 1928.
Mitt bland kontoren ligger ett gammalt å: In the midst of the offices stands an old steam engine shed with a water tower, which SJ calls Sundbyberg. The buildings date from 1904 and were probably designed by Erik Lallerstedt. They're very well preserved and, according to the Stockholm County Museum, of very high cultural and historical value.
Mitt bland lagerhallar och verkstäder st: Right in among the warehouses and workshops stands an old windmill. Ulvsunda kvarn, also called Bällsta kvarn, sits at the foot of Kvarnberget, Mill Hill, beside Ulvsundavägen, just south of Bromma Airport.
