När Huddinge landskommun köpte gården 19: When Huddinge rural municipality bought the farm in 1944, it had 34 hectares of fields, 4 horses, 25 cows and 10 young cattle. The street names Lars Hindriks väg and Patron Bergs väg honour the farm’s first known farmer and a later landowner.
När Hästen skulle placeras kom en polisr: When ‘Hästen’ (‘The Horse’) was about to be installed, a mounted policeman happened to ride by on Doktor Westrings gata. Horse and rider posed on the spot to show how the sculpture would look, and that settled where it stands today. The Horse has also been shown on Götaplatsen and in Finland.
När Ingemar Frodbom köpte marken 1710 fö: When Ingemar Frodbom bought the land in 1710, it came with a few ponds for farming crucian carp. A beautiful garden was laid out next to them, later mentioned by Carl Linnaeus. The carp live on in the name of the Ruddammen housing area – the Carp Pond.
När Järla sjö planerades från 1998 hämta: When Järla sjö was being planned from 1998, ideas were borrowed from small towns such as Trosa, Norrtälje and Arboga. The blocks measure just 50 by 50 metres. The public art includes Peter Linde's 2005 sculpture Pilt-Carin.

When Järla sjö was planned from 1998, ideas were borrowed from small towns such as Trosa, Norrtälje and Arboga. The blocks measure 50 by 50 metres, with two- to five-storey buildings mixed in among old industry. Look out for Peter Linde's sculpture Pilt-Carin.
När Kooperativa Förbundet rostade Cirkel: When the cooperative Kooperativa Förbundet roasted its Cirkelkaffe in Gäddviken across the water, parts of Ryssbergen smelled of coffee. That's why one of the slopes down towards the Värmdöleden road is called Kaffebacken – Coffee Hill.
När LM Ericsson flyttade till Telefonpla: When LM Ericsson moved to Telefonplan in the late 1930s, the master builder Olle Engkvist put up about 1,000 flats in LM-staden, building fast and keeping the blocks narrow, just 8 to 10 metres deep. Over in Aspudden, in a small park on Manhemsgatan, is the 1912 fountain sculpture Fontändamm. It was paid for by the building company Manhem, which also got the street named after itself.
När Landala IF ordnade tivoli på torget: When Landala IF put on a funfair in the square, boxer Ingemar Johansson gave an exhibition bout to roaring crowds. He reckoned it was probably the only club in Gothenburg ever to stage boxing in a town square.
När Landalas vattenreservoar invigdes 18: When Landala's reservoir opened in 1871, the minister for civil affairs sampled the water from the very glass Gustav III had used at the opening of Kallebäck spring in 1787. The reservoir held "2 million kannor" – 4.9 million litres – of water from Lake Delsjön.
När Lidingöbanan nådde Gåshaga 1916 bygg: When the Lidingöbanan railway reached Gåshaga in 1916, the transport company built a beach café and an open-air bathing spot. Around 1919 Gåshaga sportrestaurang opened, designed by Erik Hahr, complete with a dance rotunda and a skittle alley. As Gåshaga Wärdshus it became a favourite stop for boaters, until it burned down in 1982.
När Magna Sunnerdahl sålde det mesta av: When Magna Sunnerdahl sold most of the land in 1922, she kept the farm, surrounded by a tall black fence with spiked iron posts. The way into 'the enchanted garden' was through the iron gates at Alviksvägen 131, where there was a market garden.
När Marabou ville riva Sundbybergs gård: When Marabou wanted to demolish Sundbyberg's manor house, the council insisted that the park be restored and remain open to the people of Sundbyberg for ever. So it became a park for staff and public alike.
När Midsommarkransens folkskola öppnade: When Midsommarkransen primary school opened in 1915, it had 13 classrooms for around 450 children – plus a classroom for an open-air school for children with tuberculosis. Its architect, Georg A. Nilsson, was one of the country's foremost school designers.
När Mälarbanan byggdes ut till fyra spår: When the Mälaren railway line was widened to four tracks, the Yellow Villa was moved about ten metres closer to the rails. On 20 July 2014 it stood in its new spot. It's the only one of Järfälla's four old station buildings still standing.
När Mälaren låg tio meter högre: When Lake Mälaren was ten metres higher
När Nynäsbanan öppnade 1901 gick bara sj: When the Nynäs railway opened in 1901, there were only seven departures a day from the Central Station, and they went via Liljeholmen. A tram line from Skanstull was discussed but never built, and the metro didn't reach Farsta strand until 1971.
När Ola Serneke berättade om planerna 20: When Ola Serneke unveiled the plans in 2010, the tallest building was to have 35 storeys. In 2013 came Karlavagnstornet, with 60 storeys and 201 metres – and the finished tower reached 246 metres.
När Palladium öppnade 1918 var det Stock: When Palladium opened in 1918 it was Stockholm's largest cinema, with 1,240 seats. After a renovation in 1960 it showed mostly westerns, and by the 1970s it was known as the raggare cinema, after the Swedish greaser car-culture crowd. On its last day in 1987, every ticket cost 10 kronor.
När Paul Hedqvist ritade stålbalkarna ti: When Paul Hedqvist designed the steel beams for Hangar A, he reused truss girders from the old Traneberg Bridge, demolished in 1934. Hangar A is still used for aviation.
När Reinhold Rudbeck skänkte skolhuset t: When Reinhold Rudbeck donated the schoolhouse to Sollentuna in 1885, he asked for it to be named after his father, Claes. That's why the school is called Klasro. Today the museum shows a Lancaster school from the 1840s and a teacher's house from the 1880s.
När Richard Dybeck hittade Äggelundasten: When Richard Dybeck found the Äggelunda stone in 1857, it lay in two pieces, serving as doorsteps for a house and an outbuilding. By 1902 only the lower half remained, and a dig in 2009 searched in vain for the missing piece.
När Sieverts Kabelverk byggdes hittades: Several intact Viking graves were found when Sieverts Kabelverk, the cable factory, was built. Some were left in place, and Sundbyberg Museum holds a body and objects from one of them.
När Silverdal byggdes trodde man att äld: When Silverdal was built, the idea was that older people whose children had left home would move in. But when the homes went on sale in 2002, almost everyone who moved in had young children, and there was a sudden, urgent need for nursery places.
När Silverdal planerades trodde man att: When Silverdal was being planned, people expected older residents whose children had flown the nest to move in, so the focus was on housing for the elderly. When the homes went on sale in 2002, almost everyone who came turned out to be parents of young children, and nursery places were suddenly in urgent demand.
När Skintebodalen bebyggdes på 1970-tale: When Skintebodalen was built up in the 1970s, it was given car-free footpaths, terraced houses, two-storey wooden houses and ‘båtmansgårdar’ – a cross between a terraced house and a detached one. In 1975 the area won the Per and Alma Olsson Fund’s prize for the best building of the year in Gothenburg.
När Solberga planerades på 1940-talet äg: When Solberga was planned in the 1940s, the land to the south belonged to the Church of Sweden, so Folkparksvägen could only be reached from the north. It wasn't until the late 1960s that the city bought the land and the road could be extended to Älvsjö.

When Solberga was planned in the 1940s, the city owned only the northern part; the land to the south belonged to the Church of Sweden. So Folkparksvägen became a dead end from the north, and it wasn't until the late 1960s that the city could buy the rest and build Apelsinlunden.
När Stockholm sökte sommar-OS 2004 sakna: When Stockholm bid for the 2004 Summer Olympics, the city lacked a large hall for badminton. The answer was an athletics hall here that could easily be turned into a badminton arena during the Games.
När Thiels ekonomi rasade köpte staten s: When Ernest Thiel's finances collapsed, the state bought his collection in 1924 for 1.5 million kronor. The purchase wasn't funded by taxes but by a special cash lottery. In autumn 1926 an entrance fee of 25 öre was introduced.
När Trappan återinvigdes efter renoverin: When Trappan reopened after renovation in spring 2016, Kulturhuset Stadsteatern opened a stage of its own here, bringing permanent theatre to Vällingby. The building is now protected for its heritage value.
When Trappan reopened after renovation in spring 2016, Kulturhuset Stadsteatern opened a permanent stage here. The building also has a library, music, talks and a café.
När Trädgårn öppnade som kafé 1858 fanns: When Trädgårn opened as a café in 1858, the staff were all men, and the only spirit served was punsch, a Swedish arrack liqueur. The building beside the stop, Exercishuset, was finished in 1867, a gift from the wholesaler Julius Lindström. It was meant for schoolchildren to do gymnastics and riflemen to drill. Heden itself was the army's training ground, and until 2019 it had a bandy rink.
När Tuletorget invigdes 1964 var det Sun: When Tuletorget opened in 1964, it was Sundbyberg's most modern shopping centre, complete with an underground car park, a BP petrol station, Systembolaget – the state-run off-licence – a Tempo department store, a post office and a shoe shop. But the shoppers never came, and by the 1970s the square was emptier by the year. Since 2016 it has been renovated and gained two new tower blocks, Tuletornen. Tulegatan is named after the mythical Thule, because the street once marked Sundbyberg's northern edge.
När Tumba pappersbruk grundades 1755 beh: When Tumba paper mill was founded in 1755, it needed a transport route from Fittja. Boats travelled via Tullingesjön, the Flottsbro canal, Albysjön, Fittjaviken and Hagaviken out to Lake Mälaren.
När Törnby nämns första gången 1342 är d: When Törnby is first mentioned, in 1342, it's because two villagers, Jöns and Botolf of Törnby, served as witnesses when a farmer in Ekeby swapped land with Vårfruberga convent. The old letter spells the village “de Tørneby”.
När Vattenfall byggde sitt huvudkontor 1: When Vattenfall built its head office in 1957–1963, the architect Sven Danielsson was advised to demolish the farm. Instead, he kept the main house and used it as his architect's office during construction. Today it contains six owner-occupied flats.
När Volvo ville köpa gårdarna i Sörredsd: When Volvo wanted to buy up the farms in Sörredsdalen, CEO Assar Gabrielsson worried the farmers would raise their prices if they knew who was buying. County governor Per Nyström promised to keep quiet, and Gabrielsson bought the land through a firm of agents that never revealed its client.
När Västerorts kulturkommitté tog över d: When the Västerort culture committee took over in 1973, the Prisma cinema escaped the wave of closures that wiped out many suburban cinemas. In 2005 the film '165 Hässelby' had its world premiere here, and today the auditorium is used by the school's drama and music classes.
När all inredning rivits på 1990-talet f: After all the fittings were stripped out in the 1990s, the rock cavern became a film set – for several Martin Beck films and the TV series Kommissionen, among others. In winter 2010/2011 the Museum of Far Eastern Antiquities showed part of the Terracotta Army here.
När anläggningen invigdes av Gustav VI A: When King Gustaf VI Adolf opened the exhibition centre in 1971, people started calling it Älvsjömässan – a name the company never had. It was actually called S:t Eriks-Mässan, after Stockholm's patron saint, and in 1976 it became Stockholmsmässan.
När banan byggdes ut till fyra spår måst: When the line was widened to four tracks, the Gula villan – the Yellow Villa – had to be moved about ten metres closer to the rails. On 20 July 2014 the house stood in its new spot. It's the only one of Järfälla's four old station buildings along the Västerås line still standing.
När banan förlängdes 1937 anlades slutst: When the line was extended in 1937, the terminus was built by the croft Tullhus, where trains could turn back towards Stockholm Östra. The station was originally called Näsby Park, as two words.
När befolkningen växte på 1960-talet köp: As the population grew in the 1960s, the parish bought a portable church as a temporary solution in 1968. In 1973 it was replaced by the Bollmora parish centre, with a church in yellow brick designed by Bo Sahlin.
När beslutet om ett kulturhus togs 2013: When the decision to build a cultural centre was taken in 2013, the city organised events to find out what the people of Bergsjön wanted. Sweco won the architectural competition, and the building opened on 17 August 2022.
När bion stängt hyrde Teater Aurora loka: After the cinema closed, Teater Aurora rented the premises from 1982 to 1985, and in the 1990s it housed the youth café Magasinet. Today Moment teater has two stages in the building, which the City Museum has green-listed as particularly valuable.
När bostadsområdet kring Sannegårdshamne: When the housing around Sannegårdshamnen was built, the streets were named after cargo vessels that had used the harbour. In 2003 the schooner Ingo got a street of her own. Today she sails in races such as The Tall Ships Races.
När brukspatron Björkman byggde ny kvarn: When the ironmaster Björkman built a new mill, he fell out with the beer brewer Friedrich Neumüller of Skarpnäck farm, who wanted to drain his land by Lake Ältasjön. The dispute ended in 1888, when Neumüller simply bought Nacka farm, mills and sawmill included, for 80,000 riksdaler.
När bröderna Ditzinger 1882 byggde varsi: When the Ditzinger brothers each built a villa by Långsjö farm in 1882, the road was improved. Their charabanc, an open carriage, used it every day as the families travelled to and from Stockholm. The road ends at Långsjö torg, also known as Häggens hörna.
När bröderna Ditzinger byggde sina villo: When the Ditzinger brothers built their villas in 1882, the road was improved too. After that their charabanc ran along it every day, carrying the families to and from Stockholm.
När bussarna ska lämna sina gater får de: When the buses pull out of their bays they get help from reversing cameras – unusual at the time the terminal was built. Inside the hall the floor is limestone, and the benches and service kiosks are pale oak.
När bygget av Annedalsmotet började 1959: When work on the Annedal interchange began in 1959, Fågeldammen, the bird pond in Slottsskogen park, was moved further into the park. The interchange, with its footbridge between Änggården and Slottsskogen, opened on 30 September 1961 at 10 o'clock.
När bygget av Fysiken startade i augusti: When construction of Fysiken began in August 1982, there were four million kronor in the kitty, including 1.5 million from the Wallenberg Foundation. That was enough for three sports halls and changing rooms for 230 people. Fysiken opened on 7 February 1983.
När bygget startade 1946 bodde bara 45 p: When building began in 1946, only 45 people lived here. Two years later there were more than 5,000, and by 1952 the suburb had 16,000 residents – a few more than planned. The newcomers to Hökarängen were also younger than people living in the inner city.
När båtbygget upphörde 1953 hade varvet: By the time boatbuilding stopped in 1953, the yard had turned out 179 ships and boats in all. From then on Sverres went back to making only model ships, right up until the company closed in 1993.
När centret byggdes om till inomhuscentr: When the centre was rebuilt as an indoor mall in 1989, its closeness to Filmstaden, the old film studios, was reflected in the decor – not least the Hollywood staircase with portraits of classic film stars.
När centrumet öppnade fanns en enkel bio: When the shopping centre opened there was a simple cinema called Camera. In 1991 it became Filmstaden Camera with two screens, and in 1997 four. The biggest auditorium had 163 seats.
När centrumet öppnade i slutet av 1960-t: When the centre opened in the late 1960s, it got a simple cinema called Camera. It became a multiplex with two screens in 1991 and four in 1997, then moved in 2013 to become Filmstaden Täby.
När den första Nockebybron blev klar 178: When the first Nockeby bridge was finished in 1787, farmers from the islands of Lake Mälaren began driving their loads to the capital, and Nockeby inn stood at the end of the bridge. In 1912 the Nockeby laundry took over, and it kept going until 1976.
När den första Nockebybron stod klar 178: When the first Nockeby Bridge was finished in 1787, farmers from the Lake Mälaren islands began driving their loads to the capital, and Nockeby tavern by the bridgehead was where they could fortify themselves. Later the Nockeby laundry took over the site, and it kept going until 1976.
När den gamla kyrkan vid Hötorget revs 1: When the old church at Hötorget was demolished in 1953, some of its building materials were reused for a mission church in Stuvsta. The pulpit moved to the new Bethlehem Church and is still in use today.
När den gamla varvsbyggnaden blivit hote: After the old shipyard building was turned into a hotel, it won the Swedish Stone Industry Federation's Stone Prize in 1993. In 1995 the hotel and Eriksbergshallen were jointly named Gothenburg's building of the year.
När den nya kyrkan invigdes 1906 övergav: When the new church was consecrated in 1906, the old one was abandoned and left to decay. But in 1943 it was restored, and it has been in use again ever since. The altar cross is thought to have been brought home from Italy by an 18th-century sea captain.
När den nya vägen mot Södertälje stod kl: When the new road to Södertälje was finished in 1669, Fittja ended up a comfortable day's journey from Stockholm, and this was where horses were first changed on the way south. A half-mile post west of the bridge at Fittjanäset still shows the distance to the capital.
När domstolen prövar en ansökan bevakar: When the court considers an application, a privacy protection representative looks after the interests of individuals and is bound by confidentiality. The court's decisions cannot be appealed.
När en kopia av ängeln skulle avtäckas i: When a copy of the angel was to be unveiled in Skövde in 1955, Carl Milles wrote a short poem for the occasion: "Today you play the flute for us who are gathered here..." These were his last words. He got up from his desk, sat down in an armchair and died a few minutes later.
När fisket sinade kom färjan: When the fishing dried up, the ferry came
När flygfältet planerades 1933 fanns min: When the airfield was being planned in 1933, there were at least 243 graves on eight burial grounds in the area. The oldest was dated to the late 6th or early 7th century.
När folkminnesforskaren Richard Dybeck h: When the folklorist Richard Dybeck found the Äggelunda stone in 1857, it lay in two pieces, both being used as steps – one for a farmhouse and the other for an outbuilding. The top part has never been found again.
När fontänen överlämnades till staden 19: When the fountain was handed over to the city in 1930, Hjalmar Wijk said in his speech that the people of Olskroken shouldn't take the figures as a picture of life in their neighbourhood. The work was paid for by Charles Felix Lindberg's donation fund.
När fortet stod klart kom kronprinsen, s: When the fort was finished, the Crown Prince – later King Gustaf VI Adolf – came to open it. The fort was never used for anything but exercises. It was built for a platoon with four machine guns and is privately owned today.
När församlingen bildades 1786 fanns ing: When the parish was founded in 1786, it had no church. Instead, a large wooden storage shed, put up when the churchyard was laid out, served as the church for 20 years. Known as Mariakyrkan, St Mary's, it had a low tower with two bells and was demolished in 1826.
När församlingen tog tillbaka gården 195: When the parish took the farm back in 1959, several of the buildings were so riddled with rot and house longhorn beetles that they couldn't be saved. They were torn down and rebuilt on the same spots to the original plans. An old brewhouse became the farm chapel, consecrated in 1970.
När godsägaren Axel Berg tog över Vårby: When landowner Axel Berg took over Vårby farm in 1899, Segertorp was divided into plots for villas. At the same time – for reasons unknown and to the annoyance of many – the name was changed to Segeltorp. In 1924 the area became a municipal community in its own right.
När gravfältet Beckomberga-Råcksta under: When the Beckomberga-Råcksta burial ground was excavated in 1950–1953, 190 graves from before the Viking Age were found. The finds – glass beads, gold rings, gaming pieces, combs and bear claws among them – point to a prosperous farming community with trading links across Europe.
När gravfältet var i bruk stod havet cir: When the burial ground was in use, the sea stood about five metres higher than today. Just 150 metres to the south was Frösundet, an inlet of the Baltic that was probably used as a natural harbour. People have lived here since around AD 500.
När gravfältet var i bruk under yngre jä: When the burial ground was in use in the late Iron Age, the sea was about five metres higher than it is today. Just 150 metres to the south lay Frösundet, an inlet of the Baltic that probably served as a natural harbour. People have lived here since around AD 500.
När gravfältet vid ängens östra del anla: When the burial ground at the eastern end of the meadow was laid out, Ålstensängen was a sheltered inlet of Lake Mälaren where ships could be hauled up on the shore. There are at least ten graves. A sign reminds you that the living had their ancestors' graves in view every day.
När gården Karlslunds huvudbyggnad revs: When the main house at Karlslund farm was demolished in 1939 to make room for a larger airfield, a large burial ground was found, with 60–70 graves from the Roman Iron Age, along with a paved road that may have been a ceremonial processional way.
När hallen invigdes den 11 januari 1973: When the hall opened on 11 January 1973, Olympic gold medallist Gunnar Larsson was there to try out the pool. Construction cost around 16 million kronor.
När herrgårdsbyggnaden Karlslund revs 19: When the Karlslund manor house was demolished in 1939 to extend the airfield, a burial ground with 60–70 graves from the Roman Iron Age was discovered. There was also a stone-paved road, thought to have possibly been a processional way.
När hospitalsförsamlingen bildades köpte: When the hospital parish was founded, the German congregation's wooden church was bought and moved to this spot. It served not only the hospital's residents but also the people of the surrounding countryside, and was consecrated in 1627.
När hovfotografen Aron Jonason en kväll: One evening, after the court photographer Aron Jonason had used a lot of magnesium flash, King Oscar II exclaimed: "My, how Jonason flashes!" Quick as lightning, Jonason replied: "Well, if one man flashes, the other must thunder!"
När husen var nya bodde cirka 120 person: When the houses were new, around 120 people lived here, half of them children under 11. A terraced house cost SEK 86,000 to build, and the monthly cost came to 400 kronor.
When the houses were new, about 120 people lived here – and half of them were children under 11. Roughly 30 per cent of the housewives went out to work. The monthly cost was 400 kronor.
När huset byggdes låg det längst ut mot: When this building went up, it stood on the very edge of the open Ladugårdsgärdet fields, where the Svea and Göta Life Guards held their drills. A large archway in the middle of the building leads through to Breitenfeldsgatan, with its planting and fountain.
När huset restaurerades hittade man på v: When the house was restored, parts of a painted 17th-century wooden ceiling were found in the attic, in shades of grey with a floating cherub and the Stenbock coat of arms. The ceiling is now back up, in the entrance hall.
När hållplatsen byggdes om 2013 fick den: When the stop was rebuilt in 2013, it was given a huge triangular roof of toughened glass, held up by beams and steel cables. The effect is rather like a space station.
När högskolan startade 1996 fanns ungefä: When the university college opened in 1996 it had about 1,000 students, spread across Södertälje, Flemingsberg and Haninge. Since 2008 everything has been gathered in Flemingsberg. The journal Baltic Worlds, published here, has subscribers in some 50 countries.
När innerstaden fick rätvinkliga kvarter: When the inner city was laid out in a grid of straight blocks, there was no room left for the windmills. Stora Stampan was moved to Kvarnbacken near Ursvik in 1882. A Stockholm panorama from 1870 shows Lilla Stampan with new buildings creeping ever closer.
När jordbruket upphört blev herrgården p: Once farming had stopped, the manor became a guesthouse in 1930, and by 1940 a detergent factory was operating in the building. During the Second World War it housed families who had fled from Norway. The municipality later planned to demolish it, but a local community association saved the house, and since 2013 it has been a restaurant.
När juristen Johan Cederbielke ägde gård: When the lawyer Johan Cederbielke owned the estate from 1717 to 1752, the Vårby spring was in its heyday as a spa. He laid out the forerunner of Vårby allé, a straight road between the manor and the health spring.
När järnvägen byggdes ut till fyra spår: When the railway was widened to four tracks, the station building had to be moved about ten metres closer to the tracks to save it. On Sunday 20 July 2014 the Yellow Villa stood in its new spot.
När järnvägen mellan Stockholm och Väste: Once the railway between Stockholm and Västerås opened in 1876, it wasn't long before villa suburbs such as Solhem and Bromsten began to spring up. From Spånga the Lövsta line also ran to Hässelby, mostly carrying rubbish, until 1970.

When the railway between Stockholm and Västerås opened in 1876, it wasn't long before villa communities such as Solhem and Bromsten sprang up. Until 1970 the Lövsta line also ran from Spånga to Hässelby, mostly carrying rubbish.
När järnvägens Hagalundstunnel byggdes 1: When the railway's Hagalund tunnel was built in 1908, the water table dropped and the wells in Hagalund ran dry. The solution was to pump water from the esker at Frösundavik, more than five kilometres away, up to a new water tower on Hagalundsberget.
När järnvägshållplatsen kom 1922 tog vil: When the railway halt arrived in 1922, house building took off. In 1926 the architect Arvid Stille drew up a town plan called Eriksbergs villastad, the Eriksberg garden suburb. In time the summer cottages became year-round homes, and the plots were divided up for new houses.
När koloniområdet startade 1973 fanns 24: When the allotment area opened in 1973, there were 242 plots in the valley along the Spångaån stream. Today there are about 120, each roughly 150 square metres. The valley was spared when the Million Programme housing estates were built to the north.
När korsningen byggdes om till rondell 2: When the junction was rebuilt as a roundabout in 2015–2016, a footpath and cycle path were added along Tuvevägen. You can now cycle or walk from the village of Säve all the way into central Gothenburg without mixing with car traffic.
När kvarnarna var rivna stod mjölnarbost: Once the mills had been torn down, the miller's house remained as Qvarntorpet. It was here, on 29 October 1889, that Gerda, daughter of the estate manager Karl Rehn, was born. Under the name Gerd Ribbing she became a well-known writer and journalist.
När kyrkogården utvidgades 1955–1956 lad: When the churchyard was extended in 1955–1956, its walls were built of rough, undressed stone, covered with turf and planted with sedum. The churchyard covers 0.7 hectares and has 345 graves.
När kyrkogården utvidgades på 1830-talet: When the churchyard was extended in the 1830s, Captain Lorenz Gjers donated the land – on one condition: the parish had to stop using the ‘klingelpung’, a collection bag hung with little bells.

When the churchyard was extended in the 1830s, Captain Lorenz Gjers of Underås donated the land – on one condition. The parish had to stop using the klingelpung, collection bags fitted with little bells.
När kyrkskolan skulle läggas ned i börja: When the church school was due to close in the early 1990s, the teachers took it over themselves. It became one of Sweden's first independent schools, opening in August 1993 with 120 pupils.
När kyrkskolan skulle läggas ner i börja: When the church school was due to close in the early 1990s, the teachers took it over themselves. It became one of Sweden's first independent schools, opening in 1993 with 120 pupils in years 1 to 6.
När lokalerna byggdes om till bryggeri f: When the premises were converted into a brewery there was already a steam engine on site – something no Stockholm brewery had had before. The name was chosen to conjure up Bavarian beer, which was hugely popular.
När man sprängde ner Sågargatan i början: When Sågargatan was blasted down to a lower level in the early 1900s, many doorways in the old wooden houses were left hanging high above the street. Take a look at Sågargatan 11, built before 1759.
När mittdelen byggdes på 1930-talet döpt: When the middle section was laid out in the 1930s, the cemetery was renamed Mölndal West Cemetery. Around 1960 it got its old name back. The oldest grave with its monument still in place dates from 1775.
När nya Lidingöbron kom 1971 förlorade S: When the new Lidingö Bridge opened in 1971, Stockholmsvägen lost its role as the main thoroughfare, and the steep, notorious Torsviks backe was closed to cars. Since 1995 the road has run through Lidingö centre as a pedestrian street lined with shops.
När nya vägbron byggdes 1825–1826 bodde: When the new road bridge was built in 1825–1826, the engineer Olof Forsgren lodged at the inn, while the workers from Dalarna and Värmland stayed at the tavern. Forsgren complained about the drinking and wanted the tavern shut, but it never was. From 1916 to 1935 the inn housed Café Stocksundsbro.
När ombyggnaden startade 2009 lyftes den: When the conversion began in 2009, the 26-tonne roof dome was lifted off. Today the building has 41 flats, and right at the top, in the dome, a function room for residents. Many windows that had been blocked up could be opened again.
När området började bebyggas 1921 hette: When building started here in 1921, the area was called Ersta Villastad. The name sparked protests, and in 1926 it was replaced with a made-up one: Stureby. A couple of hundred metres away are the Vivstavarvsvägen terraced houses from the early 1950s, designed by Erik F. Dahl. Their 36 homes are the only ones in Stureby to get the City Museum's blue rating for high cultural value.
När partihallarna invigdes av Gustaf VI: When King Gustaf VI Adolf opened the wholesale market halls in 1962, they were the largest in Scandinavia and the most modern of their kind in Europe. Over time the area became a general food hub, nicknamed 'Stockholm's larder'.
När prästerna kritiserade ängeln svarade: When the clergy criticised the angel, the cemetery board responded with a statement from Erik Lallerstedt, among others. He wrote that the figure seems to want to take those entering the realm of the dead into its embrace, giving their loved ones a sense that there is mercy in death. After that, the debate died down.
När radhusen byggdes 1908–1909 var många: When the terraced houses went up in 1908–1909, plenty of people were sceptical. The magazine Arkitektur called them a single-family barracks, arguing that anyone moving out to the country expected something else. Nobody wanted to buy, so at first the houses were let instead.
När radhusen byggdes 1908–1909 var tidsk: When these terraced houses were built in 1908–1909, the journal Arkitektur was scathing, calling them 'single-family barracks'. Nobody wanted to buy them at first, so they were let instead. Terraced houses didn't catch on in Sweden until the 1950s.
När reservatet utökades 2013 kom Brattås: When the reserve was extended in 2013, it took in Brattåsberget, an oak-covered hill with boulder-strewn slopes and sheer cliffs. Look out for mosses such as fällmossa and guldlockmossa here. The area is part of the EU's Natura 2000 network.
När röset restes låg Mälarens strandlinj: When the cairn was raised, the shoreline of Lake Mälaren was about ten metres higher than today, so the cairn stood closer to the water. People lived at a Late Bronze Age settlement, around 1000–900 BC. The settlement covers about two hectares, but only a small part has been excavated.
När simhallen öppnade igen 2018 invigdes: When the swimming baths reopened in 2018, the artwork Mo(der)nism by Carl Boutard with Our Architectural Office was unveiled at the same time. The building is also home to Åkeshov Bowling Centre.
När sjön stod fyra meter högre: When the lake was four metres higher
När skolan invigdes med tal och sång den: When the school opened with speeches and song on 13 September 1914, the newspaper Svenska Dagbladet wrote of premises with 'a pleasant, rustic air', white ceilings and walls in 'a mild, blue colour'. The classrooms were described as spacious, cheerful and pleasant.
När skolplikten fick elevantalet att väx: When compulsory schooling made pupil numbers grow, the wall between the classroom and one of the teacher's rooms was knocked down. The teacher, Abraham Ulrik Ekman – the school's first college-trained teacher – was given a room in the attic instead. He lived in the house until his death in 1888.
När spårvagnshållplatsen byggdes om 2013: When the tram stop was rebuilt in 2013 it gained a large triangular glass roof held up by beams and cables. It looks rather like a space station – fitting for a district with space-themed street names.
När spårvägen byggdes ut i början av 194: When the tram network expanded in the early 1940s, several Hisingen bus routes got their terminus at Vågmästareplatsen. It became the island's central bus interchange – much like a travel centre today. Later, Hjalmar Brantingsplatsen took over that role.
När spårvägen och järnvägarna kom slogs: When the tramway and railways arrived, the horse-drawn omnibuses were put out of business. So from 1907 to 1929 there was no public transport to the centre of Mölndal – only the railway station Mölndals Övre.
När staden byggde sjukhuset sparades del: When the city built the hospital, part of Hökälla's oak woodland was spared, and in it stands the Ascheberg Oak. It's named after Gustaf Adolf von Ascheberg, who is said to have held his wedding feast beneath it.
När stadsdelen byggdes sparades några av: When the district was built, some of the oldest factory buildings were kept and given new roles as an exhibition hall, a conference venue and a car museum. Nacka Strand Bilmuseum, however, closed as early as December 1992, after just seven months.
När stadsdelen planerades på 1960-talet: When the district was being planned in the 1960s, there was debate over whether the name Rinkeby might be confused with an area of the same name in Danderyd. But the street and block names had already been settled, so the name stayed anyway.
När stadsplanen 1943 gjorde området till: When the 1943 town plan made the area industrial land, Engkvist moved away. In the 1950s the factory was converted for Armaturfabriken Trio, which made taps, and the villa became the home of the factory manager.
När stadsplanen ändrades 1943 ville man: When the town plan was revised in 1943, the idea was to try out new ideas from abroad and gather all the shops in one place, at what is now Riksdalertorget. A nine-storey building went up in the centre like an exclamation mark.
När stationen planerades på 1960-talet d: When the station was being planned in the 1960s, there was talk that the name Rinkeby could be confused with an area in Danderyd. But the street and block names had already been decided, so the name stayed despite the risk.
När stationen skulle namnges föreslog na: When the station was being named, the naming committee first suggested Kista gård, so that nobody would confuse it with the word ‘kista’ – coffin. It also pointed out that the proper local pronunciation has a long i.
När stationen öppnade den 26 oktober 195: When the station opened on 26 October 1952, the 600-metre tunnel under Blackeberg was the only underground stretch of the metro outside the inner city.
När stenhuset på Farsta började byggas p: When work began on the stone house at Farsta in the 1620s, a brickworks was set up nearby. It stood roughly where the porcelain factory was later built, and in 1649 it held 33,500 fired bricks. Gustavsberg is named after Gustaf Gabrielsson Oxenstierna.
När tillfartsvägen till Värtaverket bred: When the access road to the Värtaverket power station was widened, the ground around Kungseken, the King's Oak, was raised. To protect the tree, a stone-lined well with a railing was built around its trunk. The oak took root as far back as the 1400s.
När tingshuset byggdes hittade man en 2,: When the courthouse was being built, workers found a 2.7-metre-deep giant's kettle, or pothole, from the Ice Age. You can see it through a window in the cellar wall on the lake side. The stones that ground out the hole are set into the gateposts.
När tomtförsäljningen gick trögt efter 1: When plots were slow to sell after 1917, the owner turned the area into an amusement park, with merry-go-rounds and shooting galleries in the 18th-century park and a café in the main house. Stocksundstorps Tivoli closed after barely a year. Two gateposts by the old country road survive.
När torget vid Finn Malmgrens plan byggd: When the square at Finn Malmgrens plan was built in the 1930s, several oaks and pines were left standing. Much of the surrounding housing is green-listed by the Stockholm City Museum.
När tornet var nytt användes några rum t: When the tower was new, some of its rooms served as an open-air café in summer. There was dancing on Wednesdays, Saturdays and Sundays, and the big draw was 'the most glorious view'.
När tullen flyttades till korsningen mel: When the toll gate moved to the junction of Norrtullsgatan, Uppsalavägen and the busy winter road across the ice of Brunnsviken, business picked up considerably for the coaching inn Stallmästaregården.
När tunnelbanan nådde Farsta den 19 nove: When the metro reached Farsta on 19 November 1958, it started out at a temporary station – right here, at Farstavägen 78 and Pepparvägen 81. Two years later the station moved into the new Farsta centrum, where the square, Farsta torg, was laid out like an Italian piazza, perhaps inspired by the Piazza delle Erbe in Verona. Fruit and flowers are still sold there most days of the week.
När tunnelbanan till Hässelby strand inv: The opening of the metro to Hässelby strand on 18 November 1958 was a real celebration. The first train, decked out with a cluster of six flags front and back, left Bagarmossen at 13.28. The 320 invited guests were served coffee on the way, and at the controls was the tramway's oldest driver, Karl Johan Gustavsson. Today the station is the north-western end of the green line.
När tunnelbanestationen öppnade 1975 i d: By the time the metro station opened in 1975 in the former Ingentingskogen – the ‘Nothing Forest’ – the woods had been renamed Västra skogen. Today they have largely given way to buildings, and in 2013 the new headquarters of Säpo, the Swedish Security Service, was completed in Ingenting.
När varvet lagts ned 1976 låg den stora: When the shipyard closed in 1976, the huge site was left empty. The Slottsberget-Lindholmen association campaigned to preserve the area, and the city council voted 78 to 3 to save and regenerate it.
När verksamheten flyttade 1932 bytte den: When the institution moved in 1932, it changed its name to the Finsen Home Foundation. The home closed in 1966, and today the building in Stadshagen houses a dementia care home.
När villan visades i tidskriften Byggmäs: When the villa was featured in the magazine Byggmästaren in 1939, the photographs were taken by the American photographer Andreas Feininger, who lived in Stockholm from 1933 to 1939.
När villorna byggdes 1882 förbättrades o: When the villas were built in 1882, the road was improved too. After that, the Ditzinger family's charabanc travelled it every day to and from Stockholm.
När vägen restaurerades 1998 byggdes en: When the road was restored in 1998, a dry-stone arched bridge of grey stone was built over the Valla å stream, modelled on the Alby bridge. At the same time the old highway was cleared and gravelled.
När Älvsborgs lösen skulle betalas 1613: When the Älvsborg ransom had to be paid in 1613, only one crofter in the area – 'Erich i Ålsten' – could afford to keep a maid. Even so, the farm was one of the largest in Bromma parish.
När Älvsjö station invigdes 1 november 1: When Älvsjö station opened on 1 November 1879, interest in building here grew. In 1908 and 1911 the company AB Hem på landet bought large parts of the estate's land and divided it into villa plots.
När Älvsjö station invigdes 1879 ökade i: When Älvsjö station opened in 1879, interest in building here grew. In 1908 and 1911 the company AB Hem på landet bought large parts of the estate's land and divided it into plots for villas.
När Åbyfältets trav- och galoppbana öppn: When the Åbyfältet trotting and racing track opened in 1936, it had two stables with room for 52 horses and a stand for just over 1,000 spectators. Both trotting and flat racing were held here until 1976.
När Årstafältet skulle göras om för blan: When Årstafältet was to be redeveloped for new housing and more, the allotment society had to leave its old site. From New Year's Eve 2017 until October 2018 it had no land at all, before it could move in next to Huddingevägen.
När Örby slott hade sålts 1897 och ägorn: When Örby Palace was sold in 1897 and its land carved up into plots, Valdorshem was probably built – the very first villa in the area. It was demolished in the autumn of 2020. Older still is Örby kvarn, a windmill first built in 1672 and replaced by a new one in 1885. All that's left from the mill days is the miller's cottage, which has since been turned into a villa.
När ägaren ville riva palatset för ett h: When the owner wanted to demolish the mansion to make way for a block of flats, the court jeweller Jean Jahnsson bought it in 1902 for 125,000 kronor. It was remodelled in 1903–1906 with the help of Agi Lindegren, Kasper Salin and Isak Gustaf Clason.
När ångbåtarna började gå på Mälaren på: When steamboats began plying Lake Mälaren in the 1830s, Fittja fell silent. In 1841 Crown Prince Oskar wrote that Fittja shines "like the Pole Star in the firmament, but it is now so quiet and desolate there since the steamboats splash in every direction".
När ångbåtstrafiken på Mälaren kom igång: When steamboat services got going on Lake Mälaren in the 1840s, C.A. Wallman, the impresario of Mosebacke, organised outings to the Skärholmen jetty, where passengers could dance.
När ön kallades Djävulsö: When the island was called Devil's Island
När översten Adolf Fredrik Wijnbladh tog: When Colonel Adolf Fredrik Wijnbladh took over the estate, the buildings were partly in ruins. He bought the property in 1782 and the following year had a manor house befitting his rank built among the tumbledown houses. He himself wrote that it "made a stark contrast at first".
Nära Villa Källhagen, en anrik krog med: Near Villa Källhagen, a long-established restaurant with roots in the 18th century, is a large stone carrying a message of thanks. Norway's King Olav V presented it to King Carl XVI Gustaf in 1983 as an official thank-you for Sweden's help to Norway during the Second World War. Among other things, a Norwegian army of 15,000 soldiers was trained on Swedish soil, disguised as 'police troops'. There were also film studios nearby, in use from 1940 to 1960.
Nära platsen där Bjurslätt låg finns en: Close to where Bjurslätt once stood is a slab of bedrock inscribed "Hällarne nämna frejdade gäster" ("The rocks name famed guests") along with almost 60 names of Hedlund's guests, Viktor Rydberg among them. The rock gave its name to Hällskriftsgatan, and several of the names have become street names too.
Nära stationen finns Leksaks- och samlar: Near the station is the Toy and Collectors' Museum, all about toys and play, which since May 2018 has shared a building with Historiearvsmuseet, the History Heritage Museum. Also known as HAMN, it was Sweden's first and only battlefield museum. And Fisksätra itself, by the way, is Sweden's most densely populated urban area, with 7,724 people per square kilometre.
Nära Önneredsskolan ligger badplatserna: Close to Önneredsskolan are two swimming spots, Ganlet and Rörvik. Ganlet is a lovely natural recreation area where the wetlands have been restored.
Närheten till Mälaren ger hög luftfuktig: Being close to Lake Mälaren keeps the air humid, which suits mosses, lichens and fungi. The orchid creeping lady's-tresses grows in the spruce forest, and the fungi include rarities such as the woolly bracket and the fragrant tooth fungus. In a reed-free patch of the lake grows the unusual water plant lesser water-plantain.
Närlunda nämns i skrift redan 1329, som: Närlunda is mentioned in writing as early as 1329, as in nærdholundum. The surviving main building at Närlunda gård, with its two detached wings, dates back to the 1600s. North of the house lay a large orchard, part of which is still there.
Närlunda är ett av bostadsområdena i tät: Närlunda is one of the residential areas in the town of Ekerö. A little further on is Tappström, which counted as a separate town right up until 1975. That's also where you'll find Ekerö centrum, designed by the architect Ralph Erskine and completed in 1991, crowned by its trademark dot more than twenty metres up. Erskine's vision of a ‘Mälaren town’ has drawn international attention to the area.
Närmast stranden byggde JM 2020 Fyrtorne: Right by the shore, JM built Fyrtornet Dalénum, "the Lighthouse", in 2020, designed by Wingårdh Architects. At 22 storeys, it's the tallest building on Lidingö and the area's new landmark.

Right by the shore, JM built Fyrtornet Dalénum in 2020, designed by Wingårdh Architects. At 22 storeys it is the tallest building on Lidingö. Several parts of Dalén's old factory survive, including the machine shop with its saw-tooth roof.
Närmast torget, vid Götgatan 48, ligger: Nearest the square, at Götgatan 48, stands the 17th-century Lillienhoff Palace. On the square itself is Göran Strååt's cheeky sculpture Kasper.
Närsjukhuset började ta emot patienter r: The local hospital began seeing patients as early as 2008, in a series of temporary premises. That gave staff and patients a rare chance to shape how it would work before the new building by the terminal was finished in May 2015.
Näsby slott fick sitt utseende på 1600-t: Näsby Castle took on its present appearance in the 1600s to designs by Nicodemus Tessin the Elder, and several parks were planted around it. Näsbypark takes its name from these castle parks. A grand avenue more than a kilometre long was also planted leading up to the castle.
Näsby slott ligger vid Näsbyviken av Sto: Näsby Palace stands on Näsbyviken, a bay of Stora Värtan, and is now a conference venue with a hotel and restaurant. The station next door has a little naming story of its own: it opened in 1937 as Alléparken, but after just four months it was renamed Näsby allé. At times the name has even been written as one word, Näsbyallé.
Näsbydal byggdes 1958–1961 efter ritning: Näsbydal was built in 1958–1961 to designs by Sune Lindström, among others. Its eight 17-storey tower blocks realise Le Corbusier's vision from the 1930s. The architecture writer Jerker Söderlind has called Täby 'The House that Sune built'.
Näsbydal planerades på 1950-talet när Tä: Näsbydal was planned in the 1950s, as Täby was changing from a farming community into a suburb. Its location close to the Roslagsbanan railway and the planned motorway to Norrtälje was a big draw. Building started in 1958, and the first residents moved in in February 1959.
Näsbydal är format som ett ägg, med 900: Näsbydal is shaped like an egg and has 900 flats, ranging from studios with a sleeping alcove to seven-room flats on two floors. The housing cooperative even has its own football pitch, tennis court and several playgrounds. Right next to it is Kvarntorpshällen, a rock slab with runes on it that the author Jan Fridegård discovered in 1943, carved with the word 'stepsons'.
Näsbydals hus ritades 1958–1961 av Sune: The Näsbydal buildings were designed in 1958–1961 by Sune Lindström, Åke Arell and Alf Bydén. The facades are clad in corrugated aluminium with square windows without glazing bars. Not even the balconies are allowed to break the form – they're recessed into the facade.
Näsbypark räknas som ett av Täbys mer ex: Näsbypark is one of Täby's more exclusive neighbourhoods, with villas, flats and terraced houses by the water on Stora Värtan. Further on is Näsby allé station, which opened in 1937 as Alléparken but changed to its current name after just four months. On Näsbyviken bay stands Näsby slott, a palace that's now a conference hotel with a restaurant.
Näsbyparks kyrka är en kvadratisk träkyr: Näsbypark Church is a square timber church with a pyramid-shaped roof of black-painted sheet metal and glazed corners. It was consecrated in 1980, and its free-standing bell tower was designed by Rune Monö.
Näset är en halvö på ungefär tre gånger: Näset is a peninsula roughly three kilometres by two. The biggest marinas are Bjölahamnen, facing Askimsviken bay to the east, and Hammars båthamn to the west, while Smithska udden is one of the larger bathing spots.
Näsets krog låg där flera landsvägar möt: Näsets krog, an inn, stood where several country roads met near the church. In the 18th century there were reports of "disorder and scenes", and the inn was said to keep parishioners from going to church. Today the building is a scout hut.

Näsets krog, an inn, stood where several country roads met near the church, and this is where the centre of Lidingö parish grew up, with a parish hall and a poorhouse. The inn probably closed in the early 1800s, and since the 1970s the building has been a scout hut.
Näsets kvarn stod först på Södermalm, dä: Näset windmill originally stood on Södermalm, where it was nicknamed "Kodön" ("Cow-death") after one of its sails struck and killed a cow. It was moved here in the 1840s. It's a post mill, so the whole building can be turned to face the wind.
Näsets kyrka ligger bara ett par hundra: Näsets kyrka, Näset Church, is only a couple of hundred metres away. The Näset peninsula has lots of places to swim along its rocky shore, including a nudist beach, and at its highest point, 50 metres above sea level, is an old lookout hut once used by maritime pilots. Åkered, with around 600 homes, was built between 1964 and 1966.
Nässlan hade flera systeranläggningar by: Nässlan had several sister shelters built on the same principles, including Pionen on Södermalm and Liljan in Bromma. After being modernised in the 1970s, Nässlan could withstand a direct hit from a 250-kilo aerial bomb and had protection against gas and radiation.
Nästan alla gator i Ärvinge är uppkallad: Almost every street in Ärvinge is named after a place in Denmark. The exceptions are Ärvingevägen and Igelbäcksgatan, named after the area itself and the nearby Igelbäcken stream.
Nästan granne med hållplatsen ligger Blå: Almost next door to the stop is Blå Stjärnan, Sweden's largest animal hospital, which treats dogs, cats and small pets around the clock, every day of the year. Many people know it from the SVT series Djursjukhuset, 'The Animal Hospital'. A little further off, Hotel The Weaver rises 22 storeys high. Its name – Vävaren in Swedish – is a nod to the Krokslätt mills, which ran a complete weaving operation until the 1970s.
Nästan granne med hållplatsen står Kasta: Almost next door to the stop is Kastalakyrkan, the church of the Komarken district. Kungälv lies where the Göta älv river splits and the Nordre älv branches off, about 20 kilometres north of central Gothenburg. The town is also home to Nordiska folkhögskolan, the Nordic Folk High School, and to the west the municipality stretches out into a rugged coastline with an archipelago.
Nätets lugnaste station: The quietest station on the network
Någonstans här i närheten gömmer sig kan: There may be a runestone hiding somewhere around here. It's said to have stood by the avenue leading from Ulriksdal Palace, where there's now a road interchange, and it was probably built into a road culvert in the second half of the 1800s. People have gone looking for it several times, without any luck. Right next to it is Villa Jacobsdal, which shares its name with an older name for Ulriksdal Palace.
Någonstans i Veddesta stod en gång en vi: Somewhere in Veddesta there once stood a Viking Age runestone, U 93. Olof Celsius the Elder wrote about it in 1728 – and no one has seen hide nor hair of it since. The area takes its name from Veddesta gård, a farm that survived until 1983, and the industrial estate is set to become a mixed neighbourhood with several thousand new homes.
Någonstans nedanför Albyberget låg Svart: Somewhere below Albyberget lay Svartlöten, a thing site where local assemblies met as early as the founding of Stockholm in the mid-13th century. The Göta landsväg ran here, and it remained the most important road until the end of the 17th century.
Några av Nora gårds gamla byggnader finn: Some of Nora farm's old buildings survive, including an 18th-century watermill by Kvarnparken and a couple of storehouses. The present main house, from the first half of the 19th century, has been a preschool since 1975.
Några byggnader från militärtiden finns: A few buildings from the military era survive with new uses. The old headquarters now houses SIPRI, the peace research institute, and a former barracks has become a preschool.
Några hundra meter bort ligger lilla Sto: A few hundred metres away lies little Stockbysjön lake, barely two metres deep at its deepest point, with yellow water lilies on its surface. It drains into Kottlasjön through the Stockbyån stream, which runs through flooded woodland and swamp where beavers, among others, are thriving. The area also has the Skärsätra water tower, a drinking-water reservoir that opened in 1912 and closed in 1959.
Några hundra meter bort står en runsten: A few hundred metres away, beside Kummelby Church, stands the Kummelby stone, a runestone from the late 11th century. The church has a little story of its own. The first one was built on the site of the old Kummelby farm, but it only held 50 people and was nicknamed Kummelby's little church. It was taken out of use in 1999, and just before Christmas 2000 a new church was consecrated.
Några hundra meter härifrån glittrar Söd: A few hundred metres from here sparkles Södra Långevattnet, a long, narrow lake with crystal-clear water that's popular for swimming. It drains north into Stensjön, close to Gunnebo House, which has lent its name to both Stensjön parish and Stensjökyrkan church. On the neighbouring ridge, Kikås, you'll also find Sweden's largest free-standing insect hotel.
Några hundra meter härifrån ligger Safjä: A few hundred metres from here is the Safjället nature reserve, on a rocky plateau near the Gothenburg border. To the south-west, the hill drops steeply down to the Toltorp valley. The reserve was set up in 1991 and covers 88 hectares. Closer to the stop is the Bifrost area, where the street names all have a farming theme.
Några hundra meter härifrån ligger Studi: A few hundred metres from here is Studio Fredman, the recording studio Fredrik Nordström set up in 1990. A long line of Swedish metal bands have recorded here – In Flames, Hammerfall, Opeth, Dark Tranquillity and Soilwork among them – and even Britain's Bring Me the Horizon. Just beyond is Radiotorget, opened in 1954 as Sweden's first satellite-town square.
Några hundra meter härifrån ligger Åbyba: A few hundred metres from here is Åbybadet, Mölndal's swimming centre, which opened on 16 June 2023 and cost 500 million kronor to build. In the same area is Åbytravet, the second-largest trotting track in Sweden. In the other direction lies Eklanda, a district built mostly from 1993 onwards.
Några hållplatser tillbaka mot stan. Vid: A few stops back towards town. At Lackarebäck you'll see The Weaver hotel tower, a nod to the textile company next door.
Några kilometer nordväst om Kärna väntar: A few kilometres north-west of Kärna lies Kärna beech wood, a nature reserve since 2008. Lichen lovers are in for a treat, with several red-listed species, and the flora also includes a rare grass, wood fescue. The reserve covers about 18 hectares and is managed by the West Coast Foundation, Västkuststiftelsen, with some parts adapted for visitors with limited mobility.
Några minuter bort ligger Bandyhallen i: A few minutes away is Bandyhallen in Gubbängen, Stockholm's first indoor bandy arena. It's 25 metres high and opened in the summer of 2020, having originally been planned for Tallkrogen. The area also has the Majroskogen nature reserve, created in 2026 – the largest unbroken stretch of forest in all of Söderort, Stockholm's southern suburbs.
Några minuters promenad bort tar Fagersj: A few minutes' walk away is Fagersjöskogen, a forest of 100 hectares and one of the largest in Söderort, Stockholm's southern suburbs. It's also home to the biggest spruce tree in Stockholm! Nearby is Villa Lindhov, a wooden villa that Harald Lind had built in 1910 and then named after himself. It's one of the few well-preserved houses left from Södertörns villastad, a planned garden suburb.
Några musikintresserade byggarbetare ber: A few music-loving construction workers told Anders Carlberg there was a shortage of rehearsal rooms. He made sure 50 of them were built in the building and got the ABF adult education association on board to run study circles – and so Fryshuset became a hub for young musicians.
Några scener i Svenska Ords film Äppelkr: Some scenes from Svenska Ord's 1971 film Äppelkriget (The Apple War) were shot at Finedal. During the restoration of 1980–1985, the villa got back its green weatherboarding and its open veranda.
Några utomhusscener i tv-serien Svensson: Some outdoor scenes for the TV series Svensson, Svensson were filmed in Östra Rudboda. Lidingö also has Sweden's first terraced houses, the Canada houses from 1908–1909.
Nödbostadshuset vid Ulvsundavägen har bo: The emergency housing on Ulvsundavägen has a stone ground floor topped by two wooden storeys – a type known in Gothenburg as a landshövdingehus. It was meant to be temporary but became permanent in the 1960s, not least thanks to its handsome façade.
OS första serve slogs här: The Olympics’ first serve was struck here
OS i Stockholm 1912 började redan den 5: The 1912 Stockholm Olympics got under way as early as 5 May, with indoor tennis in the Tennis Pavilion. At 1.15 pm Carl Kempe struck the first serve, with King Gustav V watching from the stands.
Oas ligger i rondellen vid Kungens kurva: Oas sits on the roundabout where Kungens kurvaleden meets Smistavägen. In a miniature landscape with a pond and gentle hills, 15 imaginary plants in stainless steel 'grow', their buds lit from within by LEDs.
Oasen invigdes 1995, fyra år efter att d: Oasen opened in 1995, four years after the old swimming baths burned down. The 25-metre pool has eight lanes, and there's a splash pool for the little ones.
Obelisken som tackade borgarna: An obelisk to thank the burghers
Obelisken vid Storkyrkan lät Gustav III: Gustav III had the obelisk by Storkyrkan, Stockholm Cathedral, put up to thank Stockholm's burghers, who had kept watch over the city during the war of 1788–1790.
Odenbiografen på Långedragsvägen 23 öppn: The Oden cinema at Långedragsvägen 23 was opened in September 1919 by Anders and David Lagergren. It changed hands in 1922 and closed in February 1925. From 1955 the Olympia was run by AB Cosmorama.
Odenbiografen öppnades i september 1919: Anders and David Lagergren opened the Oden cinema in September 1919. It changed hands as early as 1922, and on 8 February 1925 it closed for good.
Odenplan har inga egna gatuadresser – de: Odenplan has no street addresses of its own – they belong instead to Odengatan, Karlbergsvägen and Upplandsgatan. Odengatan, by the way, was originally going to be called Rörstrandboulevarden.
Odling mot matbristen: Growing food in a time of shortage
Officerarna från militärakademin Karlber: Officers from the Karlberg military academy were fond of going to Norrbacka – supposedly because the inn had the prettiest waitresses. For those after other diversions, there were also four skittle alleys.
Officiellt heter ön fortfarande Trälen: Officially, the island is still Trälen
Oftast kommer pristagare inom naturveten: The visitors are usually science laureates. In 2014 the school welcomed the chemistry prize winners Eric Betzig and William Moerner, and in 2017 Michael W. Young came.
Olaus Petri kyrka är integrerad i den no: Olaus Petri church is built into the northern end of a curving apartment block with around thirty flats and a gym. Locally it's simply called OP. A large white concrete cross stands at an angle in front of the gable.
Oljeraffinaderiet Preemraff Göteborg en: The Preemraff Göteborg oil refinery, not far off, gets most of its crude oil from the North Sea. Giant tankers dock at the crude oil harbour on Hjärtholmen, and the oil is stored in rock caverns right beside it. Tankers also unload further in at Skarvikshamnen harbour, but the water there is too shallow for the very biggest.
Oljeraffinaderiet Preemraff Göteborg kan: The Preemraff Göteborg oil refinery can process around six million tonnes of crude oil a year, most of it from the North Sea. Even ULCC-class supertankers – the biggest in the world, 333 metres long – have docked at the crude oil harbour on Hjärtholmen. The oil is then stored in huge caverns in the rock next to the harbour.
Oljetåg på Lidingöbanan: Oil trains on the Lidingö line
Olof Rudbeck den äldre läste in något he: Olof Rudbeck the Elder read something entirely different into the carving. With his imaginative interpretation in Atlantica, he hoped to support the idea that there had once been a Nordic cult of the goddess Isis.
Olof Skötkonungsgatan fick 1925 sitt nam: Olof Skötkonungsgatan got its name in 1925, after King Olof Skötkonung and his supposed link to Örgryte Old Church, just a short walk from here. It's one of the most popular churches in Gothenburg for weddings, and the old churchyard, dating from the 13th century, is the resting place of three bishops, among others. At the entrance stands the statue Genomkämpat, roughly 'Fought Through' – the original is in Berlin.

Olof Skötkonungsgatan was named in 1925 after King Olof Skötkonung and his supposed connection with Örgryte Old Church, a short walk away. It's one of Gothenburg's most popular churches for weddings, and among those resting in its 13th-century churchyard are three bishops. Beside the church stands the bronze statue Genomkämpat, 'The Struggle Is Over', a copy of a work by the Berlin professor Stephan Walters.
Olshammarsgatan, en av Hagsätras två huv: Olshammarsgatan, one of Hagsätra's two main streets, runs for about 600 metres from Hagsätra centrum out to Ormkärr, crossing both Huddingevägen and the green metro line on the way. The centre itself went up in a single year and opened in 1960, and the copper sculpture 'The Child with the Hobby Horse' still stands guard there.
Olyckan 1908 skedde för att godstågets f: The 1908 accident happened because the driver of a goods train thought an extra train to Malmö was the express he was due to meet. He ran past the station and collided with the express on a bend by Döda bron. The damage was extensive, but the drivers escaped with only minor injuries.
Olycksbilen står på bilmuseet vid Sparre: The car from the accident is on display at the motor museum at Sparreholm Castle. But a similar Cadillac was kept at the Skokloster motor museum, and both museums claimed theirs was the "real" one.
Om man bortser från en liten flik av Mäl: Apart from a small corner of Lake Mälaren, Lötsjön is the only lake in Sundbyberg, and since 2018 it has been a nature reserve together with the neighbouring Golfängarna meadows. Beside the lake is Lötsjökapellet, a chapel on the edge of Sundbyberg cemetery. The sports ground nearby is known to locals as Sumpan IP, and its all-weather track isn't full-size – it's just 366 metres.
Om namnet Segertorp finns två teorier. D: There are two theories about the name Segeltorp. One says it comes from an old word for waterlogged ground; the other that it commemorates a Swedish victory over the Danes in the 1500s. The place-name scholar Jan Paul Strid, however, considers both to be legends.
Omkring 1,5 miljoner människor besöker N: Around 1.5 million people visit the Nacka nature reserve every year, which probably makes it Sweden's most visited. This is also where the Sörmlandsleden long-distance trail begins, and there are some 30 kilometres of walking trails.
Omkring 1558 anlades en hammarsmedja här: Around 1558 a hammer forge was set up here on the orders of King Gustav Vasa. Swedish and German smiths made locks, horseshoes, chains and armour, and by 1589 there were no fewer than three gunpowder mills. At times up to ten waterwheels were turning at once.
Omkring 1865 lät Karl XV bygga tre villo: Around 1865 King Karl XV had three Swiss-style villas built by Brunnsviken bay, all named Karlsro after him. Övre Karlsro sits in the middle, with the other two placed symmetrically below it like detached wings, and an English-style park was laid out between them. The king let the houses to his friends as summer retreats.
Omkring 1870 byggde varvsarbetare från E: Around 1870, workers from Ekensberg shipyard built small villas along the shore in their spare time, giving them names like Selmyhill, Bergshyddan and Linneaborg. The owner offered to sell them the whole island for 60,000 kronor, but they couldn't raise the money.
Omkring 1870 började arbetare från Ekens: Around 1870, workers from the Ekensberg shipyard began building houses along the shores in their spare time, decorated with fretwork and Old Norse details. The villas were given names such as Loviseberg, Bergshyddan and Selmyhill. A few survive, including some below Aluddsvägen.
Omkring 1904 såldes salarnas väggmålning: Around 1904 the wall paintings in the reception rooms were sold off – those in the hunting room for 75 and 150 kronor apiece – and ended up in a house at Västra Trädgårdsgatan 9. Agneta Wrede's drawing room did get its original wallpaper back, however, after it was found in the attic of St Erik's Hospital.
Omkring 1908–1909 anlades en dansbana på: A dance floor was laid out at Kikås around 1908–1909, and from 1918 to 1945 the same spot by Träsnidaregatan and Glasbergsgatan was home to a folkpark, one of the open-air entertainment parks of the labour movement. A shooting range had already opened in 1899 on what is now Skyttegatan.

Around 1908–1909 a dance floor was laid out at Kikås, and from 1918 to 1945 a folkpark – a people's park for dances and entertainment – stood on the same spot by Träsnidaregatan and Glasbergsgatan. As early as 1899, Kikås got a shooting range by what is now Skyttegatan.

Around 1908–1909 a dance floor was built at Kikås, and from 1918 to 1945 the same site by Träsnidaregatan and Glasbergsgatan hosted a folkpark – a people's park with music and entertainment. Kikås had already got a shooting range back in 1899, on what is now Skyttegatan.
Omkring 1940 byggdes ett soldathem för d: Around 1940 a soldiers’ home called Bellevue was built for the conscripts stationed at Kviberg. When the regiment was disbanded in 1992 the building was sold to a free-church congregation, and since 2008 it has been used by the New Life church.
Omkring 25 företag har fasta försäljning: Around 25 companies have permanent stalls in the hall, selling cut flowers, perennials, dried plants and soil, among other things. The goods come from their own nurseries in the Mälaren valley and from abroad. It's wholesale only, though, so private customers can't buy here.
Omkring en kilometer sydost om kyrkan li: About a kilometre south-east of the church, a stone labyrinth 7.5 metres across lies on a slab of bedrock. It once had twelve rings, but only six circuits of stones survive. The spot is known as Stora Möet.
Områdena planerades för över 100 000 inv: These districts were planned for more than 100,000 residents and built from south to north: Hjällbo in 1966, Hammarkullen in 1968, Gårdsten in 1969, Lövgärdet in 1970 and Rannebergen in 1971. Angered Centrum, where the tram has its terminus, didn't come until 1978.
Området Sandbäck i närheten har långa rö: The nearby area of Sandbäck goes back a long way. As early as the 1550s it was made up of two homesteads – two farms – long before any buses came rolling through. A little further on is Rävekärr, whose grey, square terraced houses are known locally as 'box houses', and south-east of them lies the glittering Lake Horsikan.
Området Skårdals skate på älvens östra s: Skårdals skate, the area on the east bank of the river, belonged to Norway from the 1400s until 1658. From Bohus Fortress on the opposite bank, Norway controlled traffic both on land and on the water.
Området består av två brott med cirka 20: The site is made up of two quarries about 200 metres apart. The larger, northern one has a short, curving mine tunnel, while the southern one is a smaller open pit.
Området har fått sitt namn efter en dike: The area takes its name from the time King Gustaf V's car ended up in a ditch on Södertäljevägen in September 1946 – Kungens kurva means "the King's Bend". The spot is on the grounds of the Scandic hotel, where the ditch and a stretch of the old road embankment could still be seen in 2018.
Området har fått sitt namn efter hemmane: The area takes its name from the Rävekärr homestead in Fässberg parish. One of its farms was Rävekärr vicarage, which stood where Fågelberg Church is today. The last priest moved out in 1978, and the vicarage was demolished in January 1984.
Området har sina rötter i Norra Askims i: The area grew out of the Norra Askim industrial estate. In 1934 the fireworks maker Hanssons Pyrotekniska moved here from Norra Guldheden. Today it is mostly shops and offices, and the only big industry left is Forbo Flooring.
Området har sitt ursprung i det som kall: The area grew out of what was once called the North Askim industrial estate. In 1934 the fireworks factory Hanssons Pyrotekniska, previously based in Norra Guldheden, set up shop on the road leading up to Västra Frölunda cemetery.
Området har varit bebott i minst 2500 år: People have lived here for at least 2,500 years. A Viking Age trade route ran from the Baltic across Edsviken and Norrviken to the settlements by Lake Mälaren.
Området hette först Maltesholm, efter en: The area was first called Maltesholm, after a small farm. The driving force behind the development was city planning director Sven Markelius, but many objected to building so close to the water and would rather have taken the metro to Hässelby villastad.
Området kallades Rörstrand eftersom Klar: The area was called Rörstrand because the shores of Klara sjö were lined with reeds. The porcelain factory was founded in 1726 by Johann Wolff, who had promised he could make true porcelain – but all he managed was faience, and he was sacked in 1728.
Området kallades länge Vita fläcken, eft: For a long time the area was known as Vita fläcken, “the White Spot”, because it was a blank on the development maps while the plans dragged on. Its official name is Trollängen, and the housing cooperative HSB built flats here in 1963–1964.
Området kring Telefonplan kallades LM-st: The area around Telefonplan was known as LM-staden – LM Town – and became a company town of its own, with homes, a factory, shops and healthcare. In 1937 the land was still fields belonging to Hökmossen farm.
Området planerades i tätt samarbete med: The area was planned in close cooperation with the police and has stood out for its unusually low level of everyday crime.
Området planerades som Gröna byar, inspi: The area was planned as Gröna byar, "Green villages", inspired by small towns, with 15–20 terraced houses around each courtyard. Every courtyard was given a tree name, such as Apeltunet (apple), Hasseltunet (hazel) and Misteltunet (mistletoe), and its own colour – red or yellow.
Området runt Askims torg kallades Vita f: The area around Askims torg, Askim’s square, was nicknamed Vita fläcken – ‘the blank spot’ – because building plans dragged on and it stayed blank on the map for years. Its official name is Trollängen, and the HSB co-operative flats went up in 1963–64.
Området runt Stora Sköndal håller på att: The area around Stora Sköndal is turning into a whole new district. Work began in 2014 and is expected to continue until 2035, by which time there should be 4,500 new flats and 1,500 new jobs here.
Området var en skogbevuxen kulle. Husen: The area was a wooded hill. To spare the natural surroundings, the buildings were assembled using light mobile cranes, and the landscape architect Sylvia Gibson helped shape the setting.
Området var från början mest skog, men 1: The area was mostly forest at first, but in 1911 the Dalen allotment gardens were laid out. Some of the cottages survive: 42 still stand on the edge of the housing estate.
Området är cirka 84 hektar, och nästan h: The area covers about 84 hectares, almost half of it shared land. Krusboda is one of Sweden's largest joint-ownership estates and has its own pool with sauna, Krusbodabadet.
Områdets elva kvarter har fått namn efte: The area's eleven blocks are named after old farming occupations, such as Dannemannen (the Yeoman), Fodermarsken (the Fodder Master), Lantpatronen (the Squire), Lillpigan (the Under-Maid), Slåtterkarlen (the Mower), Plöjaren (the Ploughman), Vallpojken (the Herd Boy) and Vallflickan (the Herd Girl).
Opalområdet började byggas i mitten av 1: Building began in the Opal area in the mid-1960s. In April 2016 ground was broken for a new block around a square, with shops, a community hall, offices and some 500 homes close to the buses and trams.
Opalområdet får nytt torgkvarter: A new square for the Opal area
Operahuset är 160 meter långt och 32 met: The opera house is 160 metres long and 32 metres high, and the auditorium seats around 1,300. The main stage has a revolving section 14 metres across, lit by 1,000 spotlights.
The Gothenburg Opera was inaugurated over three evenings in 1994. At a staged meeting of three kings on the stage, Carl XVI Gustaf, joined by 'Gustav II Adolf' and 'Gustav III', declared the house open. On the third evening the opera was 'launched' like a ship by its godmother, the court singer Birgit Nilsson.
Operasångaren i Villa Wållgren: The opera singer at Villa Wållgren
Operasångerskor på gatuskyltarna: Opera singers on the street signs
Optisk telegraf på berget: An optical telegraph on the hill
Orangeriet ritades av Carl Hårleman och: The orangery was designed by Carl Hårleman: a long, low building with restrained Rococo façades in yellow render and large orangery windows, typical of his style. The double doors to the greenhouse are probably original.
Orangeriet är en låg byggnad i gul puts: The orangery is a low building in yellow render, with the large windows and rusticated quoins typical of Hårleman. To the south are footpaths and lime-tree avenues, to the west the sheep barn, the kennels and the arboretum, and the park borders the Judarskogen nature reserve.
Ordet göteborgsvits är känt sedan 1863,: The term göteborgsvits – the famous Gothenburg pun – goes back to 1863, when the magazine Söndags-Nisse wrote that it was mostly wordplay 'where the sound is everything, the meaning nothing'. Travelling salesmen spread the puns around the country to draw buyers at markets.
Ordet prol kommer från portugisiskans em: The word ‘prol’ comes from the Portuguese ‘em prol’, meaning an advantage. The name was chosen on a train journey between Lisbon and Stockholm in 1903, because the working name – the Swedish Sawdust Sweeping Compound Factory of the Old Town, Surroundings and Abroad – was deemed unsuitable.
Ordet stampan tyder på att kvarnen stamp: The word 'stampa' suggests the mill pounded plants such as flax and hemp to make rope and sails. But whether Stora and Lilla Stampan really were hemp mills has never been documented.
The word stampan suggests a stamping mill – one that pounded plants such as flax and hemp for rope and sailcloth. Whether Lilla and Stora Stampan really were hemp mills, however, isn't documented.
Organiserad handelsundervisning har funn: Gothenburg has offered organised business education since 30 January 1826, when Göteborgs handelsinstitut opened as the first commercial institute in Sweden. Its first premises were rented in the building then occupied by the Grand Hotel.
Orgel med engelsk och fransk klang: An organ with English and French tones
Orgel och Boforsklocka: An organ and a Bofors bell
Orgelfasaden snidades av bildhuggaren Fr: The organ case was carved by the sculptor Frithiof Richter, and since 2003 it has held a fourteen-stop instrument from the Tostared organ works. The church bell, a gift, was cast at the Bofors works in 1919.
Orgeln byggdes 1861 av Johan Nikolaus Sö: The organ was built in 1861 by Johan Nikolaus Söderling and has been rebuilt twice since. Today it has fourteen stops and two manuals.
Orgeln byggdes av A. Magnussons orgelbyg: The organ was built by A. Magnussons Orgelbyggeri and has ten stops, two manuals and a pedalboard. It was rebuilt in 2011 by Tostareds Kyrkorgelfabrik.
Orgeln byggdes redan 1982 av Walter Thür: The organ was built back in 1982 by Walter Thür Orgelbyggen and has 14 stops. It was moved here and repainted in 2005, when the church was finished.
Orgeln byggdes ursprungligen 1865 av org: The organ was originally built in 1865 by the organ builder August Martin for a chapel in Saulkrasti, Latvia. After a chequered history it was restored and installed here in 2004 by a Latvian organ workshop.
Orgeln på läktaren byggdes 2006 av Ålems: The organ in the gallery was built in 2006 by Ålems Orgelverkstad, modelled on 19th-century English and French instruments. It has thirteen stops and also incorporates some older pipework.
Orgeln är äldre än kyrkan: The organ is older than the church
Orienteringsklubben byggde en av distrik: The orienteering club built one of the district's first saunas here, and it was a hit, with more than 9,000 bathers a year. Every weekend from January to March there's a café at Brotorp, open to all.
Originalet finns på Historiska museet oc: The original is in the Swedish History Museum, and a copy stands outside the church. Another copy, in plaster, is at the Victoria and Albert Museum in London. The rune stone Sö 282 lay under the church threshold for a long time and was found in 2024.
Orkidéer i kommunens enda rikkärr: Orchids in the only rich fen
Ormen Långe och Erskines berg: The Long Serpent and Erskine's hill
Ormen i åttan: The serpent in a figure of eight
Ormkärr kallas den del av Hagsätra som l: Ormkärr is the name for the part of Hagsätra that lies south-west of Huddingevägen. From here it's a short way to Hagsätra torg, the square named in 1962, which surrounds the shopping centre.
