Redan 1876 ritade stadsingenjören Hans W: As early as 1876, city engineer Hans Wilhelm Brandel drew up a grid of streets here, but nothing came of it. The square only took shape with Albert Lilienberg’s town plan of 1916. The wooden houses along Slottsskogsgatan were pulled down between 1917 and 1937 and replaced by landshövdingehus – Gothenburg’s typical tenements with a stone ground floor and wooden upper storeys.
Redan 1878 öppnades en hållplats här på: A halt opened here as early as 1878 on what was then the SWB railway. Several station buildings have stood east of the tracks; the last, from 1922, was pulled down in 1969. In 1963 a station building was put on the platform instead, reached through a pedestrian tunnel.
Redan 1904 fick en gata på Lundbyvassen: As early as 1904 a street on Lundbyvassen was named Tellusgatan, after our own planet. That street is long gone. Today's Tellusgatan got its name in 1965 and is lined with three-storey red-brick buildings from 1966.
As early as 1904 a street on Lundbyvassen was named Tellusgatan, after our own planet. That street has long since gone; today's Tellusgatan got its name in 1965.
Redan 1904 föreslog Johan August Hertz e: As early as 1904, Johan August Hertz proposed a tunnel under the river from Lilla Bommen to Tingstadsvassen, at a cost of 3.5 million kronor. Yet it wasn't until 1961 that ground was finally broken – on what was then the biggest road project Sweden had ever seen.
Redan 1924 skenade en tom släpvagn nedfö: Back in 1924 an empty tram trailer ran away down this same street. A driver heading uphill reversed his tram at speed and managed to catch it, so only property was damaged. Ever since, tram couplings have always had an extra safety chain.
The tower was already out of use by 1926. The wells in the Järva ridge had been pumped so hard that brackish water from Brunnsviken seeped in, so Sundbyberg switched to water from Görväln on Lake Mälaren.
Redan 1930 gick spårvagnslinje 19, Örbyb: As early as 1930, tram route 19 – the Örby line – ran from Slussen to Örby, with a stop at Svedmyran. After 21 years it was replaced by the metro, and the stretch between Globen and Stureby follows the old tramway.
Redan 1930 gick spårvägen Örbybanan förb: As early as 1930 the Örby tram line ran past here, with a stop called Svedmyran. The metro opened on 9 September 1951 and follows the old tramway between Globen and Stureby.
Redan 1933 föreslog tidningen Rörinstall: As early as 1933 the trade journal Rörinstallatören (The Plumber) suggested Sweden should have a museum of plumbing and heating. The idea didn't take shape until the 1980s, and in 1993 a small exhibition opened in the entrance of Katrineholm's technical college.
Redan 1937 bestämde fräntorpsborna sig f: The people of Fräntorp decided back in 1937 to build a community hall, but it didn't open until 3 September 1954. Fundraising took time, and the Second World War brought a shortage of building materials. A shared laundry was installed in the basement.
Redan 1938 kom en motion om bättre förbi: A council motion calling for better links to Rörö, Hyppeln and Knippla was tabled as early as 1938, but the ferry route didn't open until 12 May 1970. Since 2000 it has been free of charge.
Redan 1942 beslöt LM Ericssons vd Hans T: As early as 1942, LM Ericsson's managing director Hans Theobald Holm decided to support a leisure centre near the factory, where employees and their families could socialise and educate themselves. Building had to wait until after the war, and the centre opened on 2 November 1946.
Redan 1953 provades en modell av Fina fi: A model of the sculpture Fina fisken was tried out on the square as early as 1953, and in 1955 the design won a competition. In 1961 a smaller version was bought for the sculpture park at Norrköping Art Museum.
Redan 1974 flyttades huset cirka 400 met: As early as 1974 the house was moved about 400 metres south, because the land was needed to widen Gibraltargatan. Its occupants included travel companies and the Italian consulate.
Redan 1975 sändes Eurovision Song Contes: As early as 1975 the Eurovision Song Contest was broadcast from Stockholmsmässan, the Stockholm International Fairs, and Melodifestivalen, Sweden’s Eurovision selection, was held here in 1996 and 1999. Since then the Kristallen TV awards, the Friday finals of Idol and Talang (Sweden’s Got Talent) have all been recorded here.

The Eurovision Song Contest was broadcast from here as early as 1975, and Melodifestivalen, Sweden's Eurovision selection, was held here in 1996 and 1999. Since then the TV awards Kristallen, Idol and Talang have all been recorded in the exhibition halls.
Redan 1988 föreslogs en företagspark här: A business park was proposed along the motorway here as early as 1988. The buildings were to have a "good shopfront position" facing the E4/E20 while also shielding the older houses of northern Segeltorp from the noise. Work on the street began in the late 1990s.
Redan 1999 ordnades Highvalley Classic &: Back in 1999 the Highvalley Classic & Festival was launched, a downhill competition with live music, held ten times until 2009. The idea for the park came from the Stockholm Sub Surfers association, and the first phase was built in 2011–2012 for about 30 million kronor.

As early as 1999, Highvalley Classic & Festival was held here – a contest with a halfpipe, downhill and live music that got the whole project going. The first stage of the facility was built in 2011–2012 for about 30 million kronor.
Redan 2006 fanns planer på ett 70-våning: As early as 2006 there were plans for a 70-storey tower, Tell US Tower, designed by Gert Wingårdh. It was blocked partly because the county administrative board ruled in 2015 that buildings over 45 metres could interfere with the armed forces' technical systems. In 2018 came a final no, on the grounds of air traffic.
Redan från 1930 hade spårvägen Örbybanan: As early as 1930 the Örby tram line had a stop here called Enskede gård. The metro station opened on 9 September 1951, and the stretch towards Stureby follows the route of the old tramway.
Redan från början hade sjukhuset en egen: From the very start, the hospital had its own ambulance, and in the 1930s an air ambulance service was launched together with the air corps at Hägernäs. Today one in ten Swedes is born at Danderyd Hospital.
Redan första sommaren 1929 levererade In: In its very first summer, 1929, the Inverness spring delivered 700,000 bottles of water and soft drinks. The range included Vichy water, dry ginger ale, Sockerdricka lemonade and Grappo. Svenska Dagbladet praised the water for its "unusual purity".
Redan första sommaren 1929 levererade br: In its very first summer, 1929, the brewery delivered 700,000 bottles of water and soft drinks, including sockerdricka (a Swedish lemonade), Grappo and dry ginger ale. The founder, Torsten Ax:son Johnson, probably brought the recipe for club soda back from Ireland.
Redan första året påbörjades en version: In its very first year, work began on a version of the programming language Prolog that became SICStus Prolog. It's still being developed today, and from around 1991 it was also used for constraint programming.
Redan i början av 1700-talet byggdes ett: As early as the beginning of the 18th century a first poorhouse was built here, on the initiative of Tumba paper mill, which wanted to look after its old workers. A map from 1712 shows a small poor cottage just west of today's building.
Redan i början av 1700-talet fanns här e: By the early 1700s there was already an avenue of trees here, along with flower gardens, orchards, vegetable plots and large ponds for raising crucian carp, bream and carp.

As early as the start of the 1700s there was a roadside tavern here, Röda stugan (the Red Cottage), by the Hesslingeberg farm, named after a huntsman called Hessling. In 1810 Lieutenant Anders Chytraeus opened an inn on the estate. The Red Cottage is still here – in 1988 it was moved about fifteen metres to make room for the new building.
Redan i början av 1800-talet fanns en op: As early as the beginning of the 19th century there was an optical telegraph station here. Before that there was probably a beacon – a fire lit to raise the alarm.
Redan i slutet av 1830-talet hade L. Buc: As early as the late 1830s, L. Buchholtz ran a dye and bleaching works on this spot, employing around twenty people. When Buchholtz ran into financial trouble, the business was taken over by Hans Hemming Wesslau, a native of Uddevalla.
Redan i slutet av 1890-talet idrottade p: Boys from Södermalm were already doing sport by Källtorpssjön lake in the late 1890s. In the 1920s members of the Swedish Society for Nature Conservation wanted to turn the area into a people's park for Nacka, and in 1926 the botanist Rutger Sernander wrote that it had no equal anywhere around Stockholm.
Redan innan Stadion fanns idrottade stoc: Stockholmers were playing sport here long before the Olympic Stadium was built. Stockholms idrottspark opened in 1896 as the city's first civilian sports ground. It had a 400-metre concrete track for cycling and running and was demolished in 1910. Along Valhallavägen, in the Villastaden area, stand 1880s houses that carry the City Museum's highest heritage rating.
Redan när Klasroskolan öppnade 1804 skre: When Klasroskolan opened in 1804, Baron Rudbeck and Dean Althén drew up a set of rules that were ahead of their time. Teaching was to be marked by gentleness and tact, and corporal punishment was only to be used as an absolute last resort.
Redan när Årsta byggdes på 1940-talet di: A church was already being discussed when Årsta was built in the 1940s, but it took a while. In 1952 a bell tower bought from Fyrunga parish in Västergötland was inaugurated, and only in November 2008 was it decided to build the church itself.
Redan på 1300-talet fanns Näsby slott vi: Näsby Castle stood by Näsbyviken bay as early as the 1300s. It got its present look in the 1600s to designs by Nicodemus Tessin the Elder, and several parks were planted around it. It's those palace parks that gave Näsbypark its name.
Redan på 1600-talet började Mölndal bli: Mölndal was already becoming an industrial town in the 1600s. Paper came first, followed by oil mills and textiles. The good water in the river gave the factories a head start.
Redan på 1600-talet gick trätrappor uppf: As early as the 17th century, wooden steps climbed the steep slope here. On Petrus Tillaeus's map of 1733 they're called Munkens trappor, after P. Munck, who built them. Today's stairway climbs a height of around 18 metres.
Redan på 1620-talet lät Klas Horn bygga: As early as the 1620s Klas Horn built a three-storey stone castle about 60 metres north of today's main building. It's long gone, but an excavation in 1999 turned up fragments of wall, glass, porcelain and pottery.
Redan på 1690-talet fanns ett värdshus v: There was an inn at Kolbotten as early as the 1690s. Its 18th-century guests included Carl Gustaf Tessin and Märta Helena Reenstierna, the ‘Lady of Årsta’, who wrote about the place in her diaries.
Redan på 1730-talet fanns ett oljeslager: There was already an oil mill on the headland in the 1730s. The wholesaler Carl Magnus Fris built two windmills, one for linseed oil and paint and one for sawing planks. The sawmill burned down in 1849, but the oil mill from the 1780s still stands and is described as unique in the world.
Redan på 1750-talet bryggdes öl vid ån,: Beer was already being brewed by the river in the 1750s, on the spot where Johan Albrecht Pripp later ran his brewery right up until 1976. In the late 1700s a distillery was also set up here, drawing its water from the Fattighusån canal.
Redan på 1890-talet oroade man sig för t: People were already worrying about the square's nightlife in the 1890s. In 1897 the newspaper Morgonposten complained about the "rather outspoken company" who gathered here at weekends on their way to or from alcohol-fuelled entertainment.
Redan på 1920-talet fanns ett litet affä: Back in the 1920s there was already a small shopping centre here. It included the so-called 'horizontal skyscraper', a long, low timber building of one and a half storeys packed with shops and services.
Redan på 1920-talet fanns planer på att: There were plans to develop the land around Viksjö farm as early as the 1920s, but the farm lay far from the railway and the main roads. Only once cars became common did it pay off. That's why Viksjö is the only part of Järfälla that grew up independently of the Västerås railway line.
Redan på 1920-talet växte ett litet affä: A small shopping centre grew up here as early as the 1920s. It included the so-called 'horizontal skyscraper' – a long, low timber building of one and a half storeys filled with shops and services.
Redan på medeltiden var Utby en egen för: Utby was already a parish of its own in the Middle Ages. The old church is said to have been destroyed in 1566 by Danish troops under Daniel Rantzau, who were laying waste to this part of Västergötland at the time.
Redan på vikingatiden hade landhöjningen: By the Viking Age, land rise had already formed a narrow isthmus between Edsviken and Norrviken. Boats had to be unloaded there, or rolled over land on logs. That’s why Sollentuna’s coat of arms shows three red Viking ships standing on rollers.
Redan sommaren 1920, innan anläggningen: In the summer of 1920, before the studios were even finished, the first film was shot here: Victor Sjöström's The Phantom Carriage, with a graveyard built specially for it. But all the double exposures took time, so Mauritz Stiller's Erotikon reached cinemas first.
Redan sommaren 1920, innan bygget var kl: As early as summer 1920, before the building was even finished, Victor Sjöström's The Phantom Carriage was filmed here. With all its double exposures, though, Mauritz Stiller's Erotikon beat it to the cinemas. In 1929 the first Swedish talkie, Säg det i toner, was recorded here.
Redan tidigt på 1800-talet fanns en opti: As early as the beginning of the 19th century there was an optical telegraph station here, probably preceded by a beacon fire. Today the Gnistäng tunnel is the only one of Gothenburg's major road tunnels where hazardous goods may be transported.
Redan under vikingatiden var Drevviken e: As far back as the Viking Age, Lake Drevviken was a transport route, with a passage out to the Baltic. Later, Länna coaching inn stood beside Dalarövägen, open from the 1630s until 1902 – 'the only one between Stockholm and Dalehamn'.
Redaren Jacob Gustaf Setterwall gjorde s: The shipowner Jacob Gustaf Setterwall did very well for himself, and in 1896 he built a grand villa in Finntorp that is now one of the oldest buildings in Nacka. A little further off, by the bay of Svindersviken, is Svindersvik, a mid-18th-century summer residence designed by Carl Hårleman for the merchant Claes Grill. It's considered one of the best-preserved Rococo estates in Sweden – partly because nobody has ever lived there all year round.
Redaren Jacob Gustaf Setterwall köpte 18: In 1871 the shipowner Jacob Gustaf Setterwall bought the land between the Kyrkviken and Svindersviken bays, and his first summer home was a small wooden villa in Swiss chalet style. Then the shipping line took off and things got grander: in 1896 the lavish Setterwall villa, designed by Johan Laurentz, was completed. On the Nysätra headland a little further on stood the Nackanäs inn, which welcomed guests right up until it burned down in 1960.
Redbergsplatsen hette förr Korsvägen och: Redbergsplatsen square was once called Korsvägen, 'the crossroads', and got its current name in 1883. In 1873 a public water pump was put up here, so that people could enjoy water from Lake Delsjön. Just north of the square, in Redbergslids Folkpark – a 'people's park' for popular entertainment – a pavilion with a stage for performers went up in 1886. And below Sankt Pauli kyrka, St Paul's Church, look out for the bronze fountain group Elementens kamp, the Struggle of the Elements, which was moved here from Olskrokstorget in 1968.
Redutten fick stenmurar och flera byggna: Up until 1808 the redoubt was given stone walls and several buildings. On top of Lilla Billingen, 20 metres high, you can still clearly see the remains of the redoubt, its walls and the foundations of its buildings.
Reenstiernska palatset, även kallat Momm: The Reenstierna Palace, also known as Mommas hus, was built in the 1660s and still looks much as it did then. It's a fine example of the influence Dutch immigrants had on Stockholm's architecture. Right next door stood Södra barnbördshuset, the city's maternity hospital, and Maria Hospital, which opened in 1876. The hospital started out with 125 beds in an old 18th-century factory building, which has since been converted into flats and a nursery school.
Reflexen byggdes av SF och hade 437 plat: The Reflexen cinema was built by SF and had 437 seats, 48 of them 'sweethearts' sofas' – double seats for couples. It also had a CinemaScope screen and extra speakers in the ceiling.
Rekordet på Råsunda är 52 943 åskådare,: Råsunda's record is 52,943 spectators, set at the World Cup qualifier between Sweden and West Germany on 26 September 1965. For club sides, Djurgården hold the record, with 50,750 fans against IFK Göteborg in 1959.
Rekordet på Spånga IP är 3 057 åskådare,: The attendance record at Spånga IP is 3,057, set when Spånga IS played Hammarby in 1993. Djurgården's men's bandy team has also played here, as AIK did before them. The indoor football hall is popular with Stockholm clubs for winter training.

Resecentret invigdes den 11 april 2003 o: The travel centre opened on 11 April 2003 and the following year won the Svenska Stadskärnor award for good design. The team behind it included the architect Gert Wingårdh and the artist Mats Theselius.
Reservatet Igelbäcken i Solna har varit: The Igelbäcken nature reserve in Solna has been protected since 2004 and covers about 167 hectares. It follows the stream from its mouth up to the boundary with Sundbyberg, and is one of several reserves along Igelbäcken.
Reservatet inrättades 2007 och är på omk: The nature reserve was created in 2007 and covers about 16 hectares, of which 6.6 are woodland, 5.2 waterways and 1.6 grazing land. It's also a Natura 2000 site.
Reservatet är ett populärt friluftsområd: The nature reserve is a popular spot for getting outdoors, with a beach and sport fishing. It also has one of the few wheelchair-accessible fishing jetties in Sweden.
Reservatet är ett typiskt mellansvenskt: The reserve is a typical central Swedish rift-valley landscape. The hill to the south is covered in pine and spruce forest, while the northern part is flat clay. A map from the 1700s shows that the lower areas were once meadow and pasture.
Reservoaren rymmer 18 000 kubikmeter dri: The reservoir holds 18,000 cubic metres of drinking water, pumped here from the Lovö waterworks. At its highest, the water level stands 66.10 metres above sea level.
Reservoaren är en betongcylinder, 68 met: The reservoir is a concrete cylinder, 68 metres across and 10 metres high. In the middle a spiral staircase leads up to the roof and its wide views, and through windows you can look down into the inner basin.
Restaurang Sturehof har serverat fisk oc: Restaurant Sturehof has been serving fish and seafood since 1897. A stone’s throw away is Sturebadet, a bathhouse opened in 1885. Where East stands today was once the Brända tomten restaurant, which closed in 1987.
Restaurang i 1680-talshus: A restaurant in a house from the 1680s
Restaurang mitt på ön: A restaurant in the middle of the island
Restaurangen Gässlingen på Brännkyrkagat: The restaurant Gässlingen on Brännkyrkagatan was started in the early 1970s by a man who collected leaded windows from old houses being torn down, and built them into the interior. Later the kitchen took on an Alsatian flavour.
Restaurangen Sjöpaviljongen vid Traneber: The Sjöpaviljongen restaurant on Tranebergs strand stands on piles out in the water. Its light timber structure has an 1870s feel – a nod to the oldest houses in Äppelviken.
Restaurangen låg i en villa som byggts s: The restaurant was in a villa built as a show home, to demonstrate what the new garden suburb might look like. After a rebuild in 1895 it had pointed towers with pale green roofs and views over Stora Värtan.
Restaurant Löwenbräu ligger vid Fridhems: Restaurant Löwenbräu has been at Fridhemsplan since 1970, when it moved from Jacobsgatan. The old Draken cinema was also here.
Restauranten var också namnet på en håll: The restaurant also gave its name to a stop on the Djursholm railway, opened in 1890. It only became Djursholms torg in 1968 – and the line closed as soon as 1976. The restaurant building itself was burned down by the fire brigade in 1963.
Rester av bergen finns kvar inne i kvart: Remnants of the old rocky hills survive inside the blocks along Nybrogatan, which is why the buildings are often six storeys high on the street side but only three on the courtyard side. You can see it in the courtyard of Nybrogatan 72, for example.
Revykungen invigde hatten: The revue king unveiled the hat
Rialto hade 496 platser, varav 126 på lä: The Rialto had 496 seats, 126 of them in the balcony. As early as 1922 the owners went bankrupt, and the Norwegian Odd Biörnstad bought the cinema. It became the first in the Ri-Teatrarna chain.
Riddarfjärden var en gång en av Stockhol: Riddarfjärden was once one of Stockholm's sewers and rubbish dumps, known as Lortfjärden ('Filth Bay') and Guldfjärden ('Gold Bay'). In winter, households carted their excrement out onto the ice. The name Guldfjärden lives on in Guldgränd, a lane on Södermalm.
Riddarfjärden är Mälarens östligaste fjä: Riddarfjärden is the easternmost bay of Lake Mälaren, and the border between the provinces of Uppland and Södermanland actually runs right through the middle span of Västerbron bridge. On the Kungsholmen shore, Mälarbadet opened in 1906. At the time it was the biggest and most exclusive indoor bathhouse in Scandinavia, with pools beneath large skylights. Street names around here remember the tanners who once worked in the area – Garvar Lundins gränd, for example, is named after the tannery owner Anders Wilhelm Lundin.
Riddarholmen och utsikten över Riddarfjä: Riddarholmen and the view over Riddarfjärden
Riggen består av två punkthus i mönstrad: Riggen consists of two tower blocks made of patterned concrete panels, linked by a glazed stairwell. In the bin room, the graffiti artist Carolina Falkholt, alias Blue, has created the artwork sKRäp.
Riksantikvarieämbetet kallar Canadakvart: The Swedish National Heritage Board calls the Canada block groundbreaking. Even so, it wasn't until the 1950s that terraced houses really caught on in Sweden. The block has been a listed building since 1981.
Riksdagen beslutade 1905 att garnisonen: In 1905 parliament decided that the garrison should move its exercises from Gärdet to Järvafältet. At its largest the training ground covered 5,000 hectares. At first the soldiers of the Svea Life Guards had to make their way out here all the way from their barracks on Linnégatan in central Stockholm.
Riksdagsmannen och handlanden Johan Jaco: The merchant and member of parliament Johan Jacob Ekman lived in the villa. In 1890 he sold the Kviberg estate to the Crown for 323,000 kronor, and the barracks of the Göta Artillery Regiment were built on the land.
Riksgränsen går genom fabriken: The national border runs through the factory
Riksmuseet byggdes 1907–1916 i rött hels: The Swedish Museum of Natural History was built in 1907–1916 of red Helsingborg brick to designs by Axel Anderberg. One of the first parts to be finished was the whale museum with its skeletons, which opened in 1908. A Foucault pendulum was meant to hang in the 25-metre tower.
Ringdahl Leg Optiker har funnits på Flem: Ringdahl Leg Optiker has been at Fleminggatan 36 since 1946. When new owners took over in autumn 2007, they kept both the company name and the well-known signs, which had already been included in the City Museum's survey of neon signs in 1998.
Ringen som aldrig byggdes: The ring that was never built
Ringparksstugan började som en liten sal: Ringparksstugan began as a small market stall in rustic style with a turf roof. Traders from the Klarahallen market hall in Stockholm came here a few days a week. Since 1916 the cottage has been the community hall for the people of Duvnäs.
Rinkeby i Danderyd ska inte förväxlas me: Rinkeby in Danderyd shouldn't be confused with the Rinkeby district in northern Stockholm – this one is an old farm and a housing area. A fragment of a Viking Age runestone, U 132, was once found here, but it vanished without trace in the second half of the 1800s. Nobody knows where it went.
Rinkeby Östergård byggdes på 1800-talet: Rinkeby Östergård was built in the 19th century and is now a restaurant.
Rinkeby Östergård, byggd på 1800-talet,: Rinkeby Östergård, built in the 1800s, is a restaurant today.
Rinkeby är äldre än många tror. Byn omta: Rinkeby is older than many people think. The village is mentioned as early as 1347, when it was made up of several farms. Modern Rinkeby was built from 1968 onwards as part of the Million Programme, Sweden's huge housing drive of the 1960s and 70s. Rinkebytorget, the square, now has a small shopping centre and Folkets hus, the community centre, and it's a good place to pick up fruit and veg.
Rinkebybocken – stor som en tia: The Rinkeby goat – the size of a coin
Rishögen fick köras bort: The brushwood pile that had to go
Rissne station på blå linjen togs i bruk: Rissne station on the blue line opened on 19 August 1985. From the platform it's 10.4 kilometres to Kungsträdgården, the end of the line in the city centre.
Rissne station togs i bruk den 19 august: Rissne station opened on 19 August 1985 and is 10.4 kilometres from Kungsträdgården, the terminus of the blue line. The ticket hall is beneath the square.
Rissne är den enda tunnelbanestationen i: Rissne is the only metro station in Stockholm with its name carved in runes. The name also appears on a runestone in Sigtuna, raised in memory of 'Gunnar's son in Risnö'. In 1640 Rissne gård was bought by Reinhold Goevert Leuhusen, secretary of the Admiralty board. Today the old farm is a restaurant and conference venue.
Ristaren av U 91 gjorde många misstag oc: The carver of U 91 made a lot of mistakes, mixing up runes that look alike, especially a and n. In one place he wrote is instead of r, which suggests he may have been copying someone else's model.
Ristningen i Törnby är gjord direkt i et: The Törnby inscription is carved straight into an earth-fast boulder of reddish granite. The stone is 1.2 metres high and the runes are 9–10 centimetres tall.
Ristningen på U 101 sitter på stenens pl: The carving on U 101 is on the stone's flat upper surface and covers about 1.85 by 1.50 metres, with runes 7–16 centimetres high. It's one of the Jarlabanke stones and was described by Richard Dybeck in the 1860s.
Ristningen är Stockholms läns största oc: The carving is the largest in Stockholm County and dates from the Bronze Age. Among other things it shows 18 ships, three animal figures, two footprints and 210 cup marks. One of the two human figures has unusually sturdy calves.
Ristningen är inte signerad. Runforskare: The carving isn't signed. Even so, the runologist Elias Wessén believed it was probably the work of the famous rune master Fot, since the careful craftsmanship, spelling and rune forms are similar to his other stones.
