Sedan 1916 visar Tornbergs klocka tiden: Since 1916 Tornberg's clock has been telling the time on Nybroplan – though not always accurately. Trams have stopped here since 1877, apart from a break from 1967 to 1991.
Sedan 1921 hålls varje år Vårsalongen, o: Every year since 1921 Liljevalchs has held its Spring Salon, often featuring work by members of the public or unknown artists selected by a jury. In August 2021 the gallery gained a large extension, Liljevalchs+.
Sedan 1946 har Lundbergs konditori legat: Lundbergs konditori has stood on the same corner of Gröndalsvägen since 1946, with the same name and in the same premises, making it a true fika classic – fika being Sweden's beloved coffee-and-cake break. Up on the Sannadal plateau rise the point blocks of Ljuskronan, Ljussaxen and Lyktan, built between 1958 and 1972 and now a familiar part of Gröndal's skyline. The light-themed block names – the Chandelier, the Candle Snuffer and the Lantern – suit the hilltop nicely.
Sedan 1960-talet har man flera gånger fö: Since the 1960s there have been several attempts to build on Hansta. In the 1980s the area was earmarked for 20,000 residents and 7,500 flats, but the protests were so fierce that the whole plan was dropped. In the ‘Rädda Hansta’ (Save Hansta) campaign, people could adopt trees to save them from the axe.
Sedan 1967 går en avgiftsfri bilfärja fr: Since 1967, a free car ferry has run from Lilla Varholmen on Hisingen along the Björkö route. Passenger ferries come here from Kalvsund, Grötö and Öckerö.
Since 1967 a free car ferry has run from Lilla Varholmen on Hisingen along the Björköleden route. Passenger ferries also come here from Kalvsund, Grötö and Öckerö.
Sedan 1968 håller GKSS seglarläger på ön: Since 1968 the GKSS sailing club has run a sailing camp on the island, with activities like ghost walks and discos. Electricity didn't arrive until 1970, and running water until 1973.
Sedan 1970 står vattentornet Fornborgsre: Since 1970 the Fornborgsreservoaren water tower has stood right in the middle of the ancient hillfort. Parts of the fort were investigated when it was built, but no objects were found. Up on the plateau there are also a few holiday cottages.
Sedan 1975 är Hågelby en folkpark med ca: Since 1975 Hågelby has been a folkpark – a traditional Swedish people's park – with a café, a 4-H farm, a dance floor and a stage. Hågelbyparken is the only folkpark to have won Folk Park of the Year twice, in 1989 and 2000.
Sedan 1980 hålls Stockholm Jazz Festival: Every July since 1980, the Stockholm Jazz Festival has been held at the old naval shipyard below Moderna Museet, the Museum of Modern Art.
Sedan 1983 använder Göteborgs Finska Pin: Since 1983 Gothenburg's Finnish Pentecostal congregation has used Flamman for its services. Olskroken's very first cinema was called Quo Vadis; it opened in 1918 and closed for good in 1963, by then going by the name Östra Bio.
Sedan 1986 drivs Tellus av en ideell kul: Since 1986 Tellus has been run by a non-profit cultural association with around fifty members, who do everything from baking cakes to repairing the film projectors.
Sedan 1986 finns en matematikutbildning: Since 1986 Danderyd upper secondary school has run a fast-track maths programme together with Stockholm University. Students can study maths at university level, and since 2009 the school has taken pupils from all over Sweden.
Sedan 1986 finns här en matematikutbildn: Since 1986 the school has run a faster-paced maths programme together with Stockholm University, letting students take maths at university level. Since 2009 it has been a specialist programme open to applicants from all over Sweden.
Sedan 1992 har Västra Frölunda Naturvård: Since 1992 the Västra Frölunda nature conservation society has let Highland cattle graze the shore meadows at Välen. The grazing keeps the meadows open.
Sedan 1996 drivs Konditori Lyran här med: Since 1996 Konditori Lyran has been here, a café with its own bakery and a popular spot for an outing. The place used to be called Leopolds Lyra, after a large gilded wooden lyre put up by the poet Carl Gustaf af Leopold. A new, smaller lyre arrived in 1941.
Sedan 1998 finns Ekebyhovs Äppelgenbank: Since 1998 the palace has been home to Ekebyhov's apple gene bank. The main building, the park and the building known as the Citadel have been listed since 1970.
Sedan 2005 pryds entréhallen och platsen: Since 2005 the entrance hall and the area facing the bus station have been decorated with Fredrik Landergren's art: inlaid glass mosaics of human heads. The station building is also green-listed by the City Museum.
Sedan 2006 skyddas knappt sex hektar tal: Since 2006, just under six hectares of pine and broadleaf woodland at Malmvik have been protected by a 50-year conservation agreement. Look out for trees with a painted white ring and an N above it – they mark the edge of the area.
Sedan 2006 är hela Rådasjön med stränder: Since 2006 the whole of Rådasjön lake and its shores has been a nature reserve. Mölndal Rowing Club and the Rådasjön sailing society are based here, and in summer racing lanes for competitive rowing are laid out on the lake.

Since 2006 the whole of Lake Rådasjön and its shores have been a nature reserve. Mölndal Rowing Club and Rådasjön Sailing Club are among those based on the lake, and in summer lanes are laid out for competitive rowing.

Since 2006 the whole of Lake Rådasjön, shores included, has been a nature reserve. It's home to clubs such as Mölndal Rowing Club and the Rådasjön Sailing Society, and in summer courses are laid out for competitive rowing.
Sedan 2009 heter Gränsbergets mellersta: Since 2009 the middle part of Gränsberget has been called Kärrtorpsparken and the northern part Fäholmaskogen – Fäholma being the old name for a stretch of marsh and woodland here. The Kärrtorp croft, which gave the district its name, was also preserved.
Sedan 2012 har stationen en skulptur i g: Since 2012 the station has had a green-patinated bronze sculpture by the artist Carin Ellberg.
Sedan 2014 delar konsthallen ut ett text: Since 2014 the art gallery has awarded a writing prize to young people living in Stockholm's suburbs. Several winners have gone on to become published authors, and the jury has included Jens Lapidus and Athena Farrokhzad.
Sedan 2016 kan man läsa serieskapande på: Since 2016 you can study comics at Skarpnäck folk high school, now under the name Comics, Illustration and Animation. The school also runs a course in Spanish and development cooperation, held in Barcelona and in South American countries.
Sedan 2018 finns glassbaren Snö Gelateri: Since 2018 the Snö Gelateria ice-cream bar has occupied the ground floor of Gamla kvarnkontoret, the old mill office. The building has an onion-domed corner tower and Art Nouveau touches.
Sedan 2019 är Aspen biograf igen och des: Since 2019 Aspen has been a cinema again, as well as a local arts centre. After a thorough renovation it has two screens, a stage and a bistro.
Sedan 2021 förvaltas lokalerna av den fi: Since 2021 the premises have been run as a showroom by the Finnish loudspeaker maker Genelec. The control room was rebuilt for Dolby Atmos and named the Bohman Room as a tribute to its history.
Sedan 2021 heter arenan Avicii Arena, ef: Since 2021 the arena has been called Avicii Arena, after Tim Bergling's stage name. The change of name is meant to raise awareness of mental ill-health among young people – something Tim Bergling suffered from himself.
Sedan Citybanan öppnade 2017 använder pe: Since the Citybanan rail tunnel opened in 2017, commuter trains have used the two northern tracks. In the summers of 2018–2020, because of engineering works, Södra station took over from Central Station for eight weeks as the starting point and terminus for long-distance trains heading south.
Sedan början av 1600-talet har det sutti: Since the early 1600s a hat on a pole has topped the cliff, a well-known landmark for sailors. The sixth hat, made of copper, was unveiled in 1925 by the revue king Emil Norlander. Today's hat went up in 1996 and measures 1.6 metres across the brim.
Sedan början av 1600-talet har en hatt s: Since the early 1600s a hat has sat on a pole on top of the Kungshatt cliff, a well-known landmark for sailors. In the reign of Charles XI the wooden hat was replaced by one of sheet metal. Today's hat went up in September 1996 and measures 1.6 metres across the brim.
Sedan början av 1700-talet låg här ett d: From the early 18th century there was a croft here whose tenants paid their rent in labour for Näsby manor. The name comes from a gate – 'grind' – on the road between Näsby and Tibble that marked the boundary. In 1926 the croft became a pig farm.
Sedan de gamla husen revs 2014 har ön by: Since the old buildings were demolished in 2014, the island has been redeveloped. The aim is more than 60 small houses for year-round living and holidays.
Sedan den 16 augusti 2015 är Stenpiren e: Since 16 August 2015, Stenpiren has been a transport hub with a terminal building for trams, buses and boats. The new track cut four minutes off the journey from Brunnsparken to Järntorget, and in 2017 the scheme won the Siena Prize for landscape architecture.
Sedan den 18 augusti 2014 är Solna stati: Since 18 August 2014 Solna station has been the terminus of the Tvärbanan light rail's Solna branch. On an ordinary winter weekday about 3,100 people board here. From the northern end of the stop it's about 150 metres to the railway station entrance.
Sedan hösten 2017 byggs torget om under: Since autumn 2017 the square has been redeveloped under the name Selma stad. The plan includes 1,000 new homes, offices, shops and a new district centre with space for culture. A tram line past the square is also planned for the future.
Sedan januari 2005 kan du se Ingemar Joh: Since January 2005 you can see Ingemar 'Ingo' Johansson's trophy collection at the Sports Museum. There's also a Hall of Fame of 148 Gothenburg sporting greats, and a library with more than 70 shelf-metres of sports literature.
Sedan maj 2022 finns museet i Värtagasve: Since May 2022 the museum has been housed in Building 9 of the Värtan gasworks, the old regeneration house. It's a huge industrial hall from 1897 designed by Ferdinand Boberg, with 3,700 square metres of exhibition space.
Sedan våren 2009 står verket Ur väggen a: Since spring 2009 the square has been home to ‘Ur väggen’ (‘Out of the Wall’), a work by Yvonne T. Larsson. Its geometric angles were inspired by Endre Nemes’s marble wall from 1955.
Sedan våren 2022 heter huset House of Po: Since spring 2022 the old community hall has been called House of Possibilitas, after the cultural company that took over the premises and focuses mainly on performing arts and music. Inside are rehearsal rooms, studios and stages for shows – though the building is still owned by the City of Gothenburg.

Since spring 2022 the building has been called House of Possibilitas, after a production company working in theatre, dance and music took it over. It has rehearsal rooms for dance and theatre, artists' studios and rooms for local clubs, and puts on performances, talks and film screenings.
Segeltorp har inget med segel att göra: Segeltorp has nothing to do with sails
Segertorp var dagsverkstorp under Vårby: Segertorp was a croft whose tenants owed labour to the Vårby estate. In 1846 it consisted of a main house with two wings and three farm buildings, and in 1862 it became an independent farm.
Senempir i ljusgul puts: Late Empire in pale yellow render
Separatorhuset är fullt av symboler: mer: Separatorhuset is full of symbols: a caduceus, Hermes' winged helmet and an anchor above the main entrance, and above the portico a separator, a spade and a pitchfork. The corner tower has two tower clocks and a copper-clad cap.
Ser 30 mil åt flygledarna: A 300-kilometre view for air traffic control
Ser du tunnlarna från söder går tåg mot: Looking at the tunnels from the south, trains to Stockholm use the right-hand one, while the middle one – the very first, from 1911 – takes trains heading north. Furthest west is a single-track freight tunnel that merges with its neighbour inside the rock.
Serietecknaren Rune Andréasson, skådespe: Cartoonist Rune Andréasson, actor Jessica Liedberg and film director Björn Runge were all born in Lindome.
Serveringen upphörde några årtionden inn: The café closed a few decades before the building was demolished. From 1910, pigs were raised here instead, fed on kitchen scraps from Långbro Hospital.
Sessionssalen var först klar och fick vä: The council chamber was finished first and was decorated with murals by Sven "X:et" Erixson. In the airy main staircase hang caricatures by Ewert Karlsson.
Setterwallska villan har höga murar av g: The Setterwall villa has tall walls of yellow-red Dutch brick on a sandstone base, with a tower, a lantern and bay windows on the outside. Inside are oak panelling, silk wallpaper and open fireplaces of Italian marble. Even so, the Setterwalls only lived there in summer.
Setterwallska villan har murar av gulröt: The Setterwall villa has walls of yellowish-red Dutch brick on a high sandstone base, with a tower, bay windows, a terrace and a veranda. Inside are tall oak panels, silk wallpaper in the drawing room and fireplaces of Italian marble.
Sex broar på en kort å: Six bridges on one short river
Sex våningar mot gatan, tre mot gården: Six storeys to the street, three to the yard
Sextio skulpturer och ett åttkantigt hus: Sixty sculptures and an octagonal building
Sfären byggdes av Evangeliska Brödraförs: Sfären was built by the Evangelical Brethren congregation, with nine star-shaped blocks on a hilltop around a church. The homes are divided into Glädjen (Joy) for under-40s, Friheten (Freedom) for 40- to 60-year-olds and Tryggheten (Security) for older residents. The hill was originally earmarked for Skandia's head office.
Shopping Park Kållered var från början t: Shopping Park Kållered was originally meant for audio and video shops, and was called Ljud & Bild-huset – the Sound & Vision House. When it opened in 1986 it had nine shops, most of them selling home electronics. Since then it has also gone by the names K-Center and K-gallerian.

Shopping Park Kållered was originally meant for hi-fi and TV shops and was called Ljud & Bild-huset, the Sound & Vision House. Nine shops were open when it was inaugurated in 1986. It was later renamed K-Center, and then K-gallerian.
Shopping i gamla flyghangarer! Köpcentre: Shopping in old aircraft hangars! The Bromma Blocks shopping centre is housed in Bromma Airport's hangars, which were the largest in northern Europe in their day. The architect Paul Hedqvist designed them in a chunky, block-like functionalist style – hence the name. And out in Bällstaviken bay is an islet that's actually a shipwreck: an old cargo ship that sank and has slowly been taken over by greenery.
Shoppingen här sker i Bromma flygplats g: The shopping here takes place in Bromma Airport's old hangars, which were once the biggest in northern Europe. In 1972 the first hypermarket moved into one of them, and in September 2010 the converted Hangar 3 opened, with around 80 shops under one roof. The name Bromma Blocks is a nod to the boxy functionalist architecture.
Shoppingsugen? Bäckebol Center rymmer et: Fancy some shopping? Bäckebol Center has around twenty shops spread over 95,000 square metres. The area has changed hands several times, and in 2008 Media Markt – later Power – opened its second Gothenburg store in Coop Bygg's old premises. A short walk away is the Lärjeån river, which gave its name to the whole Lärjedalen valley.
Sibirien har inga officiella gränser. En: Sibirien, "Siberia", has no official boundaries. By one account the border runs through the courtyards on the north side of Odengatan – so people living in the street-front buildings aren't in Siberia, but their neighbours in the courtyard buildings are.
Sickla har länge varit en plats där bruk: Sickla has a long history of industrial workers living close to their jobs. As early as the late 1890s, homes went up in Tallbacken for workers and foremen at AB Diesels Motorer. Then, in 1947–48, the Sickla strand housing area was built for employees of Atlas Diesel – later Atlas Copco – to designs by the architects Erik and Tore Ahlsén. The name Sickla itself roughly means a low-lying spot where water wells up.
Sickla kanal skiljer Södra Hammarbyhamne: The Sickla canal divides Södra Hammarbyhamnen from Nacka. The industrial past is easy to see here: in the 1920s Atlas Diesel, later Atlas Copco, moved its entire operation to Sickla, and the company's head office is still here. The factories kept going until the late 1980s, and in 1994 the area was transformed into the Sickla shopping quarter.
Sickla kanal öppnades 1931 för att båtar: Sickla canal opened in 1931 so that boats could reach Sicklasjön lake after the water level had been lowered. When two low road bridges were built in 1999–2003, another lock was needed, so today boats pass through two.
Sieverts Kabelverk grundades av Max Siev: Sieverts Kabelverk, the cable works, was founded by Max Sievert in 1888 and was originally called Trådfabriken, the Wire Factory. For many years it was Sundbyberg's biggest employer. Today the Signalfabriken quarter, with homes, restaurants and hotels, has grown up among the old industrial buildings. Just nearby, Bällsta bro, the Bällsta bridge, crosses Bällstaån stream, which marks the boundary between Sundbyberg and Stockholm.
Sigfrid Edström såg till att Göteborg fi: Sigfrid Edström made sure Gothenburg got electric trams and that the English horse-tram company was bought out in 1902. The street used to be part of Willinsgatan and was named after him in 1999.
Sigge Cronstedt ritade verkstäderna i rö: Sigge Cronstedt designed the workshops in red brick, partly in decorative patterns, with stepped gables and roof lanterns that let in daylight. There's also an old acetylene gasworks, now used as staff quarters. A planned engine shed for 16 locomotives was never built.
Sigurd och Brynhild på gatuskylten: Sigurd and Brynhild on the street signs
Sikreno låter italienskt, men namnet har: Sikreno sounds Italian, but the name has nothing to do with its neighbours Frescati and Albano. According to one unconfirmed theory, it's actually an anagram based on the name Erikson! This is also where you'll find the Stocksund Inn, built between 1814 and 1816 by what was once the end of the Stocksund Bridge. The inn closed in 1938, and today the building is divided into homes.
Sikttavla på andra sidan dalen: A sighting board across the valley
Sillrök, gjuteri och fångar: Smoked herring, a foundry and prisoners
Sillviks Havskoloni bildades när Burgård: Sillvik’s seaside allotment colony was founded when the Burgården colony in central Gothenburg was cleared to make way for the Valhalla swimming baths. The colony has just over 120 cottages, a shared clubhouse and a beach café.
Silo III hade 42 behållare som tillsamma: Silo III had 42 bins holding 5,000 tonnes of grain between them. The grain was pumped straight from the ships into the building, lifted to the top and then dropped down through chutes into the right bin.
Silon som syns långt: A silo you can see for miles
Silverdals griftegård anlades 1914 som g: Silverdal cemetery was laid out in 1914 as the burial ground for the Stockholm garrison, and Sollentuna parish took it over in 1960. A crematorium and a funeral chapel were added later. The area now called Silverdal was once home to two crofts, Rådan and Silverdal, which in time grew into farms.
Silverdals griftegård var fram till 1960: Until 1960 Silverdal cemetery was the garrison cemetery of the Svea Life Guards. The author Harry Martinson and the singer Ted Gärdestad are buried here. The chapel, designed by Lage Knape, was consecrated in 1969.
Silverdals gård har varit krog, tingshus: Silverdal farm has been an inn, a courthouse and a village shop. The inn ran until 1860, and the shop closed in the late 1950s. All that's left of the large farm today is the main house and the little smithy.
Silverpilen var ett soptåg: The Silver Arrow was a rubbish train
Silverskatten är från 900-talet och blan: The silver hoard dates from the 10th century and mixes Nordic jewellery with objects from both west and east. Two genuine Arabic coins and four imitations had been made into pendants, and there's also a necklace of 42 beads. Today the hoard is on display at the Swedish History Museum.
Sim- och sporthallen invigdes 1973 och a: The swimming and sports centre opened in 1973, and two years later its architects, Gustaf Rosenberg and Olle Stål, won the Kasper Salin Prize, Sweden's top architecture award, for it. Just a couple of hundred metres away is Edsberg Palace from 1760, home to the Rudbeck family for almost 200 years. Up on the stable hill, until 2019, was Edsvik konsthall, an art gallery that put on twelve exhibitions a year.
Simbassäng i källaren: A swimming pool in the basement
Simhallen hade trampoliner på fyra och å: The swimming baths had four- and eight-metre diving boards and 84 changing cubicles, and the water was drawn from Lake Mälaren and cleaned in three stages. A speciality was the hot-air bath with a massage from "self-rubbing brushes".
Simhallen ligger på övervåningen och har: The swimming hall is on the upper floor and has a 25-metre pool with diving platforms, where the water stays at around 27 degrees all year round. There's also an adventure pool, a sauna and a relaxation area with a hot tub.
Siriusgatan fick sitt namn 1968 i en gru: Siriusgatan was named in 1968 as one of a group of names on the theme of space and the universe – just like the Orion stop. In the early 1900s there actually was another Siriusgata, in Lundbyvassen, but it vanished long ago.
Siriusgatan fick sitt namn 1968, i en gr: Siriusgatan got its name in 1968, as one of a group of street names on the theme of space and the universe. In the early 1900s there actually was another Siriusgatan, in Lundbyvassen, but it disappeared long ago.
Sisjön är en förvanskning av Skärsjön oc: Sisjön is a corruption of Skärsjön and probably comes from Skälsjön, where 'skäl' means a boundary – here between the parishes of Askim and Fässberg. An older name for the lake is Balltorpsjön.
Sisjöns industriområde ligger runt hörne: The Sisjön industrial area is just around the corner, directly south of the Söderleden road. It grew up as an industrial area in the 1960s but has gradually turned into a shopping area. Frölunda torg is just over two kilometres away, and Mölndal's town centre four.
Sista biten till Saltholmen, där skärgår: The last stretch to Saltholmen, where the archipelago boats leave from.
Sista björnen sköts 1750: The last bear was shot in 1750
Sista butiken från starten: The last shop from opening day
Sista huset från bondbyn: The last house from the farming village
Sista landskampen 2012 var en repris av: The last international in 2012 was a rematch of the World Cup final against Brazil – and, just as in 1958, the Brazilians won. The final Allsvenskan league match was played between the same two teams that had opened the stadium, AIK and Malmö FF. At the open day, visitors could take seats and turf home with them.

The last international at the stadium in 2012 was a replay of the World Cup final – and Brazil won again, 3–0. On 25 November that year there was an open day, and visitors got to start the demolition by taking seats and turf home as souvenirs.
Sista matchen, samma lag: The last match, the same teams
Sista motorn till Slite: The last engine went to Slite

Sista tåget gick strax efter midnatt: The last train left just after midnight
Sista utposten mot öst: The last outpost to the east
Sista utposten mot öster: The last outpost to the east
Sju rader med skivhus på en höjd, det är: Seven rows of slab blocks on a hillside – that's Siriusgatan, a real landmark as you enter Bergsjön. From some of the flats you can see all the way out to the island of Vinga! It's the most populous street in Gothenburg. The façades were originally grey and yellow, but during an eco-minded renovation in 1992, the anthroposophist Fritz Fuchs gave the buildings a new palette of light, soft shades.
Sju rum och vaktmästarbostad: Seven rooms and a caretaker's flat
Sju vrak och ett Helveteshål: Seven wrecks and a Hell's Hole
Sju värmepumpar på totalt 225 MW tar var: Seven heat pumps with a combined 225 MW recover the energy in treated wastewater from the Henriksdal treatment works. The heat goes into southern Stockholm's district heating network, the chilled water becomes district cooling – and since the water still has some head of fall, it finally generates electricity in a turbine.
Sjukhem på gamla Galgbacken: A nursing home on the old Gallows Hill
Sjukhemmet byggdes 1891–92 i sten, tre v: The nursing home was built in stone in 1891–92, three storeys high, with a park and an open view over Ulvsundasjön lake. From the very start it had central heating and electric light, and its water came from a diamond-drilled well.
Sjukhus med bostäder ovanpå: A hospital with homes on top
Sjukhus med simhall: A hospital with a swimming pool
Sjukhus som började i tillfälliga lokale: A hospital that started in temporary premises
Sjukhuset hade 640 platser 1912 och växt: The hospital had 640 beds in 1912 and grew to a peak of 1,350 in the 1970s. It also had large gardens and fields of its own, used both as therapy and to grow food.
Sjukhuset hade cirka 70 hektar mark, eft: The hospital had about 70 hectares of land, because farming and gardening were part of the treatment. Working in the fields and gardens was meant to be therapy for the patients.
Sjukhuset i Babels hus: The hospital in The House of Babel
Sjukhuset invigdes 2 januari 1922 som Mö: The hospital opened on 2 January 1922 as Mörby lasarett, with 118 beds and 75 staff. As early as the 1930s it had an air ambulance, run together with the air corps at Hägernäs. When it reopened in 1964, it had 900 beds.
Sjukhuset invigdes den 2 januari 1922 so: The hospital opened on 2 January 1922 as Mörby lasarett, with 118 beds and 75 staff. It was too small from day one and was constantly being extended. It took the new name Danderyd Hospital in 1964, by which time it had 900 beds.
Sjukhuset ritades av Carl Westman med kl: The hospital was designed by Carl Westman with classical symmetry, a bell tower and a large park for open-air therapy. It became one of Europe's biggest psychiatric hospitals. The site was originally meant for housing – which is exactly what it has become today.
Sjukhuset ritades av Carl Westman, medic: The hospital was designed by Carl Westman, architect to the National Board of Health. It was given a symmetrical layout, a clock tower on the main building and a large park for ‘open-air therapy’. It was a lavish build for its time.
Sjukhuset ritades av Melchior Wernstedt: The hospital was designed by Melchior Wernstedt and opened in 1935. It came with around 70 hectares of land for farming and gardening as therapy, along with a chapel, smithy, bakery, laundry and even an open-air dance floor.
Sjukhuset ritades av professor Melchior: Designed by Professor Melchior Wernstedt, the hospital was begun in 1930 and opened on 17 June 1935 at a cost of around 14 million kronor. It had ten wards for about a thousand patients, and the grounds also held a bakery, a smithy, a joinery, a chapel and a dance floor.
Sjukhuset som aldrig användes: The hospital that was never used
Sjukhusets renovering skulle ha varit kl: The hospital's renovation was meant to be finished in spring 2018. Damp and mould in the foundation slab, along with delayed deliveries, pushed the opening back again and again, until 15 January 2020. The main building is an eight-storey slab surrounded by nine single-storey sections.
Sjukhuskyrkan blev sammanträdessal: The hospital church became a council chamber
Själva Byälvsvägen byggdes runt 1970 och: Byälvsvägen itself dates from around 1970 and is the odd one out in Bagarmossen, otherwise a well-preserved 1950s suburb. The district won international praise for keeping pedestrians and cars strictly apart and for buildings that follow the lie of the land. A little further on, the Nacka nature reserve begins, with forest along the southern shore of Lake Sicklasjön and historic surroundings at Lilla Sickla.
Själva Roparstenen var en holme, cirka 4: Roparstenen itself was an islet, about 4–6 metres wide, lying off Ropudden. Landfill and post-glacial land rise have since made the area bigger: since 1795 the land has risen by the equivalent of roughly a metre's drop in sea level.
Själva borgplatån är ungefär 200 meter l: The fort's plateau itself is about 200 metres long and 100 metres wide. On the east side, a wall some 100 metres long survives with a clear entrance in the middle, and the fort was probably reinforced with a wooden palisade.
Själva diket och en bit av den gamla väg: The ditch itself and a stretch of the old road embankment survive in a patch of woodland about 200 metres north of the Circle K petrol station. DN found the spot in 1985 with the help of the man who recovered the car. The Cadillac was hauled out by a lorry from Wårby Bryggerier brewery.
Själva gasbehållaren hade formen av en t: The gasholder itself was shaped like a twenty-sided polygon and supplied by the German firm MAN. It held 100,000 cubic metres of gas, and you could get up to the roof by outside stairs or an external lift.
Själva olycksdiket och en bit av gamla S: The ditch where the accident happened, along with a stretch of the old Södertäljevägen embankment, was still there in 2018, in a patch of woodland on the Scandic hotel's grounds. The name Kungens kurva ("the King's Curve") was first given to two Esso petrol stations by their owner, Tore Jakobson.
Själva reservoaren låg dold, nersprängd: The reservoir itself was hidden away, blasted into the Stadshagsberget hill, with water 6.2 metres deep. All you could see was the stone tower over the outlet chamber, which looked like a medieval castle and gave Vattenborgen, the Water Castle, its name.
Själva utställningshallen är 50 meter lå: The exhibition hall itself is 50 metres long and set below ground level. The façade has battens of oiled red oak, and in the middle of the long roof there's an opening for a tree to grow through. Milles had bought the plot back in the 1950s, but the plan only came to life 44 years later.
Sjättenovembervägen har fått sitt namn e: Sjättenovembervägen, "Sixth of November Road", is named after the day Gustav II Adolf died: 6 November 1632. The funeral procession carrying the king's remains travelled along the Göta highway, and its solemn entry into the capital is said to have begun here.

Sjättenovembervägen, 'Sixth of November Road', is named after the day Gustav II Adolf died: 6 November 1632. The funeral procession carrying the king's body travelled along Göta landsväg, and its entry into the capital is said to have begun here. The street was previously called Torsvägen.
Sjättenovembervägen hette tidigare Torsv: Sjättenovembervägen – Sixth of November Road – used to be called Torsvägen, and most of it follows the old Göta landsväg, the historic highway south. The long log causeway that gave Långbro its name – “long bridge” – back in the 1400s probably lay where the northern end of the street runs today. The district of Älvsjö was formed in 1932, and at the time it also took in what are now Rågsved, Solberga and Hagsätra.
Sjöarna var en havsvik: The lakes were once a sea inlet
Sjöberg har fått namn efter Sjöbergs går: Sjöberg takes its name from Sjöberg farm on Edsviken. A croft stood there first, also known as Skeppartorp or Ålänningstorp. The present main house was built in the 1850s for a palace steward at Haga and Ulriksdal.
Sjöberg ligger inklämt mellan tre naturo: Sjöberg is squeezed between three green areas: Edsviken, Rösjön and Rinkebyskogen. A little further away is Rösjön, a long, narrow lake 7.3 metres deep and 6.3 metres above sea level. Most of it belongs to Sollentuna and a smaller part to Danderyd – while Täby, right next door, doesn't touch its shores at all.
Sjöbergs fornborg ligger på en hög platå: Sjöberg's hill fort sits on a high plateau and measures about 210 by 100 metres. Archaeologists examined it in the 1980s and dated the wall to AD 400–550, but also found traces of even older settlements. The fort has given its name to Borgvägen along Edsviken.
Sjödalsgymnasiet var en riktig mästare i: Sjödalsgymnasiet was a true champion in Junior Achievement, the student enterprise programme. The school won the Swedish championship in 2001, 2002, 2004, 2005 and 2009, and once even took European gold. In 2019 it was named the best Junior Achievement school in the Stockholm region.
Sjöfartsmuseet Akvariet: Sjöfartsmuseet Akvariet, the Maritime Museum and Aquarium
Sjökaptenen bakom namnet: The sea captain behind the name
Sjökrigsskolan i slottet: The naval academy in the palace
The waterside tavern at Pettersberg is recorded as early as 1772. Its jetty was one of the first steamboat piers on the southern shore of Lake Mälaren, with services between Riddarholmen and Fittja from 1856. From 1863 three different steamers served the route, all named Sjöfröken.
Sjökrogen med kägelbana: The waterside inn with a skittle alley
Sjökrogen som blev varvskontor: The waterside inn that became a shipyard office
Sjökrogen vid segelleden: The tavern on the shipping lane
Sjömannasällskapet bildades 1831 för att: Sjömannasällskapet, the Seamen's Society, was founded in 1831 to help sailors and their families. Residents of the houses on Sjömansgatan paid no rent, and until the late 1950s only seafarers lived here. In 1918 the two houses had around 60 residents, among them retired sea captains and engineers.
Sjön Bergsjön, som gett stadsdelen sitt: Lake Bergsjön, which gave the district its name, is very close by – though it's tiny, to say the least. It covers just 0.0257 square kilometres, roughly two and a half hectares. It does sit high up, though, at 101.7 metres above sea level, and its water drains into the Göta älv river.
Sjön Grötfatet ligger bara några hundra: Lake Grötfatet – 'the porridge bowl' – is only a few hundred metres away, and the name tends to raise a smile. Fisksätra Church beside the square is a little out of the ordinary: it belongs to Nacka parish but is also used regularly by the Catholic parish of Saint Konrad, as part of the Guds hus, or God's House, project.
Sjön Trekanten hette Trehörningen fram t: Lake Trekanten was known as Trehörningen until the mid-19th century. On its north shore lay Nynäs, a ramshackle working-class suburb with a tannery, a coffee roastery, workshops and a bakery famous locally for its Nynäs loaf. Once the houses had fallen into disrepair, they became the backdrop for Bo Widerberg's 1970 film Joe Hill, standing in for the 'Lumberyard' and the 'Saloon'. The last of them were demolished in 1980.
Sjön anses ha fått sitt namn efter ett r: The lake is thought to take its name from a cairn ('röse') on an island in its southern part. The cairn marked the boundary between Danderyd's 'skeppslag' and Sollentuna's 'hundare', two old administrative districts.
Sjön har fått namn efter torpet Källtorp: The lake is named after the croft Källtorp, known since 1610. From 1723 it was a parsonage, and the present house was built in 1783. Källtorpssjön is a fissure-valley lake stretching about 1.5 kilometres from east to west.
Sjön har namn efter gården Stockby, förr: The lake is named after Stockby farm, once Stukka by. The name is thought to come from log causeways (‘stock’ means log) laid across the marshes. A thousand years ago the lake was bigger, and settlements and burial mounds from the late Iron Age have been found on a rise by the north shore.
Sjön heter troligen Trehörningen efter s: The lake probably takes its name, Trehörningen – 'three-cornered' – from its three bays. In prehistoric times it was joined to Orlången and Magelungen. A third island, Balstaholmen, was still there in the western bay in the 1860s, but it has since become overgrown and turned into marsh.
Sjön nådde stationen: When the lake reached the station
Sjön planteras med öring och regnbåge, o: The lake is stocked with brown and rainbow trout, and you can fish here with a fishing permit. In winter the council clears a circular skating track on the ice, and a 1.75-kilometre walking trail loops around the lake.
Sjön rinner ut genom Kåbäcken vid en för: The lake drains through the Kåbäcken stream at a dam in the south-east. From there the water flows on to Lake Maderna, then into the Säveån river and finally out into the Göta älv. Around the lake you'll find everything from sandy beaches to smooth rock slabs.
Sjön som fick tillbaka sitt namn: The lake that got its name back
Sjön som är toppen: The lake at the very top
Sjön var djup: vid provborrningar i den: The lake was deep: test drilling in the dried-up lakebed hasn't reached bedrock even at 40 metres down. On Georg Biurman's map from 1750, the lake is almost as big as Gamla stan, the Old Town.
Sjöns vatten har svårt att stå emot surt: The lake's water has little resistance to acid rain. In the 1980s it was limed to stop it becoming permanently acidified, and its fish and wildlife recovered. The liming is repeated at regular intervals.
Sjöräddningens flytande stationshus är 1: The sea rescue service's floating station is 18 metres long and used to be the event boat Sea Lounge/Sea Eagle. Around 60 volunteer lifeboat crew are based here.
Sjöräddningens station vid Hammarbysluss: The sea rescue station by the Hammarbyslussen lock
Sjöskumspipan 4 kallas sicksackhuset för: Sjöskumspipan 4 is known as the zigzag house because of its pleated shape, with staggered façades and balconies tucked into the angles. The entrances have marble surrounds, and the original oak doors are still in place. The City Museum has given the building its highest heritage rating as one of Stockholm's most distinctive 1950s residential buildings.
Sjöstugan, även kallad Stora Sjötullen 3: From the mid-18th century to the late 19th century, Sjöstugan – also known as Stora Sjötullen 3 – was an inn and brewhouse. Seafarers who had to wait for a customs inspection could get refreshments here.
Sjötorp blev till slut ett tvätteri, som: Like many lakeside crofts in Södertörn, Sjötorp ended up as a laundry. Crofting families washed Stockholmers' clothes to make ends meet. For 20 öre a kilo, well-to-do city dwellers had their laundry collected and delivered back to the door.
Sjötorp var ett torp under Balingsta går: Sjötorp was a croft belonging to Balingsta gård, on the Flemingsbergsviken inlet. Its main building was put up in 1904 by the Ersta Deaconess Society as a home for what were then called “wayward girls”. Since 1998 it has been a private house, set in the middle of the Orlången nature reserve. A couple of hundred metres away is Stensättra gård, an old manor estate in an area that was probably first settled in the Viking Age.
Sjövalla FK bildades 1946 och byggde sin: Sjövalla FK was founded in 1946 and built its own clubhouse, Sjövallagården, which opened on 5 January 1960. Today the building belongs to Mölndal Rowing Club.
Sjövillan är ett panelat trähus i en vån: Sjövillan is a single-storey, timber-clad house in the Gustavian style, with a mansard hipped roof and an Empire-style porch on columns. Two Gustavian tiled stoves led museum man Gösta Selling to date the house to the late 1700s, while the City Museum believes it's from the early 1700s.
Sjöängen söder om Brännkyrka kyrka ansåg: Sjöängen, the meadow south of Brännkyrka Church, was long considered almost impossible to build on. Since 2007 there have been plans for housing and a park, and in 2009 it was decided the area would get an artificial lake recreating a small part of the old Lake Brännkyrkasjön.
Skagershuset tillverkades i fabrik i 112: The Skagershuset building was made in a factory as 112 ready-made modules, which were trucked here and assembled. That kept construction time down to a single year. Both the frame and the facade are wood.
Skagersvägen 1–20 byggdes 1944 av HSB so: Skagersvägen 1–20 was built by HSB in 1944 as the Vänern housing cooperative, designed by the architects Wejke & Ödeen. Numbers 17–31 and 30–38 went up the same year to designs by Carl Melin.
Skalden Carl Michael Bellman tillbringad: The poet Carl Michael Bellman spent the summer of 1773 at Fållan by Lake Magelungen, where his relatives the Zetterman family had their summer home. That's why four lime trees beside the old house foundations are known as Bellmanslindarna, the Bellman Limes. The houses themselves were pulled down around 1840. Closer to the stop is Magelungsfortet, a fort wedged between Nynäsvägen and Gamla Nynäsvägen. It's a remnant of the Southern Front, a ring of defences built to protect Stockholm around the time of the First World War.
Skalden Elias Sehlstedt var stamgäst och: The poet Elias Sehlstedt was a regular and wrote about happy times at Nackanäs. In summer 1950 the feature film ‘När syrenerna blomma’ (‘When the Lilacs Bloom’) was shot, and the inn was one of the locations.
Skandalen som ändrade reglerna: The scandal that changed the rules
Skandiahamnen intill är Sveriges största: Next door is Skandiahamnen, Sweden's largest container port, with 2,200 metres of quays. Huge container ships and car carriers sail from here. A little further away is Arendalsbanan, the old speedway track of the team Kaparna. Its attendance record of 5,940 was set in 2002, and the lap record belongs to none other than Tony Rickardsson, from 2004.
Skandiahamnen öppnades 1966. Den skapade: Skandiahamnen opened in 1966. It was created by enclosing and filling in 1.3 million square metres of the Älvsborg fjord.
Skansen Kronan, utsikt över staden: Skansen Kronan fort, with views over the city
Skansen öppnade 1891 och är världens äld: Skansen opened in 1891 and is the oldest open-air museum in the world. It has old farmsteads from all over Sweden, Nordic animals and a wide view over Stockholm.
Skansens vallgrav kallades i början av 1: In the early 19th century the moat around the redoubt was called Skansgraven or Ryssgraven, 'the Russian Ditch'. According to an unconfirmed legend, a Russian force was cut down there in 1719 and buried in the ditch.
Skanstull har fått sitt namn efter Söder: Skanstull gets its name from Söder skans, a fort between Årstaviken bay and Hammarby sjö lake. It was built in 1645 and later enlarged to plans by Nicodemus Tessin the Elder, and the last traces weren't cleared away until the 1920s. These days the spot is watched over by Folksamhuset, a 27-storey tower that has been called an indispensable part of Stockholm's skyline since it went up in 1960. Down at Hammarbyslussen lock is the Swedish Sea Rescue Society's floating station, opened by Prince Carl Philip in 2019.
Skanstull har fått sitt namn efter en sk: Skanstull is named after a skans, a small fortification, and the toll gate at the city's southern entrance. From here the Skanstullsbron bridge heads south towards Johanneshov, and across the water you can see the big white dome of the Globen area. Götgatan, Södermalm's main street, starts just north of here.

Skanstull is named after a skans, a small fortification, and the tull, or toll gate, at the city's southern entrance. From here the Skanstull bridge heads south, and across the water you can see the big white dome of the Globen area.
Skarpa by nämns för första gången redan: The village of Skarpa is first mentioned as far back as 1318. The Skarpnäck manor was established in 1660 by Maria Sofia De la Gardie of Tyresö Palace, but its golden age came under the German brewer Friedrich Rudolph Neumüller, who built the main house between 1865 and 1867. In 1922 his descendants sold the farm and its land to the City of Stockholm.
Skarpa by nämns första gången redan 1318: The village of Skarpa is first mentioned as far back as 1318, and the Skarpnäck manor estate was created in 1660 by Maria Sofia De la Gardie of Tyresö Palace. The present main house was built in the 1860s by the German brewer Friedrich Rudolph Neumüller, and under his ownership the estate enjoyed its golden age. The district itself was formed in 1963 from Pungpinan and Skarpnäck. Its metro station, opened in 1994, lies in a rock cavern 25 metres underground.
Skarpnäck blev tunnelbanans 100:e statio: Skarpnäck became the metro's 100th station and is the easternmost on the whole network. The artist Richard Nonas has decorated it with 17 bench-like sculptures in dark granite.
Skarpnäck är den östligaste stationen i: Skarpnäck is the easternmost station on the whole metro network and the end of line 17. Richard Nonas's bench-like sculptures are made of dark granite.
Skarpnäcks koloniområde från 1936 har 55: Skarpnäck's allotments, from 1936, have 554 plots, most of them at least 300 square metres with cabins of around 25 square metres. With just over 184,000 square metres under cultivation, it's one of the largest allotment areas in Europe.
Skarpnäcks tunnelbanestation, en kort pr: Skarpnäck metro station, a short walk away, became the hundredth station on the network when it opened on 15 August 1994. It sits in a rock cavern 25 metres underground, decorated by the artist Richard Nonas with 17 sculptures that look like benches. Even closer is Skarpnäcks folkhögskola, the largest folk high school in Stockholm.
Skarpnäcksfältet var förr ett flygfält,: Skarpnäcksfältet was once an airfield, and for many years it hosted the Skarpnäcksloppet motor race. The last air show took place in August 1980, and during the 1980s a new residential area grew up on the field. Today Australian rules football is played at The Jordo Cricket Ground, where the very first match, between the Södermalm Blues and the Norrtälje Dockers, took place on 6 August 2012.
Skarpnäcksgrottan besöktes 1903 av bland: Visitors to the Skarpnäck cave in 1903 included Carl Larsson and Bjørnstjerne Bjørnson. Tradition has it that the famous swindler Lasse-Maja lived here for a while in 1813, and Kings Karl XIV Johan and Karl XV also came to see it.
Skarpnäcksloppet började 1950 och kördes: The Skarpnäck race began in 1950 and was run over 15 laps. In the May 1967 race Reine Wisell won the Formula 3 class, while Ronnie Peterson came seventh. The following year, and again in 1969, it was Ronnie Peterson who won.
Skarpnäcksloppet startade 1950 och körde: The Skarpnäck race started in 1950 and ran over 15 laps. In May 1967 Reine Wisell won the Formula 3 class, while Ronnie Peterson finished seventh. Peterson got his revenge, winning in both 1968 and 1969.
Skarpäng har fått sitt namn av ett dagsv: Skarpäng takes its name from a day labourer's croft on the Ella farm, built in 1715. In the 1920s land began to be divided into plots for holiday homes, and by 1940 around 550 had been sold. Neighbouring Ella park got its name in the early 1930s, when what was then northern Ella was split up. Today it's a purely residential area of large villas.
Skateparken har en freestyle-yta, ett ki: The skatepark has a freestyle area, a kids' section, a bowl ride and the Mega Ditch, where the Banked Slalom World Championships were held in 2016, 2017 and 2018. The Gathering event in 2013 drew around 2,000 skaters.
Skatten inspirerade keramikern Mari Påru: The treasure inspired ceramicist Mari Pårup's relief Vårbyskatter ('Vårby Treasures') on the Vårbyhuset building, unveiled in 2008. Over a hundred glazed hemispheres on the brick wall form a giant necklace, the largest bead around 50 cm across.
Skepp och fiskar på berget: Ships and fish on the rock
Skepp, hjort och fiskar på berget: Ships, a deer and fish on the rock
Skeppsholmen var länge flottans ö. I dag: For a long time Skeppsholmen was the navy's island. Today it's home to Moderna museet, the Museum of Modern Art, and to the old sailing ship af Chapman, now a youth hostel. From the shore you get one of the best views across to Gamla stan, the Old Town.
Skidbacken Ekebyhovsbacken är hemmabacke: Ekebyhovsbacken is the home slope of Mälaröarnas Alpina Skidklubb, the local alpine ski club, and from the top you get a sweeping view over Ekerö and Lake Mälaren. A little further on, on Gällstaö, grows the Gällstaö oak, which may be between 400 and 500 years old. By volume it's Sweden's second-largest broadleaf tree, beaten only by the Ekebyhov oak.
Skinngruppen heter i dag Store. Sedan om: Skinngruppen is now called Store. Since around 2020 the company has been owned by Nordiska Kompaniet and trades under that brand.
Skintebo finns omnämnt redan 1567, som S: Skintebo is mentioned as early as 1567, as Skinteboda or simply Skintan. The name may mean good soil, but it could also mean a furrow, hollow, ditch or sunken track. Skinta in the sense of good soil appears in several places around Askim.
Skintebo finns som bynamn redan 1567, då: Skintebo appears as a village name as early as 1567, then spelt Skinteboda or simply Skintan. The name may mean good soil, but it could also mean furrow, pit, ditch or sunken lane. The word 'skinta' in the sense of good soil turns up in several places around Askim.
Skintebodalen byggdes på 1970-talet med: Skintebodalen was built in the 1970s with car-free footpaths, terraced houses and båtmansgårdar, a cross between a terraced house and a detached villa. In 1975 the area won the Per and Alma Olsson Foundation's prize for the best new building in Gothenburg.
Skintebodalen var jordbruksmark fram til: Skintebodalen was farmland until the 1970s. The new estate was given car-free footpaths, terraced houses, two-storey timber homes and "båtmansgårdar", a cross between a terrace and a detached house. It won the prize for Gothenburg's best building of the year in 1975.
Skissen gjordes till Uppståndelsefontäne: The sketch was made for the Fountain of Faith in Falls Church, Virginia – Milles's most ambitious work, with 38 sculptures in a large basin, unveiled in 1952. Milles called it ‘probably the finest work I have ever made’.
Skivhus i rött, grönt, gult, blått: Slab blocks in red, green, yellow, blue
Skivhusen på Siriusgatan står i sju rade: The slab blocks on Siriusgatan stand in seven rows on a hillside, a landmark as you come into Bergsjön. From some of the flats you can see all the way out to Vinga lighthouse! It's Gothenburg's most populous street, with 3,199 residents in 2021. The facades were originally grey and yellow, but during a renovation in 1992 the anthroposophist Fritz Fuchs was given the job of repainting them in a range of pale shades.
Skivhusen vid Siriusgatan ligger så högt: The slab blocks on Siriusgatan stand so high that from some flats you can see all the way to Vinga. The buildings were originally grey and yellow, but in 1992 the anthroposophist Fritz Fuchs gave them a palette of pale colours.
Skivhuset i kvarteret Murbruket var tänk: The slab block in the Murbruket quarter was meant to be the district's exclamation mark. It was designed by Fred Forbat and Harry Egler at the housing co-operative HSB and built by Skånska Cementgjuteriet, now Skanska. The façade was painted in squares, a feature that all but disappeared during a renovation in the 1990s.
Skivhuset ritades av Andreas Carstens, ä: This slab block was designed by Andreas Carstens, is about 300 metres long and was completed in 1964. It has 9 or 10 storeys depending on which side you approach from, and holds 421 flats. Bands of red brick and white balcony fronts make it look even longer.
Skjortfabrikören Simon Berendt köpte Bjö: The shirt manufacturer Simon Berendt bought Björken 18 when it was newly built, and the house stayed in the family for four generations, until 1986. Today it's a listed building.
Skog och bad vid Mälaren: Woods and swimming by Lake Mälaren
Skog och berg dominerar i den här delen: This part of Huddinge is all forest and rocky hills. Not far from here, Kynäsberget stretches out to the south-west of Lake Magelungen – an area of woods and crags considered of national importance for outdoor recreation, and there are plans to protect its northern part as a nature reserve. In the other direction is Björkängen sports ground, home to the ice hockey team Huddinge IK.
Skog och berg tar över en bit härifrån:: Not far from here, forest and rock take over. Kynäsberget, south-west of Lake Magelungen, is of national importance for outdoor recreation, and its northern part may become a nature reserve. Further off, on the Stockholm border, is the Rågsved open space, also called Kräppladalen – just over 100 hectares of rift-valley landscape, with ridges, steep slopes and clay-filled valleys.
Skogarna här hör till Nackareservatet, e: The forests here are part of Nackareservatet, a large nature reserve and outdoor recreation area shared by Stockholm and Nacka. A little further on is Lake Källtorpssjön, 7.6 metres deep, with the Hellasgården outdoor sports centre on its shore. Test fishing in the lake has turned up perch, white bream, common bream, ruffe and roach.
Skogen där vargen syntes: The forest where the wolf was seen
Skogen där vargen synts: The forest where the wolf was seen
Skogen har efter hand omringats av Ryave: Over time the forest has been hemmed in by the Rya sewage works, oil refineries and a gas-fired combined heat and power plant, cutting it off from the Göta älv river at Rya Nabbe. When building started on the sewage works in 1958, part of the reserve was taken over.
Skogen här är full av små sjöar. Örtjärn: The forest here is dotted with little lakes. Örtjärnen, a few hundred metres away, is a full ten metres deep despite its small size, and its water drains out through the Finnebäcken stream. A little further away is Västra Kroppedammen, just 0.006 square kilometres – a real dwarf among lakes.
Skogen i Ryssbergen är mycket gammal, me: The forest in Ryssbergen is very old, with pines up to 370 years old and three metres round. It has barely been touched by forestry and is home to several red-listed species, such as the pine bracket fungus and the longhorn beetle Nothorhina muricata.
Skogen som bytte namn: The forest that changed its name
Skogskapellet var det allra första kapel: Skogskapellet, the Woodland Chapel, was the very first chapel at Skogskyrkogården, the Woodland Cemetery. Gunnar Asplund designed it, and it was built in 1919–20. Close by stands the Resurrection Monument, a bronze group of six figures that John Lundqvist worked on from 1928 to 1941. The new crematorium, designed by Johan Celsing, has also won acclaim, picking up the Kasper Salin Prize, Sweden's top architecture award, in 2013.
Skogskapellet är fullt av symboler. Förh: The Woodland Chapel is full of symbols. The porch rests on twelve columns, one for each apostle, and the keyhole in the door forms the eye of a skull. The chapel holds just 35 people.
Skogskyrkogården skapades av Gunnar Aspl: Skogskyrkogården, the Woodland Cemetery, was created by Gunnar Asplund and Sigurd Lewerentz on a pine-covered gravel ridge, and it has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1994. On the roof above the entrance to the Woodland Chapel stands Carl Milles' small gilded Angel of Death – the only time Milles and Asplund worked together. The angel sparked a debate in the city council, as some priests found it offensive and indecent!
Skogspartiet är cirka 1,3 kilometer lång: The wooded ridge is about 1.3 kilometres long and rises up to 51 metres. A park path runs over the hill, but otherwise the park has been left in its natural state, with bare rock and mostly pine forest.
Skogås sträcker sig från Mörtvik i norr: Skogås stretches from Mörtvik in the north to Gräsvreten in the south, with Lake Drevviken along its eastern edge. On Mörtviken, a bay of the lake, is Mörtviks gård, a group of buildings that still feels like a farm even though several of the houses have been heavily rebuilt. Closer to the stop is Östra gymnasiet, an upper secondary school that was named one of the buildings of the year in 2005.
Skola i ett gammalt torp: A school in an old croft
Skola kring ett torg: A school built round a square
Skola med egen tandklinik: A school with its own dental clinic
Skola och läkare för arbetarna: A school and a doctor for the workers
Skola och simhall i samma veva: School and pool in one go
Skola och statarbostad emellan: A school and farmworkers' homes in between
Skola, statarbostad och krog igen: School, farmworkers' homes – then an inn again
Skolan byggd i massivträ: A school built of solid timber
Skolan byggdes 1952–1953 för drygt 300 e: The school was built in 1952–1953 for just over 300 pupils in 21 classes. Cyrillus Johansson split it into three connected buildings around the playground. On the main building is the relief Noah's Ark by the artist Allan Wallberg.
Skolan byggdes 1958–60 efter ritningar a: The school was built in 1958–60 to designs by Curt Laudon and began life as an experimental upper secondary school. The 'studentexamen' school-leaving exams were held here from 1961 to 1968, and a committee from Eskilstuna came on a study visit before building its own school.
Skolan började som Olofskolans verkstad,: The school began as the workshop of Olofskolan, the school Carl Malmsten founded in 1930. For 60 years it was on Södermalm. One of its best-known heads was the guitar maker Professor Georg Bolin.
Skolan driver också hotell, konferens oc: The school also runs a hotel, conference centre and hostel all year round, with some 160 hostel beds in summer. Its owner, the temperance organisation IOGT-NTO, changed its name to Movendi Sverige in 2025 after a merger.
Skolan följer gamla allén: The school follows the old avenue
Skolan har fått sitt namn efter klockarg: The school is named after the klockargården, where the bell-ringer of Lidingö Church lived. In the late 19th century the school day ran from 8 am to 3 pm, with a fifteen-minute break between lessons. Lunch also lasted a quarter of an hour, and pupils ate packed food they had brought from home.
Skolan har sina rötter i kommunens yrkes: The school has its roots in the municipality's vocational schools in Råda and Landvetter from the 1930s, which offered courses in everything from sewing to bookbinding and welding. In 2009 it launched its first higher vocational programme: Airport Officer.
Skolan hette först Skarpnäcks skola, ble: The school was first called Skarpnäcks skola, became Nya skolan in 1968, Skarpnäcks nya skola in 1985, and finally Skarpnäcks skola once again. The old and new schools face each other, with the district boundary running down the middle of Kärrtorpsvägen.
Skolan invigdes 1948 under namnet Långbr: The school opened in 1948 as Långbrodal elementary school and was only renamed Johan Skytteskolan in 1997. In the 2023/24 school year it had 1,152 pupils, from pre-school class up to year nine.
Skolan lades ner 1939 när det bara fanns: The school closed in 1939, when there were only four children left in the area. They were taken by school bus to Aspnäs school instead. Since 1994 the schoolhouse has been used by a motorcycle club.
Skolan mitt i trafikplatsen: The school in the middle of an interchange
Skolan ordnar \"öppen kroki\", lärarlösa: The school runs "open kroki" – untutored evening and weekend life-drawing sessions with a model. There's no need to book; you just pay at the door.
Skolan placerades mitt i godset Vårby gå: The school was built in the middle of the Vårby estate so that all the children would have roughly the same distance to walk. Even so, from Kråkvik in eastern Segeltorp it was about 8 km there and back – until Segeltorp's primary school opened in 1917.
Skolan ritades av Lennart Brundin, som r: The school was designed by Lennart Brundin, who designed many school buildings in the Stockholm area in the 1950s and 60s. Right at the top of the central building is a single bay window intended for growing plants.
Skolan ritades av Stig Åkermark, som län: The school was designed by Stig Åkermark, who had long worked with the school architect Paul Hedqvist. Six buildings are grouped around a large schoolyard, tied together by the same yellow brick. The complex is 'green-listed' by Stockholm City Museum as culturally valuable.
Skolan ritades av Åke E. Lindqvist och i: Designed by Åke E. Lindqvist, the school opened in 1973. The buildings were planned around a square, with each function given its own design, and façades of yellow-red brick and timber with exposed concrete elements.
Skolan som bara fick fem år: The school that lasted five years
Skolan som blev bostad: The school that became a home
Skolan som fick två tvillingar: The school that got two twins
Skolan som tog EM-guld: The school that won European gold
Skolan startade 1928 som Spånga högre fo: The school opened in 1928 as Spånga högre folkskola, a senior elementary school, and only gained a gymnasium – an upper secondary school – in 1956. The first school-leaving exams were held in spring 1960, and every candidate passed. The school building dates from 1945.
Skolan startade i januari 2007 som filia: The school opened in January 2007 as a branch of Göteborgs folkhögskola, a folk high school for adult learners. In 2010 it became independent as Agnesbergs folkhögskola, named after its first premises, and in 2011 it moved to Bergsjön. Since 2021 the Finnish Multicultural Folk High School on Gärdsås torg has taken over its students.
Skolan utan vattenklosett: The school without a flushing toilet
Skolan var den första verkstadsskolan i: This was the first vocational workshop school in Sweden to be an integral part of a municipal company. Until 2017 it shared a building with the Söderhallen bus garage on Södermalm, and since 2021 you can also train as a goldsmith here.
Skolan var från början en del av Olofsko: The school was originally part of Olofskolan, founded by Carl Malmsten in 1930, and was known as Olofskolans Verkstad, the Olofskolan Workshop. It was based on Södermalm for 60 years, and one of its best-known heads was the guitar maker Professor Georg Bolin.
Skolan var först med att erbjuda slöjd v: The school was the first to offer handicrafts alongside academic subjects. It closed on 10 June 1977 after its 100th end-of-year ceremony. In 1988 the French state bought the building on Kommendörsgatan and converted it into an embassy.
Skolan är byggd i sten i en våning över: The school is a single-storey stone building over a high basement, with facades in a soft old-rose pink. A stone tablet on the front records that it was built in 1849 and rebuilt in 1925.
Skolan är en av få bevarade skolor i trä: This is one of the few wooden schools left in Gothenburg, and the only one in the city built in the National Romantic style. Columns frame each of its three entrances.
Skolan är uppkallad efter Johan Skytte,: The school is named after Johan Skytte, and its main building, begun in 1946, was designed by the architect Paul Hedqvist. Close by is Långbrodal School, whose 2017 extension attracted a lot of attention. And further off was Långbro Hospital, a psychiatric hospital built between 1905 and 1910 and closed in 1997.
Skolan är utsmyckad av tre konstnärer fr: The school is decorated with works by three artists from Nacka: Erik Jensen, Gunnar Larsson and Sven Sahlberg. The latest addition is ‘Spiralen i evighet’ (Spiral in Eternity) by Lova Lindroos, a spiralling piece in steel and textile that plays with the open space and the lighting.
Skolan öppnade 10 maj 1846, men den tänk: The school opened on 10 May 1846, but the intended teacher was still in training, so in the first year the church caretaker, Erik Mellberg, did the teaching. The teacher's salary was paid partly in grain and grazing for a cow.
Skolan öppnade 1982 som Botvidsgymnasiet: The school opened in 1982 as Botvidsgymnasiet, offering mainly technical vocational courses. In 2000 it moved from Slagsta to Hallunda and took its present name. Today students from all over the country apply for its contemporary circus programme.
Skolan öppnade den 10 maj 1846, men den: The school opened on 10 May 1846, but the intended teacher was still in training. So for the first year lessons were given by the church caretaker, Erik Mellberg. In April 1847 the parish clerk and organist Ludvig Ulric Öberg took over.
Skolans kapell, ritat av Carl Nyrén, fic: The school chapel, designed by Carl Nyrén, won the Swedish Wood Award in 1967. The folk high school closed in 2014, and the property was sold for housing in 2015.
Skolans kubiska del i tre våningar har e: The school's cube-shaped, three-storey section has a generous light-filled hall surrounded by classrooms. From outside you can spot it by the tall glazed gable facing the playground. The City Museum has green-listed the school as culturally valuable.
Skolarkitekten Georg A. Nilsson tog fram: The school architect Georg A. Nilsson drew almost identical plans for three schools – Långbrodalsskolan, Enskede skola and Örbyskolan – all built around 1915. You'll recognise them by the projecting stairwell with a giant clock. The style is National Romantic, harking back to the plain stone houses of the 1600s.
Skoldag med kvartsraster: A school day with quarter-hour breaks
Skolgården ligger i två nivåer med spara: The schoolyard is on two levels with a strip of natural ground left in between. The upper level has a playground and a rocky outcrop to climb on, and the grounds back directly onto the woods of the Nacka nature reserve.
Skolgården var Sveriges största, bara li: The school playground was the largest in Sweden, only slightly smaller than Gustaf Adolfs torg. It was graced by a fountain of water-spouting frogs that gave the children their drinking water. The fountain sculpture survives in the inner courtyard of the Herden block.
Skolhus i båtsmanstorpet: A schoolhouse in the sailor’s croft
Skolhus med tandklinik: A schoolhouse with a dental clinic
Skolhuset från 1849 är byggt i sten i en: The schoolhouse from 1849 is a single-storey stone building over a high basement, with rendered façades in dusky pink. A stone tablet records its rebuilding: "Botkyrka kyrkskola byggd 1849 ombyggd 1925" – Botkyrka church school, built 1849, rebuilt 1925. It's part of the old parish setting around Botkyrka Church.
Skolhuset från 1901 hade en folkskolesal: The 1901 schoolhouse had a primary classroom for 64 children and an infant classroom for 36. It also had a teacher's flat, a council room that doubled as a woodwork room, and a dental clinic with a treatment room and waiting room.
Skolhuset var en panelad enplansbyggnad,: The schoolhouse was a single-storey panelled building, painted yellow with red corner boards and window frames. It had two classrooms, one for the younger pupils and one for the older ones, and the teacher lived up in the attic.
Skolklassernas grodtjärn: A frog pond for school trips
Skolrestaurangen har två matsalar och se: The school restaurant has two dining halls and serves lunch to both Nacka gymnasium and Eklidens skola. The cafeteria next door is used by the school during the day but opens to the public after school hours.
Skolscenen har tvååriga utbildningar i t: The school stage runs two-year programmes in theatre and musical theatre. Since 1989 it has put on a New Year revue every January and February. The theatre, built in 2002, seats 223.
Skoltomten ligger strax norr om det gaml: The school grounds lie just north of the old Bredäng croft, which gave its name to the whole district. It was farmed until 1949 and demolished in 1963. The school itself is named after Slätten farm in Mälarhöjden.
Skomakarens torp blev kronjuvel: The cobbler's croft became the crown jewel
Skonaren hette först Minde och bar sedan: The schooner was first called Minde and later bore names such as Altair, Per-Olof and Marina. When her restoration began in 1991 she was renamed Constantia, after the ship in Dan Andersson's poem ‘Jungman Jansson’.
Skorstenarna som gav kvarteret namn: The chimneys that named the block
Skorstenen i gult och blått: The chimney in yellow and blue
Skorstenen som blev en bågskytt: The chimney that became an archer
Skotten Alexander Keiller kom till Göteb: The Scotsman Alexander Keiller arrived in Gothenburg in 1825. In 1841 he was granted permission to run Keillers Werkstad, with the motto "strength and speed". It was the beginning of what would become the Götaverken shipyard.
Skotten och engelska sättet: The Scot and the English method
Skotten som valde Säveån: The Scots who chose the Säveån
Skrapan är 86 meter hög med 22 våningar: The Skyscraper is 86 metres tall, with 22 storeys, and was designed by Ralph Erskine together with White Architects. Gothenburg's soft clay called for stabilising piles up to 90 metres long – longer than the building is tall.
Skredet kom klockan 08.11, bara några mi: The landslide struck at 8.11 am, just minutes after a train carrying 800 passengers had passed Surte södra station. It lasted under three minutes and was even covered by the American magazine Life.
Skredet omkring år 1150 omfattade 37 hek: Around the year 1150 a landslide covering 37 hectares swept down here – the largest ever recorded in Sweden. The masses of earth almost blocked the river, then 500 metres wide, and to this day its course bends in an arc, pushed some 200 metres to the west.
Skredet som skärpte reglerna: The landslide that tightened the rules
Skredet upptäcktes klockan nio av en lot: The landslide was spotted at nine o'clock by a pilot aboard a ship. Early that morning, at the city's water intake downstream, sharply rising levels of silt had already been measured – the slide most likely began underwater, on the slope down to the river's deep channel.
Skridsko och sandstrand vid Rösjön: Skating and sandy beach at Rösjön
Skridskoprinsessan blev aldrig mer än en: Skridskoprinsessan, 'the Skating Princess', never got beyond a bronze sketch around 70 centimetres tall, which stands at Millesgården. There's also a statuette some 50 centimetres high in Skytteholm park on Ekerö.
Skrubba nämns redan 1397. Stockholms sta: Skrubba is mentioned as early as 1397. The City of Stockholm bought the farm in 1894 and opened a reform home where some 90 boys went to school and learned carpentry, tailoring and farming. The old oak avenue is among what survives.
Skrubbatriangeln var tänkt som ett energ: The Skrubba triangle was meant to be an energy centre with low-energy buildings. So the blocks were named Vattenkraften, Solkraften and Vindkraften – Hydropower, Solar Power and Wind Power – and the streets were given matching names. The idea was only partly realised, however.

The Skrubba triangle was meant to be an energy hub with energy-efficient homes. The blocks were named Vattenkraften, Solkraften and Vindkraften – Hydropower, Solar Power and Wind Power – and the streets were given matching names. The idea was only partly realised.
Skruven var inget vanligt torp utan bost: Skruven was no ordinary croft but housing for Säby's estate craftsmen, above all the blacksmith. Shoemakers and tailors lived there too, and an inn served travellers on the through road until 1809.
Skrönan om Gustav III:s gåva: The tall tale of Gustav III’s gift
Skulle ha blivit rådhus: It was meant to be a courthouse
Skulle ha hetat Neptunus: It was meant to be Neptune
Skulle han köra in med bil?: Was he planning to drive in?
Skulpturen Arbetarhustru: The sculpture Arbetarhustru, the Worker's Wife
Skulpturen Arbetarhustru gjordes av Elma: The sculpture Arbetarhustru ('Worker's Wife') is by Elma Oijens and came about at the initiative of Gamla Landalapojkar, an association of old Landala boys, who raised the money. It was unveiled on 11 October 1980, and the poem on the plinth was written by Holger Oijens.
Skulpturen Boll är gjord av Berit Lindfe: The sculpture ‘Boll’ (‘Ball’) is by Berit Lindfeldt and was installed in 2007. The sphere was first polished to a mirror finish, then partly painted light blue, with shiny dots left unpainted.
Skulpturen Fosterbröderna: The sculpture Fosterbröderna, the Foster Brothers
Skulpturen av amerikanen Alexander Calde: The city bought this sculpture by the American artist Alexander Calder in the early 1960s through the Charles Felix Lindberg donation fund, specifically for the new district of Angered. When construction fell behind, it had to wait outside the art museum.
Skulpturer och meditationsplats: Sculptures and a place to meditate
Skulpturgruppen visar en äldre krigare s: The sculpture shows an older warrior lifting his wounded comrade, trying to catch his fading gaze. Theodor Lundberg signed it ‘Roma 1888’. Nationalmuseum, Sweden's national gallery, bought its cast in 1891.
Skulptörens sista år i Solna: The sculptor's last years in Solna
Skuru gård köptes 1903 av Stockholms sju: In 1903 Skuru estate was bought by Stockholms sjukhem and became a convalescent home. Mathilda Sundelin became matron in 1919, bought the estate in 1922 and renamed it Solsunda vilohem. She stayed on as matron right up until 1968.
Skuru var från början namnet på en gård,: Skuru was originally the name of a farm, and that farm lives on today as Solsunda. In the 1500s King Gustav Vasa gave it to Danvik's hospital, and in the early 1900s it belonged to Stockholms sjukhem, a nursing home. The area also has Bastusjön, a lake you can swim in, and a little further off is Glasbrukssjön, which is small but a surprising 13 metres deep.

Skuru started out as the name of a farm, and today the area is mostly villas and semi-detached houses surrounded by nature. Not far from here, on the shore of Saltsjön, is Stora Nyckelviken, a manor from the mid-1700s – and as early as the 1600s there was a sailors' inn on the spot. Around the manor lies the Nyckelviken nature conservation area, 171 hectares of hilly, historic farmland.
Skvalta var ursprungligen en sjö, och va: Skvalta was originally a lake, and the water flowing out through Vikdalen powered several 'skvaltkvarnar', small horizontal water mills – which is where the name comes from. A little further on, in the villa suburb of Storängen, are two genuine artists' homes. Villa Bergh was home to the painter Richard Bergh from 1904 to 1919, and next door is Villa Pauli, where the artists Georg and Hanna Pauli lived. Both were designed in 1904 by the architect Albin Brag.
Skvaltan, barackcentrumet: Skvaltan, the shopping centre in huts

The reform home moved to Skrubba in 1896. The city wanted the boys to live far enough from Stockholm that neither city life nor their families could influence them. Some 90 boys aged between 9 and 18 went to school here and learned trades such as carpentry and gardening.
Skyddsrum blev däckfirma: From air-raid shelter to tyre shop
Skyddsrummen ligger cirka fem meter unde: The shelters lie about five metres underground, and at the bottom of the stairs you pass through a gas lock. Together they held around 320 people, and in the first room there are metal-walled cubicles that served as dry toilets.
Skyttegatan har fått sitt namn efter en: Skyttegatan takes its name from a shooting range built here in 1899 (skytte means shooting). Around 1908–1909 a dance floor was put up on Kikås, and from 1918 to 1945 there was a folkpark, an open-air entertainment park, by Träsnidaregatan.
Skälby gård har funnits sedan 1500-talet: Skälby farm has existed since the 16th century, but today's main house was built in 1802.
Skälby hade en järnvägshållplats på Lövs: Skälby had a halt on the Lövsta railway until 1956, when the metro to Hässelby gård opened. Rubbish trains nicknamed the Silver Arrow kept rolling past right up until 1970.
Skälby är ett villaområde i södra delen: Skälby is a residential area of villas in southern Järfälla, part of the Stockholm urban area, and in 2005 it had 6,336 residents. The name comes from Skälby gård, a manor dating back to the 16th century. To the south, across the municipal boundary, begins Kälvesta, a Stockholm neighbourhood of terraced houses and villas.
Skälby, villaområdet runt omkring, har f: Skälby, the residential area all around us, is named after Skälby gård, a manor house not far from here. It's a former noble estate in Järfälla parish dating back to the 1500s, though the current main house was built in 1802. It's also in an unusual spot – right in the middle of four ancient burial grounds.
Skälltorp, området här intill, omfattar: The neighbouring area, Skälltorp, takes in northern Backa with Selma Lagerlöfs torg square, as well as Backadalen, Blå staden, Åketorp and Backatorp. A little further on is Sophie Elkans gata, named in 1992 after the Gothenburg-born writer Sophie Elkan – best remembered as Selma Lagerlöf's close friend. So here, the two friends meet again in the street names.
Skändla by började troligen växa fram på: Skändla village probably began to take shape in the 12th century, when it was Norwegian. In the 13th century the border was redrawn and the village became Swedish; the hill beside it formed part of the border of the day.
Skändla rös är 18 meter i diameter och d: Skändla rös, a Bronze Age-style burial cairn, is 18 metres across and just over two metres high. Every year the Swedish Society for Nature Conservation holds a haymaking day in the meadows next to it, when the grass is cut by hand, scythes and all.
Skär, ekskog och strandängar: Skerries, oak woods and shore meadows
Skärgård där bilarna kör: An archipelago where cars now drive
Skärgårdsbåtarna till Donsö kallas i fol: Locals still call the archipelago boats to Donsö 'the steamer'. The island is also linked to Styrsö by a bridge.
Skärholmen har en egen liten bergbana. S: Skärholmen has a little funicular of its own. The inclined lift between Skärholmen and Ekholmshöjden is 63 metres long, holds about 30 people and takes around a minute – and there's no driver on board. Also nearby is Skärisbiografen, a non-profit municipal cinema that opened in 2017 and is part of Kulturhuset Stadsteatern, the city's culture house and theatre.
Skärholmen hörde till Huddinge ända fram: Skärholmen was part of Huddinge until 1963, when it was transferred to Stockholm along with Vårberg. Down on the metro platform you can take a little trip to America: in 1990 the artist Ulf Wahlberg painted a spot in New Mexico in a series of 23 pictures, from sunrise to sunset. And close by, a funicular carries passengers up to Ekholmshöjden.
Skärholmens gård, vid Mälaren en bit här: Skärholmens gård, down by Lake Mälaren, started out as a simple croft belonging to Vårby gård. In the mid-18th century it was rebuilt as a summer retreat for wealthy Stockholmers. The City of Stockholm has owned it since 1945, and the City Museum has given it a blue listing, meaning its buildings are judged to be of exceptional cultural and historical value.
Skärisbiografen finns i gymnasiets före: Skärisbiografen is in the upper secondary school's former assembly hall, built for around 400 people. Skärholmen had been without a cinema since Vågen closed in 2004. Today the largest screen seats 150.
Skärisbiografen ligger i Skärholmens gym: Skärisbiografen occupies the former assembly hall of Skärholmen's upper secondary school, designed by Lennart Brundin. Between 2004 and 2017 Skärholmen had no cinema of its own, after the Vågen cinema from 1969 had closed. The largest screen seats 150.
Skärmen finns för att hindra saltvatten: The barrier is there to stop salt water seeping in at the Alelyckan water intake, where all of Gothenburg gets its water. The risk is greatest when the Göta älv river is carrying little water while the sea level is high. The barrier came into service in 1934.
