In the 17th century it served as a threshold in the church doorway, was later built into a wall, and broke into four pieces when it was taken out. Inside the church are more fragments, including one by the rune carver Öpir, found under the central aisle in 1915.
Vid Draget byggdes 1904 arbetarbostäder: In 1904 housing was built at Draget for the staff of the Norsborg waterworks. The two large houses, painted traditional Falu red, have Art Nouveau-style woodwork and prominent external staircases. Every house had running water and drains from the very start.
Vid Drevvikens nordvästra kant ligger Hö: On the north-western shore of Lake Drevviken is Hökarängens gård, a farm named after ‘hökare’, or grocers, which in turn gave its name to the whole district of Hökarängen. Oddly enough, the farm itself is in Farsta! Right next to it is the Hökarängen bathing spot, with a sandy beach about 60 metres long, a jetty, rocks to sunbathe on and a big meadow.
Vid Edsvikens strand en bit härifrån lig: On the shore of Edsviken bay, not far from here, lies the Rådan estate, first recorded in 1599. It's had quite a varied career: first a croft, then a farm manager's house, a manor, a boarding school, an army barracks and a police academy – and now it's a school once again. Nearby, the Igelbäcken stream winds through a nature reserve of pine forest, broadleaf woodland and open meadows.
Vid Ekensbergsvägen finns resterna av et: On Ekensbergsvägen you'll find the remains of a Second World War anti-aircraft battery that was meant to protect the shipyard. When the homes were built in the 1980s, the gun emplacements became a seating area and a playground. The ramparts of grey stone and concrete are still easy to make out.
Vid Eneby torg står Enebykyrkan, en kyrk: On Eneby torg stands Enebykyrkan, a church with two congregations under one roof. It's shared by Danderyd parish of the Church of Sweden and Enebykyrkan's own congregation in the Uniting Church in Sweden, formerly part of the Mission Covenant Church. All around is Enebyberg, a villa suburb with many houses from the first half of the 20th century.
Vid Fittjavikens västra sida låg Fittja: On the west side of Fittjaviken bay stood Fittja brickworks, one of the larger brickworks around Stockholm, which closed in 1964. The bay was also part of an important trade route: from 1755 Tumba paper mill shipped its goods via Lake Albysjön and Fittjaviken out to Lake Mälaren, until the railway arrived in 1860.
Vid Flabäcken mellan Kållered och Lindom: At Flabäcken, the stream between Kållered and Lindome, important border meetings with the Danes were held in 1591, 1601 and 1603. Most of the negotiating was done face to face on a bridge over the stream. In 1603 Duke Karl and Christian IV both took part, and one of the things they quarrelled over was the right to the Three Crowns emblem.

At Flabäcken, the stream between Kållered and Lindome, important border meetings with the Danes were held in 1591, 1601 and 1603. The negotiations were mostly conducted by word of mouth on a bridge over the little stream, with the Swedes based in Kållered and the Danes in Kungsbacka.

At the Flabäcken stream between Kållered and Lindome, important border meetings with the Danes were held in 1591, 1601 and 1603. Most of the negotiating was done face to face on a bridge over the stream. In 1603 Duke Karl and Christian IV took part in person, and one of the burning issues was the right to the Three Crowns emblem.
Vid Flatens norra vik låg fyra torp: Fla: By the northern bay of Lake Flaten there were four crofts: Flaten, Listudden, Ekudden and Sköntorp. Sköntorp disappeared when the Flatenbadet bathing area was built in the 1930s.
Vid Forsån på Magelungssidan låg Forsens: By Forsån on the Magelungen side stood the 18th-century Forsen farm; today only its foundations remain, about 25 metres from the bridge. For a while the Feith family lived here – the people behind the well-known Feith's patisserie on Strandvägen and Hornsgatan.
Vid Frölunda torg står Ställbart univers: At Frölunda torg stands Ställbart universum, Adjustable Universe, an abstract copper sculpture by Arne Jones from 1967. While it was taken down during the rebuilding of the tram stop, someone stole its innermost rings. It has since been restored and is back in place – just slightly moved. Kal and Ada, Gothenburg's famous comic duo, would surely have had a joke or two to crack about that.
Vid Fullerstavägen 1 byggdes 1947 Huddin: Huddinge's first block of flats was built at Fullerstavägen 1 in 1947: three storeys, with shops on the ground floor. It has since been demolished, along with the simple shop buildings, which made way for the tower blocks of Huddinge centrum in the 1950s.

Huddinge's first block of rental flats was built at Fullerstavägen 1 in 1947: three storeys with shops on the ground floor. It's gone now, like the simple shop buildings torn down when Huddinge Centrum was built in the 1950s.
Vid Gamlestads torg ligger Världslittera: On Gamlestads torg is Världslitteraturhuset, the House of World Literature, a public library devoted to many languages that opened on 1 December 2018. The idea came from librarian Ingrid Atlestam in an opinion piece in Göteborgs-Posten, and the politicians took it up. Its three floors are filled with books in a wide range of languages, and there's an auditorium at the top. Just south of the square are the Gamlestaden factories.
Vid Gröna Lund ligger restaurang Tyrol o: By the Gröna Lund amusement park you'll find the Tyrol restaurant and the Gröna Lund theatre. On the west side of the street is the old inn Wärdshuset Bellmansro, among others.
Vid Grönsakstorget slingrar vallgraven,: At Grönsakstorget the moat winds past – all that remains of the fortifications that once encircled Gothenburg.
Vid Gubbängstorget låg en gång biografen: Gubbängstorget square was once home to the City cinema, which opened in April 1953 and closed twenty years later. In the 1950s the new suburbs were meant to provide every service their residents could need – right down to a cinema of their own. Today the old auditorium has a new lease of life as Moment teater, a theatre that started here in 2000 and won Svenska Dagbladet's Thalia Prize in 2008 for its work with the classics.
Vid Göteborgs vattenintag någon kilomete: At Gothenburg's water intake a kilometre or so downstream, sharply raised silt levels were recorded at 06.00 and again at 09.45 that same day. Everything suggests the landslide began underwater, probably on the steep slope down to the river's deep channel.
Vid Hagsätramotet korsar Olshammarsgatan: At the Hagsätra interchange, Olshammarsgatan crosses Huddingevägen on a bridge. It's one of the district's two main streets, linking Hagsätra centre with Ormkärr, the part of Hagsätra south-west of Huddingevägen. 'Orm' means snake – a slippery-sounding name, but nothing to worry about! The Hagsätra woods became a nature reserve in 2021.
Vid Herkulesgatan står Renströmska badan: On Herkulesgatan stands Renströmska badanstalten, a public bathhouse completed in 1915 to designs by Eugen Thorburn. The baths closed in 1973 and were converted for the Banzai Karate Kai karate club. The last bath attendant was a man named Ante Melander. A short walk away rises Karlatornet – at 246 metres, the tallest building in the Nordic countries.
Vid Hustegafjärden ligger Rönneberga, en: On the shore of Hustegafjärden bay is Rönneberga, a conference centre that opened in 1969 for trade union courses, with plenty invested in art and decoration from day one. By Elfvik jetty stands Villa Söderås, a grand house from 1912 that was up for sale in 2021–2022 for 350 to 380 million kronor. And the islet of Svanholmen, at the mouth of the bay, was almost certainly named after the swans that nested there long ago.
Vid Hägerstens brandstation dolde sig Nä: Hidden at Hägersten fire station was Nässlan – “the Nettle” – a secret command centre. It was blasted into the rock in 1943 as a bombproof district control room and vehicle shelter for the Stockholm fire brigade, converted in 1977 into a forward command unit, and closed in the 1990s. Bäckvägen, the street next to it, was named in 1924 after a stream that flows out into Årstaviken bay.
Vid Hälleviken finns en välbesökt badpla: Hälleviken has a popular bathing spot run by volunteers from the local club, HIF. They look after the jetties, a slide, a bathing raft and even a dance floor. In winter, Lågedammen often turns into a skating rink.
Vid Hällskriftsgatan finns familjen Hedl: On Hällskriftsgatan you'll find the Hedlund family's “guestbook”, carved into a slab of bedrock. Among the names are Henrik Ibsen, Viktor Rydberg, Fredrika Bremer and the balloonist S.A. Andrée. The stonemason is said to have been paid a krona per letter.
Vid Hötorget ligger Konserthuset, där No: At Hötorget you'll find the Stockholm Concert Hall, where the Nobel Prizes are presented every year. There's a market on the square, and inside Hötorgshallen, the market hall, are food stalls from all over the world.
Vid Jakobsbergs station står Gula villan: By Jakobsberg station stands Gula villan, the Yellow Villa – Jakobsberg's old station building, put up in 1876. Amid the bustle of Jakobsbergs Centrum, with its shops, cafés and restaurants, it's a reminder of the day the railway came. Today Jakobsberg is Järfälla's commercial and administrative centre.
Vid Jungfrusunds hamn på Ekeröns östra s: From Jungfrusund harbour on the eastern side of Ekerön, you look out over Vårbyfjärden bay and the Jungfruholmarna islands, where the Göta Sailing Club has had its own club islands since 1915. Not far from here is Ekebyhovsbacken, the home slope of the Mälaröarna Alpine Ski Club, with sweeping views over Ekerön and Lake Mälaren.
Vid Järneksvägen har man hittat spår av: Traces of a Late Stone Age settlement have been found by Järneksvägen, along with settlements from the Bronze Age, Iron Age and Viking Age. Nälsta village is known from the 14th century, with three farms where Nälsta farm stands today.
Vid Karl XII:s torg står Karl XII i bron: In Karl XII:s torg, a bronze Charles XII stands pointing towards Russia.
Vid Kottlasjöns västra strand ligger Ape: On the western shore of Lake Kottlasjön stands the Orange Villa, whose real name is Skogsbacken. The master carpenter Per Johan Asker built it on spec in 1890 as a summer house with two flats. It was one of several summer retreats that sprang up around the lake in the late 19th century, and the villa and two small outbuildings have been listed since 1982.
Vid Kåhögs gård samlas tusentals människ: Every spring thousands of people gather at Kåhög farm for the kosläpp, when the cows are let out to graze for the first time after winter. The Kåhög village association also organises a midsummer party and quiz walks.
Vid Landsnora kvarn och såg gör Landsnor: At Landsnora mill and sawmill, Landsnoravägen takes a sharp bend and runs straight between the mill building and the miller's cottage. The gap is so narrow that traffic lights are needed to control it.
Vid Lejontrappan ner mot kanalen ligger: On Lejontrappan, the Lion Steps leading down to the canal, sit two bronze lions by Camilla Bergman from 1991. Between 1638 and 1673 four lion statues stood by the wooden bridge here, which is why it was known as Lejonbron, the Lion Bridge. In winter a 4 x 6 metre heart lights up the spot.
Vid Liljeholmens station byggdes 1860–18: In 1860–1862 Sweden's first workshop for repairing locomotives and carriages was built at Liljeholmen station. It even had a large laundry for the sleeping cars' linen, and in 1895 the SJ workshops were Liljeholmen's biggest employer, with 324 staff.
Vid Lill-Tumba gård finns ett gravfält f: Lill-Tumba farm has an Iron Age burial ground. The farm is part of the listed Tumba paper mill and was given a new barn in 1905 and a new farmhouse in 1908.
Vid Lilla Bommen möter staden älven. Den: Lilla Bommen is where the city meets the river. The red-and-white skyscraper is known as Läppstiftet, the Lipstick. It was completed in 1989 and has a viewing floor right at the top. Next to it is the Gothenburg Opera, opened in 1994, and moored at the quay is the sailing ship Barken Viking from 1906.
Vid Linnéplatsen börjar Slottsskogen, st: Linnéplatsen marks the start of Slottsskogen, the city's great park, opened in 1874. It has animals, ponds and the Natural History Museum, home to a stuffed blue whale from 1865. In the other direction runs Linnégatan, one of Gothenburg's best-loved streets for eating out.
Vid Luxgatan 26 sprängdes under andra vä: At Luxgatan 26, an air-raid shelter for up to 1,000 people was blasted into the rock during the Second World War. Today a tyre company has its premises there.
Vid Lärjeån ligger Lärjeåns trädgårdar,: Down by the Lärje river you'll find Lärjeåns trädgårdar, a biodynamic market garden with a café – a green escape just a short walk from the square.
Vid Löfströmsbron mellan Sundbyberg och: At Löfströmsbron bridge, between Sundbyberg and Mariehäll, Bällstaån flows out into Bällstaviken, an inlet of Ulvsundasjön and so of Lake Mälaren. At Solvalla the stream is regulated by a dam.
Vid Lövsta finns tre övertorvade gravhög: At Lövsta there are three turf-covered Iron Age burial mounds. One is more than 20 metres across, making it Stockholm's only 'great mound'. More mounds are said to have stood nearby, but they were cleared away in the early 1800s.
Vid Maltesholmstorget, mitt i Hässelby S: On Maltesholmstorget, in the middle of Hässelby Strand's centre, is Hässelby Strand Church. A stone's throw away the metro runs out: this is the north-western end of the green line, a full 18.6 kilometres from Slussen. The station opened in November 1958, and guests on the very first train were served coffee along the way.
Vid Mälarstranden i Nedre Hallunda lät l: In the 1800s, on the shore of Lake Mälaren at Nedre Hallunda, Lieutenant Wennberg built houses, a jetty and a bathing spot for well-to-do summer guests. With their ornate gingerbread woodwork, the houses are early examples of Stockholmers' summer homes.
Vid Mårbacka valde arkitekterna låga hus: At Mårbacka the architects opted for low buildings of prefabricated concrete with red windows repeated in a steady rhythm. There are 900 offices, 80 per cent of them identical. Even so, 'every space' was given its own identity, according to the jury of the Kasper Salin Prize.
Vid Mårbackagatan byggdes 1966 Televerke: In 1966 the Swedish Telecommunications Administration's offices went up on Mårbackagatan, designed by Gösta Danielson and Bengt Hidemark. The building won the Kasper Salin Prize, Sweden's top architecture award, in 1969 and is now being converted into homes.
Vid Mårbackagatan uppfördes 1966 Telever: In 1966 the administrative buildings of Televerket, the state telecoms authority, went up on Mårbackagatan, designed by Gösta Danielson and Bengt Hidemark. The building won the Kasper Salin Prize in 1969 and served as the head office of Televerket and later of Telia's Swedish operations. The area is now being turned into housing.
Vid Mårtensdal ligger Hammarbyverket som: At Mårtensdal is the Hammarby plant, which extracts heating and cooling from treated waste water, and at Tjärhovsplan you'll hear about Kafé 44 in the old Swedish bottle-cap factory.
Vid Mörbyfjärden, en kort bit härifrån,: On Mörbyfjärden bay, a short way from here, is Lovö waterworks, opened in 1933 – and it's no small operation. In 2002 it supplied drinking water to 40 per cent of the northern half of Greater Stockholm, and on an ordinary day it produces around 133,000 cubic metres. So when someone in northern Stockholm fills a glass from the tap, there's a good chance the water came through right here on western Lovön.
Vid Nacka ström föddes själva namnet Nac: The name Nacka itself was born here at Nacka ström, the rapids – it was at Nacka gård that the place was first called by that name. Nacka's first industries grew up around the rapids, with roots going back to the Middle Ages: mills, and a works making iron and brass goods. The big yellow wooden building now known as Nacka gård is the tenant farmer's house from 1874, and Lake Järlasjön beside it is named after Järla gård, a farm mentioned as early as 1426.
Vid Nordre älv ligger Ragnhildsholmens s: On the banks of Nordre älv stand the ruins of Ragnhildsholmen castle, dating from the 1250s. Villa Ellesbo was built in 1795–1796 as a summer residence to designs by Carl Wilhelm Carlberg. In the 18th century the commandant of Bohus Fortress lived at Ellesbo Nordgård.
Vid Nordre älvs mynning, en bit härifrån: Not far from here, at the mouth of the Nordre älv river, lies the little village of Korseberget. It may well be the same place as Horsaberg, where King Magnus Ladulås and his brother Valdemar sat down to negotiate peace one summer's day in 1274. Close by are Kyrkeby and Nereby, whose boundaries and names have been redrawn in the official statistics several times over.
Vid Norrtull fick resenärerna från Uppsa: At Norrtull, travellers arriving from the direction of Uppsala had to pay a toll to enter the city, from the 1670s until the early 19th century. Norra Stationsgatan, incidentally, was called Solnavägen right up until 1940. Today it's home to the restaurant Etoile – French for 'star' – with just 26 seats and tasting menus of up to 20 courses. Fittingly enough, it earned a Michelin star in 2020.
Vid Norsborgs station projiceras ljussku: At Norsborg station, Raha Rastifard's light sculpture A Tribute to Movement is projected onto the rock walls facing the platforms. The work measures 60 by 12 metres and is best seen after dark.
Vid Nybroplan ligger Dramaten, Kungliga: At Nybroplan stands Dramaten, the Royal Dramatic Theatre, which opened in 1908. This is where Strandvägen begins, lined with grand turn-of-the-century buildings along the water, and from Nybrokajen, the quay, boats head out into the archipelago.
Vid Odenplan ligger Gustav Vasa kyrka. E: At Odenplan stands Gustav Vasa Church. A short distance away, on Sveavägen, is the Stockholm Public Library, designed by Gunnar Asplund and famous for its round lending hall.
Vid Pampas trafikplats byggdes 1982–84 e: At the Pampas interchange, a long elevated exit ramp was built alongside the Tomteboda postal terminal in 1982–84. It didn't open until the early 2020s – and then only for buses heading to the Tomteboda bus depot.
Vid Riddarhustorget ligger Riddarhuset f: On Riddarhustorget stands the 17th-century House of Nobility. Do take a stroll out onto Riddarholmen (4 min), where Swedish kings have been buried in Riddarholmen Church for several hundred years.
Vid Råckstavägen står två bostadshus med: On Råckstavägen stand two apartment buildings with 247 flats, built using a rapid-construction concept called Snabba hus, or “Fast Houses”. The first tenants moved in at the end of 2019, and the project made the shortlist of ten for Stockholm Building of the Year 2020. Nearby is Råcksta gård, an old farm, next door to the buildings that used to house the energy company Vattenfall's head office. And Anundsvägen, a quiet street of detached houses, once had a visit from none other than Queen Elizabeth II.
Vid SL:s räkning 2016 hade Enskede gård: In SL's 2016 passenger count, Enskede gård had the fewest people boarding on a weekday of any metro station. Around 2032 the station is due to close, when a new one opens in the Slakthusområdet area.
Vid Sicklasjön finns en bocciabana som b: By Lake Sicklasjön there’s a bocce court, built for the many Italian workers who came to Atlas Copco. Next to it is Sickla Strandbad, a bathing spot with a sandy beach and a diving raft.
Vid Siriusgatan finns en hällkista, en s: Near Siriusgatan you'll find a stone cist, a chambered grave from the Late Neolithic, around 4,000 years ago. It has never been excavated. When it was built, a lake lay below it, where Gärdsås mosse bog is today.
Vid Sjödalsvägen står ett lager från 195: On Sjödalsvägen stands a warehouse from 1956 that was converted for Swedish Peugeot in 1982. Since 2001 it has been home to the industrial bakery Alimenta, which changed its name to Bake My Day in 2017.
Vid Skogslöparvägen finns flera bevarade: Along Skogslöparvägen there are several well-preserved Viking Age burial grounds, and on Flystaberget a cairn probably from the Bronze Age. The land began to be divided into villa plots in 1905, and in 1915 Flysta became a township.
Vid Skrävsta, som naturstigen passerar,: At Skrävsta, which the nature trail passes, ancient monuments and burial grounds are especially dense. An excavation in 1997 uncovered a longhouse measuring 51 by 8 metres, one of the largest in the Stockholm area. It's thought to have been a feasting hall.
Vid Skälby gård står Grytan, en gammal a: By Skälby farm stands Grytan, 'the Pot', an old workers' dwelling. It owes its name to its three chimneys, which make it look like an upturned cooking pot.
Vid Slagstabadet finns lämningar av Slag: By the Slagsta bathing spot are the remains of the Slagsta brickworks, in operation from the 17th century to the early 1900s. In the western part of the reserve lie the remains of the Norsborg anti-aircraft position from the Second World War, with a gun emplacement and several firing trenches.
Vid Smörgatan står ett däckshus från 196: On Smörgatan stands a 'deck house' from 1960 by the architect Erik Friberger: 18 detached houses sitting on three levels of concrete decks. Built as an experiment in flexible, prefabricated housing, it is one of a kind.
Vid Solvägen bodde författaren Karin Boy: The writer Karin Boye lived near Solvägen for part of her life. Her family had built a tall villa, Villa Björkebo, on a wooded slope where Sjödalsgymnasiet school stands today. The house has since been demolished.
Vid Spånga kyrkväg en bit härifrån ligge: By Spånga kyrkväg, not far from here, is the Sörgården block: 76 L-shaped houses from the early 1970s, designed by Höjer and Ljungqvist. The City Museum has given them its green rating as particularly valuable. Down in Rinkeby metro station, opened in 1975, three artists created the decor, including Nisse Zetterberg's brick-red walls.
Vid Stadsbiblioteket hör du om biografst: At the City Library you'll hear about the old cinema strip, where Rialto opened in 1921 and Röda Lyktan showed films from 1917 to 1982.
Vid Stadsgården hade Saltsjöbanan en gån: Saltsjöbanan, the Saltsjö railway, once had its terminus at Stadsgården. It was in use from 1893 to 1936, and the station building then became the Seamen's Institute. Next to it, the Lokatten steps climb up to Katarinavägen. They were built in 1914, closed off in the 1970s and opened to the public again in 2023. The old cruise terminal has been reborn too – since 2022 it's been the Stadsgårdsterminalen cultural centre, with a bar, a roof terrace and a stage for live music.
Vid Stigbergstorget berättas om biografe: At Stigbergstorget you'll hear about the cinema that became a record shop, and Majvallen is where Göteborgs FF play their home games.
Vid Stockbysjön byggde fyrverkaren Adolf: Around 1880, the pyrotechnician Adolf Rickard Törner built a fireworks factory by Lake Stockbysjön, tucked away because of the risk of explosions. His relatives kept it running until 1972, and it gave its name to Raketstigen – Rocket Path – a little way off.
Vid Stocksundets strand låg bryggeriet I: On the shore of the Stocksundet strait stood the Inverness brunn brewery, where Sweden's first club soda was made. The spring is still there, but the water tastes salty. A stone's throw away is Calles klimp, Calle's Lump, a slab of rock with gilded lettering. Legend has it that Calle was Karl IX, Karl XII or Karl XV – but most likely he was a spice merchant called Carl Eneroth, who was given the rock as a birthday present.
Vid Stora Värtan låg sjöflottiljen F 2 H: On the shore of Stora Värtan was the F 2 Hägernäs naval air wing, the only one of its kind in Sweden. The military stayed until 1974, and street names like Radarvägen, Pontongränd and Flygvillevägen are reminders of that era.
Vid Stora Ängby står den gamla visthusbo: At Stora Ängby, the old storehouse known as Fatburen stands on a small mound. It's built of notched logs, painted Falu red and was put up at the same time as the main house, but using timber from the 16th century. It's considered the oldest surviving wooden building in Stockholm.
Vid Stävholmsgränd låg ett stort gravfäl: Near Stävholmsgränd lay a large Bronze and Iron Age burial ground, excavated in 1966–1967. Its domarring – a ring of standing stones – is a burial type unique in Stockholm, so the outer circle of stones was re-erected, while the rest made way for terraced houses. North-east of Skärholmen farm there's a Viking Age hillfort.
Vid Sundby, en bit härifrån, finns spår: At Sundby, not far from here, there are traces of the Viking Age: a large, richly decorated rune-carved rock, and right beside it another rune rock that was never finished. History doesn't tell us who left it half done. The name Sundby has been known since 1312, and today the district is part of Gamla Spånga, Old Spånga, with its many villas.
Vid Svingeln ligger Gamla begravningspla: At Svingeln you'll find the Old Cemetery, once the burial ground of Gothenburg's synagogue. Göteborgs högre samskola, a long-established school, is here too.
Vid Sätra prästgård, i nordvästra hörnet: By Sätra rectory, in the north-western corner of Danderyd parish, stands Sätraäng Church, a district church. The area around it is all water and woodland: a little further away, on the Sollentuna side, the district of Sjöberg is squeezed in between Edsviken bay, Lake Rösjön and the Rinkeby woods. It's made up of Östra Sjöberg, Västra Sjöberg and Falkberget.
Vid Södermannagatan 44 låg biografen Ugg: At Södermannagatan 44 stood the Ugglan ('Owl') cinema, opened in 1927 and designed by Björn Hedvall. It closed in 1941, and the auditorium became a meeting hall for the Salvation Army, which is still in the building.
Vid Södertäljevägen låg en gång Gyllene: Södertäljevägen was once home to Gyllene ratten, the Golden Steering Wheel, one of Sweden's first American-style motels. It opened in 1957 and became a landmark for drivers thanks to the mast with a steering wheel on top, but it was demolished 50 years later. A short way off is Fruängen metro station, which at 46.8 metres above sea level is the highest station on the entire network.
Vid Södertäljevägen, i höjd med trafikpl: On Södertäljevägen, near the Bredäng junction, stood the Gyllene ratten motel – “the Golden Steering Wheel” – one of the first motels in Sweden built on the American model. It opened in 1957, and its tall mast topped with a steering wheel was a landmark for drivers until the motel was torn down 50 years later. There's older history to be found in Segeltorp, where the croft of Istorp, also known as Komöte, was set up around 1650 on land belonging to the Vårby estate.
Vid Södra Långevattnet ligger Sveriges s: By Södra Långevattnet lake stands Sweden's largest free-standing insect hotel. It's there to boost biodiversity, with a focus on wild bees, butterflies and birds.
Vid Televerkets äldre anläggning Vitsand: At Vitsand, the old Swedish Telecom site, stood a 90-metre telecommunications tower bearing the company's logo, built for radio links. It was a Farsta landmark until it was demolished in 2023 to make way for housing.
Vid Torpagatan sitter skulpturen Ensam a: On Torpagatan you'll find Margareta Ryndel's sculpture Ensam, Alone: a small child crouching with its arms clasped tight to its chest. It was put up in 1988 in memory of the Vidkärr children's home, which once stood nearby. For many years a plaque here spoke of the love and care at the home, but many who had grown up there found the words a cruel mockery, and the plaque has since been taken down.
Vid Träkvista torg finns det mesta en vi: Träkvista torg has most of what a villa suburb needs: a supermarket, a pizzeria, a paint shop, a toy shop and a restaurant. Träkvista village was in fact the centre of Ekerö municipality until 1990, when Ekerö centrum opened. Nearby on Ekerövägen is Fantans hög, a legendary offering cairn. The homes around here are mostly villas, linked houses and terraced houses.
Vid Uddbyfallet och Follbrinkströmmen bl: At Uddbyfallet and Follbrinkströmmen the land turns steep, with rocky outcrops and swirling rapids shaped during the Ice Age. The municipality's highest point is Telegrafberget.
Vid Ulvsundasjön flyttade man en gång en: Beside Lake Ulvsundasjön, a whole manor house was once moved. The old main building of Huvudsta gård was shifted about 300 metres to the north-west, and the new manor was finished in 1836. Right next to it, along the waterfront promenade, is Huvudstabadet, a heated outdoor pool. A little further away, down in Västra skogen metro station, you'll find Sweden's longest escalator, all 66 metres of it.
Vid Valla hittades två myntskatter, 1910: Two coin hoards were found at Valla, in 1910 and 1919 – perhaps a single 'twin hoard' that had been split up. The first was discovered by a railway worker when the Nyboda–Enskede line was being built. Together they held almost 3,900 coins, wrapped in cloth and birch bark.
Vid Västra Porten ligger Stora smällen,: At Västra Porten lies Stora smällen, one of the largest burial grounds in Bohuslän, with 160 burial mounds, standing stones, stone ships and a stone circle from AD 500–1000. From the top you look out over the valley as the Nordre älv river winds its way towards the sea.
Vid Vårby källa fanns en hälsobrunn reda: There was a health spring at Vårby källa as early as the 1700s. In the 1930s a mineral water factory opened here and grew into Wårby Bryggerier, and since 1989 the brewery at Hagaudd has been owned by Spendrups.
Vid avfarten till Eriksbergs industriomr: By the turn-off to the Eriksberg industrial area stands an old stone arch bridge that was part of the Göta landsväg road to Botkyrka and Södertälje. It has been repaired and preserved as a historic monument. In 1568 King Erik XIV crossed the bridge at Flottsbro on his way to fight his rebellious brothers.
Vid avtäckningen ska Bellmans änka Lovis: At the unveiling, Bellman's widow Lovisa is said to have whispered: “I wonder what they'd have said if they'd had him for a husband?” To the queen she supposedly remarked that he “was very dull when he was at home”. The lines were surely made up afterwards, but they're part of the Bellman legend.
Vid barnboksbiblioteket finns Bagar-Birg: By the children's library is Bagar-Birgit's café, run in summer together with the City of Solna.
Vid brofästet på Huddingesidan ligger Br: By the bridgehead on the Huddinge side stands Brostugan, a cottage known since 1689. Before there was a bridge, a ferry ran here, and the crofter was both ferryman and innkeeper. When a pontoon bridge arrived, he collected the tolls.
Vid brofästet på Kärsön finns sedan 2012: Since 2012 there's been a treatment pond by the bridgehead on Kärsön. Surface water from the bridge runs there along channels and is cleaned before it reaches Lake Mälaren – and if a tanker carrying hazardous goods ever overturned, the spill would be caught in the pond.
Vid bäcken Flabäcken mellan Kållered och: Important border meetings with the Danes were held by the Flabäcken stream between Kållered and Lindome in 1591, 1601 and 1603. The talks were mostly conducted face to face on a bridge over the stream. In 1603 Duke Karl and Christian IV attended in person, and among other things they quarrelled over the right to the Three Crowns emblem.
Vid dalens södra sida, vid nuvarande Lov: On the south side of the valley, near today's Lovisebergsvägen, there was a bridge in Viking times. Here you'll find Glömstahällen, an 11th-century rune-inscribed rock that reads: 'Sverker had the bridge made in memory of Ärengunn, his good mother.'
Vid den gamla biografen låg restaurangen: Next to the old cinema was the restaurant Postiljonen. It has long since closed, but you can still see its distinctive statue of a postilion on horseback in what is now the covered indoor square.
Vid den gamla stationen, öster om dagens: The old station, east of today's, had a station building. It was demolished in 2013, ten years after the station moved.
Vid den stora cirkulationsplatsen Bergsl: Several roads, including Lövstavägen and Bergslagsvägen, meet at the big Bergslagsplan roundabout. Nearby is Hässelby Palace from the 1650s, one of the oldest surviving secular buildings in Stockholm, with a runestone on a Viking Age burial mound by its entrance. Close by in Vällingby centre is the brick church of St Thomas, S:t Tomas kyrka, designed by Peter Celsing and consecrated in 1960. Inside is a wooden crucifix by Bror Hjorth.
Vid den övre stationen slutade man stann: Passenger trains stopped calling at the upper station only in May 1989, several years after the station building, designed by Adrian C. Peterson, was demolished in 1983.
Vid en auktion 1899 såldes bland annat 5: An auction in 1899 included 58 dairy cows and 11 workhorses. Today Ågesta Riding School is based here, with 55 riding horses and around 900 pupils a week.
Vid en brand i Torsby prästgård 1760 för: A fire at Torsby vicarage in 1760 destroyed the parish archives, parish registers and all. That makes the parish a tough nut for family historians.
Vid en brandförsäkring 1750 hade gården: When the estate was insured against fire in 1750, it had hothouses, an orangery, stables, a henhouse and a large orchard with 286 fruit-bearing trees. The growing goes on: since 1983 the Malmgården Vita Bergen foundation has run a biodynamic garden here. During Advent there’s a Christmas market in the main building.
Vid en mätning 2001 hade Hagstaeken en s: When it was measured in 2001, the Hagsta oak had a girth of 680 centimetres at chest height. It was protected as early as 1933 and described in 1935 as 'one of the stoutest on Södertörn'. It was the only oak in Huddinge with a name of its own.

When it was measured in 2001, the Hagsta oak had a girth of 680 centimetres at chest height. It was protected as early as 10 October 1933, and in 1935 the botanist Rutger Sernander described it as one of the stoutest on Södertörn.
Vid en ombyggnad 2012–2014 byggdes två b: During a 2012–2014 redevelopment, two residential blocks were built on top of the shopping centre. The taller, Tyresö View, has 23 floors, the bottom two of them shops belonging to the mall. In front, a town park with a fountain was laid out and opened in September 2015 during the Tyresö Festival.
Vid en renovering 1958 hittade man dolda: During a renovation in 1958, the original wallpaper was found hidden away. The pattern was reprinted as the Herräng wallpaper and now graces the great hall. The house also has 18th-century tiled stoves, and the year 1788 can be seen on the façade facing Långsjön lake.
Vid en renovering på 1960-talet fick sal: During a renovation in the 1960s the auditorium got more comfortable armchairs, the number of seats fell to 292 and it was renamed Nya Rialto. On 19 May 1986 the cinema closed for good. Since 2020 the venue has been run by Teaterverket.
Vid en utgrävning 1947 hittades ett sten: An excavation in 1947 uncovered a stone cairn beneath the mound with 23 coins, the oldest from 1577 and the newest from 1938. There were also burnt bones, dated in 2001 to 500–100 BC, suggesting that the site was first an Iron Age grave.
Vid entrén ligger en labyrint av stenar,: By the entrance is a labyrinth of stones, a so-called jungfrudans or “maiden's dance”, from 1990. The English-style park has a smithy from Lilla Frösunda and a pump house from Hagalunds torg, and the wing of the house is home to Solna's school museum.
Vid ett inbrott 1985 stals en kalk och e: A silver chalice and wafer box were stolen in a break-in in 1985. In October 2014, almost 30 years later, they were handed in to the police by someone who had found them among a former tenant's belongings.

In a break-in in 1985, a silver chalice and wafer box were stolen. In October 2014, almost thirty years later, someone handed them in to the police after finding them among things left behind by a former tenant.
Vid forsen i Wättinge har vattenkraften: From the 16th century to the 1930s, the rapids at Wättinge powered forges, a gunpowder mill, a weaving mill, a rolling mill and a paper mill. The paper mill, from the 1750s, was called Nyfors and gave its name to the cottage area. Today only the foundations remain.
Vid gamla by- och kyrkovägen finns ”Grod: Beside the old village and church road is 'Grodan' (the Frog), also known as 'Önskestenen' (the Wishing Stone) – an offering pile beneath an overhanging boulder. For as long as anyone can remember, passers-by have propped up the boulder with a stick for luck. The tradition lives on, and the pile of sticks now measures about six metres by one.
Vid gränsen mot Hässelby villastad ligge: On the edge of Hässelby villastad stand the Radiohusen, 32 terraced houses completed in 1958. Several Swedish radio personalities moved in, including Allan Schulman, Pekka Langer and Putte Wickman.
Vid husets norra gavel fanns en bostad f: At the northern end of the building was a three-room flat with kitchen for the postmaster. The post office itself had floors and walls of Kolmården marble, and the counter was faced with marchalite, a type of plastic laminate.
Vid huvudentrén har Carl Eldh huggit in: At the main entrance, Carl Eldh carved the key people behind the building into the capitals, following medieval custom. Look for the master builder with a drawing, the foreman carpenter with his saw and a tinsmith in a flat cap.
Vid infarten står den så kallade entréby: At the entrance to the area, the so-called entrance building sits like a slice of cake between Instrumentvägen and Jakobsdalsvägen, with a tower that catches the eye. It was built in 1964–1970 for the tyre company Michelin. Fittingly, the blocks here are called Provröret (the Test Tube), Instrumentet (the Instrument) and Plomben (the Filling).
Vid invigningen 1906 var huvudtävlingen: At the opening in 1906, the main event was a one-mile race – 1.61 kilometres – won by Johan Svanberg. By the 1912 Olympics, the sports ground was considered one of the most modern in the world.
Vid invigningen 1953 var tornet Göteborg: When it opened in 1953, the tower was the highest building in Gothenburg, 122 metres above sea level. Visitors went up by a two-person lift or climbed the 100 steps. Nearly 75,000 people came in the first six months.
Vid invigningen 1973 kallade Olof Palme: At the opening in 1973, Olof Palme called Hallonbergen ‘the best residential environment in Sweden’. Criticism soon followed, and in 1974 the doctor Nils-Erik Landell wrote a book about its planning, ‘Hallonbergen – framtidssverige?’ (‘Hallonbergen – the Sweden of the future?’).
Vid invigningen fick kyrkan en Hammondor: At its consecration the church was given a Hammond organ by AGA. The altar wall is dominated by a large stucco relief flecked with crushed brick, composed by the artist Simon Gate in 1937.
Vid invigningen flög tävlande från Rotte: To mark the opening, competitors flew from Rotterdam via Bremen and Copenhagen to Torslanda. Nobody was allowed to land before 4 pm. The Swedish lieutenant N. Söderberg came in 1 minute and 36 seconds after four and won, ahead of a Dutchman and a German.
Vid invigningen hölls en tävling där pla: The opening was marked with a race: the planes flew from Rotterdam via Bremen and Copenhagen and were not allowed to land before 4 pm. The winner, Swedish lieutenant N. Söderberg, touched down just 1 minute and 36 seconds after the hour.
Vid kommunalhusets entré står Bror Hjort: At the entrance to the council building stands Bror Hjorth's bronze Flicka med fruktkorg, Girl with a Fruit Basket, from 1951. The basket of apples pays tribute to Huddinge's thousands of villa gardens and the housewives who picked the fruit and pressed the juice. Behind the churchyard lies Biskopsstenen, the Bishop's Stone, a giant boulder left by the Ice Age. It measures 7 by 4 metres, and its peak looks like a bishop's mitre.
Vid kyrkan står en runsten som ser ut so: Beside the church stands a runestone shaped like a little stone ship. This is the Botkyrka Monument, a grave memorial to Björn, the brother of Saint Botvid, who in 1129 had the forerunner of today's church built. What you see here is a copy: the original is in the Swedish History Museum, and a plaster cast has even made its way to the Victoria and Albert Museum in London. There are more runestones around the church – one of them is built into the wall beneath the tower, and only part of it is visible.
Vid kyrkans södra långsida står en stenp: Along the south side of the church stands a stone pyramid from 1762, a burial chapel for the chamberlain Olof Adlerberg and his wife. It's thought to have been designed by Jean Eric Rehn, modelled on the Pyramid of Cestius in Rome, and the burial vault is decorated with skulls bearing bat wings.
Vid lekplatsen norr om kyrkan stod från: From 1930, a diabase bear by Anders Jönsson, known as Nalle ('Teddy'), stood by the playground north of the church. The original was replaced in 1948 by a copy, which in the early 2000s was moved to a lawn on Fjällgatan.
Vid mitten av 1900-talet användes Hässel: In the mid-1900s Hässelby villastad station was often used for filming. It looked just like a country station but was conveniently close to the Filmstaden studios in Solna.
Vid mitten av 1900-talet ägdes Långnäs a: In the mid-20th century Långnäs was owned by the textile artist Edna Martin, who ran the crafts association Handarbetets vänner for three decades. After a renovation in 1946 it became a year-round home, keeping much of its 18th-century character.

In the mid-1900s Långnäs was owned by the textile artist Edna Martin, who for three decades headed Handarbetets vänner, the Friends of Handicraft. After a conversion in 1946 the house became a year-round home, but much of its 18th-century character survives.
Vid mitten av 1900-talet ägdes Långnäs g: In the mid-1900s Långnäs farm was owned by the textile artist Edna Martin, who headed the craft association Handarbetets vänner for three decades. Artur von Schmalensee remodelled the house in 1946 but kept its 18th-century character. A small Christmas market is held here every year.
Vid mitten av 1970-talet såldes Isolda t: In the mid-1970s Isolda was sold to Finland and became a pleasure vessel, and in 2002 she was listed as a protected historic ship. An association is now restoring her as close to the original as possible, with the aim of sailing her as a training ship.
Vid mossen låg en gammal isrink, Torbjör: By the bog there was an old ice rink, Torbjörnsrinken, that had fallen into disrepair. In 1977 parents from Grinnekullen started doing it up. Teaming up with local hockey clubs, they formed the Tuve rink association and got Tuve ishall, an indoor arena, built. It opened for the 1980/81 season.

Down by the bog was an old ice rink, Torbjörnsrinken, that had been neglected for years. In the summer of 1977, young parents from Grinnekullen started restoring it together with the city's leisure department.
Vid mossen låg en gammal, förfallen isri: There used to be a run-down old ice rink beside the bog. In summer 1977, parents from the Grinnekulle area began doing it up, and together with local hockey clubs they founded the Tuve ice rink association. The result was Tuve ishall, the indoor rink that opened for the 1980/1981 season.
Vid mossen låg isrinken Torbjörnsrinken,: The Torbjörnsrinken ice rink by the bog had fallen into disrepair. In summer 1977 parents from Grinnekullen began fixing it up, and together with hockey clubs on Hisingen they formed the Tuve rink association. The result was Tuve ishall, an indoor arena that opened for the 1980/81 season.
Vid mötet 1603 gällde en av tvistefrågor: At the meeting of 1603, one of the disputes concerned the right to the Three Crowns in the Danish coat of arms. Several issues went to arbitration, and the tensions later helped spark the Kalmar War of 1611.
Vid norra änden av Victor Balcks väg byg: At the northern end of Victor Balcks väg, the Swedish Co-operative Union built shops for meat, cold cuts, milk and bread between 1934 and 1936, designed by Eskil Sundahl. The building in the Gymnasten block survives, while the shops in Poängen were replaced by housing in 2008.
Vid ombyggnaden 1970–1971 blev sjukhusky: During the 1970–1971 conversion, the hospital church became Gjörwellsalen, the meeting room for the regional executive board. Beneath the new terrace are the assembly hall and a staff restaurant that's also open to the public.
Vid ombyggnaden 1989 blev Solna Centrum: When it was rebuilt in 1989, Solna Centrum became an indoor shopping centre. Its closeness to Filmstaden, the old film studios, shows in the Hollywood Staircase, decorated with classic film stars. The centre was named shopping centre of the year in both 1990 and 1993.
Vid ombyggnaden 2005–2006 sprängdes fyra: During the 2005–2006 rebuild, four new screens were blasted out beneath the square, entered from the old foyer. The large auditorium is one of two listed cinemas in Stockholm that still show films.
Vid ombyggnaden blev hangarens gamla por: When the hangar was converted, its old doors became part of the facade, fixed partly open with glazed entrances. Inside you can see the 1,500-tonne steel roof structure, and the control panel for the doors is still on the central pillar.
Vid pendeltågsstationen finns också en s: Next to the commuter train station there's also a large bus stop with no fewer than eight islands, with buses heading on to Mölndal centre and Gothenburg, among other places. Kållered's shopping centre, home to Ikea among others, is just round the corner.
Vid pendeltågsstationen står Gula villan: By the commuter rail station stands Gula villan, the Yellow Villa, Jakobsberg's old station building from 1876. Today about 10,200 people a day catch the train here, 17.4 kilometres from Stockholm Central. The bus terminal next door is a 'docking' terminal: you wait indoors and go out through a separate door to each bus.
Vid plaskdammen på Älvsborgsplan ligger: By the paddling pool at Älvsborgsplan sits a beach ball that no one can throw. Berit Lindfeldt's sculpture Boll – Ball – is a stainless steel sphere about two metres across, pale blue with shiny dots. Nearby is Astrid Noack's bronze statue Young Man, and the Slottsskogen allotments, founded in 1916, now have 154 plots.
Vid porslinsfabriken arbetade en rad kän: A string of famous designers worked at the porcelain factory: its first artistic director Wilhelm Kåge, Stig Lindberg and the ceramicist Lisa Larson. Today some small-scale ceramics work still goes on in the town.
Vid premiären i november 1969 åkte värld: At the first tournament in November 1969, world number one Rod Laver was surprisingly knocked out in the quarter-finals. Nikola Pilić won the men's title and Billie Jean King the women's. On the posters the prize money, 130,000 kronor, was printed bigger than both the players' names and the tournament's.
Vid promenadstråket står en liten bronsp: On the waterfront promenade stands a little bronze boy in a life jacket, holding a sailing boat and gazing out across the water. He's David Wretling's Den första båten, "The First Boat", from 1982.
Vid provfiske i Nora träsk har man fått: Test fishing in Nora träsk has turned up perch, pike, bream, roach, bleak, silver bream and tench, among others.
Vid renoveringen 1959 fick salongen sitt: The auditorium got its present look in the 1959 renovation. The light bulbs in the ceiling were set in star-shaped fittings and arranged in constellations. For a while there was also Lilla Capitol, with just 18 seats.
Vid renoveringen 2011 lagade företaget A: During the 2011 renovation, the firm Argonneon repaired the neon tubes and replaced the wiring. The sign hangs above Råcksta krog facing Multrågatan and still lights up every evening.
Vid renoveringen i mitten av 1980-talet: During the renovation in the mid-1980s an 80-metre office block was built between the west and south stands. Thanks to its mirrored façade, locals nicknamed it the Dallas skyscraper.

During the renovation in the mid-1980s an 80-metre office block was built between the west and south stands. Thanks to its mirrored façade, locals nicknamed it the "Dallas skyscraper". Prince Bertil reopened the stadium in 1985.
Vid renoveringen på 1980-talet byggdes e: During the 1980s renovation an 80-metre office tower was built, nicknamed the "Dallas scraper" for its mirrored façade. The attendance record is 52,943 spectators, set at the World Cup qualifier against West Germany in 1965.
Vid restaureringen 1936 kom medeltida ka: During the restoration in 1936, medieval lime paintings were uncovered on the church's north wall: horsemen in round medallions, probably from the 14th century. The oldest parts of the church probably date from the mid-13th century.
Vid restaureringen 1956 togs 1600- och 1: The 1956 restoration brought back the colours of the 1600s and 1700s and reinstated the enclosed box pews, so the church's antique feel partly dates from then. The bell tower stands high on a rocky outcrop, and the bell was cast in Stralsund in 1656.
Vid räcket mot Berzelii park stod tidiga: Karl Göte Bejemark's 1967 sculpture Humor – a road worker peering out of a manhole – used to stand by the railing facing Berzelii Park. The model was the comedian Hasse Alfredson. The sculpture was moved in 2010 and since 2011 has stood on Södermalmstorg.
Vid sjön Drevviken ligger Strandkyrkogår: On the shores of Lake Drevviken lies Strandkyrkogården, a cemetery in the Skrubba area. Skrubba farm was once home to Skrubba skyddshem, a reform school meant to take in and bring up Stockholm boys regarded as 'mildly wayward'. Nearby is Skrubbatriangeln, an industrial estate that got its name for the simple reason that it's shaped like a triangle.
Vid sjön Flatens norra strand, en bit hä: On the northern shore of Lake Flaten, a short way from here, is Listudden. Its main house dates from the mid-18th century and has been blue-listed by the City Museum for its exceptional cultural and historical value. Further along the same shore was Ekudden – first a tenant croft, then a summer retreat – until its main house burned down in the late 1960s. What remains is now a protected ancient monument.
Vid sjön Magelungen alldeles intill driv: Beside Lake Magelungen, right next door, the Salvation Army runs Ågesta folkhögskola, a folk high school, along with an officers' training school. The little crofter's cottage of Nynäs is still standing too, and is now part of the recreation area. A little further on, out on a headland, is Ågestabadet – the City of Stockholm's only official naturist beach, even though it's actually in Huddinge. So this is where you can swim just as nature intended.
Vid sjön finns bebyggelse med 11 invånar: By the lake is a cluster of houses with 11 residents who belong to Sollentuna but can only reach the rest of their municipality by road by passing through Danderyd and Täby. The bathing spot known as Täbysidan, 'the Täby side', is also officially in Sollentuna.
Vid sjön ligger en före detta kursgård s: By the lake is a former conference centre, owned by the labour movement from 1937 to 2014. For many years the woods around the lake hosted the Rösjöloppet cross-country race, which was cancelled from 2009 as numbers dwindled.
Vid sjöns nordvästra sida ligger sommarc: On the north-west side of the lake is the summer café Gröna stugan, the Green Cottage. It's a close copy of the original Gröna stugan, which stood on the corner of Sturegatan and Rosengatan and was probably built in 1878.
Vid sjöns utlopp i nordväst fanns förr e: At the lake's outlet in the north-west there used to be an overflow weir regulating the water level. That's now done by a smaller sluice gate, and the old weir has become a footbridge just under 52 metres long.
Vid slutet av stenåldern låg vattnet cir: At the end of the Stone Age the water stood some 20 metres higher than today, and an archipelago spread out between Fittja and Alby. The stone cist originally lay 400 metres further north-west and was reconstructed here after it was investigated in 1999.

At the end of the Stone Age the water was about 20 metres higher than today, and an archipelago of islands stretched between Fittja and Alby. The grave was excavated in 1999 at its original site, about 400 metres to the north-west, and then rebuilt here.
Vid starten 1829 hade skolan bara fem or: When the school opened in 1829 it had just five regular and five extra students, and three teachers. Ten years later the student body had grown to 63.
Vid starten 1966 fanns ett 40-tal butike: When it opened in 1966, the centre had some 40 shops, the Domus and Tempo department stores, a bowling alley and its own tram stop. In the first four days alone, 50,000 people came through the doors. The building won an award for the way it expressed “American ideals and the large scale of the times”.
Vid starten hade Chalmers fem ordinarie: When it started, Chalmers had five regular students, five extra students and three teachers. Ten years later there were 63 students. Its graduates went on to become organ builders, sailmakers, brewers and goldsmiths, among other things.
Vid stationen Södertörns villastad fanns: By the Södertörns villastad station was a shop owned by Stieg Trenter's father, where young Stieg helped out in the 1920s. His crime novel Träff i helfigur is set in the area, and Stieg Trenters torg keeps his memory alive.
Vid stationen står en stor tumstock och: By the station stand a giant folding ruler and a block of Öland stone, made by Freddy Fraek in 1983. The ruler was originally wooden, but it took such a battering that it had to be clad in copper four years later.
Vid stenålderns slut låg vattnet i Mella: At the end of the Stone Age, the water in central Sweden stood about 20 metres higher than today, and the area between Fittja and Alby was a landscape of islands and skerries. Just north of the Alby cist, a stretch of the ancient Tingsvägen road, some 70 metres long, survives.
Vid södra infarten reser sig Mats Olofgö: At the southern approach rises Mats Olofgör's "Vågat möte" (Daring Encounter), a 23-metre bright red wave formed by two steel columns, inspired by "Vridande moment" (Torque) in Skärholmen. In the roundabouts stand Maria Ängquist-Klyvare's "Lysande tefat" (Glowing Saucers), umbrella-like sculptures lit up in the evening.
Vid tegelbrukets gamla kaj låg under mån: For many years the capsized vessel M/S Seaside lay by the brickworks' old quay. It wasn't salvaged until November 2011.
Vid torget ligger Teater Sesam, grundad: On the square you'll find Teater Sesam, founded in 1987 and based here since 1991, as well as the Gothenburg English Studio Theatre. Majorna's library and Majorna Church are here too.
Vid torget låg Sjömanshemmet, invigt 188: The Seamen's Home stood by the square, opened in 1886 in the presence of Oscar II and Queen Sofia. In its great hall Salomon August Andrée planned his polar expedition, and for many years a painting of his balloon rising into the sky hung there.
Vid torget planeras en entré till statio: An entrance to Hagastaden station, on a new metro branch between Odenplan and Arenastaden in Solna, is planned by the square. The artwork Inflyttarna (The Newcomers) is part of the public art around New Karolinska Solna.
Vid torgets 50-årsjubileum 2003 föreviga: When the square turned 50 in 2003, people with ties to Guldheden had their handprints immortalised here, among them Nobel laureate Arvid Carlsson and crime writer Åke Edwardson. Christer Fuglesang, Sven-Bertil Taube and Sven Wollter are among those who have been added since.
Vid torgets norra sida låg teatern Folka: On the north side of the square stood the Folkan theatre, which opened in 1856 as Ladugårdsteatern. It closed in 2001 and was demolished. Since 2010 a new building with an Åhléns department store has stood here.
Vid torgets södra del låg skolhuset Vite: At the southern end of the square stood the Vite Knut schoolhouse, which housed an elementary school from 1862 to 1889. In a doorway beside the stone steps was a urinal that locals nicknamed the "American Bar". The market hall on the square opened in 1887.
Vid tunnelbanans viadukt står skulpturen: By the metro viaduct stands the sculpture ‘Bird Rock with Three Eggs’, made by Berndt Helleberg in 1969. The viaduct is actually older than the metro: it opened in 1944, when trams ran across it. The art in the station, in sheet metal, glass and photographs, tells the story of Bromma and of aviation. The 16-storey Brommahöjden tower block is a newcomer by comparison – it only arrived in 2008.
Vid utgrävningar i Balltorp har man hitt: Excavations at Balltorp have uncovered a settlement almost 10,000 years old. The finds include bones from hunts for big game such as aurochs and wild boar, as well as thousands of flint flakes.
Excavations at Balltorp have uncovered a settlement almost 10,000 years old. Among the finds are bones from big-game hunting, including aurochs and wild boar, along with thousands of flint flakes.
Vid utgrävningar i Vårberg har man hitta: Excavations in Vårberg have turned up Stone Age pottery from the time when hunter-gatherers were beginning to settle down. There are also grave finds from the Roman and late Iron Ages.
Vid utgrävningar på 1980- och 2000-talen: Excavations in Ingentingskogen in the 1980s and 2000s turned up finds spanning the Migration Period to the Viking Age. Some place-name scholars think Ingenting may have been another name for Bålstomta, the old settlement where Tomteboda was established in the Middle Ages.
Vid utloppet fanns förr ett överfallsvär: At the outflow there used to be an overflow weir that controlled the water level. Today a small sluice gate does the job, and the old weir has become a footbridge just under 52 metres long.
Vid utställningen 1930 visades kreatur i: At the 1930 exhibition, livestock were shown in a ring that people nicknamed Kostadion, 'the Cow Stadium'. It was later used for motorcycle racing, cycling, boxing and riding competitions, and so from 1932 it was called Allstadion, 'the All Stadium'. On the same site, the tennis hall was built that later became a film studio.
Vid utökningen 2013 kom den ekklädda ber: When the reserve was enlarged in 2013, it took in Brattåsberget, an oak-covered rocky hill. On its boulder-strewn slopes and crags you can find the mosses Antitrichia curtipendula and Homalothecium sericeum. The area is part of the EU's Natura 2000 network.
Vid viken ligger Villa Bråvalla från 186: On the bay stands Villa Bråvalla from 1869, one of Sweden's first villas in the Old Norse style. Ferdinand Boberg designed Villa Farsta udde in 1910. The first permanent bridge across the bay, Farstabron, didn't open until 1985.
Vid vägen mot hamnen: By the road to the harbour
Vid västra stranden ligger Molnsättra gå: On the western shore lies Molnsättra farm, mentioned as early as the 1500s. It's one of the few remaining farms in the Stockholm area still run by private owners.
Vid Årstadalshamnen sträcker Kajen 4 på: At Årstadalshamnen, Kajen 4 soars 75 metres into the sky. Gert Wingårdh's 24-storey residential tower was named Stockholm Building of the Year in 2015. A short way off, the City Archives at Liljeholmskajen occupy two of the old Vin och Sprit liquor company's rock caverns, and since 2019 they've held the records of the city's building history. On Sjövikstorget square stands the artwork En tidsmaskin, A Time Machine, by Jan Svenungsson.
Vid årsskiftet 1970–1971 invigdes här St: At the turn of 1970–1971 Stockholm's only speed-skating oval opened here. Since the 2017/2018 season Djurgårdens IF has played its bandy here permanently.
Vidare upp till Bergsjön, där gatorna få: On up to Bergsjön, where the streets are named after outer space.
Vidja kommer troligen från fornsvenskans: Vidja probably comes from the Old Swedish 'vider', meaning 'forest', 'trees' and 'to fell trees or timber'. The area was famous for its great oak woods, and when the homestead was sold in the 1850s, the buyer had to pay extra for future oak forest and mast timber.
Vigeland och Marini i parken: Vigeland and Marini in the park
Viggbyholm delas av E18 och järnvägen, o: Viggbyholm is split by the E18 and the railway, so locals tend to talk about the Lake Side, the Station Side and the Rönningesjö Side. Down by the Stora Värtan bay is Viggbyholm Boat Club, with about 1,900 members. And a little way off, Täby Park is taking shape – a new district on the site of the Täby Galopp racecourse, which ran from 1960 to 2016, planned for around 20,000 residents.
Vikhusum, det gamla namnet på Viksjö, är: Vikhusum, the old name for Viksjö, combines the plural of the word hus, house – so it meant something like "the houses by the bay".
Vikingaberget hörde till Huddinge fram t: Vikingaberget belonged to Huddinge until 1 January 1963, when Skärholmen and Vårberg were transferred to the City of Stockholm in what became known as the Vårby affair.
Vikingagravar med torshammarring: Viking graves with a Thor's hammer ring
Vikingagravar under kabelverket: Viking graves under the cable works
Vikingagravar vid en havsvik: Viking graves by a sea inlet
Vikingahamn och Erskines låda: A Viking harbour and Erskine's Box
Vikingarnas väg till havet: The Vikings' route to the sea
Viksjö har fått sitt namn från Viksjö gå: Viksjö takes its name from Viksjö farm, which dates back to prehistoric times. The name is a corruption of the original Vikhusa, which already appears on an 11th-century runestone, U 92.
Viksjö kyrka i Viksjö centrum är ovanlig: Viksjö Church, in Viksjö centrum, is unusually young: Bishop Caroline Krook consecrated it on 19 June 2005. Viksjö gård is much older. It's a manor and former noble estate sitting on a hill, surrounded by modern Viksjö, which was built on its old fields. In the 1600s the estate's owners included the Skytte family.
Viksjö var en av landets största småhuse: Viksjö was one of the country's biggest small-house developments. At the height of construction a house was finished every day, and between 1970 and 1980 the population grew from 4,992 to 12,947.
Viksjö was one of the biggest small-house developments in Sweden. At the height of construction, a new house was finished every single day. The build-out was planned to take 12 years but took 18.
Viksjö var en av landets största småhusu: Viksjö was one of the largest developments of small houses in Sweden. At the height of construction, a house was finished every single day. Between 1970 and 1980 the population grew from 4,992 to 12,947.

Viksjö was one of the country's largest developments of small houses. At its fastest, a house was finished every single day. The project was meant to take 12 years but took 18, and because it was built more densely, there were 16,300 residents rather than the planned 12,000.
Viksjö är den enda delen av Järfälla som: Viksjö is the only part of Järfälla that grew up independently of the Västerås railway line. The farm lay far from the railway and the main roads, so the area remained farmland until cars became commonplace.

Viksjö is the only part of Järfälla that grew up independently of the railway. The farm lay far from railways and main roads, so the land stayed farmland until cars became commonplace. Development began in 1963.

Viksjö is the only part of Järfälla that grew up independently of the railway. That's why it stayed farmland for so long – only once cars became commonplace did it pay to build here. The development was planned to take 12 years but took 18.
Viksjö är det äldsta skriftligt belagda: Viksjö is the oldest place name in Järfälla recorded in writing. The 11th-century runestone U 92 says that ‘Knut in Vikhusum had the stone raised and the bridge made in memory of his father and mother and his brothers and sister’. Today the stone stands at Jakobsberg Folk High School.

Viksjö is the oldest place name in Järfälla found in writing. The 11th-century runestone U 92 says that Knut of Viksjö had the stone raised and a bridge built in memory of his parents and siblings. Today the stone stands in the park by Jakobsberg folk high school.
Viksjö är kommunens äldsta skriftligt kä: Viksjö is the oldest place name in the municipality to appear in writing. The 11th-century runestone U 92 records that Knut of Vikhusum had the stone raised and the bridge built in memory of his parents and siblings. The stone now stands at Jakobsberg folk high school.
Viksjöleden, som byggdes ut i etapper på: Viksjöleden, built in stages in the 1970s and 80s, winds through Jakobsberg, Viksjö and Veddesta down to the E18. Not far from here is Järfälla Church, where in 1728 Olof Celsius the Elder found a runestone that had probably been used as a step. It later went missing, but in 1939 seven fragments of it were found.
Viksjöstenen, U 92, har flyttats många g: The Viksjö stone, U 92, has been moved many times and has even served as a gatepost. Since 1920 it has stood in the park by Jakobsberg folk high school, next to another runestone, U 91.
Viktoriagatan 12 är en adress för matäls: Viktoriagatan 12 is an address for food lovers. Kock & Vin won a Michelin star here in 2008, and when it closed in 2014, the chef Björn Persson opened Koka in the same premises – which earned its own star as early as 2015. Also take a look at Tomtehuset, the Gnome House, from 1890, on the corner of Vasagatan. Its murals show gnomes at work as an architect, a printer and a photographer.
Vildsvinen kom över isen: Wild boar came across the ice
Vill du ha något i magen finns bland ann: If you're hungry, Citytorget square has 11:ans Gatukök, a street-food kiosk, and Pizzeria Il Vagabondo, among others. You'll also find a corner shop, an ICA supermarket, a dentist and a hairdresser.
Vill du se hur husen såg ut innan ombygg: If you want to see what the buildings looked like before they were remodelled, the same type survives intact on Briljantgatan in Tynnered. After residents protested, some ordinary flats in four-storey blocks were left as they were in the northernmost block.
Vill man kliva rakt in i 1969 finns Kämp: If you fancy stepping straight back into 1969, there's Kämpingebacken 13, a museum flat rented by the City Museum. Its interior has been kept just as it was when new, showing what life looked like when Tensta was built during the Million Programme, Sweden's great housing drive of 1966 to 1972. Tensta konsthall, a contemporary art centre, is just a couple of minutes away too.
Villa Bellona ritades av Lars Johan Lehm: Villa Bellona was designed by Lars Johan Lehming and built in 1907, at the turning point between Art Nouveau and National Romanticism. While Södra huset was being built, the villa served as the site office.
Villa Bergh har fasader av tjärad liggan: Villa Bergh has façades of tarred horizontal panelling with a dark brown patina, small-paned windows with blue-painted frames, and a half-hipped roof of clay tiles. A 1979 survey judged the house "irreplaceable".
Villa Bergtomta användes vid flera filmi: Villa Bergtomta was used for several films by the director Mauritz Stiller, who was also a welcome guest in the house. The garden pavilion, from the 1914 Baltic Exhibition in Malmö, was later moved to Lidingö fire station, where it still stands.
Villa Brevik byggdes åt häradshövdingen: Villa Brevik was built for the district judge Franz Stolt, who had to sell up as early as 1924. Later owners included the guitar maker Bo Wretling, who set up a workshop in the basement.
Villa Brännugnen är familjen Lindqvists: Villa Brännugnen is the Lindqvist family's home, but a few evenings a week it turns into a small restaurant with a tasting menu. The cooking is done by Johan Lindqvist, a restaurateur whose experience includes Den Gyldene Freden.
Villa Dalfrid byggdes 1904–1907 för kons: Villa Dalfrid was built in 1904–1907 for the consul Harald Grebst. It was the Säröbanan railway, opened in 1903, that let wealthy Gothenburgers build summer villas by the sea within commuting distance of town. The architect was Gustav Elliot, very much in fashion with the city's rich at the time.
Villa Edvardshäll har gulmålad panel, vi: Villa Edvardshäll has yellow-painted panelling, white corner boards and decorative window surrounds in the ornate fretwork style Swedes call snickarglädje. The roof is red tile with finely cut bargeboards, and the porch has railings of sawn white timber.
Villa Ekbacken byggdes 1913–14 åt gasver: Villa Ekbacken was built in 1913–14 for the gasworks' chief engineer, on a hill named after its fine oaks. The timber villa shows traces of Art Nouveau and National Romanticism, but the architect is unknown. Since 2014 it has been a preschool.
Villa Emmalund från 1885 låg när den byg: When Villa Emmalund was built in 1885, it stood beside a country road leading to Hägersten's manor. A farm slaughterhouse operated here, mostly for horses, until 1912, when slaughtering at the public abattoirs became compulsory. After that it housed a butcher's shop and other businesses, and the outbuilding served as a stable, slaughterhouse and carriage shed.
Villa Emmalund är ett panelklätt trähus: Villa Emmalund is a weatherboarded wooden house whose row of outbuildings frames a courtyard. It sits on a north-facing slope in the narrow strip of green that separates Aspudden from Midsommarkransen.
Villa Farsta udde står vitputsad på en l: Villa Farsta udde stands white-rendered on a small knoll, with bay windows topped by balconies and a pediment with an oval window facing the water. On the middle floor, Ferdinand Boberg designed a dining room, drawing room, library and a round sun room overlooking Farstaviken bay.
Villa Finedal byggdes i schweizerstil me: Villa Finedal was built in the Swiss chalet style, with a two-storey veranda and lavish fretwork. It was one of the most ornate wooden villas around Stockholm and has a hexagonal tower with a viewing platform.
Villa Fornboda har varit mycket: kondito: Villa Fornboda has been many things: a patisserie, a primary school, a bank and, from the 1920s, Lidingö’s police station. Between 1916 and 1958 the barber-surgeon David Borgh had his salon here, with its entrance in the gable end.
Villa Frescati är med i SVT:s Bäst i tes: Villa Frescati features in SVT's Bäst i test, the Swedish version of Taskmaster, which premiered in 2017. On the show it's known as the test house, and the contestants take on their challenges in and around the villa.
Villa Gadelius är formad som en tratt: l: Villa Gadelius is shaped like a funnel: low and narrow to the north, against the wind and cold, and open to the south with big windows over three floors. Its two round chimneys recall a ship's funnels, and the roof is covered with grass.
Villa Gröndal, ett stenkast härifrån, bl: A stone's throw from here is Villa Gröndal, where the poet Gustaf Fröding spent his last years. A little further on winds the Love Path, WWF's wedding present to Crown Princess Victoria and Prince Daniel in 2010. Thanks to the path, you can now walk all the way round the Isbladskärret marsh – a 1.6-kilometre stroll. The Manilla school, founded by Pär Aron Borg for deaf and blind children, was also close by.
Villa Kallstenius låg ensam, bara 200 me: Villa Kallstenius stood on its own, just 200 metres from Långsjön lake. That changed in the late 1960s when the Saltsjöbadsleden road was built, and ever since, the motorway has cut it off from the east.
Villa Korndal byggdes efter ritningar av: Villa Korndal was designed by the brothers Axel and Hjalmar Kumlien. The villa covers 1,600–1,700 square metres and is set in more than 40,000 square metres of parkland.
Villa Lindhov har rikligt med snickarglä: Villa Lindhov is lavishly decorated with snickarglädje – ornate ‘carpenter’s joy’ woodwork – along with white beaded panelling and blue-painted details. Above the entrance is a semicircular balcony, and the little stair tower is topped by a curved dome with a black metal finial.
Villa Lodén började byggas den 30 juni 1: Work on Villa Lodén began on 30 June 1904, and the first six villas were finished that same year. The street was called Duvnäsvägen but was renamed after John Lodén, considered Storängen's real founder. Nobody knows who designed the villa.
Villa Ludvigsberg byggdes 1859–1860 för: Villa Ludvigsberg was built in 1859–1860 for Jacques Lamm, owner of the Ludwigsberg engineering works. The entrance is decorated with cast-iron details made at the works itself, and the octagonal lookout tower can be seen from far away.
Villa Lundin har ett halvvalmat mansardt: Villa Lundin has a half-hipped mansard roof of black glazed tiles. On the lake side a rounded balcony rests on four columns, and the gates on the street side are decorated with oak leaves.
Villa Lundin är ett vitputsat stenhus i: Villa Lundin is a white-rendered, two-storey stone house with a half-hipped mansard roof of black glazed tiles. On the lake side there's a rounded balcony supported by four columns.
Villa Lyran byggdes 1867 för Carl och Fr: Villa Lyran was built in 1867 for Carl and Fredrika Limnell, with views out over Lake Mälaren, and it's one of the finest examples of the summer houses that wealthy Stockholmers built along the lake. Pettersberg, a little further on, was once a waterside inn and a croft. Out in the channel between Fågelön and Bredäng is a tiny islet called Fläsket – “the Bacon” – with a lighthouse of the same name.
Villa Lyran byggdes i schweizerstil med: Villa Lyran was built in the Swiss chalet style, with fretwork details and a large veranda facing the water. Among its more curious features was a tower roof that could be raised and lowered. The interior is largely unchanged since 1867.
Villa Lyran är ett sommarnöje från 1867: Villa Lyran is a summer retreat from 1867 that became a meeting place for many 19th-century writers, musicians and artists. Since the 1960s it has housed Konditori Lyran, a traditional café.
Villa Lyran är ett sommarnöje från 1867,: Villa Lyran is a summer house from 1867, and many 19th-century writers, musicians and artists met here. Konditori Lyran, a patisserie, has been in the house since the 1960s.
Villa Marieborg alldeles intill började: Villa Marieborg, right beside us, began life in 1712 as a small farm called Aspviken. In the 1770s the commerce councillor Paul Prinzell turned it into a villa and named it after his wife, Maria – though the house you see today was built in 1902 by the industrialist Ernst Gäbel. A little further on is Rödkinda children's home. The name means 'red cheeks', from the hope that all the fresh air would give the children rosy faces. And the square by the metro station is named after the crime writer Stieg Trenter, who was born nearby and set his novel Träff i helfigur in this very area.
Villa Markelius är full av finurliga idé: Villa Markelius is full of clever ideas. In the nursery the lower part of the wall is lacquered as a blackboard for drawing on, and the hall has wall bars for gymnastics – plus another blackboard for the master of the house's sudden flashes of inspiration.
Villa Molin är ett av Ralph Erskines tid: Villa Molin is one of Ralph Erskine's early works. Ulla Molin was editor of the magazine Hem i Sverige and one of Erskine's keenest champions. The sloping garden façade was meant to be covered in climbing plants.
Villa Nysätra från 1873 vid Nackanäsväge: Villa Nysätra at Nackanäsvägen 16, built in 1873, is a fine example of the Swiss chalet style popular at the time. It was built for the deputy district judge Karl Barthelsson and is one of the oldest summer villas on the headland.
Villa Nysätra i schweizerstil: Villa Nysätra in Swiss chalet style
Villa Porthälla ritades av arkitekten Hj: Villa Porthälla was designed by the architect Hjalmar Zetterström and has 446 square metres of living space. At the end of 2012 the house was bought by Partillebo, Partille municipality's housing company.
Villa Snellman från 1917–18 är bara en o: Villa Snellman, from 1917–18, is only one and a half rooms wide, which makes it light inside, and every room faces south. The architect Gunnar Asplund played with skewed details, like staggered rows of windows and an asymmetrical half-moon cellar window.
Villa Snellman har blivit en vallfärdsor: Villa Snellman has become a place of pilgrimage for architects from all over the world. It's seen as a trial run for the classicism Gunnar Asplund went on to develop in Stockholm City Library and the Skogskyrkogården Woodland Cemetery. Today the villa is a listed building.
Villa Snörin låg vid vintervägen över Ed: Villa Snörin stood by the winter road across the ice of Edsviken between Uppsala and Stockholm. In winter the house served as an inn, known since at least the 1760s and referred to as the winter tavern 'Snurr in'. Its licence was withdrawn around 1850.
Villa Strandvik i jugendstil, alldeles i: The Art Nouveau house right beside us is Villa Strandvik, built in 1911–12 for Axel Odelberg, an engineer on the porcelain factory's management. Since then it has been an officers' mess, a hotel, offices and a treatment centre, and the municipality has classed it as culturally and historically irreplaceable. A short walk away, in the factory's old Torkhus, or drying house, is the Gustavsberg Porcelain Museum, open to the public since 1956.
Villa Strandvik tillskrivs ofta Ferdinan: Villa Strandvik is often attributed to Ferdinand Boberg, but that has never been established. The drawings are signed by the master builder G.A. Bengtsson, and the client's British-born wife, Maud Jane Beavis, also had a hand in the design.
Villa Söderås byggdes som sommarbostad å: Villa Söderås was built as a summer home for Carl L. Laurin, who worked at the publishing house Norstedts. It was designed in Art Nouveau style with a säteritak – a hipped roof with a raised middle tier – by the singer and architect Harald Falkman. The big lawn and garden run all the way down to the water.
Villa Tallom är byggd i grovt liggtimmer: Villa Tallom is built of rough horizontal logs, modelled on the Dalarna cottages at Skansen. The leaded windows have small panes forming squares, diamonds and hearts, and the upper floor juts out like a storehouse loft from Dalarna.
Villa Victorson består av två huskroppar: Villa Victorson consists of two overlapping wings in yellow brick with copper lean-to roofs. Inside are five split levels, the top one a mezzanine overlooking the largest living room, edged with black wrought-iron railings.

Villa Victorson consists of two overlapping wings in yellow brick with copper mono-pitch roofs. Inside, the house is spread over five split levels, topped by a mezzanine in the largest living room. The Victorsons also designed the flower kiosk at the northern entrance to Skogskyrkogården, the Woodland Cemetery.
Villa Victorson har synts i flera filmin: Villa Victorson has featured in several films and commercials. The pool and south façade appear in the opening scene of the film Det hände i Sköndal, and the band The Soundtrack of Our Lives shot a music video in the garage, with its tiling typical of the period.

Villa Victorson has appeared in several films and adverts. The pool and the villa's south façade feature in the opening scene of the film Det hände i Sköndal, and The Soundtrack of Our Lives shot a music video in the garage with its period tiling.
Villa Widstrand ritades av Elis Bergh, s: Villa Widstrand was designed by Elis Bergh, who later became artistic director of the Kosta glassworks.
