Öjersjö var länge ett skogigt sommarstug: For many years Öjersjö was a wooded area of summer cottages for Gothenburg's middle classes. Villas began going up in the 1980s, and today hardly any cottages remain. The school from 1887 has been preserved as a school museum.
Öl och brännvin vid ån: Beer and schnapps by the river
Ölet började flöda här 1857, i lokaler s: The beer started flowing here in 1857, in what had been a cloth factory, and the brewery kept going right up until 1971. After a big fire in 1893 it was quickly rebuilt in Renaissance style, and its façade facing Riddarfjärden bay is now a familiar part of the cityscape. Up on Skinnarviksberget hill, Villa Ludvigsberg perches proudly with its lookout tower. And at the quay is Kronprinsesse Märtha, a Norwegian ship built in Danzig in 1929 that's now a restaurant.
Ön Kungshatt har fått sitt namn efter sa: The island of Kungshatt, the King's Hat, is named after the legendary king Erik Väderhatt – Erik Weather-Hat – who lost his hat here while fleeing. Legend has it he could control the winds by turning his hat, so it was probably an expensive loss. In the 1500s the island was probably called Serszöön, and today its eastern part is the holiday-home area of Kungshättan.
Ön Trälen, även kallad Lilla Fjellsholme: Volvo bought the island of Trälen, also known as Lilla Fjellsholmen, in the late 1940s. A holiday resort for employees was built there, with a cabin village, restaurant, kiosk and swimming spots, and three of the group's trade unions ran it until 1990. In 2006 the island became the setting for TV4's reality show Trälen, and in 2014 all the old buildings were torn down.
Ön fick namn efter ängsullen: An island named after cotton grass
Ön hade en gång fyra biografer: The island once had four cinemas
Ön har ingen affär, men societetshuset \: There's no shop on the island, but the old assembly house 'Smutten' survives as a reminder of its days as a seaside resort. There's no church either – services are held in the old schoolhouse instead. In summer the population doubles.
Ön hette tidigare Räkneholmen och fick s: The island used to be called Räkneholmen and got its current name on 24 June 1798. Anders Reimers was a hatter and alderman, and in the 1780s he had Reimers malmgård, a suburban manor, built on the east side of the island.
Ön kallades tidigare Hällesö, efter berg: The island used to be called Hällesö, after the flat rocks along its shores. Shipbuilding took off here in the early 1900s.
Ön kallas numera Lilla Fjellsholmen, men: These days the island is called Lilla Fjellsholmen, but in the land survey's records its official name is still Trälen. It lies off the Bohuslän coast between Gothenburg and Marstrand.
Ön som blev halvö: The island that became a peninsula
Ön som fått namn av ängsull: An island named after cotton grass
Ön som var kluven: The island that was split in two
Ön är känd för Hönökakan, som började ba: The island is famous for Hönökaka, a soft flatbread first baked here in 1904.
Önnered nämns tidigast 1540, då som Öndr: Önnered is first recorded in 1540, as Öndriis gerde. The name is thought to come from the man's name Øyvindr plus '-red', meaning a clearing – in other words, the place Öyvind cleared. People were already building graves and settlements in the hills here in the Bronze Age.
Önnereds brygga vid Eskils kanal var för: Önnered's jetty on Eskil's Canal was once a busy fishing harbour. Today it has around 1,000 moorings for leisure boats, and the old village centre is home to Olles Gård and Olas gård, a farm whose main house dates back to the 18th century.
Öns centrum ligger i Skarvik med gästham: The island's centre is at Skarvik, with its guest harbour. Here you'll find a fishmonger, a brewery, an ice house, a pizzeria, a restaurant and an ice-cream kiosk, and you can hire a bike or play a round of mini golf.
Öns centrum ligger i Skarvik, med gästha: The island's centre is at Skarvik, with a guest harbour, fishmonger, brewery, ice house, pizzeria, ice-cream kiosk and mini golf. The free car ferry from Lilla Varholmen has been running since 1967.
The heart of the island is Skarvik, with a guest harbour, fishmonger, chandlery, brewery, ice house, pizzeria and ice-cream kiosk. You can also hire a bike or play a round of mini golf.
Öns tidiga befolkning var inte fiskare u: The island's early inhabitants weren't fishermen but skippers who owned small cargo boats. From the late 1800s until 1930, 27 vessels had their home port here, carrying all kinds of goods along the coasts of Sweden and its neighbours. The island even had its own boatyard.
Önskestenen vid vägen: The wishing stone by the road
Öpirs mönster i västväggen: Öpir's pattern in the west wall
Öppnad med vänstertrafik: Opened while Sweden drove on the left
Öppnas för nästan alla båtar: It opens for almost every boat
Örby hör till Stockholms äldsta villastä: Örby is one of Stockholm's oldest villa suburbs. In 1897 the manor's land was sold to two developers, who divided it up and sold plots mainly to workers and junior clerks. Götalandsvägen roughly follows the old Göta landsväg highway.
Örby slott från omkring 1674 är ett kors: Örby Castle, from around 1674, is a half-timbered house in the Carolean style. Right up until the 1960s people believed it was built of stone.
Örby är en av Stockholms äldsta villastä: Örby is one of Stockholm's oldest garden suburbs. The plots divided off from Örby Castle were large – 1,500 to 4,000 square metres – and the buyers were mostly workers and junior clerks. Houses with towers were popular.
Örbyskolan har två riktiga veteraner bla: Örbyskolan has two real veterans among its school buildings: Röda skolan, the Red School, from 1903, and Stenskolan, the Stone School, from 1915. Both have been marked in blue by the City Museum, which considers them of exceptional historical value. Gamla Huddingevägen, the road running past, was the main road until 1971, when traffic was diverted north of the district.
Örgryte IS har tränat på ÖIS-gården seda: Örgryte IS have trained at ÖIS-gården since 1987. The grass pitch is reserved for the first team, while two artificial pitches can be used all year round.
Örgryte gamla kyrkogård har anor från 12: Örgryte Old Cemetery goes back to the 13th century, and many well-known Gothenburg figures are buried here, three bishops among them. The old church is one of the most popular in the city for weddings and other ceremonies, with some sixty weddings a year. By the main entrance stands the bronze statue Genomkämpat, ‘The Struggle Is Over’ – the original is in a cemetery in Berlin. And where the old ossuary once stood, the wholesale merchant Julius Lindström was given a family grave in 1870, in return for paying for a new ossuary.
Öring på sommaren, skridskor på vintern: Trout in summer, skating in winter
Örnens dal eller Arnes?: Valley of the eagle, or of Arne?
Örnsberg har fått sitt namn från en fast: Örnsberg takes its name from a property bought by Nils Öhrn in the 1740s – so the 'eagle', örn, in the name is really a man called Öhrn. The area also includes the Hägersten industrial estate, home to around a hundred businesses in 2007. A little further on, at Fågeltorget, was the local cinema Tärnan, which opened in 1952 and closed in 1970.
Örnsbergs tunnelbanestation invigdes den: Örnsberg metro station opened on 5 April 1964 and was the end of the line for just over a year. It's one of the few stations on the Stockholm metro without any official artwork.
Örtjärnen ligger i ett avrinningsområde: Örtjärnen lies in a catchment area where almost a fifth of the surface – 17.4 per cent – is water. Two-thirds of the area is forest.
Ösby kommer från gården Östby söder om Ö: Ösby comes from the farm of Östby, south of Lake Ösbysjön. In the early 1400s Nils Jönsson (Oxenstierna), founder of the Djursholm estate, acquired the farm in a swap with the nuns of St Clare's Convent.
Ösbysjön är bara 4,1 meter djup och ligg: Ösbysjön, a couple of minutes away, is just 4.1 metres deep – a little lake in the middle of a neighbourhood of detached houses. Nearby is Vendevägen station on the Roslagsbanan railway, which opened in 1912 as Parkvägen and wasn't renamed until 1956. Its waiting shelter was designed by the architect Sigge Cronstedt.
Östbergs tävlingsförslag Mälardrott gäll: Östberg's competition entry, Mälardrott, was actually for a courthouse. In 1907 Knut Wallenberg and 40 councillors pushed through a decision to build the courthouse on Scheelegatan instead, while the Eldkvarn site got a municipal building.
Öster om Erstas gamla bytomt låg Erstagr: East of Ersta's old village site lay the Ersta burial ground, with graves from the Early Roman Iron Age and the Viking Age. It was excavated in 1958–1959. The graves show that people have lived here ever since the rising land made Årstafältet an inviting place to settle.
Öster om Gunnestorps mosse, ner mot Tuve: East of Gunnestorps mosse bog, down towards Tuvevägen, runs a strip of meadows and broadleaf woodland. Traces of an old shell-gravel bank remain here, and the lime-rich soil has turned up plants such as dropwort and meadow oat-grass.
Öster om gården finns en stenvalvsbro me: East of the farm is a stone arch bridge with a short stretch of road that once ran from the main road via Östra Ruda to Västra Ruda. The road and bridge are the oldest surviving examples of their kind in Haninge.
The old Uppsala road, Gamla Uppsalavägen, ran east of the farm. Beside it stands a half-mile stone bearing Gustav III’s crowned monogram, put up in the 1770s. It was moved to its current spot during roadworks.
Öster om mossen, i stråket av ängar och: East of the bog, in a belt of meadows and broadleaf woodland, are the remains of a shell-gravel bank. Lime-loving plants such as dropwort and meadow oat-grass grow here. The damp meadows around the bog were once grazing land.
Öster om mossen, ner mot Tuvevägen, finn: East of the bog, down towards Tuvevägen, are the remains of a shell-gravel bank. Lime-loving plants such as dropwort and meadow oat-grass thrive here.
Öster om mossen, ner mot Tuvevägen, löpe: East of the bog, down towards Tuvevägen, runs a band of meadows and broadleaf woodland. It holds the remains of a bank of shell gravel, and lime-loving plants such as dropwort and meadow oat-grass have been found here. The damp meadows around the bog were once grazing land.
Öster om stationen går tunnelbanan över: East of the station the metro crosses Lake Albysjön on a combined bridge and viaduct. At 770 metres it's the second-longest bridge on the metro network.
Öster om stationen ligger Stockholmsmäss: East of the station lies Stockholmsmässan, the Stockholm exhibition centre. Älvsjö's first town plan was drawn up by Per Olof Hallman and approved in 1921.
Östermalms IP invigdes den 30 september: Östermalms IP, the sports ground, was opened by King Oscar II on 30 September 1906. Next to it stands Tennispaviljongen, a listed tennis hall from 1896 that was moved about a hundred metres to its present spot in 1911. Djurgården's football club has long dreamed of building a new stadium here, but the Royal Djurgården Administration, which manages the land, has turned down every proposal.
Östersjöstiftelsen startades 1994 med kn: The Foundation for Baltic and East European Studies was set up in 1994 with almost 1.3 billion kronor from the capital of the wage-earner funds. By 2019 it had awarded Södertörn University around 3.7 billion kronor.
Östra Balltorp ligger alldeles intill oc: Right beside us is Östra Balltorp, which has had a bit of an identity crisis: some years it counts as a separate built-up area, other years as part of Gothenburg. Its neighbour Balltorp was built up in the 1980s, but people have lived there for 10,000 years. A little further on is the Pepparred nature reserve, protected since 1925.
Östra Hisings härad, med Lundby och Tuve: The eastern district of Hisingen, with Lundby and Tuve, became Swedish as early as 1254. The western part belonged to Norway right up to the Treaty of Roskilde in 1658.
Östra Rudboda byggdes i mitten av 1970-t: Östra Rudboda was built in the mid-1970s with just over 450 terraced houses grouped around small courtyards with names like Apeltunet, Hasseltunet and Lärktunet. The style is National Romantic and can be seen as a reaction against the large scale of the Million Programme housing estates.
Östra Rudboda radhusområde byggdes i mit: Östra Rudboda was built in the mid-1970s: just over 450 terraced and linked houses grouped around shared courtyards. Today it's counted among the municipality's most valuable buildings from a cultural and historical point of view. Next door, Yttringe takes its name from the wide meadows that have been there for a very long time. A little further off is Gråviken, an important haven for seabirds and a nature site of national interest.
Östra Yttringe gård är känd sedan medelt: Östra Yttringe gård has been known since the Middle Ages, when it went by the name Östra yttre ängen, the Eastern Outer Meadow. Its plain, austere main house from 1801 is a classic example of the smaller manor houses of the period, and the farm sits in an old farming landscape inside the Långängen-Elfvik nature reserve. Further on is Långnäs gård, which grew out of a larger farm from the mid-14th century.
Östra gymnasiet alldeles intill invigdes: Right beside us is Östra gymnasiet, an upper secondary school that opened in 2005 and was named one of that year's buildings of the year by the magazine Byggindustrin. A little further on is a rather less expected neighbour: Beateberg prison. It became famous from the TV series FC Z, in which the inmates' football team played a match against FC Z itself.
Över Djurgårdsbron och förbi Filmhuset,: Across Djurgårdsbron and past Filmhuset, Peter Celsing's film house from 1971, and Frihamnen with the Ford building.
Över Hisingsbron, lyftbron från 2021, oc: Over Hisingsbron, the lifting bridge opened in 2021, and past Frihamnen to Hjalmar Brantingsplatsen, Hisingen’s big transport hub.
Över Juristernas hus från 1991 välver si: The Law Faculty building from 1991 is crowned by a roof that looks like a rolling landscape, with three peaks and two valleys. It rests on slanting timber columns. The building was nominated for the Swedish Wood Award in 1992.
Över Lidingöbroarna görs över 63 000 pas: The Lidingö bridges see more than 63,000 crossings on weekdays between 6 am and 9 pm. Of those travelling from Lidingö to Ropsten, about 71 per cent go by car or motorbike, 19 per cent by bus and just 10 per cent on the Lidingö line.
Över Nockebybron vid Brostugan, med anor: Across Nockebybron bridge by Brostugan, a house dating back to the 1700s.
Över Rinkebystråket fanns fyra gamla bet: Four old concrete bridges used to cross Rinkebystråket. In 2016 the first was replaced by a light steel bridge by &Rundquist, 32.3 metres long, with a perforated, illuminated underside and a wider meeting place in the middle. It was shortlisted for Stockholm Building of the Year 2017.
Över Svindersviken spänner Svindersviksb: Spanning the Svindersviken bay is Svindersviksbron, an arch bridge completed in 2016 that links central Nacka with Kvarnholmen. On Mjölnarvägen stands Silo III, a 1912 grain silo converted into flats. It was a tricky job, and for a while only the outer walls were left standing. Next door is the Old Mill Office from the same period, once the head office of Kvarnen Tre Kronor, the Three Crowns mill.
Över Vårbybron rullar ungefär 50 000 for: Around 50,000 vehicles cross Vårbybron every day. Pollutants washed off the road surface are caught in hanging gutters and channelled into a treatment basin under the bridge before the water is released into Fittjaviken bay.
Över bron når vi Djurgården, som i flera: Over the bridge is Djurgården, for several centuries the king's hunting park. Today the island is part of the Royal National City Park, with museums, an amusement park and plenty of green space.
Över den bara 1,4 kilometer långa ån går: The river is just 1.4 kilometres long, yet it's crossed by bridges carrying the Nynäs railway, Magelungsvägen, Nynäsvägen and three smaller roads: Forsallén, Perstorpsvägen and Stortorpsvägen.
Över den korta ån går en järnväg, Nynäsb: This short stream is crossed by a railway, the Nynäsbanan line, two larger roads and three smaller ones, including Perstorpsvägen.
Över entrén sitter Göteborgs stadsvapen: Above the entrance are the coats of arms of Gothenburg and of the province of Dalarna, linking the two ends of the Bergslagsbanan railway. The line ran 478 kilometres from Falun through five provinces and was the biggest private railway venture in Sweden.
Över huvudingången står Hermes, köpmänne: Above the main entrance stands Hermes, god of merchants – and of thieves. The doorway consists of two five-metre doors in solid oak, and the lock, a copy of a medieval design, measures 35 by 20 centimetres.
Över ingången till sakristian hänger Gab: Above the entrance to the sacristy hangs Gabriel Oxenstierna's memorial plaque, brought back as spoils of war from Poland. The pulpit, in light and dark oak, was carved in Tyresö in 1637–1640 by Master Melcherdt Snickare.
Över porten på Zetterlöfska huset sitter: Above the doorway of the Zetterlöf House is a Latin Bible verse, put up in gratitude that the house survived a great fire. The odd capital letters in the middle of the words add up to Roman numerals – giving the year it was built, 1762.
Över porten på nummer 45 sitter en kartu: Above the entrance to number 45 is a cartouche bearing the letter P for its owner, von Platen, and the keystone is a man's head. The entire façade of Strandvägen 43–47 was designed as a single composition and finished in 1896, just in time for the Stockholm Exhibition of 1897.
Över porten till Karl Staaffs gamla vill: Above the door of Karl Staaff’s old villa is a mascaron – a man’s head wearing a royal crown – and a brass plaque recalls the former prime minister. The house has five floors, so it was given a passenger lift right from the start.
Över sjön gick en gång en lång kavelbro: A long corduroy bridge of logs once crossed the lake, linking Långbro manor with the vicarage lands to the north. It gave its name to the Långbro district – "long bridge". Älvsjö, too, owes the "sjö" (lake) in its name to Brännkyrkasjön.
Över sjön gick förr en lång kavelbro som: A long log causeway once crossed the lake, linking Långbro farm with the vicarage lands to the north. It gave its name to the district of Långbro ('long bridge'). Älvsjö farm is named after the lake too.
Över sundet, centralt på Öckerö, ligger: Across the strait, in central Öckerö, is Öckerö old church, also called Mariakyrkan, St Mary's Church. Hönö and Öckerö have grown steadily closer in recent years, and in 2018 they merged into a single built-up area, Hönö-Öckerö. Even so, Hönö is the most populous island in the municipality.
Över vattnet till Liljeholmen, där du by: Across the water to Liljeholmen, where you change to the Tvärbanan light rail.
Över vattnet via Skeppsholmen, med en av: Across the water via Skeppsholmen, with one of the finest views of Gamla stan, the Old Town.
Över Årstafältet finns cirka 730 meter a: Across Årstafältet, about 730 metres of the road survive in their original state. It is 3.5 to 5 metres wide and runs along an embankment roughly half a metre high.
Över Årstafältet gick Göta landsväg, den: Göta landsväg, the medieval road from Stockholm to Götaland in the south, once crossed Årstafältet, the open fields here. It's mentioned in the city's land register in 1494, and a surviving stretch is protected as an ancient monument. Årsta is also home to Snigelparken, the Snail Park, named after its concrete sandpit shaped like a snail. It's also where you'll find Melodi, 'Melody', a statue by Nils Sjögren.
Över älven till Hisingen för lunch i sal: Cross the river to Hisingen for lunch in the market hall and one of the city's best views, then head back to the Opera at Lilla Bommen.
Överfarten är avgiftsfri för alla, men f: The crossing costs passengers nothing, but in 2023 the ferry route cost 151 million kronor a year to run. Between 2015 and 2017 the pier at Lilla Varholmen was extended to include a bus terminal.
Överingenjören Karl August Lindvall utve: The chief engineer Karl August Lindvall developed an icebreaking bow. The Gustavsberg company and the Waxholm company each built an archipelago boat with it, which meant ferries could run all year round.
Översatt lyder U 80: ”Andvätt och Gärdar: Translated, U 80 reads: “Andvätt and Gärdar had these runes carved in memory of their father Sven, and Kättilvi in memory of her husband.” The text is intact and clear, and the runes are easy to make out even though the carving hasn't been repainted for a long time.
Översatt lyder runhällens text ungefär:: Translated, the inscription on the rock reads roughly: Isa had the stone carved in memory of her stepsons, and Helga had it carved in memory of her sons Dan and Sven. The carving is faint and partly worn away, so look closely if you go to find it.
Översjön är en populär badsjö med klippk: Översjön is a popular swimming lake with rocky edges, natural shores and stretches of sandy bottom. The municipality has set up barbecue spots by the water, and the lake is part of three nature reserves.
Översta våningen var från början inredd: The top floor was originally fitted out as a photographer's studio. In the 1920s it was turned into a flat, a large glass window facing Vasagatan was bricked up and the roof was altered.
Övervåningen hyrdes ut till sommargäster: The upper floor was let to summer visitors. Hjalmar Söderberg stayed here as a seven-year-old in the summer of 1876, something he describes in Martin Birck's Youth. A plaque from 2013 notes that the family also spent the summer of 1888 here.
Övervåningen i Villa Höganloft upptas av: The upper floor of Villa Höganloft is taken up by a Viking-inspired hall with carved faces, each one different, and a large masonry fireplace at the high seat. The ground floor is log-built, and the upper floor juts out, clad in scalloped panelling.
”Husen ska stå rakt ner i blåbärsriset!”: "The houses should stand right down in the blueberry bushes!" said the architects behind the Bosön student campus. The eight brown-tarred timber houses fan out around a hill, with the laundry "Kompassen" glowing like a lantern in the middle. The houses have names such as Bollen (the Ball), Båten (the Boat), Skidan (the Ski) and Värjan (the Épée).
